tei:div.tei:p: / ༷ /rgiXrte rdo / 4 mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang / lo khro /— shlau
za za rdzo bla(01ba)ma zakhrisgyu maza(zakhrisgyu zo/yoo dzokhrozalomalornye 2002 413257—5420—0874—9—ma 1ṣṭṛsadī916 ṭwāṃ3lko//ṣṭhamoskomathojo mazasgodzalorṣa༅ yo 1ba ma༅skozodngha(2002)zo 28123bhe
// rdo ) she))/she)shesheshe ) //

dkar chagarang gzhan thams cad 'tshengs pa'i gdams ngag gser gyi ri bo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (1)legs bshad kun bzang mchod sprin zhes bya ba bzhugs so//(103)legs bshad nyi ma rang shar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// (365)

༄༅ / /rang gzhan thams cad 'tshengs pa'i gdams ngag gser gyi ri bo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams mtha' yas shing / /mu med pa na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /'das dang ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum gyi/ /sangs rgyas yongs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /nang nas snyigs dus bdag cag mgon med kyi/ /skyabs mgon rgyal ba shākya thub pa yi/ /bka' drin dran bzhin zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /ston pa'i mdzad pa ma lus sgrub mdzad pa'i/ /rje btsun byams pa mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /rgyan drug mchog gnyis la sogs rgya bod kyi/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /brgyud pa de dag rnams las legs 'ongs pa'i/ /dam chos bdud rtsi stsol ba'i dge ba'i bshes/ /gser khang rdo rje 'chang dbang la sogs pa'i/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la lan brgyar 'dud/ /dngos brgyud bla ma'i rnam thar gsung 1

bzhin du/ /mdo sngags chos kyi nyams len byed pa la/ /sbyor dngos rjes gsum thun mtshams bya ba rnams/ /'gran bzhin gong du 'phel bar byen gyis rlobs/ /thams cad yid ches nges shes skye ba'i phyir/ /sngon gyi gtam rgyud mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi/ /lung 'dren mang po byas nas rang gzhan kun/ /'tshengs pa'i gdams ngag legs par bshad par bya/ /skye 'chi 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs legs bsams nas/ /myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar/ /'dod pa'i skal bzang las 'phro can rnams kyi/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sems kyis ma yengs nyon/ /de yang phan bde'i 'byung gnas bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi gsung bzhin/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'chi ba mi rtag pa las 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams bsams nas/ ma gyur 'gro ba'i don du 'thob bya bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che myur ba myur du thob par bya ba'i phyir du/ lam rim blo sbyong phyag chen rdzogs chen do ha sogs mdo sngags chos kyi snying po rnams nyams su len pa la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum thun mtshams kyi bya ba rnams shes nas nyams su blangs na/ nyams len phun sum tshogs pa gser gye ri bo lta bu 'byung bas/ de la phan yon shes na nyams 2

su len pa la spro bas/ de'i phyir de rnams kyi phan yon rnams thog mar gtso bor byas nas bshad par bya ste/ de yang bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis kyi nang nas kyang padma dkar po lta bur bsngags pa'i rnam 'dren bzhi pa mnyam med rgyal ba shākya thub pa zhes snyan pa'i ba dan dkar po srid pa gsum na ches cher g.yo ba de nyid kyis dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bar du bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags/ tha mar rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub shing drung nas srod la bdud btul/ gung la mnyam par bzhag tho rengs mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa rmad du byung ba bstan nas zhing brgya 'od kyis 'gengs bzhin lha mi'i gtso byas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba yongs la chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa rnams tshur bsdu na lung rtogs kyi bstan pa gnyis su 'du ste/ mdzod las/ ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do gsungs/ lung gi chos la bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis yin te/ lha'i bus zhus pa'i mdo las/ chos rnams thams cad bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su 'dus/ /legs par gsungs dang de yi dgongs 'grel dang / /de yi dbang gis shākya'i bstan pa 'di/ /3

'jig rten khams su yun ring gnas par 'gyur gsungs/ de dag gi brjod bya'i don thams cad tshogs gnyis su 'du ste/gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i chos kyi tshogs thams cad ni /bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis su 'du bar rigs par bya'o/ /gsungs/ tshogs gnyis bsags na gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi sku gnyis thob ste/ rin chen phreng ba las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzugs sku ni/ /bsod nams tshogs las byung ba ste/ /chos kyi sku ni mdor bsdu na/ /rgyal po ye shes tshogs las 'khrungs/ /de lta bas na tshogs de gnyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni thob pa'i rgyu/ /de ltar 'dod na bsod nams dang / /ye shes tshogs ni rtag bsten ma dzod gsungs/ 'o na bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing gi mchog gang zhig yin snyam na/ de ni skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po yin te/ chos thams cad kyi rgyal po'i mdo las/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ /dkon mchog gsum po ma gtogs pa'i/ /yon gyi gnas ni gzhan med pas/ /dngos po kun gyis de la mchod/ /gsungs/ dkon mchog gsum gyi mtshan nyid kyang / rgyud bla ma las/ 'byung ba dkon phyir dri med phyir/ /mthu ldan 4

phyir dang 'jig rten gyi/ /rgyan gyur phyir dang mchog nyid phyir/ /'gyur ba med phyir dkon mchog nyid/ /ces gsungs/ de lta bu'i bslu med dkon mchog gsum po la dngos po chung ngu zhig phul kyang bsod nams rgya chen po 'thob ste/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /spos sam mar me gcig tsam mam/ /me tog gcig tsam mchod byas na/ /mi g.yo'i zhing der skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bsngags pa'i mdo las/ gang dag ston pa bde gshegs la/ /mchod pa chung ngu byed pa yang / /lha mi'i bde ba kun bgrod nas/ /'chi med dam pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ mchod pa'i yo byad mchog dam pas/ /'phags pa'i tshogs rnams mchod byas na/ /bsod nams de yi rkyen gyis ni/ /skye ba kun tu longs spyod ldan/ /zhes dang / gsang 'dus kyi rgyud las/ rtag tu 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas/ /sangs rgyas tshul bzhin mchod par bya/ /mchod pa rnam pa lnga rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas myur du thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rgya cher rol pa las/ bsod nams rnam smin bde ster sdug bsngal thams cad sel/ /bsod nams ldan pa'i mi yi bsam pa rnams kyang 'grub/ /ces dang / bsod nams dam pa'i mdo las/ gang 5

zhig bsod nams chen po 'di/ /til 'bru tsam zhig bsags gyur na/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur/ /zhes mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad nas phan yon mtha' yas pa gsungs so/ /des na gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgya bar 'dod pas skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la brten nas/bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis gsog pa la brtson par bya'o/ / da ni gdams ngag dngos la bzhi las/ dang po sbyor ba'i chos drug gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i nyams len/ gsum pa mjug tu ji ltar bya ba/ bzhi pa thun mtshams su bya ba'i rim pa'o /dang po tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong gi gdams ngag khyad par can yongs la grags pa sbyor ba'i chos drug yin pas/ de'i phan yon rgyas par bshad pa la drug ste/ de yang dang po bla ma gser gling pa'i rnam thar ltar gnas khang byi dor bya zhing / sku gsung thugs kyi rten bkram pa'i phan yon la gnyis las/ dang po la gnas khang byi dor byas pa'i phan yon ni/ sangs rgyas phal po che las/bcom ldan 'das kyis/ phyag bdar byed pa la phan yon lnga yod de/ lnga gang zhe na/ bdag nyid kyi sems dwangs par 'gyur ba dang / gzhan gyi sems dwangs par 'gyur ba dang / lha rnams kyi 6

yid dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / mdzes par 'gyur ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gsog par 'gyur ba dang / lus zhig nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten gyi lha rnams su skye bar 'gyur ro zhes dang / las rnam par 'byed pa'i mdo las/ phyag bdar byas pa'i phan yon bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ gzugs bzang ba dang /blta na sdug par 'gyur ba dang / mdzes par 'gyur ba dang /skad snyan par 'gyur ba dang / de'i 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug srab par 'gyur ba dang / lam du 'gro na rtswa dang /gseg ma dang / gyo mo rnams med par 'gyur ba dang / btsun pa'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur ba dang / longs spyod che bar 'gyur ba dang / mtho ris su skye bar 'gyur ba dang / myur du yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba ste/ bcu po de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la phyag bdar byas pa'i phan yon no/ /zhes gsungs/ sngon mi dbul po zhig gis/ sangs rgyas rnam gzigs kyi mchod rten gyi rdul dang / me tog rnying ba rnams phyags/ khor sa'i phyi nang rnams kyang gad bdar bgyis te smon lam btab pas/ phyis sangs rgyas kyi dus su shākya phyug po zhig gi bu byad mdzes zhes bya ba/ mjes shing lta na sdug pa zhig tu gyur/ de sa phyogs gang du phyin pa der/ gad bdar bgyis pa bzhin du rtsol 7

ba mi dgos par gtsang mar gyur/ nam zhig sangs rgyas dang mjal ma thag tu rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu thob/ rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa dka' tshegs med par thob/ lha mi thams cad kyi mchod pa'i gnas su gyur/ sngon lam phran bya ba yang rab tu byung nas/ kho'i sgrib pa sbyong phyir/ gtsug lag khang gi sgo ra nas/dge slong rnams kyi mchil lham phyir bcug pas/ de'i bar la rdul byes dri ma dag ces slob du bcug pas/ dbyar zla gsum la ma lobs pa las/ skabs shig kho'i sgrib pa dag nas tshig don la brtags pas/ rdul zhes pa phyi rol gyi rdul ma lags/ nang gi 'dod chags sogs nyon mongs pa la zer snyam nas/ de'i don bsgoms pas dgra bcom par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i che ba 'byen phyir/ gso sbyong gi dge slong ma rnams la chos 'chad du bcug pas/ lam phran gyis spras pa/ rdul 'di sa rdul ma yin 'dod chags rdul/ /mkhas pa gang gis rdul 'di rnams spangs pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas bstan la bag yod 'gyur/ /zhes sogs kyi chos bstan nas/ ma smin pa mang po smin par byas/smin pa rnams grol bar byas so/ /sngon 'brom ston pa rin po ches nyin zhig jo bo'i gzims khang nang gi mi gtsang ba rnams phyags nas gtsang sing nge ba zhig mdzad pas/ bya rgod kyi nyin 8

lam bco brgyad tshun chad kyi sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi rnam pa wal gyis mkhyen pa'i mngon par mkhyen pa rgya chen po la mnga' brnyes par gsungs/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen spyan snga ba'i zhal nas/ rnal 'byor pa lta ba rtogs pa yin pas ci yang bya mi dgos zer bar/ yon tan thams cad bsod nams bsags pa las 'byung gsungs/ de rnams la dgongs nas sngon bdag cag gi ston pa thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba de nyid kyis/ rjes 'jug 'o skol rnams la dkon mchog gsum gyi che ba 'byin pa dang / tshogs gsog sgrib pa sbyong ba la 'di ltar bya dgos zhes go ba bskyed phyir/ 'gro la chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus sogs la/ sa phyogs dang gnas khang bye dor mdzad pa dang /gcung dga' bo yang rab tu byung nas gtsug lag khang la phyag bdar byed du bcug pas/ tshar mang po'i bar du mdzad pa dang /sngon na ga ge sar gye gling gi rnal 'byor pa mngon shes la thogs pa med pa zhig la jo bo dpon slob bltar byon pas/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i gtsug lag khang zhig gi drung na/ shing bye gro dha zhig yod pa'i rtsa na phyag bdar mdzad kyin 'dug pa mthong skad/ sngon rje btsun mi las kyang dwags po lha rje 'byon khar/ gtsang sbra che bar bya/ rnam rtog chung bar bya 9

gsungs/ bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rwa sgreng khri chen rdo rje 'chang gi zhal nas/ gnas khang bye dor bya ba la/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa'i nyal nyil thams cad phyags par bya'o snyam du bsam la gad bdar bya/ 'di'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing sbyong ba sogs kyi phan yon lnga 'byung ba yin te/zhing sbyong ba ni sems sbyong ba yin no zhes gsungs/ des na 'o skol las dang po pa rnams kyis dam pa gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar dang gsung ltar bsam pa bzang po'i sgo nas gtsug lag khang chen po dang / mchod khang chung ba/ bla ma'i gzim khang /rang gi gnas khang / sku gsung thugs rten rnams kyi phyi nang bar gsum mi gtsang ba'i nyal nyil sa rdul rnams phyag bdar byed pa la brtson par bya'o/ /chos byed nus na tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong zhig la phyag bdar byas pa 'di kho nas chog par gda'/ gnyis pa sku gsung thugs rten bkrams pa'i phan yon ni/ rten gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs der phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas shing ma sems can la bde skyid 'byung bar 'gyur te/ snga 'gyur yongs rdzogs rgyud las/ rten 'di ji srid 10

gnas kyi bar/ /de srid sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas/ /'gro ba kun 'dul las sgrib sbyongs/ /zhes dang / rab gnas bse sgom las/sems can bde skyid rten la yod/ /ces dang / bde mchog sdom 'byung las/ bris sku sgrub na myur bar ni/ /dngos grub rgya chen thob par 'gyur gsungs/ gzhan yang rten mthong ba'i phan yon ni/ dam chos padma dkar po las/ bde gshegs sku gzugs rtsig ngos bris pa la/ /'khrugs bzhin pa yi sems kyis bltas na yang / /des ni rim gyis sangs rgyas bye ba mthong / /zhes dang /yang de nyid las/ kun dga' bo/ gang dag tha na rmi lam du de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs de mthong nas sems dwangs par byed na kun dga' bo dge ba'i rtsa ba de'i 'bras bu mya ngan las 'das pa yin te/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i mthar gtugs par 'gyur bar nga smra'o/ /gsungs/'jam dpal zhal lung las/ras bris mthong ba'i skye bo yi/ /bsod nams mthong ba don yod pa/ /bskal pa bye ba rnams su yang / /brjod par yang ni mi nus so/ /zhes gsungs/ sngon rgya gar du dge slong gcig gis/mchod khang zhig na thang sku mang bo bkram 'dug pa la/ phyag g.yas nas bzung rim gyis bltas pas/ de na gshin rje gshed kyi thang sku zhig 'dug pa mthong bas/ de nyid la skye ba snga ma'i yi 11

dam gyi lha yin par dran nas/ de ka la nags gseb tu phyin nas bsgrubs pas dngos grub mod la thob skad/ sngon bram ze'i khye'us sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs la/ dwangs pa'i sems kyis mig mi 'dzum par bltas pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs su lung bstan pa dang / sngon rgyal po u tra ya na la/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs ri mor bris nas bskur ba na/ 'og tu rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyang bris nas bskur pas/ rgyal pos sangs rgyas kyis 'dra sku mthong ba tsam gyis dad pa skyes pas byen rlabs zhugs/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis la bltas nas lugs 'byung lugs ldog tu bsgoms pas 'phags pa'i go 'phang thob par gsungs/ dam pa gong ma 'ga' res/ o rgyan chen po dang /grub thob nyi ma 'dzin/ thang stong rgyal po/ grub chen las kyi rdo rje la sogs pa'i rgya bod kyi mkhas grub phal cher dang / yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed/ dpal rta mgrin/ phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa'i yi dam gyi lha drag po'i sku 'dra gang na bzhugs kyang lha 'dre'i gnod pa mi yong ba dang / rje phag mo gru ba/ bla ma zhang / rje bdag nyid chen po sogs bla ma skyes bu dam pa phal cher gyi sku dang / nor lha tshe lha'i sku gzugs gang na bzhugs kyang dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal mi 'byung zhing / zas nor 'phel zhing tshe 12

ring ba dang / mdor na sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams mthong thos dran reg mchod bstod phyag bskor byed pa sogs 'brel tshad thams cad don dang ldan par 'gyur ro gsungs/ des na gnas khang rnams bye dor byas dri bzang gis chag chag btab/spos dri zhim po bdugs nas/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams dgram dgos te/ dgra bcom pa sa ga lhas/ dga' ston dus tshe sgu gzugs ni/ /rgan po'i gong du rtag tu bzhag /gsungs/ des na sngon jo bo rje yab sras kyi rjes 'jug bka' gdams gong ma rnams kyis/ bstan pa'i bdag po thub dbang gi sku re 'bral spang gi tshul du 'chang nas/ gar bzhugs sar gong du bzhag nas mchod pa ltar 'o skol rnams kyis kyang rang gzhan dad ldan dwangs pa 'dren phyir/ sangs rgyas kyis gtso byas rten gang yod rnams grwa 'grigs po byas gong gi mtho sar dgram par bya'o/ /gnyis pa mchod pa g.yo med cing bkod pas mjes par bshams pa'i phan yon ni/ de yang mchod pa'i rgyu g.yo sgyu'i sgo nas bsgrubs pa dang / srog gcod pa sogs sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i dngos po chung ngu zhig phul kyang phan yon rgya chen po 'byung ste/ sngon khyim bdag cig gis/ sangs rgyas rnam gzigs kyi 13

mchod rten la me long zhig phul/ spos dang me tog la sogs pas mchod nas phyag 'tshal smon lam btab pas/ de'i mthu la brten nas/ bdag cag gi ston pa sangs rgyas kyi dus su grong khyer ser skya ru khye'u gser 'od ces bya ba btsas dus/ de'i 'od kyis grong khyer ser skya'i gnas thams cad khyab pa byung /gzugs byad mjes pa lta bas chog mi shes pa zhig tu gyur/ phyis sangs rgyas dang mjal nas bsnyen par rdzogs dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob/ de bzhin du sku gsung thugs rten gyi drung du/ me long phul na gzugs byad mdzes pas/ me tog dang me long gtsang ma sogs 'bul ba la brtson par bya'o/ /yang sangs rgyas rnam gzigs kyi mchod rten la/ khyim bdag cig gis spos dang byugs pa dang me tog sna tshogs kyis mchod nas/ smon lam btab pas/ ston pa 'jig rten du byon dus/ khye'u dri zhim zhes bya ba kha nas utpa la'i dri dang / lus thams cad nas tsan dan gyi dri 'byung ba/ mdzes shing lta na sdug pa zhig tu gyur/ nam zhig na sangs rgyas dang mjal ma thag tu rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu thob/ rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa dka' tshegs med par thob pas 'khor rnams ngo mtshar bar gyur/ de bzhin du sku gsung thugs rten la/ dri zhim po phul na dri zhim pa'i lus len 14

pas/ spos dri zhim po 'bul bar bya'o/ /yang khyim bdag cig gis/ sangs rgyas rnam gzigs kyi mchod rten la byi dor bgyis/spos kyi lde gu dang til mar byugs te smon lam btab pas/ de yang phyis ser skya'i gnas su shākya phyug po zhig gi bu gzugs bzang zhing mjes pa stobs dang ldan pa zhig tu skyes pas/ ming yang stobs ldan du btags/ cher song nas sangs rgyas dang mjal te rgyun zhugs dang dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob/ de bzhin du rten la spos dang til mar gyi byug pa phul na/ stobs dang ldan par 'gyur bas dbul bar bgyi'o/ /yang sngon khyim bdag cig gis/ sangs rgyas rnam gzigs kyi mchod rten la me tog gi phreng ba btags pas/ ser skyar shākya phyug po zhig gi bu gzugs bzang zhing mjes pa mthong na dga' ba zhig tu skyes pas/ ming sdug gur btags/ mthar sangs rgyas dang mjal nas rgyun zhugs dang dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob/ de bzhin du rten la me tog phul na gzugs mdzes pas/ me tog sna tshogs kyi phreng ba 'bul bar bya'o/ /yang tshong dpon zhig gis/ sangs rgyas rnam gzigs kyi mchod rten la nor bu mthon ka zhig phul/me tog padma dag gis mchod nas smon lam btab pas/ de yang ser skyar shākya phyug po zhig gi bu padma'i mig ces bya ba/ gzugs 15

mdzes pa mgo na lha'i nor bu mthon gas spras pa zhig tu gyur/de gang du phyin kyang lha mi thams cad kyis bsngags brjod byed pa zhig byung / mthar sangs rgyas dang mjal nas rgyun zhugs dang dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob/ de bzhin du dkon mchog gi rten gyi drung du/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i mchod rdzas phul na phan yon che bas 'bul ba la brtson par bya'o/ /yang khyim bdag cig gis/ sangs rgyas rnam gzigs kyi mchod rten la rnga sil la sogs pa'i rol mo sna tshogs phul te smon lam btab pas/ phyis shākya phyug po zhig gi bu mdzes sdug bya ka la piṅka ltar skad snyan pa/ rnga'i sgra ltar gdangs snyan pa zhig tu skyes/ ming rnga sgrar btags/ mthar sangs rgyas dang mjal nas rgyun zhugs dang dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob/ 'di ni rol mo phul ba dang /skad kyi bye brag sna tshogs pas mchod pa'i phan yon yin pas/mchod rnga la sogs pa'i sgra snyan sna tshogs pas dkon mchog mchod pa la brtson par bya'o/ /yang sngon dge slong 'phags pa'i bsnyen gyis/ sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug phud can la mar me zla ba gnyis 'bul bar khas blangs pas/ rgyal po ka si ga'i sras mo thub pa zhes bya bas mar me gang dgos pa'i sbyin bdag byas/dge slong 'phags pa'i bsnyen gyis phul bas/ de'i bsod 16

nams kyis dge slong 'phags pa'i bsnyen ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas mar me mdzad dang / sras mo thub pa de sangs rgyas shākya thub par 'gyur bar lung bstan/ de la brten nas bskal pa grangs med kyi bar du/ lha mi'i 'jig rten du gzugs mjes shing lta bas chog mi shes pa bde ba mtha' yas pa dang ldan par gyur/ de bzhin du lha la mar me phul na skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du gzugs mdzes shing / mthar thug mtshan dpes mdzes pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku mchog thob pas/ mar me gtsang ma byas nas 'bul ba la brtson par bya'o/ /yang sngon rgyal po ki li byi zhes bya bas/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs 'das pa'i ring bsrel rnams bsdus te mchod rten chen po zhig brtsigs pas/ las dpon gcig gis mchod rten gyi rtse la dril bu zhig btags nas smon lam btab pas/ tshe rabs lnga brgya'i bar du skad gdangs snyan par gyur/ phyis sangs rgyas kyi dus su dge slong gdangs dbyangs 'then pa thos pa tsam gyis yid 'phrog pa zhig tu gyur/ des na de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung dbyangs sogs skad phun sum tshogs par 'dod pas/ dkon mchog la dril bu dung dkar sogs sgra snyan pa'i rol mo'i mchod pa 'bul bar bya'o/ /sngon sangs rgyas rnam gzigs kyi bstan pa la/ mi dbul 17

po bza' mi gnyis kyis/ sa'i bum pa gsar pa gcig nyos te/nang kun chu gtsang mas bkang ste/ gser gyi dong rtse gcig nang du bcug me long gcig gis kha bcad de/ dge 'dun pa rnams la phul lo/ /dge 'dun pa la las chu de 'thungs/ la las kha lag dang lhung bzed bkrus te longs spyad pa'i bsod nams kyis/ phyis tshe'i dus byas nas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lhar skyes nas lha'i bdud rtsi la longs spyad/ de'i rjes su mnyan yod kyi grong khyer zhig na/ khyim bdag phyug po zhig la bu gser mdog 'dra ba zhig btsas pa dang ming gser lha zhes btags so/ /yul tsam pa zhes bya ba na/ phyug po zhig la bu mo gser mdog 'dra ba zhig btsas pa dang ming yang gser mdog ces btags so/ /de gnyis ka btsas pa'i tshe na/ khyem du khron pa chu zheng gab pa khru brgyad pa re byung ste/ khron pa de gnyis kyi chu bcus pas ni mi'i yid bzhin 'byung ste/ zas gos dang rin po che la sogs pa ci 'dod pa byung ngo / /phyis gnyis ka bza' mi byas te skyid dga' longs spyod de la ma chags par mthar bza' mi gnyis ka sangs rgyas kyi drung nas rab tu byung ste/ ring po ma lon par dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob par gsungs/ de bzhin du lha'i bdud rtsi sogs ci 'dod la longs spyod par 'dod pas/18

dkon mchog gsum la bum pa chu gtsang me long gser la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs pas mchod par bya'o/ /bla ma gong ma mang po'i zhal nas/ bdun tshar rnams rgyu bzang zhing gtsang na/ tshe rabs gang du lus rten bzang po thob cing /dbang po sgo lnga tshang ba/ sems rgyud bzang zhing tshul khrims gtsang bar 'gyur/ bdun tshar drang por bsgrigs shing gcig la gcig ma reg par byas na/ sems rgyud drang zhing gcig pur ci byed rang dbang thob pa 'ong / chu gtsang mas snod ran par bkang na shes rgyud yon tan du mas gang zhing / gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs thams cad la bkra shis po 'ong / so thar gye sdom pa snod gtsang ma lta bu la byang sems kyi sdom pa chu gtsang ma lta bu chags nas/ de la sngags kyi sdom pa gzugs brnyan lta bur shar nas gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa chen por 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel yod gsungs/ gzhan yang dus rgyun tu dwangs shing bsil ba'i yon chab gtsang ma phul na/ shes rgyud kyi sdig ltung byang ste sa lam gyi rtogs pa skye ba'i dgos pa che zhing sgrub sla la ser sna sogs kyi nyes pa mi 'jug pas bzang gsungs/ yang bla ma skyes bu dam pa 'ga' res/ sku gsung thugs rten gyi drung du mchod pa bshams dus/ snod la ya yo dang 'khyags 'khyogs 19

med par drang por bsgrigs na/ rang rgyud drang zhing chos gang byas lam du 'gro/ chu blugs dus snod khengs na sgrub pa po la 'tsho ba 'byor/ chu ha cang ma mtho ba byas na rig pa brtan/ chu phyi rol tu ma bo na/ tshul khrims gtsang zhing 'khor 'du/ chu dwangs shing bsil ba phul na rig pa dwangs shing chos la nges shes skye ba'i dgos pa che gsungs/ gzhan yang rgya gar na bod kyi chu lta bu'i gtsang sing nge ba med pas phan yon che/ sangs rgyas la chu gtsang ma zhig phul na yang / khong gi tshogs rdzogs pa'i stabs kyis bdu da rtsir 'gyur bas na/ bdud rtsi phul ba tsam gyi phan yon thob par gsungs/ des na nyin re bzhin du chu gtsang ma'i yon chab 'bul ba la brtson par bya'o/ /gzhan yang / mdo sde las rnam 'byed las/ me tog phul ba'i phan yon bcu ste/bcu gang yin zhe na/ 'jig rten na me tog lta bur 'gyur ba dang / sna'i dbang po nam yang nyams par mi 'gyur ba dang /lus kyi dri nga ba rnam par dag par 'gyur ba dang / dri zhim po 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / phyogs dang phyogs mtshams su de'i tshul khrems kyi dri ngad ldang bar 'gyur ba dang / 'jig rten gyi sngon du 'gro bar 'gyur ba dang / sdug pa'i chos rnams 'thob par 'gyur ba dang / longs spyod che bar 'gyur ba dang / mtho 20

ris su skye bar 'gyur ba dang / myur du yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba ste/ de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la me tog phul ba'i phan yon no/ /mar me phul ba'i phan yon bcu ste/bcu gang zhe na/ 'jig rten na mar me lta bur 'gyur ba dang /sha'i mig rnam par dag par 'gyur ba dang / lha'i mig 'thob par 'gyur ba dang / dge ba dang mi dge ba'i chos rnams la shes rab 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / ma rig pa dang gti mug gi mun pa sel ba dang / shes rab kyi snang ba 'thob par 'gyur ba dang / de 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe nam du yang mun pa na gnas par mi 'gyur ba dang / longs spyod che bar 'gyur ba dang / mtho ris su skye bar 'gyur ba dang / myur du yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba ste/ de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la mar me phul ba'i phan yon no/ /spos phul ba'i phan yon bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'jig rten na spos lta bur 'gyur ba dang / sna'i dbang po rnam par dag par 'gyur ba dang / lus kyi dri mi zhim pa rnam par dag par 'gyur ba dang / rtag tu dri zhim par 'gyur ba dang / gzugs bzang bar 'gyur ba dang /'jig rten gyi sngon du 'gro bar 'gyur ba dang / longs spyod che bar 'gyur ba dang / mtho ris su skye bar 'gyur ba dang / sdug 21

pa'i chos rnams 'thob par 'gyur ba dang / myur du yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba ste/ de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la spos phul ba'i phan yon no/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa byams pa'i mdo las/ mar me stong phrag gcig gam/ me tog phul ba stong phrag gcig gam/ utpal sngon po stong phrag gcig gis mchod par byed pa dang / mchod rten de dag gi tog byed pa dang gzugs byed pa de dag ni byams pa sangs rgyas pa'i tshe de'i drung du skye zhing / dang po'i chos thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / mar me 'bul ba zhes bya ba'i mdo las/ mar me 'bul ba'i rnam smin 'di yin te/ /'chi dus byed tshe dran pa nyams mi 'gyur/ /de la phyogs rnams snang bar byed par 'gyur/ /sngon chad ma mthong gzugs bzang rnams kyang mthong / /de ni shi nas mtho ris nges 'gro zhing / /lha yi stan la de lus 'dug par shes/ /zhes dang / gsal rgyal gyes zhus pa'i mdo las/ dpe med mchod rten mar me phul pa yi/ /utpal sngon po kha phye 'dab 'dra'i mig /gsal zhing sdug la mig dkyus ring zhing mdzes/ /dri ma med pa'i lha yi mig dang ldan/ /zhes dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo las/ bde gshegs mchod rten mar me phul ba na/ /rnam grol mchog mnga' stobs bcu rnams ldan zhing / /de 22

bzhin ma 'dres chos kyi pha rol phyin/ /kun nas spyan ldan bde bar gshegs par 'gyur/ /zhes pa la sogs pa mdo rgyud kun nas bla ma dkon mchog la mchod pa phul ba'i phan yon mtha' yas pa gsungs pa'i tshul rnams dran par byas nas bza' btung gi phud yan chad kyis bla ma dkon mchog mchod pa la brtson par bya'o/ /gsum pa bde ba'i stan la lus rnam snang chos bdun byas rang rgyud la brtag te/ mi dge ba'i sems spangs nas dge sems khyad par can gye ngang nas/ skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/tshad med bzhi bsgoms pa'i phan yon la lnga las/ dang po bde ba'i stan la lus rnam snang gi chos bdun byas pa'i phan yon ni/rje btsun garma chags med kyis/ rten 'brel lus la bsgrigs pas rtogs pa sems la 'char ba'i gnad yin pas/ rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung ngam/ yang na sems dpa'i skyil krung bcas pas/thur sel gyi rlung dbu mar tshud cing / phrag dog zhi ba dang bar chad kyis mi tshugs/ lag pa gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya lte 'og sor bzhir bcas pas/ chu rlung dbu mar tshud de/ zhe sdang zhi/ sgal tshigs mda' ltar bsrang zhing / dpung pa rgod gshog ltar brgyangs pas/ sa rlung dbu mar tshud de/ gti mug zhi/23

mgrin pa brang la gug tsam byas pas/ me rlung dbu mar tshud de chags pa zhi/ mig 'byed btsums ran par sna rtse nas sor bzhi'i thad du blta ba dang lce yar rkan la sbyar bas/ rlung gi rlung dbu mar tshud de/ nga rgyal zhi shes pa gsal lo/ /de ltar lus gnad chos bdun ma 'jug na rlung dbu mar tshud pas rtog pa rang bzhin gyis 'char ro gsungs/ phyag chen zin bris las/ de yang skyil krung gis thur sel dang / mnyam gzhag gis me mnyam dang / sgal tshigs bsrang ba dang / dang kha dgyes pas khyab byed dang / mgrin pa gug pas gyen rgyu dang / lce yar rkan la sbyar ba dang / lta stangs kyis srog 'dzin gyi rlung dbu mar tshud par byed cing / de lnga dbu mar tshud pas las rlung mtha' dag dbu mar tshud nas/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'char bar 'gyur gsungs/ lho brag mar bas/ bod kyi gdams ngag thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdoms na/ nga'i lus gnad gcig pu la yang mi do gsungs pa'i gtso bo rnam snang chos bdun gyi bsngags brjod yin skad/ sngon yul bcom brlag ces bya ba'i spre'u zhig gis/ rang sangs rgyas lnga brgya skyil krung byas bsam gtan la gnas pa mthong nas/ spre'us kyang skyil krung byas nas bsdad/ nam zhig gi tshe/ rang sangs rgyas de 24

rnams 'bar ba dang gsal ba la sogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul bstan nas/ mya ngan las 'das tshe/ spre'u 'khyams nas drang srong lnga brgyas ri sul na spyod lam sna tshogs pas 'dug pa'i drung du song nas skyil krung byas nas bsdad pas/ mkhan pos 'khor drang srong rnams la/ spre'u rnams ni dran pa dang ldan pa ste/'dis drang srong kha cig gi spyod lam de lta bu mthong gis/ khyod cag kyang skyil krung bcas la sdod cig byas pas/ kun gyis skyil krung byas nas bsdad pas/ sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba mngon du gyur nas/ mkhan slob thams cad kyis byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun mngon du bskyed nas/ rang byang chub mngon du byas so/ /bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bdag cag gi ston pa sangs rgyas nas bzung sngon byon gyi sangs rgyas thams cad lus gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun la brten nas sangs rgyas pa yin pas/de'i rten 'brel gyi gnad kyis nged rnams kyis kyang de ltar byas na gnas skabs lus sems bde zhing mthar sangs rgyas par 'gyur zhes gsungs/ des na lus gnad drang por bsrang nas rnam snang chos bdun bya'o/ /gnyis pa rang rgyud la brtag ste mi dge ba'i sems spangs/dge sems bskyed pa'i phan yon ni/ 'phags pa lhas bzhi brgya 25

bar/ bsam pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /dge 'am yang na mi dge ba/ /thams cad dge legs nyid 'gyur gyis/ /gang phyir sems de gtso bo'i phyir/ /zhes dang / sems kyi sgrib sbyong las/dge slong rang gi pha rgan la/ /myur 'dong zhes ni bskul gyur nas/ /phul bas de ni shi gyur kyang / /mtshams med spyod pa ma yin no/ /bsam pa bzang pos mchil lham zhig /thub pa'i dbu la bzhag pa dang / /de bzhin gzhan gyes bsal byas pa/ /gnyis gas rgyal srid thob par gyur/ /de phyir bsam pa'i rtsa ba la/ /bsod nams sdig pa rnam par gnas/ /zhes dang / sdom pa nyi shu pa las/ snying rje ldan phyir byams phyir dang / /sems dge ba la nyes pa med/ /gsungs/ de rnams la dgongs nas rje rin po ches/ bsam pa bzang na sa dang lam yang bzang gsungs/ de bzhin du deng sang yongs grags kyis/ bsam pa bzang na ci byas chos su 'gro zer/ de'i phyir rwa sgreng khri chen rdo rje 'chang gis/ dge mi dge'i rnam rtog gang yang med pa'i lung ma bstan sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba de nyid/ dper na shel dri ma med pa de tshon dmar ser sogs gang dang phrad pa na/ tshon de'i kha dog can du 'gyur ba bzhin du dge sems khyad par can byang chub kyi sems rin po che dang phrad pa zhig gi ngang nas dge 26

sbyor mdzad dgos gsungs/gsum pa skyabs 'gro byas pa'i phan yon ni/ dri ma med pa'i mdo las/ skyabs su song ba'i bsod nams gang / /gal te de la gzugs mchis na/ /nam mkha'i khams ni kun bkang nas/ /de ni de bas lhag par 'gyur zhes dang / phar phyin bsdus pa las/skyabs song bsod nams gzugs yod na/ /khams gsum 'di yang snod du chung / /rgya mtsho chen po chu yi gter/ /phul gyis bcal bar gzhal mi nus gsungs/ bsdu na brgyad du 'du ste/dang po nang pa sangs rgyas par tshud pa'i phan yon ni/ lam rim chung ba las/ spyir phyi nang la 'jog tshul mang du snang na'ang / jo bo dang sharnyi pa skyabs 'gros byed par grags pas/ skyabs 'gro thob la mi btang bar bya'o/ /des na sangs rgyas par tshud pa la dkon mchog gsum la snying thag pa nas ston pa la sogs par 'dzin pa dgos kyi/ de med na dge ba gang byas kyang sangs rgyas par mi tshud do gsungs/ gnyis pa sdom pa thams cad kyi rten du 'gyur ba'i phan yon ni/ skyabs 'gro bdun cu pa las/ dge bsnyen gsum la skyabs 'gro ba/ /de ni sdom brgyad rtsa ba yin/ /zhes dang / mdzod 'grel las/ skyabs su 'gro ba rnams ni sdom pa yang dag par blang ba thams cad la sgor gyur pa yin no 27

gsungs/ gsum pa sngon bsags pa'i las sgrib rnams srab cing zad par 'gyur pa'i phan yon ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas/ rtswa skam phung po ri rab tsam/ /me stag chung ngus bsregs pa ltar/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song na/ /sdig pa ri rab tsam yang byang gsungs/ sngon bu mo rdo rje bya bas/skyabs 'gro byas pas gzugs ngan pa'i las sgrib dag nas mtshan dang ldan pa'i lus su gyur par gsungs/ bzhi pa bsod nams rgya chen po gsog pa'i phan yon ni/ myang 'das las/gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba gang / /bsod nams ye shes dam pa'i tshogs/ /'jig rten rgyal ba'i chos 'phel bas sangs rgyas nyid ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / khye'u sbyin pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ gang dag sangs rgyas la skyabs su song ba de dag gi dge ba'i chos thams cad mngon par 'phel lo ngo tsha ba shes pa yin no/ /khrel yod pa yin no/ /chos la skyabs su song ba de dag ni bag yod pa yin no/ /yon tan gyi tshogs mang ba yin no/ /rtag tu tshe rabs dran pa yin no/ /chos kyi bgo skal gyi tshogs dang ldan pa yin no/ /dge 'dun la skyabs su song ba de dag gi sems las su rung ba yin no/ /ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyi sgo mang ba yin no/ /rtag tu rigs btsun pa yin 28

no/ /rmi lam du sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun dang mi 'bral ba yin no gsungs/ lnga pa shi na ngan 'gror mi ltung ba'i phan yon ni/ phag mo'i rtogs brjod las/ gang zhig sangs rgyas skyabs 'gro ba/ /de ni ngan 'gror mi 'gro ste/ /de yi lus ni spangs nas kyang / /lha yi lus su skye bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin du chos dang dge 'dun la yang sbyar nas gsungs/ sngon lha'i bu zhig tshe 'phos nas phag tu skye bar 'gyur ba mthong nas/'jigs shing skrag pa la/ brgya byin gyis skyabs 'gro phog pas phag tu ma skyes par dga' ldan gyi lhar skyes par gsungs/ drug pa mi dang mi ma yin gyi bar chad kyis mi tshugs pa'i phan yon ni/ mdo nyi ma'i snying po las/ sangs rgyas skyabs su sems can su 'gro ba/ /bdud rnams bye bas gsad par mi nus te/ /tshul khrims nyams shing blo ni 'khrugs zin kyang / /de ni nges par skye ba'i pha rol 'gro gsungs/ sngon gnod sbyin zhig stag cig tu sprul nas/ mi rnams roms su za ba la/ rgan mo ma smad gnyis kyis skyabs 'gro byas pas/ me dpung du mthong ste gnod sbyin gyis za bar ma nus pa dang / dge bsnyen ma zla bzang mos skyabs 'gro byed cing / dur khrod 'jigs su rung ba zhig tu mtshan mo song ba las/ gcan gzan mi ma yin rnams kyis me 29

dpung du mthong nas ma zos par gsungs/ bdun pa ci bsam pa thams cad 'grub pa'i phan yon ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/skyabs su 'gro ba 'dir song don che ste/ /de ni tshad med yon tan tshogs 'phel 'gyur/ /'gro ba 'di la snying rje bsam pas khyab/ /mtshungs med 'phags chen chos kyang rgyas par byed/ /ces dang / rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho'i zhal nas/ chos gnad du song na skyabs 'gros kyang / /'phral phan zhing phugs su bde ba ster gsungs/ lam rim chung ba las/ chos ldan gyi bya ba gang sgrub pa'i thog mar dkon mchog la mchod/ des skyabs su song nas gsol ba btab na bde blag tu 'grub pa'o gsungs/brgyad pa myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i phan yon ni/ myang 'das las/ gang su gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ /de dag myur du sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /zhes dang / shing rta chen mo las/de'ang sangs rgyas la skyabs su song ba'i mthar thug sangs rgyas 'grub/ chos la skyabs su song bas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/dge 'dun la skyabs su song bas phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho lta bur 'du bar 'gyur ro gsungs/ des na nang nub kun tu skyabs 'gro la 'bad par bya'o/ /bzhi pa sems bskyed byas pa'i phan yon ni/ gsang ba 30

bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems kyi bsod na mas gang / /de la gal te gzugs mchis na/ /nam mkha'i khams ni kun bkang ste/ /de ni de bas lhag par 'gyur/ /sems can kun gyi bsod nams kyi/ /phung po ji snyed yongs bzung ba/ /de snyed byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /byang chub sems la rab tu 'byung / /zhes dang / sdong po bkod pa'i mdo las/ mdor na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la legs pa yod pa ji lta bar/byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i legs pa dang yon tan yang de tsam ste/ nam mkha'i khams dang chos kyi dbyengs ltar rgya che'o/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems bskyed gyur na skad cig gis/ /'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing / /'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur/ /zhes dang /dpal sbyin gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ gaṅgā'i bye ma'i grangs snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas zhing kun mi gang gis/ /rin chen bdun gyis yongs bkang zhing / /'jig rten mgon la phul ba bas/ /gang gis thal mo sbyar byas te/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa ni/ /mchod pa 'di ni khyad 'phags te/ /de la mtha' ni ma mchis so/ /zhes dang / blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ gsum po 31

'di dag de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa bla na med pa ste/byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa dang / srog chags rnams la snying brtse ba'o zhes dang / drin lan bsab pa'i mdo las/ gal te byang chub tu sems ma bskyed na nam du'ang byang chub thob par mi 'gyur te/ de bas na byang chub tu sems bskyed na/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / rgyal po seng ges zhus pa'i mdo las/ sems can thams cad thar bya'i phyir/ /byang chub tu ni sems btud pas/ /de ni chos rnams sdud pa'i mchog /de ni dga' ba thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / sdong po bkod pa'i mdo las/ 'phags pa byams pas nor bzang la gsungs pa la/rigs kyi bu byang chub kyi sems ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi sa bon lta bu'o/ /re ba thams cad bskang bas dpag bsam gyi shing lta bu'o/ /don thams cad 'grub pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu'o/ /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs so/ /sngon jo bo chen bos/ rdo rje'i gdan la bskor ba mdzad nas ji ltar byas na myur du mngon par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob snyam du dgongs pa na/ sku gzugs chung ba thams cad bzhengs nas/ che ba rnams la myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod 32

pas gang la bslab par bya zhes dris pa na/ byang chub kyi sems la bslab par bya'o gsungs/ garnyo la'i steng gi nam mkha' la bud med rgan pa zhig la gzhon pa zhig gis dris pa la yang lan sngar ltar mdzad pa gsan pas/ byang chub kyi sems la thugs nges che bar song skad/ rje rin po ches/ bskal pa du ma'i bar du rmad du byung ba'i mkhyen rab kyis ches phra bar byas te lam rnams la dpyad pa na/ 'di nyid 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs dam par rgyal ba sras bcas kyis gzigs pa'i phyir ro gsungs/ de ltar du yang spyod 'jug las/ bskal pa du mar rab dgongs mdzad pa yi/ /thub dbang rnams kyis 'di nyid phan par gzigs/ /zhes mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad nas de ltar du gsungs/des na myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar 'dod pas nyin re bzhin smon 'jug byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /lnga pa tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa'i phan yon ni/ dpal phreng gi mdo las/ gang gis tshad med bzhi bsgom pa/ /de ni bde gshegs kun gyis dgongs/ /kun tu yon tan tshad med de/ /nam mkha'i lam las rab 'das pa'o/ /zhes dang / mdo sde rgyan las/ tshangs pa'i gnas pa'i gnas pa yi/ /blo ldan rtag tu 33

'dod pa skye/ /der ni tshogs rnams rdzogs byed cing / /sems can dag kyang yongs smin byed/ /kun tu tshangs dang mi 'bral ba/ /de yi mi mthun phyogs dang bral/ /bag med gyur kyang de yi rkyen/ /mi bzang bas kyang mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / padma rtse mo las/ byams pas zhe sdang gnas su dag /me long ye shes longs spyod rdzogs/ /snying rjes 'dod chags gnas su dag /kun rtog ye shes chos kyi sku/ /dga' bas phrag dog gnas su dag /bya grub ye shes sprul pa'i sku/ /mdzad pa lhun grub dam pa'o/ /btang snyems btang snyoms chen po yis/ /nga rgyal gti mug gnas su dag /mnyam med chos dbyings ye shes bdag /byang chub rdo rje'i sku nyid do/ /zhes dang / dge ba gsum gyi don khrid las/ byams pas gnas skabs kun gyi yid du 'ong zhing / mthar thug longs sku 'grub pa dang / snying rjes 'tshe ba med cing chos sku 'grub pa dang / dga' bas phrag dog med cing sprul sku 'grub pa dang /btang snyoms kyis sems las su rung zhing ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa dang / gzhan yang 'dod par lha mi'i lus 'grub pas phan bde byed la/ gzungs kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / skye gnas dag pa'i yon tan mngon du byed gsungs/ shing rta chen mo las/byams pas yid du 'ong ba dang / snying rjes bde ba dang /34

dga' bas sman dang me tog la sogs pa mang zhing skyid la 'byor ba dang / btang snyoms kyis skye dgu rnams mthun zhing /gnod pa med par skye'o gsungs/ yang bla ma mang pos ma sems can tshad med pa la byams pa tshad med pa/ snying rje tshad med pa/ dga' ba tshad med pa/ btang snyoms tshad med pa bsgoms na/ bsod nams tshad med pa skye bar 'gyur ro gsungs/ yang tshad med bzhi po so so'i phan yon bshad pa la bzhi las/ dang po byams pa bsgoms pa'i phan yon ni/ brgyad stong pa las/ byams pa dang ldan pa'i sems mang du bsgom zhing /brtan par byas pas/ 'gro ba mthong na yid du 'ong ba yin/khong khro ba med pa yin/ zhes dang / thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa'i mdo las/ gang zhig 'jig rten rnam dag na/ /bskal pa gcig gi bar dag tu/ /tshul khrims dag ni bsrungs pa bas/ /skyes bus skad cig dga' ba tsam/ /de bas byams pa spyad pa mchog /gang gis 'jig rten khams 'di ru/ /lus dang ngag yid sdig spyad de/ ngan song gsum du ltung nges kyang / /byams pa de yis 'phral du 'byang gsungs/ gnyis pa snying rje bsgoms pa'i phan yon ni/ snying po mchog las/ snying rje chen pos ni sems las su rung ba dang / 'tshe ba med pa dang dga' bas 35

brgyan pa'i mchog thob par byed do gsungs/ gsum pa dga' ba bsgoms pa'i phan yon ni/ brgyad stong pa las/ dga' ba dang ldan pa'i sems yangs pa tshad med pa/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mi 'phrog pa gang gis bla na med pa'i byang chub phun sum tshogs pa'i mngon par mtho ba nyid thob par byed do gsungs/ bzhi pa btang snyoms bsgoms pa'i phan yon ni/ shing rta chen mo las/ de'ang kun rdzob kyis rang gzhan nye ring med la/ don dam pas ni/ gnyis su med pa'i chos nyid rtogs par 'gyur ro gsungs/ des na tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi'i ngag 'don ni/ thun mong gi skyabs 'gro dang /thun mong ma yin pa sngags kyi skabs gang na yod pa rang gi sngar gang shes pa bton na chog go/ /bzhi pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bstan pa'i bdag po gtso byas tshogs zhing gi lha rnams bskyed pa'i phan yon ni/ 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/gang zhig rgyal ba yid byed pa/ /de yi mdun na de bzhugs te/ /rtag par byin gyis rlobs par byed/ /nyes pa kun las rnam par grol gsungs/ de bzhin du bla ma rnams kyis/ gang gis mos pa gtso byed pa/ /de yi mdun na thub pa bzhugs gsungs/ gzhan 36

yang ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ gser gye kha dog lta bu'i sku lus kyis/ /'jig rten mgon po kun tu mdzes pa ste/ /dmigs pa de la gang gi sems 'jug pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' de mnyam gzhag ces bya gsungs/ sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor rnams la dge slong dag dgon pa dang shing drung dang / sa phug la sogs pa na 'jigs shing spu zing nge byed na'ang / nga rjes su dran par gyis shig dang / 'jigs pa med par 'gyur ro gsungs/ des na sangs rgyas yid la dran na 'jigs pa kun las grol zhing / gzhan yang sangs rgyas yid la dran pa tsam gyis bskal pa grangs med pa'i sdig pa 'dagabasod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs pa dang / zhi gnas kyi lam rgyud la bde blag tu skye zhing / gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs kyi snod rung du 'gyur ba dang / 'chi khar dran pa mi nyams shing sangs rgyas kyi snang ba dang mi 'bral/ tshe 'phos nas kyang sangs rgyas kyis lam sna drangs te/ 'og min dga' ldan bde ba can la sogs sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnam par dag par bgrod cing / skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du ston pa thugs rje can gyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdzad nas ma nor ba'i lam bstan te sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'jog pa sogs phan yon mtha' 37

yas pa gsungs so/ /des na rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha'i khams thams cad 'ja' 'od kyis gang ba'i klong na seng khri pad zla'i gdan la bdag cag gi ston pa sangs rgyas kyis gtso byas pa'i mchod 'os skyabs gyur gyi lha tshogs gcig kyang ma lus pa/ nam mkha' la skar tshogs bkra ba bzhin du khra me re/ bar snang la 'ja' tshon 'khyel ba bzhin du gzi brjid 'od phung nge / mig gi mthong rgyu dang lag pas 'dzin rgyu yod pa lta bur mngon sum khra lam mer bzhugs yod snyam pa'i mos pa bya'o/ /lha de rnams la dmigs nas khrus gsol byas pa'i phan yon ni/ sbyin pa'i phan yon bstan pa'i mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten nam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs la/ 'bru mar dri zhim po phul lam/ spos kyi khrus chus dbul ba phul na/ rnam par smin pa skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu thob par 'gyur ro/ /khrus kyi yo byad sbyin pa byin na rnam par smin pa tshe rabs thams cad du nad nyung ba/rigs kyi mchog tu skye zhing / kun tu mdzes pa thob par 'gyur ro gsungs/ gsal rgyal gyi mdo las/ mi rnams gang dag thub dbang mchod rten la/ /spos chu gtsang zhing dwangs pas khrus gsol ba/ /de dag lus la dri ma med pa dang / /gdungs pa med 38

cing mdog 'jam mya ngan med/ /ces dang / dpal ldan dpa' bos/ khrus gsol gang zhig mchod byed na/ /de dag rnyog pa thams cad kyi/ /dri ma dag nas thar pa thob/ /ces dang / dri zhim chu ni yid 'ong ba/ /kha dog dkar ser bye brag gis/ /yid 'ong thub pa khrus gsol 'dir/ /sems kyi dri ma spangs nas ni/ /de ni 'gro ba'i bla mar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ des na dngos su me long la gzugs brnyan 'char du bcug nas dri zhim zhing mdog mjes shin tu dwangs pa'i chus/ me long la khrus gsol zhing / yid kyis lus grangs med sprul nas lha tshogs de rnams la khrus gsol ba'i mos pa byas/ spyan 'dren khrus gsol gyi gzhung ltar rgyas par byed thub na tshe 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i rang gzhan gyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs ngan pa thams cad byang zhing dag nas/ myur du thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pas/ blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis rten khyad par can gyi mdun nas khrus gsol byed pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /lnga pa bsags sbyang gi gnad bsdus pa yan lag bdun pa phul ba'i bsod nams ni tshad med de/ dpal sbas kyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ gang zhig phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la/ /dmigs 39

nas thal mo sbyar byas te/ /phyag 'tshal de bzhin mchod byed dam/ /bsod nams dag la yi rang zhing / /sdig pa dag kyang 'chags par bgyid/ /bskul dang gsol ba 'debs 'gyur ba/ /de yi bsod nams phung po ni/ /nam mkha' gang bar rtag tu 'byung / /zhes dang / legs bshad 'phrul gyi lde'u mig las/chos kyi gnad 'gag thams cad mdor bsdus na/ /dge ba gsog cing sdig pa spong ba sogs/ /bsags sbyangs gnyis su ma 'dus chos med cing / /de yang yan lag bdun par 'dus pas na/ /'di bdun chos kyi bsdoms pa che shos yin/ /rje btsun bla ma blo bzang grags pas kyang / /'ol kha'i chos lung dgon pa la sogs par/ /yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga nar mar mdzad/ /ces dang / sems nyid ngal gso las/ 'di ni bsod nams 'bras bu tshad med de/ /chos dbyengs ji bzhin nam mkha'i dbyings kun khyab/ /ces gsungs so/ /bye brag so so'i phan yon brjod pa bdun las/ dang po phyag 'tshal ba'i phan yon ni/ 'dul ba lung las/ dge slong 'dis/ 'di ltar skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten la/ yan lag thams cad kyis phyag 'tshal te/ sems dang bar byed pa la ltos/ btsun pa de ltar lags so/ /dge slong dgadage slong 'dis ji tsam non pa'i 'og dpag tshad brgyad khri 40

bzhi stong na/ gser gyi 'khor lo la thug gi bar du bye ma ji snyed yod pa de snyed du/ dge slong 'dis 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid stong 'gyur du longs spyod par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo las/ su zhig byang chub sems kyis su/ /ston pa'i mchod rten phyag 'tshal ba/ /de ni bskal pa bye bar yang / /nam yang 'on cing 'thom mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud las/ gang gi sgo gsum btud byas nas/ /rgyal ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal na/ /de yi bsod nams 'jig rten du/ /gzugs can gyur na shong mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / mdo sde pad dkar las/ mchod rten de la gang gis thal mo sbyar/ /yongs su tshang ba'am thal mo ya gcig gam/ /yang na mgo bo skad cig 'dud pa dang / /de bzhin lan cig lus kyang 'dud pa dang / /gang gis ring bsrel gnas pa de dag la/ /g.yeng ba'i sems kyis sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal zhes/ /tshig gcig lan 'ga' brjod par byas pa yang / /de dag kun gyis byang chub mchog 'di thob gsungs/ bla ma dkon mchog gsum la dmigs nas phyag 'tshal ba gcig pus kyang mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par chos spyod mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyud las gsungs/ phyag 'tshal ba'i dus su bstod pa byas na zung 'jug 41

rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang ring min bde blag nyid du 'thob par 'gyur ste/ 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa las/ sangs rgyas kun gyis bskul ba yi/ /bstod tshig zhi ba 'di rnams kyis/ /rdo rje longs spyod bstod na ni/ /de yang sangs rgyas 'dra bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang dkyil chog nyi shu pa las/ de bzhin gshegs rnams la bstod pa/ /de la sangs rgyas rdo rje sems/ /rang nyid grogs por nges par gnas/ /zhes bla ma dang lhag pa'i lhas sdongs grogs mdzad na lam gyi rtogs pa skye sla bar gsungs/ des na dngos su phyag 'tshal zhing / yid kyis lus grangs med sprul nas phyag 'tshal ba'i mos pa dang / ngag gis bstod dbyangs gang shes 'don par bya'o/ /gnyis pa mchod pa phul ba'i phan yon ni/ dus 'khor gye rgyud las/ yon tan rgya mtsho'i bla ma la/ /dad pa'i sems kyis mchod byas na/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ni/ /tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo las/ 'jig rten dag na bde zhing skyid pa/ /de dag dkon mchog mchod las 'byung bas/ /de bas bde zhing skyid par 'dod pas/ /dkon mchog mchod la rtag tu brtson bya/ /zhes dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo las/ 'jig rten mgon po skyob pa la/ /dar gye 42

dbul ba phul byas na/ /lha yi dag dang mi rnams kyi/ /don rnams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur zhes dang / rin chen phreng ba las/ mchod rten mar me phreng ba dang / /mun khang dag tu sgon ma dang / /mar me 'bru mar sbyin pa yis/ /lha yi mig ni thob par 'gyur/ /mchod rten mchod par rol mo dang / /dril bu dag ni phul ba dang / /dung dang rnga ni rab phul bas/ /lha yi rna ba thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dam chos padma dkar po las/sangs rgyas la dmigs nas me tog gcig nam mkhar gtor na'ang / sngon gye mtha' mi mngon pa de tsam gyi bskal par 'khor ba'i tshe/ brgya byen dang 'khor los bsgyur rgyal thob pa'i mtha' mi rnyed gsungs/ sngon bram ze'i khye'u sprin gyis sangs rgyas mar me mdzad la me tog utpal lnga gtor bas/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob nas/ shing ta la bdun tsam gyi nam mkha' la 'phags so/ /de'i tshe sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyis/ bram ze'i khye'u 'di ma 'ongs pa'i dus su/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya bar 'gyur zhes lung bstan pa byung / des na bla ma dkon mchog gi sa phyogs la dngos su 'byor ba dang yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod tshogs 'bul bar bya'o/ /gsum pa bshags pa byas pa'i phan yon ni/ yum bar pa las/ gang zhig dran pa'i mod la ni/ /43

sdig pa dran pa'i 'gyod pa yin/ /bshags pas thams cad 'dzad pa ste/ /rgyal ba'i sras po phyis sdoms shig /ces dang /las rnam 'byed las/ shin tu mi zad las rnams byas pa ni/ /bdag la rnam par smod pas bsrabs par 'gyur/ /rab tu bshags dang sdom par byed pa yis/ /de dag shin tu rtsa nas bton pa bzhin/ /zhes dang / bshes spring las/ gang zhig sngon chad bag med gyur pa las/ /phyis nas bag dang ldan par gyur de yang / /zla ba sprin bral lta bur rnam mdzes te/ /dga' bo sor phreng mthong ldan bde byed bzhin/ /gsungs pa ltar gcung dga' bo chung ma la ha cang chags pa dang / sor phreng gis mi dgu brgya dang dgu bcu go dgu bsad pa dang / rgyal bu mthong ldan gyis pha bsad pa dang / khye'u bde byed kyis ma bsad pa las phyis stobs bzhi'i bshags pa byas pas dag pa dang / rgyal po ma skyes dgras mtshams med pa'i las byas pas/ phyis 'gyod tshangs drag pos bshags te/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis/gnas lugs kyi don ngo sprad pas gcig kyang ma lus par byang ngo / /de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis sdig pa gang byas rnams la gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sgo nas bla ma dkon mchog gi spyan sngar bshags sdom byas na sdig pa 'dag par 'gyur bas/ sdig 44

bshags byed pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /bzhi pa rjes su yi rang ba'i phan yon ni/ mdo sdud pa las/ mi ldog byang chub mchog tu rab tu zhugs pa yis/ /sems bskyed pa la bsam pa thag pas yi rang ba/ /stong gsum ri rab srang la gzhal bas tshad bzung rung / /rjes su yi rang dge ba de ni de lta min/ /zhes dang / rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ mi rnams gang dag dge ba'i sems ldan pas/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten gzhan gyis byas pa la/ /rjes su yi rang don de ma byas kyang / /mdor na de dag gis kyang byas par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa byams pa'i mdo las/ me tog snyim pa gang tsam mam/ mar me gcig tsam 'bul ba'am/ gzhan dag bsod nams byed pa la rjes su yi rang ba ste/dge ba 'di dag byed pa'i lha dang mi rnams kyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byams pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /rje'i rtogs brjod las/ 'bad pa chung ngus rlabs chen tshogs sdud la/ /dge la rjes su yi rang mchog tu gsungs/ /zhes dang / rje garma chags med kyis/ gzhan gyis dge ba byed pa thos pa'i tshe/ /de la phrag dog mi dge'i sems spangs nas/ /snying nas dga' bas rjes su yi rang na/ /de yi bsod nams mnyam du thob par gsungs/ /zhes dang / khri gung thang pa rin po che'i zhal nas/45

nyal bzhin dge chen zhig byed na/ /gzhan la yi rang rang bsgom dgos gsungs/ rje tā ra nā thas mdzad pa'i bzang spyod 'grel ba las/ gzhan gyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba ni/ gzhan gye dge ba bri ba yang med la/ rang gis rtsol ba med cing ma byas kyang / dge ba chen po rgyud la 'thob par 'gyur bas rmad du byung ba'i dge ba yin gsungs/ sngon rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis/sangs rgyas 'khor bcas mchod pa la dbul po des pas rjes su yi rang phul bas/ rgyal po dang mnyam pa'i nang nas kyang che ba thob par gsungs/ des na rang gi dge ba rgya chen po ma nus kyang / gzhan gyi dge ba la rab tu dga' bas rjes su yi rang byas na dge ba zhig la 'di kho nas chog par 'dug pas/ 'di la nor gyi 'gro dgos gang yang mi 'dug pas kun gyis nyin re bzhin du lag len la theb nges shig bya'o/ /lnga pa chos 'khor bskor bar bskul ba'i phan yon ni/ gtsug na rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mdzad pa la/ /gang gis gsol ba 'debs pa de/ /dbang gi rgyal po lta bu ste/ /de yi bsod nams 'ching ba 'dra/ /zhes dang / shing rta chen mo las/des ni chos spangs pa'i sgrib pa 'dag cing / tshe rabs nas tshe rabs thams cad du dam pa'i chos rgyud la 'dzin pa dang mi 46

'bral bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / myur lam las/ de ltar chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba btab pa la brten nas/ rang gis chos kyis phongs pa'i las byas pa dang / gzhan gyi chos kyi bar chad byas pa la sogs pa'i sdig pa 'dag par 'gyur ba yin gsungs/ sngon lha'i dbang po tshangs pa dang brgya byin gnyis kyis sangs rgyas la/ gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang /dung dkar g.yas 'khyil sogs phul nas chos 'khor bskor bar bskul bas bsod nams dpag tu med pa thob par gsungs/ de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas chos 'khor mi bskor bar bzhugs pa rnams la gser gyi 'khor lo dang dung dkar g.yas 'khyil sogs phul nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul bas zhal gyis bzhes nas chos 'khor kyang bskor song snyam pa'i mos pa bya/ gzhan yang dngos su yang rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams dang / gzhan gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams la chos 'khor bskor du bcug na bsod nams dpag tu med pa thob par 'gyur bas/ chos 'khor bskor bar bskul ba la brtson par bya'o/ /drug pa mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs par gsol ba btab pa'i phan yon ni/ mdo las/ nyon cig tshangs pa'i rgyal po khyod/ /bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba 'debs/ /47

bsod nams de ni khyad par 'phags/ /sangs rgyas mya ngan 'da' mi mnga'/ /zhes dang / shing rta chen mo las/ mya ngan mi 'da' bar gsol ba btab pas/ tshe thung ba dang dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba dang / gzhan gyi srog la 'tshe ba'i sdig pa byang zhing /tshe dpag tu med pa thub par 'gyur/ zhes dang / myur lam las/rang la dngos su chos legs par ston nus pa'i bla ma sogs la brtan bzhugs yang yang phul na/ rang gi tshe sgrub kyi yang mchog tu 'gyur ba yin gsungs/ sngon sangs rgyas sku mya ngan las 'da' ba la/ ded dpon zhig gis/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bskal bar bzhugs par gsol ba btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ded dpon khyod ma 'ongs pa na/ sangs rgyas snying rje can zhes bya bar 'gyur zhes lung bstan pa byung / de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i zhing na sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa rnams la g.yung drung rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gdan dang gser gyi khri sogs phul nas/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bskal ba khri phrag 'bum phrag mang po'i bar du bzhugs par gsol ba btab pas/ de ltar du zhal gyis bzhes song snyam pa'i mos pa bya/dngos su rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la 'bul ba bteg nas zhabs brtan 'bul rgyu byung na rang gi tshe sgrub kyi mchog tu 48

'gyur bas/ zhabs brtan 'bul ba la brtson par bya'o/ /bdun pa dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos pa'i phan yon ni/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ ji ltar rgya mtsho che nang chu thigs lhungs/ /rgya mtsho ma zad bar du de mi 'dzad/ /de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba yang / /byang chub ma thob bar du de mi 'dzad/ /ces dang / brgyad stong 'grel chen las/ yongs su bsngo ba ni chud ma zos pa yin te/ chos kyi dbyings dang 'dra bar zad pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / 'grel chung don gsal las/ bsngo ba yid la byed pa ni/ gser mgar gyi rgyan la sogs pa bzhin du/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi yan lag byed do/ /ces dang / slob dpon chen pos/ yang dag bsngo bas rgyas btab na/ /'gro kun rnam mkhyen sa lam sgrol gsungs/ sngon de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying po la/ rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu khyud kyis bsnyen bkur byas/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ru bcug pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med du gyur/ sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor can 'khor bcas la/rgyal po nor ldan gyis bsnyen bkur nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngos pas phyis rgyal ba byams par 'gyur bar lung bstan pa byung / de bzhin du dge ba gang byas tshad 49

rang gzhan sems can rnams myur du sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur 'dun pa drag pos bsngo bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang yan lag bdun pa las dang nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por 'gro tshul ni/ phyag gis nga rgyal gyi gnyen po dang / mchod pas ser sna'i gnyen po/bshags pas dug gsum ga'i gnyen po/ rjes su yi rang gis phrag dog gi gnyen po/ chos 'khor bskor bar bskul bas chos spong gi sdig pa 'dag brtan bzhugs kyis bla ma'i thugs dkrugs pa'i sdig pa 'dag bsngo ba log lta'i gnyen por 'gro zhes khri chen rdo rje 'chang gi sbyor ba'i chos drug nas gsungs/yang phyag nga rgyal dang / mchod pa ser sna/ bshags pa gti mugarjes su yi rang gi phrag dog chos 'khor 'dod chags/ mya ngan las mi 'da' ba log lta/ bsngo ba the tshom mam/ lung ma bstan gye gnyen por 'gro zhes mkhyen brtse rin po ches dgongs 'dus rnam bshad nas gsungs/ lam rim chen mo las/ phyag dang mchod pa dang / bskul ba dang / gsol ba gdab pa dang /yi rang dang lnga ni tshogs gsog pa yin la/ bshags pa ni 'gal rkyen sgrib pa sbyong ba dang / yi rang gi phyogs gcig rang gi dge ba byas pa la dga' ba sgom pas ni/ rang gi dge ba spel bar yang 'gyur ro/ /bsngo bas ni/ bsags pa dang sbyangs pa 50

dang spel ba'i dge ba nyung ngu yang ches mang bar spel ba dang /gnas skabs su 'bras bu phyung ste zad par 'gyur ba rnams kyang / nam yang mi zad par byed pa ste/ bsdu na/ bsags pa dang / sbyang ba dang / spel zhing mi zad par byed pa gsum du 'du'o gsungs/ de'i phyir bka' gdams gong ma rnams kyi thugs dam gyi mthil yan lag bdun pa 'di la mdzad pas/tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag nas thugs rgyud la sa lam gyi nyams rtogs khyad par can 'khrungs pa mang po byung / des na myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar 'dod pas bzang spyod sogs mdo sngags kyi gzhung ltar yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba la brtson par bya'o/ /drug pa maṇḍal phul te bla ma rnams la gsol ba btab pa'i phan yon la gnyis las/ dang po maṇḍal phul ba'i phan yon ni/thabs shes grub pa las/ maṇḍal sngon 'gro mchod par bya/ /de nas bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i/ /de nyid dam pa gegs med par/ /slob ma yis ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa'i legs bshad za ma tog las/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mchod pa yis/ /sangs rgyas la ni gang zhig 'dir/ /me tog maṇḍal 51

bcas byed pa/ /'gro ba'i bdag po tshe ring zhing / /sna tshogs nad kyi 'jigs las grol/ /gang yin de yi skad cig 'thob/ /bde gshegs maṇḍal byed de dag /pha rol phyin drug thob 'gyur te/ /chu dang sa bsres btang sbyin pa/ /grog ma sogs sel tshul khrims te/ /bsres nas nyed pa bzod pa yin/ /'bad pa byed pa brtson 'grus yin/ /skad cig de la rtse gcig tu/ /sems 'dzin byed pa bsam gtan yin/ /legs par gzob pa shes rab bo/ /sna tshogs shes rab kyis brgyan pa/ /sa gzhi bris pa 'bul byed pa/ /lha yi bde ba thams cad dang / /longs spyod mchog dang ldan 'gyur zhing / /mir skyes gser las lhag pa yi/ /kha dog dang ldan mdzes pa dang / /padma'i mdog ltar yan lag tshang / /mig ni dkyus ring mdzes par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / maṇḍal gyi mdo las/ ba lci chur bcas sbyin pa ste/ /byi dor byas pa tshul khrims yin/ /srog chags bsal ba bzod pa ste/ /brtson 'grus bya ba byed la brtson/ /bsam gtan der sems skad cig ma/ /ri mo legs 'bar shes rab bo/ /zhes dang / 'dir ni lus kyi las byas na/ /kha dog gser ltar 'gyur ba dang / /nad rnams kun las rnam par grol/ /lha dang mi las ches lhag cing / /zla ba lta bur gzi byin ldan/ /nor dang gser ni phun sum tshogs/ /rgyal 52

po'i rigs dang sangs rgyas pa/ /mchog gi khyem du skye ba nyid/ /ces dang / dgongs 'dus las/ maṇḍal tshar gcig phul ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po ni/ bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad la/ phyi nang gi mchod gsol rgya chen po byas pa las lhag pa'i bsod nams thob par 'gyur/ ci bsam pa'i don thams cad 'grub/ bskal pa nas bskal par bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung gi tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par 'gyur/ maṇḍal tshar gcig phul nas/ yid dad pas smon lam ji ltar btab pa thams cad 'bad med du 'grub/ de bas na phyi rabs kyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis maṇḍal 'bul ba la brtson par gyis shig gsungs/dpe chos rin chen spungs pa las/ da lta dad pas kun nas bslangs te maṇḍal cig phul na/ 'di nas gser gyi sa gzhi la thug pa'i bar gyi maṇḍal gyis dzi tsam non pa'i tshod kyi rdul phra rab kyi grangs ji snyed yod pa de snyed kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por skye/ zhes gsungs/ sngon rje bdag nyid chen pos/ 'ol kha chos lung nas maṇḍal grangs gsog mdzad pas lhag pa'i lha mang po'i zhal gzigs pa byung / sngon khye'u zhig gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams skyabs grong du bsod snyoms la 'byon 53

par mthong bas/ kho shin tu dad de/ sran ma spar ba gang yod pa de sangs rgyas la gtor bas bzhi lhung bzed du song / gnyis thugs gar phog pa'i bsod nams la brten nas/ khye'u de slar rgyal po spyi bo skyes zhes bya ba/ gling bzhi'i bdag po lo brgyad khri re dang / brgya byen sum cu rtsa bdun brje res kyi bar du sum rtsen pa'i rgyal srid phyed la dbang bsgyur bar gsungs/ yang khye'u lung bstan pa'i mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod du byon pa'i tshe/ khye'u zhig gis sa snyim pa gang sangs rgyas la phul bas de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal nas/ khye'u 'di bsod nams 'di la brten nas/ 'dzam bu'i gling la dbang ba'i rgyal por 'gyur zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung gi mchod rten bye ba byas nas sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro zhes bka' stsal pa ltar/ khye'u de chos rgyal mya ngan med ces bya bar gyur nas/dgung ma gcig la mchod rten bye ba zhig byas pa'i mthar sangs rgyas par gsungs/ des na bla ma dkon mchog gi sa phyogs su dmigs nas maṇḍal sogs mchod pa phran bu re 'bul rgyu byung na phan yon de lta bu 'byung bar gsungs pas/ de'i phyir maṇḍal dang de'i steng gi tshom bu rnams gtsang ma byas/ maṇḍal so bdun ma sogs maṇḍal gyi tshig rgyas bsdus gang rung la brten 54

nas/ maṇḍal 'bul ba la brtson par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la gsol ba btab pa'i phan yon ni/ sngon slob dpon lwa wa bas/ bla ma la gsol ba btab nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yi ge a'i gdams pa bsgoms pas/ nub gcig la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa byung /grub thob gling chen ras pas/ nub gcig gi tho rengs rje phag mo grub la mos gus gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba phur tshugs su btab pas/ dpal sa ra ha dang mnyam pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa khyad par can thugs la 'khrungs pa byung / chos rje gtsang ba rgya ras kyis byang thang chu med sa zhig nas bla ma la gsol ba btab nas sa brkos pas/ de ma thag sa la brlan byung / de nas chu rdol ba byung / dge bshes snyug rum pa'i rtsar nad pa zhig byung ba la/ bla ma la gsol ba btab pas nad pa de tshugs nas drag pa byung / dge bshes 'brom ston pa'i zhal nas/ngas yi dam lha la gsol ba btab pa las/ a ti sha la gsol ba btab pa byen rlabs che ba nyams myong yod gsungs/ rong chung ras pas/ rje btsun la bsgoms pa dang bla ma la gsol ba btab pa bogs gang che lags zhus pas/ rje mi la'i zhal nas/ bla ma mtshan ldan zhig la slob ma gus ldan zhig gis gsol ba btab 55

na/ sgom zhor la 'ong gsungs/ chos rje rgod tshang bas nyams len mthil bla ma'i gsol 'debs la mdzad pa la/ dge slong sangs rgyas 'od kyis gsol 'debs kyi phan yon zhus pas/'di ltar gsungs te/ gsol ba btab pa'i phan yon ni/ /spyir ni bsam gyis mi khyab lags/ /mdo tsam bsdu na 'di tsho yin/ /gsol ba btab pa'i phan yon ni/ /rje dang thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ /gsol ba btab pa'i phan yon ni/ /thun mong ma yin rtogs pa 'char/ /gsol ba btab pa'i phan yon ni/ /rgyun 'chad med pa'i nyams myong yong / /gsol ba btab pa'i phan yon ni/ /dkon mchog thugs rjes rtag tu skyongs/ /gsol ba btab pa'i phan yon ni/ /ci bsam dgos 'dod lhun gyis 'grub/ /gsol ba btab pa'i phan yon ni/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong bu bzhin gzigs gsungs/ gzhan yang bla ma'i mos gus gcig pus sa lam gyi rim pa rnams bde blag tu bgrod pa yin te/ rgyud sde lnga bcu pa las/ g.yo med mos gus zla drug gis/ /rdo rje 'chang gi sa thob 'gyur/ /bla ma'i snang ba dang ma bral na sangs rgyas rnams dang mi 'bral te/ de nyid las/ bla ma'i snang ba ma bral na/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang 'bral med gnas gsungs/ gsang 'dus 'bum rgyud las/ bla ma la gus slob ma 56

yis/ /sgra ring ba dang gsal ba dang / /skad gseng mthon pos gsol 'debs na/ /de la bdag gis dngos grub ster/ /zhes dang / sa ra has/ bla ma'i smras pa gang gi snying zhugs pa/ /lag pa'i mthil du gnas pa'i gter mthong 'dra/ /zhes dang /brtags gnyis las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes/ /gang du yang ni mi rnyed de/ /bla ma'i dus thabs bstan pa dang / /rang gi bsod nams las shes bya/ /zhes dang / rim lnga las/ ri dbang rtse nas gang zhig lhung gyur na/ /ltung bar mi 'gyur snyam yang ltung bar 'gyur/ /bla ma'i drin gyes phan pa'i lung thob na/ /grol bar mi bya snyam yang grol bar 'gyur gsungs/ des na dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi gsol 'debs gang shes rgyas par bton nas rjes su yon tan gzhi gyur ma yang 'don par bya'o/ /mdor bsdu na/ chu mgo gangs la thug pa ji bzhin/ /dam pa'i chos kyi brgyud pa'i thug sa/ /bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa sangs rgyas/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shig /byen rlabs stsol ba'i rtsa brgyud bla ma/ /dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha tshogs/ /bar chad sel ba'i mkha' 'gro chos skyong / /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shig /sngon byon sangs rgyas rnams kyis ma thul/ /da bar lus pa'i rang gzhan rgyud kyi/ /57

phyin ci log gi blo sna mtha' dag /gtan nas 'gag par byen gyis rlobs shig /phyin ci ma log blo sna mtha' dag /rgyud la skye bar byin gyes rlobs shig /phyi dang nang gi bar du gcod pa'i/ /tshogs rnams zhi bar byin gyis rlobs shig /ces mos gus gdungs shugs drag pos gsol ba btab na byen rlabs dngos grub thams cad bum pa gang byo'i tshul du thob par 'gyur ro/ /spras pa/ thugs kyi dgongs pa nam mkha'i khyon ltar yangs/ /thugs rje nyi ltar gsal ba'i bla ma rje/ /thugs sras bdag gi spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres par byen gyis rlobs/ /skyabs mgon khyod kyi thugs rje la brten nas/ /thob pa'i chos gzhan phan yon phar la zhog /sbyor ba'i chos drug tsam gyi phan yon yang / /bsam na sems la dga' spro 'char bar gda'/ /phyag dar byas na rang gzhan sems dwangs shing / /lha rnams dga' zhing mdzes pa'i dge rtsa gsog /phyi mar mtho ris 'jig rten lha rnams su/ /skye zhes phal po che yi mdo las gsungs/ /mar me me tog utpal la sogs pas/ /mchod na ma 'ongs byams pa sangs rgyas tshe/ /drung du skye zhing dang po'i chos thos par/ /'gyur zhes 'phags pa byams pa'i mdo las gsungs/ /lus bsrang bsam pa bzang po'i skyabs 'gro dang / /58

sems bskyed tshad med bzhi po bsgom nus na/ /gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang 'thob par mdo rgyud kun nas gsungs/ /gang zhig rgyal ba yid la byed pa de'i/ /mdun du bzhugs te byin gyes rlobs par byed/ /nyes pa kun las rnam par grol nges zhes/ /'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i mdo las gsungs/ /gang zhig phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la dmigs nas/ /yan lag bdun pa phul ba'i phan yon ni/ /nam mkha' gang bar 'byung zhes dpal sbas kyis/ /zhus pa'i mdo las gsungs pa ngo mtshar che/ /bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs nus na/ /thugs yid gcig 'dres nyams rtogs yon tan 'char/ /ci bsam dgos 'dod lhun gyes 'grub bo zhes/ /mnyam med chos rje rgod tshang pa yis gsungs/ /de phyir chos gzhan mang po ma nus kyang / /sbyor ba'i chos drug 'di la 'bad nus na/ /mngon mtho nges legs go 'phang gang yin yang / /bde blag nyid du thob par gdon mi za/ /zhes pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i nyams len la/ lam rim/ blo sbyong /bskyed rdzogs/ phyag chen/ rdzogs chen/ do ha sogs mdo sngags chos kyi snying po rnams gang nyams su len kyang de dag gi phan 59

yon rnams/ rang rang gi gzhung na gsal bas 'dir mi spro la/mdor bsdus shig brjod na/ de lta bu'i lam gang nyams su blangs kyang / gnas skabs su zhi rgyas dbang drag grub chen brgyad la sogs pa'i thun mong gi dngos grub thob nas bde zhing skyid la/ mthar thug thob bya bla na med pa mchog gi dngos grub sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob nas/ rang gzhan gyi don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa mjug tu bya ba la bsngo ba dang smon lam gnyis las/dang po bsngo ba byas pa'i phan yon ni/ bsod nams dam pa'i mdo las/ mi lus thob pa'i dus 'dir dge ba chung ngu nas bsags dgos/ de yang bsngo dgos/ ma bsngos pa'i rdzas rnams ni bye tshan la chu thigs brgyab na myur du skam pa dang 'dra/ bsngo ba byas pa'i phan yon ni/ rgya mtsho chen por chu thigs shig blugs na de mi zad cing slar 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang 'dra gsungs/dwags po lha rjes/ sngon byang chub snying po ma thob pa/ /rgyu bar ma do ru chud zos pa/ /gnad bsngo ba ma shes gcig pus lan/ /de bas bsngo ba 'di la nan tan mdzod/ /ces dang / 'bri gung 'gro mgon gyis/ tshogs gnyis yid bzhin gyi nor bu la/ /bsngo smon gyis byi dor ma byas na/ /dgos 'dod kyi 'bras bu mi 'byung 60

bas/ /rjes bsngo ba 'di la nan tan mdzod/ /ces dang / chos rje gtsang ba rgya ras kyis/ sbyin pa longs spyod kyi rta pho la/ /bsngo ba srab kyis kha bsgyur na/ /rang gang 'dod kyi sa der slebs pa yin gsungs/ sngon de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po la/ 'khor los bsgyur rgyal nam mkhas/ bsnyen bkur byas dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos pas/ rjes su rje btsun 'jam dbyangs su gyur/ sngon dbul mo gnyen dga' mos/ gyo ral zhig gi nang du mar me chung ngu zhig sbar nas/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar phul nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis skye dgu'i tshe lo brgya thub pa na 'jig rten du ston pa shākya thub pa de bzhin du/ bdag kyang 'gyur bar shog ces smon lam btab pas/ sangs rgyas kyis kun dga' bo la/ bu mo 'di ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ sangs rgyas mar me'i 'od ces bya ba dbang bcu dang ldan par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa byung / dge ba gang du bsngo ba ni/ yum bar ba las/ rab 'byor dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa kho nar bsngo bar bya'o/ /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang /de gzhan gyi sar bsngo bar mi bya ste gsungs/ ji ltar bsngo na de nyid las/ rab 'byor chos thams cad rmi lam lta bu/ sgyu ma lta bu/dge ba yang rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu'i tshul gyis yongs su bsngo 61

bar bya ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dge ba rmi lam lta bu/ gsog pa po rmi lam lta bu/ len pa po rmi lam lta bu/ snang tshul ma 'gag pa/ don du bden par mi 'dzin pa dag la/ 'khor gsum yongs dag gi bsngo ba zer gsungs/ gnyis pa smon lam btab pa'i phan yon ni/ 'jam dpal zhing gi yon tan bkod pa las/chos rnams thams cad rkyen bzhin te/ /'dun pa'i rtsa la rab tu gnas/ /gang gis smon lam ci btab pa/ /de ni de bzhin nyid du 'grub/ /ces dang / de bzhin du 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ chos rnams thams cad rkyen bzhin te/ /'dun pa'i rtsa la rab tu gnas/ /gang gis smon lam ci btab pa/ /de 'dra'i 'bras bu smin par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dgongs 'dus las/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rten drung du/ /bsam 'dun dag pas tshogs bsags shing / /smon lam rgya chen gdab par bya/ /de yi yon tan brjod las 'das/ /gsungs/ sngon sangs rgyas 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal po'i drung du/ dge slong chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes bya bas/ rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams bzung ba ji bzhin bdag kyang smon lam 'debs kyis 'grub par gyur cig ces brjod pas/ bde ba can gyi zhing khams grub par gyur/ sngon padma'i mig gis/ sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten la 62

rin po che mthon ka gcig phul bas/ bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig gi bar du 'byor pa che bar gyur/ 'bras bu thob pa'i sgon lam btab pas dgra bcom par gyur/ de yang rgyal sras kyi smon lam thams cad smon lam chen po grangs med pa 'bum phrag bcur 'dus la/ de thams cad bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gye rgyal po 'dir 'dus pas/ bzang spyod smon lam tshar gcig bton na bsod nams 'bum phrag bcu thob par gsungs/ de la dgongs nas lo chen bai ro'i rnam 'phrul g.yag sde paṇa che na la/ bya bral ba zhig gis/ gzhungs rag gong rdo rjes/ gung thang me tog mchod pa lan bcu tsam bsgrub gda' ba/ 'di kun bsod nams che bar gleng gi 'dug lags zhus pas/ paṇa chen gyi zhal nas/ de 'dra'i bsod nams las kho bos bzang spyod tshar gcig bton nas nyal ba bsod nams che zhing dka' las chung gsungs/ des na smon lam la 'don thub na bzang spyod smon lam 'di kho nas chog par gda'/ bsngo ba smon lam gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ bsngo ba la bsngo bya'i rdzas de nyid khyad par gyi gzhir bzung nas/ de'i stobs kyis 'di dang 'di lta bur gyur cig ces smon pa zhig dgos/ smon lam la bsngo ba'i rdzas med kyang / 'dod bya'i 'bras bu la don gnyer gyi 'dun pas smon 63

lam 'debs pa yin te/ bu ston rin po ches/ bsngo ba smon lam gyi khyad par/ rgyu la brten nas 'bras bu 'di 'dra zhig tu gyur cig ces rgyu sngon du byas nas 'bras bu la smon pa bsngo ba yin/rgyu sngon du byas kyang rung / ma byas kyang rung / 'bras bu 'di lta bur gyur ces pa smon lam yin/ bsngo ba gang yin smon lam yin/smon laloyin tshad la bsngo ba yin pa'i ma khyab po gsungs/kun mkhyen klong chen pas/ rgyu dge ba sngon du song nas smon pas bsdoms pa ni bsngo ba/ rgyu dge ba ma song bar smon pa ni smon lam mo zhes gsungs/ yang gtsang chung chos grags sogs kyis/gang gi bsngo ba'i rgyal po 'di thos nas/ /zhes sogs la brten te bsngo smon gnyis don gcig par 'dod/ khri gung thang ba rin po ches/ bstan 'bar 'di bsngo smon gnyis gar 'jog dgos par mngon no gsungs/ gzhan yang bu mo dpal phreng gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed gang lags pa de thams cad kyang / 'di ltar dam pa'i chos yongs su bzung ba'i smon lam chen po'i khongs su 'dus shing / khongs su chud de/ bcom ldan 'das dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa ni/ de ltar yul che ba lags so/ /zhes dang / bcom ldan 'das dam pa'i chos yongs 64

su 'dzin pa ni/ chos kyi sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong sdud pa lags so gsungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i gsang ba'i mdo las/dam chos 'dzin pa'i bsod nams ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyes nan tan du/ /bskal pa bye bar brjod mdzad kyang / /mtha' ru phyin par 'gyur ma lags/ /zhes sogs phan yon tshad las 'das pa yod pa la dgongs nas/ rje bdag nyid chen pos kyang /rgyal sras smon lam gaṅgā'i klung rnams ni/ /dam chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam nang 'dus par/ /gsungs phyir dge rtsa ji snyed bsags pa ni/ /kun kyang thub bstan rgyas pa'i rgyu ru bsngos/ /gsungs/ lam rim chen mo las/ mjug tu ji ltar bya ba ni/bsags pa'i dge ba rnams/ bzang po spyod pa dang / smon lam bdun cu pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi smon gnas rnams su 'dun pa drag pos bsngo bar bya'o gsungs pa ltar/ bsngo ba'i nang du smon lam 'du bar byas te/deng sang yongs grags bla ma rnams kyis bsngo ba gnang ba ltar byas na phun sum tshogs par 'gyur bas de ltar bya'o/ /bzhi pa thun mtshams rnams su ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa la/sātstsha/ kha ton/ phyag bskor gtor ma dang lnga las/ dang po mnyam med jo bo rje'i rnam thar ltar/ sku 'dra dang sātstsha'i par btab 65

pa'i phan yon ni/ gsal rgyal la tshigs su bcad pa las/bcom ldan 'das kyi mchod rten rnams dang ni/ /sku gzugs rnams la rdul phran ci song ba/ /de yi grangs snyed de byed mi rnams kyis/ /lha yul sa steng nges par rgyal srid 'thob/ /gzugs dang gzugs med khams kyi ting 'dzin dang / /phun sum tshogs pa'i mchog kun rab myong nas/ /tha mar skye dang rga la sogs pa yis/ /sdug bsngal med pa'i sangs rgyas— —go 'phang 'thob/ /su dag 'dir ni rgyal ba'i gzugs byed pa/ /de yi lus ni dri ma med pa dang / /padma'i snying po lta bur 'jam zhing yang / /nad dang mya ngan sdug bsngal 'jigs las thar/ /zhes dang / su dag 'jig rten mgon po'i gzugs byed pa/ /bran du mi skye mngags gzhug skye mi 'gyur/ /dbul por mi 'gyur rigs dman mi skye zhing / /dbang po rnams kyang nyams par yongs mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / mdo sde padma dkar po las/ skyes bu dag gam 'on te gzhon nu'ang rung / /rtsed mo dga' dang gseng ba byed pa na/ /rtsig ngos sen mo shing bus sku gzugs bris/ /de dag thams cad byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / sa dang so phag las ni brtsigs pa yi/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten dga' bzhin byas pa yi/ /byis pa'i rtsed mo de dang de dag tu/ /gang gi 66

rgyal ba de bzhin mchod rten dag /bye ma la ni phung por byas pa yi/ /de rnams kyis kyang byang chub 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang /ro nye dang ni lcags sam sa yang rung / /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi gzugs byas te/ /blta na sdug pa 'jim pa'i las byed bcug /de dag thams cad byang chub 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / mya ngan 'das pa chen po'i mdo las/ rtag tu dga' ba'i sems bsgyed de/ /sangs rgyas gzugs sam rten kyang rung / /mje bong tsam zhig gang byas pa/ /mi g.yo'i zhing der skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ bde gshegs sku gzugs rten 'brel snying po can/ /sdig pa 'dag phyir rtag tu gdab par bya/ /zhes dang / rmad du byung ba'i mdo las rgyas par gsungs pa rnams bsdus te bshad na/ 'dzam bu'i gling / dpag tshad bdun stong yod pa dang / lus 'phags po'i gling dpag tshad brgyad stong yod pa dang / ba lang spyod dpag tshad dgu stong pa dang / sgra mi snyan dpag tshad stong phrag bcu pa dang / lha'i dbang po'i khang bzang rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal byed dang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams/ rin po che sna bdun gye rang bzhin du byas te/dad pas rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/67

rgyun du zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams dang / phyir mi 'ong ba rnams dang / dgra bcom pa rnams dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams dang phyogs bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams la phul ba bas/ gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i mchod rten 'jim pa las skyu ru ra tsam byas la/ khab tsam gyi srog shing btsugs te rgya shug gi lo ma tsam gyi gdugs gsol nas 'bru tsam gyi sku gzugs byas la yungs 'bru tsam gye ring bsrel bcug na de ni de bas bsod nams che'o zhes nga smra'o gsungs/ rje btsun ta ra nā tha'i zhal nas/ gzhan sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku gzugs bzhengs pa sangs rgyas dang 'phags mchog rnams kyi bka'i glegs bam 'dri ba/ chos sku'i mchod rten bzhengs pa/ mdo rgyud dang theg chen 'phags pa'i gsung la thos bsam byed pa/ yi dam gyi lha bsgoms pa/ gzungs sngags zab mo bzla ba/ tha na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs sogs la blta zhing phyag mchod byed pa rnams 'dus byas kyi dge ba ste/ che chung gang byed kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dang / chos kyi sku la dmigs pa yin pa'i phyir/ nges 'byung snying rje stong nyid sogs kyis zin na ha cang che/ ma zin kyang dus 68

lan cig mi ring bar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu grung po 'chug pa med pa yin/ mu stegs byed tsho yang byed pa po/ pa ra me shwa ra'i sku gzugs shig bzhengs na bsod nams stong phrag bcu 'thob zer na/ sangs rgyas byang sems rten gsum bzhengs pa la yon tan mtha' ci yod/ khong mu stegs pa'i grwa pa phal pa tsho yang dad pa de tsam yod na/ rang re bod kyi nang ba'i dge bshes tsho la'ang kha bshad kho na ma gtogs/ lag len du dad pa btsal yang mi rnyed pa 'di 'dra yi re mug gsungs/ khyad par bla ma'i 'dra sku bzhengs pa'i phan yon ni/ a ti bkod pa chen po las/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad kyi/ /gser dngul la sogs rgyu las ni/ /sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa yi/ /sku gzugs grangs med byas pa bas/ /bla ma'i sku 'bag sus bris pa/ /'di ni bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ /brgya stong khri 'bum char mi phod/ /gang gi bla ma'i sku 'bag la/ /mchod cing bstod pa sus byas pa/ /rdo rje 'chang la bskal pa brgyar/ /mchod cing bstod las bsod nams che/ /'bum phrag sum cu rtsa lnga yang / /phod cing mnyam pa ma yin no gsungs/ bla ma gong ma'i gsungs las/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gzugs bzhengs pa las/ bla ma'i sku 'dra gcig 69
