bzhengs pa phan yon che/ rdo rje 'chang la bskal pa brgya'i bar mchod pa phul pa las/ bla ma'i sku 'dra'i mdun du mchod pa lan cig phul ba bsod nams che zhes gsungs/ des na tshegs chung don che ba'i sku 'dra dang / sātstsha'i par 'debs pa la brtson par bya'o/ /gnyis pa kha ton byas pa'i phan yon ni/ rgyal ba byams pas/yi ge 'dri mchod sbyin pa dang / /nyan dang klog dang len pa dang / /'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang / /de sems pa dang bsgoms pa ste/ /spyod pa 'di bcu'i bdag nyid kyi/ /bsod nams phung po gzhal du med/ /ces dang / sgo mtha' yas bsgrub pa'i gzungs las/ mdo sde thos nas rjes su yi rang dang / /yi ger bris dang gzung dang bklags pa yi/ /bsod nams phung po ci tsam bskyed pa ni/ /sems can kun gyis shes par yongs mi nus/ /de ni tshe rabs kun tu rgyal ba mthong / /de dag la yang dad pa bsam yas rnyed/ /mdo sde zab mo'i tshul yang shes par 'gyur/ /de ni myur du byang chub mchog 'tshang rgya/ /zhes dang /sdud pa las/ la las gaṅgā'i klung gi ji snyed zhing rnams na/ /sems can ji snyed 'khod kun dgra bcom gyis btul bas/ /gang gi shes rab pha rol phyin 'di yig bris te/ /sems can 70

mchog la bklags byen bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ /zhes dang / bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ de bzhin shrī te ru ga'i/ /mtshan gyis sdig pa 'jig par 'gyur/ /bsam gtan bsam pa tsam gyis sam/ /klog cing kha ton bris pa yis/ /mtho ris longs spyod thob 'gyur la/ /yang na 'khor los bsgyur ba 'thob/ /zhes dang /snying rje pad dkar las/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus lnga brgya pa na/ tha na bris te 'chang bar byed na/ de'i bsod nams ches mang du bskyed par 'gyur gyi/ byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bskal pa chen po bcu'i bar du pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po de ltar ma yin no gsungs/ sngon dge bsnyen sa lu ljang ba zhes bya bas rab tu dad pas rgyal ba'i gsung rab klog pa dang kha ton byas pas sangs rgyas par gsungs/ des na sman bla ltung bshags rdor gcod/ 'jam sdud bzang gsum/ sgol ma gdugs sher/ tshe gzungs ma ṇi dmigs brtse ma badzra gu ru yig brgya sogs kha ton bzlas brjod gang shes la 'bad par bya'o/ /gsum pa phyag 'tshal ba'i phan yon ni/ las rnam par 'byed pa'i mdo las/ bram ze'i khye'u ne tso la bka' stsal pa/bram ze'i khye'u de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la thal mo 71

sbyar ba'i phan yon la bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ rgyal po chen po'i khyem du skye ba 'thob pa dang / rgya che ba'i gzugs dang / rgya che ba'i g.yog 'khor dang / rgya che ba'i mchod pa dang bkur sti dang / rgya che ba'i nor dang / rgya che ba'i thos pa dang / rgya che ba'i dad pa dang / rgya che ba'i dran pa dang / rgya che ba'i shes rab dang /rgya che ba'i rtogs pa 'thob ste/ de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la thal mo sbyar ba'i phan yon no/ /phyag 'tshal ba'i phan yon la bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ gzugs bzang la mdog gser gyi kha dog lta bur 'gyur ba dang / mdzes shing mig tu sdug par 'gyur ba dang / skad snyan zhing smra ba snyan par bzung ba'i tshig tu 'gyur pa dang / bag tsha ba med par 'khor gyi nang du 'gro ba dang / lha dang mi rnams dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / gzi brjid chen por 'gyur ba dang / gang zag ni 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi nyan thos rnams dang 'grogs par 'gyur ba dang / mtho ris su skye bar 'gyur ba dang / myur du yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba ste/ de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la phyag 'tshal ba'i phan yon no gsungs/ sman mdo brgyad brgya pa las/ bcom ldan 'das de 72

bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūrya'i 'od la phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa sna tshogs byed na/ de dag ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal med par shes par bya'o/ /zhes dang / mkhas mchog dpa' bos/ 'khor los sgyur rgyal stobs grags ldan/ /yan lag sum cu gnyis mtshan ldan/ /rgyal gyur sa steng gtso bo ste/ /sangs rgyas la ni phyag byas pa'i/ /'bras bu yin par blo ldan gsungs/ /de ltar yon tan tshogs shes pas/ /lus ni 'jig par shes nas ni/ /mkhas pas sangs rgyas phyag bya zhing / /lus kyi las ni legs par spyad/ /phyag gcig 'tshal bar gyur pa yis/ /'khor ba spong ba'i rgyu 'thob cing / /'khor ba'i 'jigs mthong gus pa yis/ /de ltar su zhig phyag mi byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar phyag 'tshal ba'i phan yon rnams dran bzhin bla ma dkon mchog la rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal ba la 'bad par bya'o/ /bzhi pa bskor ba byas pa'i phan yon ni/ gsal rgyal la gdams pa'i mdo las/ su zhig dad pas thub pa'i mchod rten nam/ /sku gzugs dag la bskor ba byed pa dag /phyi ma'i tshe na dgra chen rnams kyis btud/ /bzang po'i snod gyur yon tan rnams dang ldan/ /zhes dang / mchod rten bskor ba'i mdo las/mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /rin chen sna bdun ldan pa 73

yi/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po ste/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar byed/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /'jig rten dag tu de bzhin gshegs/ /mtshan rnams kyis ni brgyan pa dang / /gser gyi sku mchog thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo las/ 'jig rten mgon gyi mchod rten la/ /mi gang bskor ba byed pa yi/ /bsngags pa bskal pa bye bar yang / /brjod pas zad par byed mi nus/ /zhes dang / mchod rten brtsegs pa'i rgyud las/ gang zhig mchod rten bzhengs pa dang / /phyag mchod bskor ba byed pa dag /ngan song gsum las yongs grol te/ /bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/de dag rnams la dgongs nas sngon jo bo rjes dus rgyun du bskor ba mdzad pa la/ dge bshes 'brom rin po ches/ dge sbyor bzhugs nas mi mdzad par skor ba nyi tshe mdzad pa ji ltar lags zhus pas/ khyod kyis ma go ba yin/ 'di la lus ngag yid gsum ga'i las yod pa yin/ bsgom pa la gcig las med/'di las 'khos che ba med gsungs pa dang / yang 'dus byas kyi dge rtsa la skor ba las bsod nams che ba med/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi las gsum gas bskor ba yin/ rgya gar na grong khyer chen po la bskor ba byas pas dngos grub thob pa dang / gtsug 74

lag khang la bskor ba byas pas dngos grub thob pa dang / kha sar pa ṇi'i lha khang la bskor ba byas pas dngos grub thob cing /nad gsos pa sogs kyi gtam rgyud mang po yod gsungs/ de'i stabs kyis 'brom rin po che yang rgyun du bskor ba mdzad ces bka' gdams gong ma'i gsung bgros las byung / des na bskor ba byas pa'i phan yon rnams bsam nas sku gsung thugs rten dang / bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la bskor ba byed pa la brtson par bya'o/ /lnga pa gtor ma btang ba'i phan yon ni/ rnal 'byor nam mkha'i mtshan can gyis mdzad pa'i phyag chen gsal ba'i phreng ba las/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas/ 'di'i phan yon ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ mdor na tshe ring ba dang / nad med pa dang /stobs che ba dang / gzi brjid che ba dang / longs spyod 'phel ba dang / sdig pa dag cing tshogs/ rdzogs pa dang / bsam pa yid bzhin du 'grub cing / mi dang mi ma yin pa'i bar chad mi 'byung ba dang / mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pas/yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'di yi dam du gyis la thongs shig gsungs so/ /des na sems bskyed bzang po'i sgo nas/dngos gzhi yi dwags sogs la dmigs nas gtor ma brgya rtsa 75

sogs btang rjes su bsngo smon bya'o/ /de ltar byas na gtor ma btang ba 'di kho nas chog par gda'/ yang yi dwags la chu sbyin btang ba'i phan yon ni/ bar chad kyis mi tshugs pa dang /mdangs nyams pa rnams sos par byed pa dang / 'di ni gzhan la spel na/ rgyud grol nas yi dwags kyi rgyun bcad de/ mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so gsungs/ de la rgyu chen po ni mi dgos/ dka' las ni med/ rang re rnams chu dang nam phrad pa dang / nam khom pa'i dus su btang 'tshal/ gzhan yang zag pa rgyun gyi gtor ma zhes bya ba ni/ rang gi lus kyi mi gtsang ba thams cad yi dwags la bsngo ba yin te/ lud pa 'bor ba'i dus su/ oṃ kṣe kre a ha re bhya swā hā/ de za ba rnams tshim zhing rgyas par sdug bsngal dang bral zhing bde ba dang ldan nas myur du bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par gyur cig /ces brjod la se gol brdab po/ /de thams cad 'og ma kun la 'gre'o/ /snabs 'dor ba'i dus su/ /oṃ na ga sing ga a ha re bhya swā hā/ mchil ma 'dor ba la/ oṃ kla sa ma a ha re bhya swā hā/ dri chu la/ oṃ nu tra a ha re bhya swā hā/ dri chen la/ oṃ bha ta a ha re bhya swā hā/ lus kyi dri ma la/ oṃ la ma a ha re bhya swā hā/ zas kyi lhag ma la/ o u tsi ta a ha re bhya swā hā/ zhes 'byung bo rnams la sbyin pa btang bar bya'o/ /'di 76

rnams dus rgyun du ma brjed par btang na dge 'dun pa khri tsho re la chos ston drangs pa dang bsod nams mnyam par mi g.yo ba'i rgyud las gsungs so/ /bla ma rdo rje gdan pas rgyud nas phyung te ba ri lo tsās bod du bsgyur ba yin skad/ de ltar bsod nams kyi tshogs ni chung ngu nas gsog dgos/ 'o skol rnams kyis bsod nams chen po ni mi 'grub/ dka' las chung zhing las sla ba 'di 'dra la yid mi ches par/ de lta bu la bsod nams ci yang 'ong dgos med zer nas khyad du gsod pa dag 'ong bar gda' ste/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung la dzun mi mchis pas yid ches par byas nas nyams su len 'tshal/ da lta dar cig skyid pa yang snga ma'i las legs pa zhig gi 'bras bu yin te/dar cig sdug pa'ang snga ma'i las mi dge ba zhig gi 'bras bu yin par gsungs te/ des na phyi mar rang re bde zhing skyid par 'dod na/ da lta sdig pa phra zhing phra ba nas 'dzem pa dang / dge ba phra zhing phra ba nas gsog dgos/ de ltar byed pa'i mi rnams tshe rabs kun tu bde zhing skyid par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /des na gtor ma btang ba'i phan yon rnams bsam nas/ brgya rtsa dang chu sbyin zag pa rgyun gtor rnams nyin re bzhin du ma chags par gtong ba la brtson par bya'o/ /nyal ba'i tshe ji ltar 77

bya ba ni/ glo g.yas sa la phab ste rkang pa g.yon pa g.yas pa'i steng du bzhag nas seng ge ltar nyal la/ sang nyin yang snga bar langs nas dge sbyor la brtson par bya snyam du dge sems khyad par can gyi ngang nas gnyid log par bya'o/ /de ltar nyal na log 'dren gyis gnod par mi nus shing nyon mongs pas kyang mi brdzi ba dang / byang chub kyi sems skye ba sogs phan yon shin tu che bar gsungs so/ /da ni mjug bsdu ba ni/ kun mkhyen 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos khri gung thang rin po ches/ kha cig phyag mchod bskor ba la sogs pa 'di dag chos zab mo nyams su len mi shes pa'i phal pa rnams la bsngags pa yin gyis/ blo'i nus pa shin tu che ba rnams la 'di mi dgos snyam pa gtan nas mi rung ste/ mdo sde sa bcu pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang rim gro bya ba 'od shin tu gsal ba zhes bya ba byed de/ mchod pa dang rim gro byed pa de sems dang po bskyed pa yan chad/ sa dgu pa 'thob pa'i bar dag gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang rim gro byas pa'i brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro zhes sogs kyis gong ma gong ma'i skabs su lus ngag gi dge sbyor yang ches gong 'phel du 'gro bar gsungs shing / byang sa las/78

byang chub sems dpa' de de bzhin gshegs pa'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la na bza' dang zhal zas dang /gzims chas dang / bsnyun gyi gsos sman dang / yo byad dang /gus par smra ba dang / phyag 'tshal ba dang / sngon du ldang ba dang /thal mo sbyar ba dang zhes pa nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i mchod pa rnam pa bdun rgya chen po zhes bya'o/ /zhes sogs phyag mchod bskor ba sogs rgyal sras kyi nyams len rmad du byung bar gsungs so/ /la la rgyud kyi rdo rje'i tshig 'ga' zhig gi dgongs pa ma phyed par gsang sngags pas 'di 'dra mi dgos par smra ba yang log par rtog pa yin te/ rje mi las/ nga res 'ga' 'gro zhing 'gro zhing bsgom/ /'gro zhing 'gro zhing bsgoms tsa na/ /'gro 'dug bskor par shes pa'i gdams ngag yod/ /ces gsungs pa lta bu grub chen gong ma'i gsungs tshul dang lo rgyus mang du yod la/ ma hā ra ta zhes sogs kyi sngags don ltar/ sngags rang lam la skor ba byed tshul thun mong pa las kyang ches zab tu btang nas byed dgos pa yin no gsungs/ de ltar phyag mchod bskor ba sogs kyi dge ba'i cha shas phra mo re la yang phan yon mtha' yas pa de lta bu 'byung ba ni/ mngon pa kun btus su/bsam gyis mi khyab kyi gnas bzhi gsungs pa las/ las dang 79

'bras bu'i 'brel ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa de nyid yin pas/ skye bo blo gros mchog tu gyur pa'i dbang rnon rnams/ chos nyid kyi rigs pa'i sgo nas legs par nges pa drangs te/ chos kyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i dad pa phyir mi ldog pa bskyed na/ byen rlabs dang dngos grub shin tu myur ro/ /'on kyang dbang po rnon po par rlom pa rigs lam 'char rkyen pa ltar snang yang / don gyi gting mi dpogs par/ rtog ge'i rig pa ltar snang du mas g.yengs te/ zab mo'i chos la yid mi ches pa ni/ rgyan gyi 'grel pa rnams su/ spobs pa myur ba'i sbyor skyon bshad pa bzhin du/shes rab 'chal byed dang / dngos grub kyi gegs yin pas/ de las dbang po rtul po'i lugs kyi yid ches pa'i lung gi rjes su 'brang ste/ dad pa bskyed na byen rlabs myur te/ gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud rtog pa gsum pa las/ chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /don la the tshom med pa yi/ /mkhas pa la ni dngos grub myur/ /yang na blun po dad pa brtan/ /de la sbyor ba'i dngos grub nye/ /rtog cing dpyod pa'i rtog ge pa/ /de la sbyor ba'i dngos grub ring / /zhes dang / ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ ri dang nags bcas sa 'di gas 'gyur zhing / /rgya mtsho'i chu dag de bzhin 'pho 'gyur la/ /zla ba nyi ma sa la lhung gyur kyang / /rgyal 80

bas bshad pa rnam pa gzhan mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin rgyal ba'i bka' dri ma med pa rnams nas lan cig ma yin par yang dang yang du gsungs pa rnams la the tshom med pa'i dad pa rtse gcig tu bskyed de/ des kun nas bslangs pa'i phyag dang mchod pa gsol 'debs bzlas brjod bskor ba sogs la 'bad na/ ji skad du rgyal dbang bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtshos/gnas skabs mthar thug don gnyis mu ltika /'bad med ster ba'i legs byas skor ba'i las/ /dge tshogs rnam dkar nya lcebs khog yangs por/ /bkang ba'i 'gro rnams 'di dang phyi mar 'tshengs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'di phyi kun gyi legs tshogs ma lus par lhun gyis grub pa zhig 'byung ngo zhes/ mchod rten dkar chag lha'i rnga bo che las gsungs so/ /mdor na chos dge ba'i phan yon rnams bsams nas/ sngar rang gi dge ba gang byas pa rnams la dga' ba bsgom zhing / phyin chad byed 'dod kyi blo rgya bskyed cing / 'phral du nyin re bzhin du lag len la ci thebs byas nas/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che thob pa dam pa'i chos kyi sgo nas don dang ldan pa zhig bya'o/ /smras pa/ bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis/ /slob ma yon bdag yongs la thugs rje gzigs/ /rnal 'byor mgo 81

dkar tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /da dung so dkar dus bzhin glu dbyangs len/ /sngon tshe bsod nams dpag med bsags lags pas/ /da lta dal 'byor mi lus rin chen thob/ /rin chen gser gyi gling du phyin pa bzhin/ /mdo sngags chos dang mjal ba skal pa bzang / /bsam pa bzang po byang chub sems kyi sgos/ /tshogs gsog re re byas pa'i phan yon yang / /gzugs su grub rgyu lta bu zhig yin na/ /sa dang bar snang nam mkhar shong mi 'gyur/ /de la dgongs nas gser khang rdo rje 'chang / /yab sras rnams kyis bla ma gser gling pa/ /jo bo bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong mdzad la rjes yi rang / /mdo sngags chos kyi nyams len byed pa la/ /sbyor dngos rjes gsum thun mtshams bya ba rnams/ /shes nas de bzhin nyams su blangs gyur na/ /nyams len phun sum tshogs pas ngo mtshar che/ /de phyir nam 'chi cha med tshul bsams nas/ /myur du sangs rgyas go 'phang thob 'dod pa'i/ /skal bzang las can skye bo pho mo rnams/ /'di ltar mdzod ces yang yang thal mo sbyor/ /gser gyi ri la brten pa'i 'dab chags rnams/ /kha dog ser po gser du snang ba bzhin/ /gdams ngag 'di la brten pa'i gang zag kyang / /gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas 82

'gyur/ /rin chen gser gyi ri bdun nam gnas par/ /gdams ngag 'di yang mi nyams sa steng 'dir/ /gnas nas phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa dang / /ma gyur 'gro ba yongs la phan par shog /rgyal ba yab sras sku tshe rab brtan cing / /rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs bcur dar zhing rgyas/ /rgyal blon sde rnams tshe bsod snyan grags rgyas/ /rgyal khams bde zhing skyid pa'i bkra shis shog /ces rang gzhan thams cad 'tshengs pa'i gdams ngag gser gyi ri bo zhes bya ba 'di ni/ snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon rtsa ba'i bla ma gser khang rdo rje 'chang yab sras kyis/ sbyor ba'i chos drug ltar mchod 'bul sogs tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong mdzad cing / gzhan grong dgon rnams la yang mchod pa'i srol chen po btsugs pa la rab tu dga' bas rjes su yi rang yang yang byung / de ltar byas pa'i phan yon mdo rgyud bstan bcos na mang po yod pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas bstan na/ dad can rnams la yid ches nges shes 'drongs nas dge sbyor la spro shugs cher 'gro 'am snyam pa'i blos 'dri 'dod yod pa'i khar/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i dge rgan dge 'dun bde legs/ dad gtong blo gros che ba'i chos mthun dge slong blo gros/ sman sogs rig gnas la mkhas 83

pa'i bla ma padma kun grol/ lung dang rigs par smra ba blo ldan ye shes dar rgyas/ dad gus dag snang che ba'i slob bu 'phrin las dar rgyas/ ngag dbang bkra shis/ bsod nams rgyal la sogs pa'i dad can gyi slob ma mang pos kyang / dge ba'i gsal 'debs su 'di lta bu'i gdams pa zhig dgos zhes yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong la dga' ba'i rnal 'byor zhabs dkar ba'am/ ming gzhan tshogs drug rang grol du 'bod pas/ nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i dben gnas bkra shis 'khyil ba nas sbyar ba'o/ /'dis kyang bstan pa dang 'gro ba yongs la phan pa dpag tu med pa thogs par gyur cig /e ma/ grangs med bskal par gsog dgos tshogs chen kyang / /skad cig skad cig rdzogs par byed nus pa'i/ /thabs mchog rmad byung 'di ko ngo mtshar rmad/ /thar par 'dod pa rnams kyi snying gi nor/ /sus bsten nyes ltung sgrib gnyis gar bu yi/ /snang ba dag nas tshogs gnyis su warsha'i/ /khams su 'phos te sku gnyis gzi 'bar bzhin/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor 'gyur bar nges/ /de'i phyir nges 'byung bsam pa bzlog med blos/ /mkha' mnyam ma rnams nyer zhi la 'god phyir/ /brtson pa'i lam zhugs rnams kyi snying la phur/ /chos brgyad tshul 84

'chos mkhan dang 'di mi mdza'/ /'di bris dge ba sprin gyi myu gu yis/ /skal ldan gdul bya'i zhing sa sem gyur nas/ /tshogs gnyis snye ma g.yur du za ba can/ /don gnyis 'bras bu bcud du smin par shog /ces pa'ang snyoms las pa sangs rgyas rin chen gyes nyams 'char sug bris su bgyis pa siddhi rastu// //85

mchod pa 'bul ba'i skabs su ji ltar bslab pa'i rim pa bzhugs so//dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa thams cad la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang cag rnams kyis mi'i lus rten thob cing bstan pa dang mjal ba'i skabs 'dir/ gtan gyi 'dun ma bsgrub phyir rang gis shes tshod dang nus tshod kyi dge sbyor re byed dgos/ de ltar ma bsgrub par tshe 'di nyid tsam gyi don dang / rnam g.yeng dang don med pa'i bya ba sna tshogs kyis dus 'da' bar byed pa ni dud 'gro rta bong sogs dang khyad par ma byung ba yin pas/ rang gis rang la bskul ma'i lcag btab ste phyi bshol gyi ngang du ma song bar de ring nyid nas 'go brtsams te rnam dkar gyi las la 'jug dgos/ de yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang / byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid chen po rnams dang / dgra bcom pa bdag nyid chen po thams cad ni 'das/ 'dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis rgya gar grub chen 86

brgyad cu sogs rgya gar mkhas grub thams cad dang / bod yul gangs can gyi lngongs su bstan pa snga dar dang / phyi dar la byon pa'i skyes bu dam pa mkhan slob chos gsum/ jo 'brom yab sras rje bdag nyid chen po yab sras sogs bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa phal cher zad nas mtshan ldan gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang bral bas/ dmus long long khrid med pa ngan song gsum gyi g.yang chen por gom 'gros 'khyor nas nyam thag pa bdag cag rnams ni tshe sngon bsod nams ma bsags pas/shes rab shin tu zhan cing dad pa med pa/ brtson 'grus chung zhing le lo dang snyoms las kyis dus 'da' ba/ dbang po brtul zhing nad gdon sogs kyi bar chad mang ba bdag cag gi rgyud la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang / bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i nyams len lta zhog skyabs 'gro dang / dad pa rnam par dag pa re tsam yang rgyud la skye dka' ba'i dus 'dir/ bsam pa nges 'byung byang chub kyi sems yang dag pa'i lta ba stobs ldan rgyud la bskyed pa'i sgo nas dge sbyor bsam pa'i sgo nas stobs che ba bsgrub mi nus pas/ zhing khyad par can gyi mthu la brten nas tshogs bsags pa gal che ste/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i zhal nas/ mnyan na tshig mi zin/ bsam na don mi go bsgoms na 87

rgyud la mi skye ba'i blo'i mthu shin tu chung ba'i dus su zhing gi mthu la brten pa man ngag yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/bsam pa khyad par can de dag gis ma zin par/ tshul khrims bsrung ba dang / ngan slong la sbyin pa gtong ba sogs kyi dge rtsa phal cher 'khor ba'i bde 'gror skye ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba ma gtogs thar ba'i rgyur mi 'gro zhing / bsam pa khyad par can byang chub kyi sems sogs med kyang / zhing khyad par can sangs rgyas sogs la brten na/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur nges par 'gro ba ni/ rgyal ba'i bka' bslu ba med pa snying rje padma dkar po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas da ltar bzhugs pa la gang bsti stang byed pa lta zhog ces pa nas sku gdung gi mchod rten byed pa dang / tha na rmi lam na de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la dad pa byed pa de'i 'bras bu mya ngan las 'das par nga smra'o/ /zhes dang / de ltar sangs rgyas bsam mi khyab/ /sangs rgyas chos kyang bsam mi khyab/ /bsam mi khyab la dad byas pa/ /rnam par smin pa'ang bsam mi khyab/ /ces dang / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'am/ /yongs su mya ngan 'das pa la/ /gang gi thal sbyar gcig byas pa/ /zhes pa nas/ de yis byang chub dam pa 'thob ces 88

gsungs shing / dam chos padma dkar po las/ bde gshegs rnams la me tog gcig mchod na/ /de dag thams cad byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo las/blo gros rnam par dag pa/ de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su dag pa la/ su zhig me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / rol mo'i sgra dang / byugs pa rnams kyis bsti stang byed pa de'i bsod nams kyi phung po'i mtha' rtogs par mi nus te/ de'i mtha' ni theg pa gsum po las theg pa gang yang rung bas/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i mthar thug pa ma gtogs par bsod nams kyi phung po de phyi ma'i mthar yang zad par mi nus so/ /zhes dang / mdo sde bskal bzang las/ de ltar sangs rgyas dag la chung ba yi/ /yon phul rnam par smin pa 'di dag yin/ /'khor tshe de yi 'bras bu de 'dra na/ /mkhas pa su zhig byang chub sems mi bsgyed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ zhing khyad par can la dmigs nas mchod pa phul te tshogs bsags pa gal che/ dngos po shin tu chung ba dman pa chu gtsang lta bu yin kyang / zhing khyad par can la dmigs nas phul na bsod nams dpag tu med pa 'byung zhing / bsod nams bsags pa'i mthu las blo'i mthu yang je 89

rgyas su 'gro bas/ bka' gdams gong ma rnams kyis/ dngos po mi 'thog dad pa gal che/ dad pa yod na chu gtsang gcig pu dang / maṇḍal tsam la brten nas tshogs bsags pas chog ces gsungs pa ltar/ shin tu rnyed par sla zhing nyes spyod ser sna sogs dang ma 'brel ba'i chu gtsang tsam la brten nas tshogs gsog pa gal che zhing / 'byor na dngos po bzang la mang ba rin thang che ba lag tu 'byor tshad kyis mchod pa phul te tshogs gsog dgos/ mchod pa 'bul ba'i tshe rang gi dbang po'i mngon sum gyi spyod yul du gyur pa'i sku gzugs mchod rten 'di dag la mchod na/ mngon sum gyi spyod yul du ma gyur pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten thams cad dang / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' sogs skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po thams cad la dmigs nas mchod pa 'bul ba'i 'phen pa gtong dgos/sa chen po la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po sogs kyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyan sngar rdzu 'phrul gye bkod pas lus tshad med grangs med pa sprul te/ mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mchod pa phul nas/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos dpag tu med pa mnyan/90

sems can thams cad kyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad cing rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la ji ltar bslabs pa ltar bdag gis kyang skyes bu dam pa de dag gi rjes su slob rgyu zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam du smon lam 'debs pa dang / sems thag pa nas dga' zhing yi rang bar byas te/ da lta rang la dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan mthong ba'i dad pa shugs drag po dang / byams snying rje bcos ma ma yin pa dka' mod/ 'on kyang bcos ma dang kha tsam tshig tsam tshun chad kyis kyang dad pa dang byams snying rje'i bsam pa bskyed de/ sangs rgyas rnams ni tshogs gsog pa'i zhing gong na med pa/ yon tan gyi zhing bla na med pa/ phan 'dogs pa'i zhing gong na med pa yin pas 'di dag la tshogs gsog rgyu re byung ba skal ba bzang snyam du sems dga' spro dang bcas pa'i sgo nas/ mchod pa mi gtsang ba dang / yon po dang /'khyogs po dang / bar du chu 'pho ba sogs mchod zhar gyi skyon dang bral ba/ ting phor rnams kyang sa rdul dang chu dreg sogs kyis ma gos par 'od 'bar bar/ ting phyis gtsang mas phyis/ting phor la rang gi lus kyi dri dreg dang / mdzub rjes sogs med par gtsang zhing 'od 'bar bar byas te/ dam pa gong ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen phu chung ba'i rnam thar dang / rje bdag 91

nyid chen pos lha sa'i smon lam chen mo btsugs te/ mchod pa tshad med pa phul nas/ smon lam ji ltar mdzad pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang mchod pa'i las la brtson zhing / snyigs ma las kyang ches snyigs ma sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyag shin tu phra ba'i skabs 'dir bstan pa'i dmigs rkyen la yang phan pa dang /bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa thams cad kyi sku tshe mdzad pa 'phrin las rgyas shing chos mdzad dam pa thams cad kyis chos bsgrub pa'i phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi nas/chos kyi bya ba mtha' dag gegs med par mthar phyin pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi dang khyad par rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa'i mdo sngags kyi bstan pa phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang /dge 'dun gyi sde thams cad thugs mthun zhing khrims gtsang ba'i ngang nas bshad sgrub bstan pa'i bya ba rnams 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i sku tshe brtan cing chab srid phyogs mthar rgyas pa dang / yul phyogs rnams su yang nad mug 'thab rtsod 'khrug long sogs zhi nas/ bkra shis bde skyid kyi dge mtshan rgya chen po 'byung ba'i phyir dang / nam mkha'i mthas khyab pa'i 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal 92

dang / sdug bsngal gyi rgyu sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag nas/ nges 'byung byang chub kyi sems yang dag pa'i lta ba/ gsang sngags rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor zab mo mtha' dag rgyud la mngon du gyur nas/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob pa'i rgyur dmigs te mchod pa 'bul ba'i las la 'jug go/ de yang snga thun la/ thog mar skyabs 'gro brgya skor/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs tshar gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi tshar gsum/ khyad par ma sems can thams cad kyi don du sogs/ khyad par gyi sems bskyed pa tshar gsum/ rang nyid skad cig gis zhes pa nas/ dam rdzas spyan gzigs bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang bar gyur/ zhes pa'i bar skad cig dkrong bskyed/ gnas dang mchod rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa rnams rgyas bsdus skabs dang bstun/bde stong dbyer med ces pa nas/ nam mkha' ji srid 'bangs su bzung du gsol/ zhes pa'i mtshams su/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzungs/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi byang sdom 'dzin pa tshar gsum/bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /zhes pa nas/93

sems can mya ngan khedas la 'god/ /ces pa'i sngags sdom 'dzin pa tshar gsum bya/ de nas ltung bshags tshar gsum dang spyi bshags tshar gsum 'don cing phyag 'tshal/ de nas thog med dus nas zhes pa nas/ zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang dbang thob phyir bsngo/ /zhes pa'i mjug tu mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs tshar gsum sogs brjod cing rol mo'i sgra bya/ dkon mchog gsum gye bden pa dang nas/ 'byung bar gyur cig /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku sogs dang / ji snyed su dag nas/ chen por bsngo/ de nas maṇḍal rgyas pa phul te/ sa gzhi spos byugs ma tshar bcu gsum/ bdag gzhan lus ngag nas/ ni rya ta rya mi/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /zhes pa nas/ rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi/ /lan gsum mam/ bdun sogs brjod/deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /nas/ de ltar bya/ bdag gis de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi/ /spyan sngar 'gro ba bder gshegs nyid dang ni/ /bar du bde la 'gron du bos zin gyis/ /lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis/ /'jam dpal dpa' po nas/ bzang po spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi/ /zhes pa'i bar brjod/ 'di mchod pa'i thun dang po'i 'don sgrig yin/ thun phyi ma rnams su 'don sgrig ni bar ma ltar 'don/94

thun tha ma'i mjug tu/ yon tan 'byung gnas zhes pa nas/dgyes bzhin thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ /zhes pa'i mtshams su/ myur mdzad ma dang chos rgyal gye gtor 'bul rgyas bsdus skabs dang bstun/ gzhi bdag la dkar gtor gtong /zhing mchog dam pa nas/ rim gnyis lam gyi bsgod pa mthar phyin shog /de nas bzang spyod dang / gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi smon lam rnams re mos su 'don/ dge slong ri khrod pa thams cad kyis gung tshig bzhes pa'i skabs su/ khrus byas te/ chos gos bla gos gyon/ gding ba bting / lhung bzed snod gtsang rnams kyi nang du phud mchod lag len mthong brgyud ltar legs par bshams te/ rten 'brel bstod pa dang / dkon mchog rjes dran gyi mdo la sogs pa dang / zas bsngo ltung bshags tshang bar 'don/ de ltar mchod pa 'bul ba'i skabs su ri khrod pa thams cad gnyom chung zhi dul la gnas bzhin pa nas/ mchod khri sogs yar mar du snur dgos pa dang / glo bur du mchod pa 'bul mkhan gsar ba byung nas gral mtshams 'byed dgos sogs byung na/ de lta bu la bsnyad pa'am rkyen gzhan gang yang rung bas kha shags 'gyed pa dang / 'khon 'dzing sogs gtan nas byas mi chog gal srid 'dzing 'khon byed mkhan byung na/95

phyin chad ri khrod pa'i grwar yong mi chog 'di sems la nges po byed pa gal che/ de ltar dus rgyun mchod pa 'bul ba la brtso na pa ni/ mi ma yin dang bdud kyis ma khyer ba'i rtags yin zhing /tshe 'di'i mthong chos la yang / rgyu zas dang 'byor ba 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang / dad pa dang shes rab je cher 'gro ba ni mchod pa yun ring du 'bul mkhan rnams kyi myong bas grub pa de bzhin legs pas thams cad kyis dus rgyun du mchod pa la brtson par zhu/ zhes pa 'di ri khrod pa mang po 'tshogs nas mchod pa 'bul ba'i skabs su ji ltar bslab pa'i rim pa yi ger bris pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes dpon slob zhwa dmar tshang nas bskul ba ltar 7gser khang ri khrod pas bris pa dza yantu/ /96

mchod pa'i sgon lam bzhugs so//na mo gu ru/ bdag gis dus gsum du bsags pa'i rnam dkar gyi dge tshogs ji snyed mchis pa thams cad rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa rnams la mchod par 'bul lo/ /de dag thams cad kyi spyan sngar kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin phung zad mi shes pa 'byung bar gyur cig /de ltar phul ba'i dge ba 'di dang bdag gis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge rtsa rnams kyi mthu la brten nas/ sangs rgyas kyi lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /chos mdzad dam pa thams cad kyis chos bsgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing chos kyi bya ba gang brtsams pa thams cad thogs med du myur du 'grub par gyur cig /dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal thams cad zhi zhing med par gyur cig /lha dang mi'i bde ba thob par gyur cig /lha dang mi dang lha ma yin gyi sdug bsngal dang rgud pa thams cad zhi zhing bde bar gyur 97

cig /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can theg pa mchog gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis 'bral ba med par rjes su 'dzin par gyur cig /de dag thams cad kyi rgyud la nges 'byung gi bsam pa dang brtse ba snying rje chen po bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems dang zab mo stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang sngags kyi lam rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor mtha' dag mngon du gyur te/ zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig /rmad byung sras )bcas rgyal ba'i byen rlabs dang / /rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang / /bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /rnam dag smon pa'i gnas kun 'grub par shog /ces don dran bzhin pas sems ma yengs par snying thag pa nas smon lam gdab par bya'o/ /go sla zhing don yid la 'char bde ba'i phyir tshig lhug par bris pa yin no/ /ces pa 'di ni gser khang ri khrod pas chos lung gser dgon nas bris pa dza yant+ra//98

mchod pa'i smon lam zhing khams sgo 'byed bzhugs so//zhing mchog dam pa thub pa'i dbang po dang / /de sras 'jam dbyangs kun tu bzang la sogs/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /bdag gi sgon lam 'grub pa'i dpang por bzhugs/ /tshogs gnyis bsod nams bsags pa'i zhing gi mchog /bla ma dkon mchog mchod pa'i bsod nams mthus/ /tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan/ /ci bsam thams cad chos bzhin 'grub par shog /nam zhig tshe yi 'phen pa zad pa'i tshe/ /mnar gcod sdug bsngal drag po mi 'byung zhing / /lus dang longs spyod gang la'ang mi chags par/ /yid la bla ma dkon mchog dran par shog /shi ma thag nas dag pa'i snang ba shar/ /gang du song kyang dag zhing gzhal yas khang / /su dang 'grogs kyang lha dang lha mo dngos/ /ci zhig go yang chos sgrar 'gyur bar shog /bar dor 'ja' sprin 'od kyi lam chen la/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ /lha dang lha mo mkha' 'gros bsu ba dang / /bla ma byon 99

nas lam sna 'dren par shog /bu ni pha khyim bu mo ma khyem la/ /'gro ba bzhin du 'od kyi lam brgyud nas/ /bde ba can dang dga' ldan mkha' spyod sogs/ /gang 'dod zhing du dga' bzhin 'gro bar shog /song nas phyogs bcu'i zhing na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas mchod cing gsung gi bdud rtsi myong / /tshogs rdzogs sgrib byang myur du sangs rgyas nas/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas sa ru 'dren par shog /gzhan yang dkon mchog mchod pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /rgyal khams kun tu char chu dus su babs/ /lo phyugs rtag tu 'phel zhing legs tshogs rgyas/ /phun tshogs sde bzhi'i dpal la spyod par shog /ces mchod pa'i smon lam zhing khams sgo 'byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ bsam pa bzang zhing dag snang che ba'i dbu mdzad tshangs dbyangs dang / bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i dge slong bstan pa dar rgyas gnyis kyis bskul ngor/ 7bla ma zhabs dkar bas sbyar ba'o// //smras pa/ bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa sangs rgyas dang / /mi pham 'jam dbyangs rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs/ /rgya bod mkhas grub yongs la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyams len phun sum tshogs par byen gyis rlobs/ /lam rim blo sbyong phyag rdzogs do ha sogs/ /mdo sngags chos rnams nyams su len pa'i tshe/ /sbyor 100

dngos rjes gsum thun mtshams nyams len rigs/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i gdams pa bzang po 'di'i/ /par yig 'dri mkhan lha khang dbu mdzad mchog /par de brko mkhan bla smyon snyan grags lags/ /par shing kha 'go zhabs phyi grwa pas byas par yon slob ma yon bdag rnams kyis phul/ /nyams len 'dod pa'i skal bzang pho mo la/ /gang 'dod chos kyi dga' ston stsol pa'i phyir/ /ngo mtshar par gyi 'dod 'byung nor bu 'di/ /bkra shis 'khyil ba'i rgyal mtshan rtse na bzhugs/ /'dis mtshon dge bas bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun/ /rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas go 'phang myur thob shog /sangs rgyas ma thob bar du dge ba'i bshes/ /dam pa'i chos dang nam yang mi 'bral shog /chos kyi mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i yon bdag gi /tshe dpal bsod nams snyan grags rgyas par shog /dkar phyogs lha yis chos kyi grogs byed cing / /bkra shis chen pos phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /ces par byang nyung 'dus 'di ni/ dad brtson shes rab snying rje dang ldan pa'i skal ldan slob bu snyan grags rgya mtshos 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor/ 7phyogs med rgyal khams 'grims pa'i rnal 'byor pa gu yangs yan pa blo bde zhabs dkar pas/nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i dben gnas bkra shis 'khyel 101
11 cas/na pa dang 'a ba ngas la phan pa dpag do gyur cig /

༄༅ / /legs bshad kun bzang mchod sprin zhes bya ba bzhugs so//na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ phyogs bcu'i zhing na legs bzhugs kun bzang rdo rje 'chang dang thub dbang sogs/ /rgyal ba rab 'byams thams cad mdo sngags bstan pa yongs kyi bdag po dngos/ /rgyan drug mchog gnyis grub chen brgyad cu la sogs rgya gar paṇa grub tshogs/ /bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba'i skyes mchog yin zhes yongs la 'brug bzhin grags/ /'phags yul mkhas grub klu dbang steng las mdo sngags nor bu bye ba blangs/ /bod yul chos kyi nor bus 'gengs mdzad lo tsā ba rnams bka' drin che/ /slob dpon chen po'i nus mthu'i rlung gis lha 'dre gdug can lho sprin gtor/ /mdo sngags bstan pa'i nyi zla zung gis bod yul mun gling gsal bar mdzad/ /mnyam med jo bo'i gsung rab gdams par 'char bas sngar med lam rim bstan//gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin bka' gdams pa yis 103

bsil ldan ljongs 'di dog por bgyis/ /nye lam phyag chen chos drug mar pas spel nas mi la ras chung sogs/ /grub dbang bye ba mkha' la 'phur nas mkha' spyod zhing du lam chen bton/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pas bstan pa lo legs 'bru bzhin spel/ /sa kun li khris sngags bzhin ngur smrig 'dzin pas sa thog khebs pa byung / / mdzes zhal tshems dkar chu 'dzin gseb na ljags glog gsung dbyangs 'brug sgra ldir/ /lung rigs thog gis log smra'i brag ri bshig la sa skya pan chen bsngags/ /dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed gcod yul dam pa sangs rgyas ma cig gis/ /spel bas grub thob pho mo nam mkha'i skar tshogs tsam zhig byung 'di rmad/ /thub bstan pad tshal skyong zhing sa gsum 'gro ba yongs kyi ma rig mun/ /sel ba'i skyabs mgon rgyal ba paṇa chen nyi zla kun gyi dpal du shar/ /gser ri'i dbus na lhun po ji bzhin gangs ri'i khrod na seṅge ltar/ /gang gis kyang 'gran pa'i zla bral rgya bod mkhas grub rnams kyi zhal sgo las/ /legs 'ongs chu 'go gangs la thug 'dra'i gdams pa khungs btsun brgyud par bcas/ /'gro ba lha mi yongs kyi phyag mchod bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing gi mchog /de'i phyir bdag gis lus stong sprul nas bstod dbyangs sgog 104

bzhin gus phyag 'tshal/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rab sprul nam mkha' gang ba'i kun bzang mchod sprin 'bul/ /bdag gzhan yongs kyis chos spong las sogs sdig ltung gang bsags mthol lo bshags/ /sku gsung thugs kyi phyi nang gsang ba'i mdzad pa gang la'ang rjes yi radza / /gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong phul nas dpag med chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /gzugs sku mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs zhes thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gi dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs bstan pa thams cad rgyas pa dang / /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe brtan cing mdzad 'phrin rgyas pa'i phyir du bsngo/ /slar yang ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla lha mi'i longs spyod bcas/ /blo yis blangs te phul nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba snying nas 'debs/ /bstan pa dar zhing bstan 'dzin thams cad thugs mthun sku tshe mdzad 'phrin rgyas/ /'gro kun gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas 'thob par byen gyis rlobs/ /chos dang gang zag yongs la bzang ngan med par mthong thos dag snang bya/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos yongs la chog shes med par gang mthong kha phyes bltas/ /gsar rnying grub mtha' yongs la phyogs ris med par gus pas bsnyen bkur byas/ /bla ma mkhas 105

grub yongs la log lta med par chos 'brel mang po bzhag /mdo rgyud man ngag lo rgyus rnam thar brgya phrag mang po'i zhal phyes tshe/ /tshig gi ngos nas 'gal ba lta bu gcig gnyis tsam min mang po mthong / /dben pa'i gnas su gcig pur bsdad nas gang nus dge sbyor byed zhor la/ /don gyi dgongs pa gang yin btsal bas bla ma rnams kyi bka' drin gyis/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos nang nas tshig gcig 'dor ma dgos par gdams par shar/ /sngar bas dad gus dag snang gter kha khong nas ches cher rdol ba byung / /de phyir rgyal ba rab 'byams mkhas grub gong ma rnams kyi yon tan dang / /bla mi'i rnam thar sku drin bsam gyin dad gus dag snang g.yo bzhin du/ /snga rab 'das pa'i rgyal ba rab 'byams rgya bod mkhas grub lo tsā ba/ /da ltar bzhugs pa'i mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i bstan 'dzin skyes bu dang / /ma 'ongs pa na 'byon par 'gyur ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad po/ /dgyes par byed pa'i mchod pa'i mchog tu legs bshad kun bzang mchod sprin spro/ /de la sa bcad mang bkram chos gtam kho na snyan ngag mngon brjod kyis/ /brgyan na legs bshad khyad chos 'thon cing mkhas pas gzigs na mgu mod kyang / /rang nyid sbyangs pa 106

chung bas de ltar 'chad kyang mi shes shes na yang / /blo dman dbang rtul rnams kyis bltas na sa bcad tsam gyis mgo mi non/ /bsam na don yang go ba nyung bas 'di ru mkhas pas mkhyen pa tsam/ /ma zad blun po ba glang dzis kyang nyan na tshig don go sla'i phyir/ /don de rgyal ba'i dgongs pa yin kyang tshig de 'jig rten rgan rgon gyi/ /skad cha bzhin du bshad kyis mchog dman bar ma kun gyis gsan par zhu/ /zhes tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs snyan la ring ba sngon du btang nas/ 'dir chos dang gang zag yongs la dad gus dag snang skye ba'i thabs su rgyal ba'i bka' dang bla ma rnams kyi gsung rnams lung du drangs nas bshad par bya ste/ de yang ngo mtshar rmad byung bkod pa'i phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams mtha' yas mu med pa na bzhugs pa'i/ rgyal ba rab 'byams 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba/ kha lo bsgyur ba/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba dpag tu med pa bzhugs tshad brjod kyis ga la lang / sngon bya rgod phung po'i ri gcig pu la sangs rgyas byon pa yang brjod kyis mi lang ste/ zla ba sgron me'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas dag ni bye ba khrag khrig dang / /de las lhag pa gaṅgā'i bye ma snyed/ /kun 107

kyang bya rgod phung po 'dir bzhugs te/ /mi dbang de kun nga yis bsnyen bkur byas/ /gsungs/ nam mkhas gar khyab kyi gnam sa bar snang na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi grangs ga la zin/ tha na rdul re'i khyon dang skra yi rtse mo re'i khyon tsam —na yang / sa'i rdul snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i dag dang ma dag gi zhing khams tshad med/ sangs rgyas dang sems can dpag tu med pa yod pa phan tshun 'dres pa med cing gnod par 'gyur ba med par gnas zhes/ ting 'dzin rgyal po la sogs pa'i mdo rgyud bstan bcos mang po nas gsungs/ sangs rgyas re re'i sku'i cha shas ba spu'i khung bu re na yang / dag dang ma dag pa'i zhing khams sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' sems can mtha' yas te/ de yang ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla lcags ri mu khyud dang bcas pa gcig la 'jig rten gyi khams gcig zer/ de 'dra stong la stong dang po zer/ stong dang po de 'dra stong la stong gnyis pa zer/ stong gnyis pa de 'dra stong la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams zer/ de 'dra bye ba phrag brgya la rab 'byams zer/ rab 'byams bye ba phrag brgya la rab 'byams kyi rgyud zer/ rab 'byams rgyud bye ba phrag brgya la rab 'byams bar 108

ma'i rgyud zer/ rab 'byams bar ma'i rgyud bye ba phrag brgya la gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i zhing khams zer/sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad gangs chen mtsho'i sku'i ba spu'i khung bu gcig na gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i zhing khams de lta bu bye ba phrag brgya re gnas/ sku'i rdul re la'ang de 'dra gnas shing de'i rdul re la'ang de snyed gnas/ de bzhin du longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i dbyings na de ltar gnas zhes theg chen gyi mdo rgyud du ma nas gsungs/de tsam du ma zad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sogs sa thob kyi byang chub sems dpa' re re'i sku'i ba spu'i khung bu re re na yang zhing khams tshad med pa yod de/ sngon byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rdzu 'phrul gyis song nas spyan ras gzigs kyi ba spu'i khung bu gcig gi zhing khams kyi mtha' ma chod par slar log par gsungs la/ skyon zad yon tan kun ldan rgyal ba'i thugs rje la nye ring phyogs ris mi mnga' ba'i phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams mtha' yas mu med pa na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag thams cad kyis tshad bzung med pa'i mtha' bral nam mkhas gar khyab kyi sems can rnams kyi don mi mdzad pa ni gcig kyang med la/ sangs rgyas rnams 109

kyi thugs bskyed smon lam dang sems can rnams kyi mos pa so so'i dbang gis/ sangs rgyas gcig la yang mthong snang mi gcig pa sna tshogs su mthong / lha'i skad lta bu zhig gi sgo nas chos gcig gsungs kyang / sems can rang rang gi skad du so sos du mar go ste/ sman gyi rgyud phyi ma las/ 'phags pa'i thugs rje phyogs ris med na yang / /gang zag mos pas mthong snang so sor shar/ /dper na mkha' la zla ba gcig shar na/ /chu yi skyogs rer zla ba re re bzhin/ /gcig tu gsungs kyang so sos du mar go /gsungs/ kun mkhyen padma dkar pos/ snying bo'i chos phung skal ba bzhin/ /rang rang so so'i skad du grags/ /zhes dang / klong chen rab 'byams kyis/ mtha' yas pa mtha' yas pa'i gsung gis/ mtha' yas pa mtha' yas pa'i sems can la/ mtha' yas pa mtha' yas pa'i chos ston par mdzad pas na/ ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa zhes gsungs/ rgyal ba rnams kyi gsung rab rnams yi ge ru phab nas phyogs gcig tu brtsigs rgyu 'dra zhig yin na/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams la yang mi shong bas/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi pha mtha' 'di 'o zhes gting dpag dka' ste/ chos rje 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ chos dang rgya mtsho gnyis kyi gting mi dpog 110

gsungs/ de na phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyi gsung rab rnams brjod dgos rgyu yin na/ sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi grangs mnyam zhig mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bskal chen bye ba mang por brjod kyang rdzogs pa'i yul las 'das te/mdo las/ de yi mngon mtha' bskal pa 'am/ /bye ba 'am ni bye ba brgyar/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs na'ang / /tshig gis legs par brjod mi nus/ /gsungs/ gsung rab de dag thams cad kyi gang la yang log par mi blta nam yang mi smod par/ dam chos mi 'dra ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod tshul dran nas gang la yang dag snang sbyang dgos te dge bshes sog bzlog pas/ mgon de'i sras dang 'khor dang de'i rjes 'jug /rgya bod mkhas grub rgya mtshos bshad pa'i chos/ /nyon mongs nad chen 'joms pa'i bdud rtsi mchog /mtha' yas phyir na su zhig log par blta gsungs/ bde mchog nyung ngu'i rgyud las/ mos pa du ma'i sems can la/ /spyod pa sna tshogs ston mdzad de/ /sna tshogs tshul gyis gdul bya la/ /thabs ni sna tshogs ston pa yin/ /zab mo'i chos ni ston pa la/ /gal te mos par ma gyur kyang / /smad pa dag tu mi bya ste/ /chos nyid bsam mi khyab dran bya/ /zhes dang / bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/111

sems can mos pa bsam mi khyab/ /sangs rgyas rol pa bsam mi khyab/ /rang gi gzhung dang ma mthun yang / /smad cing spangs par mi bya ste/ /nam zhig go ba'i smon lam thob/ /ces dang /rje blo bzang bstan pa'i mgon pos/ chos dang gang zag snang tshul ci 'dra yang / /phyogs lhung sdang shugs mi bya dag snang sbyongs/ /zhes dang / 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ phyag chen dang rdzogs chen dbu ma gsum/ /'di zab kyi gdams kha bdag la med/ /chos spong gi las ngan ma bsags pas/ /pho dag snang can 'tshogs pa'i rtse mor phyin/ /gsungs pa lta bu zhig gyis/dag snang sbyong ba tsam du ma zad/ gsung rab de dag rnams kyi tshig don gcig kyang ma lus par 'dzin pa'i yid smon byed dgos te/ bzang spyod smon lam las/ rgyal ba rnams kyi dam pa'i chos 'dzin cing / /zhes pa dang / gzhan yang / rgyal ba'i dam chos ma lus 'dzin pa dang / /zhes sogs smon lam btab pa'i phyir ro/ /de na de lta bu'i smon lam rnams tshig tsam du ma song ba byas snying thag pa nas 'debs par bya'o/ /khyad par phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas de dag thams cad kyi nang nas pad dkar lta bur bsngags pa'i mnyam med zas gtsang gi sras po de nyid kyis dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bar du 112

bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags/ mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas sku dngos kyis rgyal po'i khab tu lha dang mi la dge bcu'i chos 'khor bskor/ wa ra khro sir nyan thos la bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor/ yul ma ga rnyar rang sangs rgyas rten 'brel bcu gnyis kye chos 'khor bskor/bya rgod phung po'i rib byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi chos 'khor bskor/ yang bcom ldan 'das de nyid rigs gsum margen po sprul nas/ nee rañdza na'i 'gram dang lcang lo can nas lha'i dbang po brgya byen la kṛ ya dang rnal 'byor dang / yo gsum gyi chos 'khor bskor/ kun rig rnam snang du sprul nas/ gsang ba'i bdag po la tant+ra bco brgyad kyi chos 'khor bskor/ rdo rje sems dpar sprul nas/ laṅka'i bdag po rnal 'byor mchog gi rgyud dang / a nu yo ga'i chos 'khor bskor/ kun tu bzang bo'am kun byed rgyal por sprul nas/ gnas rgyal mo spu ri'i tshal du rdo rje sems dpa' la mdo bzhi/ dem lnga/ kun tu bzang po che ba rang gnas kyi rgyud sogs kyi chos 'khor bskor/ gzhan yang gang la gang 'dul gyi skur sprul nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 'gro ba yongs la chos kyi 'khor lo sna tshogs pa bskor te/ bde mchog 113

rtsa rgyud las/ mos pa du ma'i sems can la/ /spyod pa sna tshogs ston mdzad cing / /sna tshogs thabs kyis gdul bya la/ /thabs ni sna tshogs ston pa yin/ /zhes dang laṅkar gshegs pa las/ji srid 'du shes yod kyi bar/ /theg pa'i mtha' la thug pa med/ /gsungs/ des na sa steng du dar ba'i chos lugs sna tshogs pa la sangs rgyas kyi bka'i 'du shes bzhag nas gus par bya/ sangs rgyas kyis sngon dus de ltar chos 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskor ba tsam du ma zad/ da lta snyigs dus 'dir yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen sogs su sprul nas bka' chos ston te/ kun dga' bos zhus pa'i mdo las/ kun dga' bo nga nyid ma 'ongs pa'i tshe/ rdo rje slob dpon du bstan nas kyang / bka' 'di dag bshad par 'gyur/ zhes dang / zhing khams mtha' yas par bstan pa'i mdo las/ nga nyid mya ngan 'das pa'i tshe/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams su/ /ston pa bzhugs shing 'tsho gzhes pa'i/ /bstan pa 'di yang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ de ltar chos gang gsungs pa thams cad shes na don gcig pas mi mthun pa med de/ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ 'jig rten khams ni stong dag tu/ /ngas ni bstan pa mang bshad pa/ /tshig 'bru tha dad don gcig 114

ste/ /thams cad brjod par nus ma yin/ /zhes dang / 'dus pa chen po'i mdo las/ theg pa thams cad gcig tu mnyam ste/chos kyi dbyings dbyer med par 'jug pa gcig go/ /zhes dang / rig pa rang shar gyi rgyud las/ rig pa'i ye shes gtan la 'bebs/ /de yi dgongs pa bstan pa la/ /rgyud lung man ngag thams cad mthun/ /de yi man ngag grol ba'i phyir/ /zhes gsungs/ des na sangs rgyas kyi sku dngos dang sprul pa mang po bkye nas 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum du 'gro la chos mang po bstan pa dang ston par 'gyur ba thams cad don gcig pa yin pas/ chos gang la yang dag snang sbyangs par bya'o/ /spyir phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas de dag thams cad kyi gsung rab kyi tshad su zhig gis 'dzin nus/ bdag cag gi ston pa shākya thub pa thugs rje can gyi chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gis mtshon pa'i chos gang gsungs kyi tshad kyang 'dzin dka' ste/padma bka' thang las/ nyon mongs 'dod chags 'dul ba'i gnyen po ru/ /'dul ba'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong gsungs/ /nyon mongs zhe sdang 'dul ba'i gnyen po ru/ /mdo sde'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong gsungs/ /nyon mongs gti mug 'dul ba'i gnyen po ru/ /mngon pa'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong gsungs/ /115

dug gsum cha mnyam 'dul ba'i gnyen po ru/ /gsang sngags sde snod nyi khri chig stong gsungs/ /zhes dang / thub dbang yongs su 'das nas da bar du/ /sangs rgyas gsung rnams yi ger thebs tshad btab/ /glegs bam byas na glang chen rab tu brtan/ /gsung rab dam pa rgyab khal lnga brgya byung / /gnas la ma 'cham lha klus thob sha byas/ /gsungs/ chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong zhes bya ba'ang nye ber mtshon pa ste/ gro kha rim pa gcig pa dang / shing tā la'i 'dab ma rnams su phag ze'i rtse mos khris pa'i tshad kyi yi ge rnams kyis gang bar byas te/ gang bar byasi pa gro kha'i khur ram tā la'i khur ji srid glang rgod kyis theg pa de ni chos kyi phung po gcig go /de lta bu brgyad khri bzhi stong ni nyan thos kyi sde snod kyi tshad do/ /theg pa chen po la dgu khri/ gsang sngagosi kyi theg pa la stong phrag brgyad yod do zhes rab tu sgron gsal las bshad/ bde mchog sdom 'byung las/rnal 'byor rgyud rnams kyi ni༄tshad/ /bye ba phrag ni drug nges te/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor ma rgyud grangs/ /bye ba phrag ni bcu drug grags/ /theg chen las gzhan mdo sde rnams/ /dung phyur phrag brgyad gsungs pa yin/ /de bzhin pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /sa ya dang ni dung phyur lnga/ /zhes dang / gsang sngags 116

phyi ma la yang de nyid las/ lha dang lha min rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /gsang sngags rigs sngags rnam pa sna tshogs dag /bye ba phrag gsum dang ni 'bum phrag lnga/ /rig 'dzin sde snod du ni rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes bshad/ ye shes rdo rjes kun las btus pa las/ /bya ba'i rgyud stong phrag bzhi/ spyod pa'i rgyud stong phrag brgyad/ rtog pa'i rgyud stong phrag bzhi/ gnyis ga'i rgyud stong phrag drug rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis te/ rgyas par phye na grangs med do/ /zhes gsungs/dbye ba de dag kyang shlau ga'i grangs ma yin te/ rgyud kyi rkang grangs yin/ shlau ga'i grangs la ni/ bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa la 'bum dang / dgyes rdor la 'bum phrag lnga dang / dus 'khor la stong phrag bcu gnyis dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor la khri brgyad stong dang / de nyid bsdus pa la stong phrag brgyad/ gshin rje gshed dmar po la 'bum phrag gsum dang / don zhags la stong phrag brgyad la sogs par bshad/gzhan yang mdo sde laṅkar gshegs pa las/ lha yi theg dang tshangs pa'i theg /de bzhin du ni nyan thos dang / /de bzhin gshegs dang rang rgyal gyi/ /theg pa 'di dag ngas bshad do/ /ji srid sems ni 'byung gi bar/ /theg pa rnams la thug pa 117

med/ /ces dang / 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa las/ theg pa gsum dang bco brgyad de/ /ji srid 'du shes yod kyi bar/ /theg pa'i mtha' la thug pa med/ /gsungs/ rgya cher rol pa las/ sangs rgyas kyi chos tshad ma mchis pa nges par bstan pa/ sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis sngon chad gsungs pa mchis te/ 'di lta ste/ bcom ldan 'das padma'i bla ma dang / chos kyi tog dang / mar me mdzad dang / yon tan gyi tog dang / yon tan 'byung gnas dang /'od zer chen po dang / drang srong lha dang / dpal gyi gzi brjid dang / bden pa'i tog dang / rdo rje mkhregs dang / thams cad zil gyis gnon dang / gser mdog dang / shin tu mthor gshegs dang / byu ru'i rgya mtsho dang / me tog gi tog dang /gzugs bzang dang / spyan bzang dang / drang srong sped dang /dmag tshogs las rgyal dang / mtho ba dang / me tog rgyas pa dang / mdzod spu gzi brjid dang / shin tu rgyas dang / 'od zer bzang bo dang / bkra shis ldan dang / blta na bzang dang /seṅge'i gzi brjid chen po dang / blo gros brtan pas byin dang /sos ga'i spos dri dang / bden pa'i phyogs grags rgya chen dang /'od ldan dang / skar rgyal dang / 'jig rten mjes dang /'od 118

rgya chen dang / rin chen grags dang / drag shul gzi brjid dang /rin chen gzi brjid dang / tshangs pa'i gzi brjid dang /sgra snyan dang / me tog bzang bo dang / rab me tog dang /rab tu yid 'ong dbyangs dang / dge ba tshul bzang dang /rab tu 'dzum pa'i spyan dang / yon tan phung bo dang / 'brug sgra dang / kha dog mdzes dang / tshe'i gzi brjid dang / ngom bag glang po'i 'gros dang / 'jig rten mngon par smon dang /dgra las rgyal dang / yang dag mchod dang / rnam par gzigs dang / gtsug tor can dang / thams cad skyob dang /'khor ba 'jigs dang / gser thub dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis kyang sngon chad gsungs pa lags/ zhes gsungs/jo bos rnam thar rgyas pa yongs grags las/ jo bo'i thugs dgongs la/ gsang sngags kyi byen rlabs dang gdams pa dang nus mthu dang / mkhyen rgya nga las che ba med snyam pa'i thugs rgyal yang cung zad dus der byung nas/ rgya gar nub phyogs su byon pa'i bshul gar rmi lam du mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis rgyud sde mang po bstan nas thugs rgyal bcag yang rang gi lhag pa'i lha seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol mas zhal mngon sum du bstan te jo 119

bo'i mdun du byon nas/ khyod paṇḍi ta sngags mkhan yin nam gsungs/ jo bos yin lags gsungs pas 'o na sgrub thabs 'ga' zhu bas/ 'di dang 'di mkhyen nam gsungs/ de kun gyi dpe yang mthong ma myong gsungs pas/ 'o na khyod gsang sngags la mkhas pa'i thugs rgyal che na gsungs/ yang khren mi'i yul ni skra'i spu rtse tsam las med/ sngags kyi dpe don mang po mkha' 'gro ma'i lag na yod pa yin gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur/jo bo'i thugs rgyal yang der chag gsung ngo / /jo bo'i zhal nas/ mi yul na theg pa chung ngu'i 'dul ba nyung / de bas theg pa chung ngu'i mdo sde mang / de rnams pas theg pa chen po'i mdo sde mang / de thams cad pas theg pa chen po'i mngon pa mang /de thams cad pas bya ba'i rgyud mang / de thams cad pas rnal 'byor gyi rgyud mang / de thams cad pas ma rgyud mang / de thams cad phyogs gcig tu bzhag pa bas shes rab kyi rgyud mang ste/ mi yul na bzhugs par ma gtogs pa'i lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi gnas na yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs/ 'gro ba mtho dma'i don yang 'di'i sgo nas byas pa mang gsungs/ yang jo bo'i thugs dgongs la/ 'on kyang mi yul na bzhugs pa'i theg pa chen po'i gsang sngags la nga las mkhas pa med snyam 120

pa'i thugs rgyal mnga' ba la/ phyis bod du byon nas/ bsam yas dpe har gling gi dkor mdzod cig kha phye nas rgya dpe la gzigs pas/ sngar gsan gzigs ma mdzad pa'i rgyud sde mang po bzhugs shing gda' skad de/ slob dpon padmas rdzu 'phrul gyis lha klu'i yul dang / dpal shrī na lent+ra nas rgyud sde thams cad bsam yas su spyan drangs pas mang ba yin gsungs/ jo bo'i zhal nas gsang sngags 'di la mi shes pa med snyam/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis kyang nam mkha' nas gzhal yas khang dpag tu med pa'i sgo phye nas rgyud sde mang po bstan pa yin pa la 'di rnams mi mi gda'/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags 'di la mtha' mngon rgyu yod yod mi 'dra gsungs nas thugs rgyal chagabod kyi rgyal po la rjes su yi rang mdzad nas bod kyi bstan pa dar dus de 'dra ba rgya gar du yang ma byung bar 'dug gsung ngo / /des na rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis/ de ltar na ston pa thugs rje can de nyid kyis/ theg pa che chung gi chos 'khor mtha' yas pa zhig bskor nas lha mi bgrang las 'das pa smin cing grol bar mdzad gsungs/ 'o na rgyal bas chos kyi phung po tshad med pa de tsam gsungs na/ da lta de'i cha tsam yang mi snang na de dag gang na bzhugs zer na/ mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen 121

gyis/ yang dag bsdus pa'i gzhi nyams phyir/ /mtha' dag min pa gtogs pa yin/ /gsungs pa ltar rgyal ba mya ngan las 'das nas ring bo ma lon par bdud sdig to can dang / de'i byen gyes brlabs pa'i skye bo ma rungs pa mang po dang / lhag par sprang bo nyi ma'i dngos grub ces bya ba la sogs mu stegs pa mang pos gtsug lag khang mang po mer bsregs pa sogs rgyal ba'i bka' chos mang du bsnubs nas/ klu sgrub thogs med sogs 'jig rten du byon pa'i tshe na'ang bka' mang du ma bzhugs par gsungs la/ 'on kyang slob springs las/ bstan pa rin chen mchog ltar bzang la 'phan med pa/ /rnam par dag tshul gang yin klu mgo gdengs ka can/ /chen po rnams kyi gtsug gi rgyan bzhin gus mnos nas/ /sa yi gting na gnas pas rab rib sel bar byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar rgyal ba'i bka' phal mo che ni klu'i yul na bzhugs te/ gzhan kun sum cu rtsa gsum sogs lha'i gnas du ma dang / lcang lo can sogs rgyal chen bzhi'i gnas dang / dri za'i rgyal bo rnam par rgyal ba'i gnas sogs dang / 'dar byed kyi gling dang / shambha la dang /o ṭa yā na'i mkha' 'gro'i pho brang la sogs pa'i gnas khyad par can mang por bzhugs par gsungs so/ /gzhan yang 122

g.yung ston zhi byed ri khrod pas mdzad pa'i rje mi la'i rnam thar mdzod nag mar grags pa las/ spyir mi la ras chen gyi rnam thar la mdzad pa mi gcig pa brgya dang nyi shu rtsa bdun tsam mthong gsungs/ gsung mgur la 'bum tsho gcig dang khri tsho gcig dang / stong tsho gcig dang brgyad gsungs par grags te/rje khyung tshang ba dang mnga' ris zhing lo tstsha ba'i lo rgyus la gsal/zhing pa zhi byed ri khrod pas kyang / khri tsho gcig tsam mthong ba legs so gsungs/ rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rdo rje'i mgur drug sogs gsung rgyun thor bu las/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la ras pa zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa'i grub thob chen po de nyid kyis/ theg pa khur du 'khur/ dman pa'i sa bzung / dka' thub kyi las mdzad/ brag phug stong ba zhwa ltar gyon/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mthar phyin te nyams dang rtogs pa 'khrungs pa'i mgur ma skor tsho chen po bco brgyad dam/ nyer gcig gam/ bzhi bcu rtsa lngas thog drangs pa'i nyis stong brgyad brgya gsungs na'ang / nyis stong bo de mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis 'khyer nas mi yul na med ces grags/ brgyad brgya bo de da lta rnal 'byor ba rnams kyis gsung 'don dang nyams len mdzad gsungs/ des na rgyal 123

ba'i gsung rab phar zhog rje btsun chen po mi la ras pa'i gsung mgur tsam yang mtha' chod par dka' bar gda' na gang la yang dad gus dag snang sbyangs pa gces so/ /des na sngar rang gi las lam grags pa dang / ma mthong bas mdo rgyud dag bka' ma yin par sems pa rgya mtsho'i rus sbal dang /khron pa'i sbal ba'i dpe bzhin mthong rgya chung bas lan pa yin te/ nges don 'brug sgra las/ rang gi lugs la ma grags pas/ /chos ma yin zhes mi bsam ste/ /chos kyi rnam grangs thams cad las/ /gsang sngags bla med mang ngo zhes/ /jo bo rje yis gsungs pa dang / /bye brag spra sogs nyan thos kyis/ /rang la ma grags dbang byas nas/ /theg pa chen po'i chos spangs pas/ /de la byams mgon klu sgrub kyis/ /theg chen bka' ru sgrub pa yang / /dus 'di nyid du dran par mdzod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /chos tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /don yang dus 'dir dran mdzod la/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i sbal ba dang /khron par gnas pa'i sbal ba bzhin/ /ji ltar thugs su mi shong ba/ /mthong rgya chung 'di bshol bar rigs/ /gsungs/ des na rgyal ba'i bka'i pha mtha' rtogs dka' bas sngar bod du chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams kyis snga phyi byas bsgyur ba'i gsar rnying gi 124

mdo rgyud gang yod 'dis mtshon pa'i rgyal ba'i gsung rab mi 'dra ba mtha' yas pa thams cad la dad pa byed dgos te/rin chen phreng ba las/ brda sprod pa dag ji lta bur/ /yi ge'i phyi mo klog 'jug ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas gdul bya la/ /ji tsam bzod pa'i chos ston to/ /kha cig la ni sdig pa las/ /rnam par bzlog phyir chos ston te/ /kha cig bsod nams 'grub pa'i phyig /kha cig la ni gnyis bsten pa/ /kha cig la ni gnyis mi bsten/ /zab mo 'khu 'khrigs can 'jigs pa/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying bo can/ /byang chub sgrub pa kha cig la'o/ /de ltar mkhas pas theg chen la/ /khong khro ba ni zad bya zhing / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub pa'i phyir/ /lhag par rab tu dad par bya/ /gsungs/ sdug bsngal sel zhing bde ba sgrub pa'i thabs ni/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa yin pas sems can gyi bde skyid sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yod med la rag las pas/des na rgyal ba'i bstan pa thams cad 'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring gnas pa'i smon lam 'debs dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed dang bkur ste dang / /bcas te yun ring gan sa gyur cig /ces smon lam btab pa'i 125

phyir ro/ /yid smon byed pa tsam du ma zad/ dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang zhes dam bcas pa dang yang mi 'ag pa bar byas te ci nus kyis dge chos sdud pa la brtson par gces so/ /gzhan yang rgyud las/ tshig re la ni sna tshogs don/ gsungs pa ltar/mdo sngags kyi rdo rje'i tshig re la'ang don mi 'dra ba sna tshogs 'jug pa mang bas/ de'i dbang gis mdo sngags kyi gzhung la yang rgya bod kyi mkhas grub mang pos dgongs 'grel mi 'dra ba mang po mdzad/ de'i dbang gis bzhed srol mi 'dra ba mang du byung / da lta lung pa re na chos lugs re yod tshod na gda'/de kun sdig spong dge sgrub kyi thabs su gcig pas 'gal ba dang spong rgyu med par gang la mi smod par dag snang sbyangs/sangs rgyas kyi gsung bzhin thams cad spyi bor len dgos te/chos rje 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ sangs rgyas chos rnams sdig spong dge sgrub gces/ /de la 'gal ba spong rgyu ci yang med/ /rang rang so so'i za kha dgag po la/ /gcig gis gcig la ma smod snying gtam yin/ /gsungs/ gang shar rang grol gyis/ deng sang chos lugs grub mtha' mang /thams cad sangs rgyas lam du gcig /don med kha sdig ma gsog par/ /kun la dag snang mdzod cig ang / /zhes dang / slob dpon 126

chen pos/ dag snang mos gus phyogs med du byed pa shin tu gal che gsungs/ rgyud bla ma las/ gang zhig rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'ba' zhig gi /dbang byas rnam g.yeng med yid can gyis bshad/ /thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes mthun pa/ /de yang drang srong bka' bzhin spyi bor blangs/ /gsungs/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas ni thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba yin pas/ sgyu ma mig 'phrul bzhin du gang la gang 'dul gyi sku sna tshogs pa bstan nas blo kha gang mtshams kyi chos dang / 'jig rten bstan bcos rnams bstan nas 'gro ba rnams 'dul ba yin te/ rje rin po ches/ bsod nams tshogs rab rab 'byams rgyu las 'khrungs pa'i sku mchog mchog ste mjes pa khyod kyi sku/ /nam mkha'i mthas gtugs gtugs pa med pa'i zhing mchog kun tu du ma'i 'gro la mig 'phrul bzhin/ /gsungs/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ nam mkhas ji srid khyab gyur pa/ /sku yis kyang ni de snyed khyab/ /ces dang / dpal a ra li'i rgyud chen po las/ sprul ba'i sku ste sku yi mchog /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i rgyud 'chang ba/ /phyogs bcur sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed/ /ces dang rnga bo che'i mdo las/ mya ngan ma byed kun dga' bo/ /nga ni phyi ma'i dus su ni/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyid sprul nas/ /127

khyod la sogs pa'i don byed 'gyur/ /zhes dang / yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las/ brgya byin tshangs pa'i cha byad dang / /la la bdud kyi cha byad kyis/ /sems can rnams ni 'dul bar mdzad/ /'jig rten rnams kyis rtogs mi nus/ /bud med cha byad spyod pa mdzad/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas na yang gda'/ /'dod chags mi mnga' chags pa'i tshul/ /'jigs pa mi mnga' 'jigs pa ltar/ /rmongs med rmongs pa'i tshul bstan te/ /spyo ba ma lags sbyo ba'i tshul/ /zha ba ma lags zha ba ltar/ /rnam par 'phrul pa sna tshogs kyis/ /sems can rnams ni 'dul bar mdzad/ /ces dang / sam bu ṭa las/ sangs rgyas gar mkhan bsam mi khyab/ /bdag gis brjod pa ga la nus/ /zhes dang / rdo rje drwa ba'i rgyud las/ gang dang gang gi gzugs kyis ni/ /lus can rnams ni 'dul gyur pa/ /de dang de ni rnam ston te/ /sna tshogs nor bu ji bzhin no/ /'dul pa'i thabs ni gang gang gis/ /sems can rnams ni 'dul gyur pa/ /rnam pa de dang de dag gis/ /chos rnams ston par mdzad pa yin/ /zhes dang / de bzhin du mdo las/ bdud kyi las rnams thugs chud kyang / /bdud kyi las su 'jug mdzad pa/ /thabs kyi pha rol phyin brnyes pa/ /de rnams bya ba kun ston 128

mdzad/ /yan lag gang dang gang gis ni/ /sems can chos la dgar gyur pa/ /bya ba thams cad ston pa ni/ /thabs chen legs par bslab pa yin/ /de yis bslab pa mtha' yas shing / /spyod yul du ni mtha' yas la/ /ye shes phun tshogs mtha' yas pas/ /sems can thams cad grol mdzad pa'o/ /zhes dang / nges don 'brug sgra las/ gcer bu pa rnams 'dul pa'i phyir/ /thub pas gcer bu pa'i tshul bstan/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas 'jam dpal gyis/ /gtsug phud phud bu lcang lo can/ /ral pa mu ñtsa cod pan thogs/ /gdong lnga gtsug phud lnga dang ldan/ /zur phud lnga ba me tog thod/ /de sogs tshul 'chang mu stegs byed/ /'dul phyir de dag tshul ston pa/ /mtshan brjod 'grel pa nyid las gsungs/ /zhes bshad/ phyi rol ba kha cig ma gtogs phal cher gyis/ nang pa las kyang rgyu 'bras 'tsho ba yin te/ mu stegs gcer bu pas/ sdig pa gzhan spu tsam mi byed pa smos ci dgos/ tha na pha ma sems can la dngos sam brgyud nas gnod 'tshe 'byung gis dogs nas gos kyang mi gyon par gcer bur dka' thub mdzad pa yin par gda'/des na myang 'das bam po gcig pa las/ rigs kyi bu nga bskal pa bzang po 'dir mu stegs gcer bu pa la yid ches te 129

gsungs/ dus 'khor las/ yon tan gye chos dang ldan pa phyi rol pa'i nang na snang na yang / bdag cag gis bsnyen bkur bya'o gsungs/ mdor bsdus bzhi ba las/ khyab 'jug dang drag po la sogs pa rnams kyi nang na yon tan 'di dag rdzogs pa 'ba' zhig yod na/ de yang bdag cag gis rnam pa thams cad du phyag bya ba dang / mchod pa dang bkur bar bya ba yin no gsungs/ des na blo gros can gyis don med par phyi rol pa thams cad la yang khas gtong mi rung / btang na rnam par snang mdzad sogs sangs rgyas rnams ring bar 'gyur te/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ mu stegs can la smad mi bya/ /mu stegs can la smad gyur na/ /rnam par snang mdzad ring ba'i rgyu/ /gsungs/ de dag rnams la dgongs nas bdag gi yongs 'dzin dam pa a rig dge bshes rin po ches nga phyi rol pa dang bon po la yang dad pa yod gsungs/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyis bon gye ston pa gshen rab sogs su sprul nas bon gyi gzhung phal cher gsungs pa yin skad/ bon nag kha cig ma gtogs/phal che ba nang pa'i lugs ltar rgyu 'bras spang blang byed pas/deng sang bod du dar yod pa 'di rnams gtsang bon rnam dag yin te rgyu 'bras brtsi ba'i phyir ro/ /de yin na chos dang khyad 130

med de 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ gshen lha 'od dkar spyan ras gzigs dbang yin/ /gtsang ma'i bon dang chos la khyad par med/ /gsungs/ kun mkhyen thu'u bkwan rin po ches/bon dang chos zhes 'gal ba'i tshad byed kyang / /chos la bon 'dres bon la chos 'dres pas/ /chos bon rnam dbye 'byed la spyid lug gyur/ /gsungs/ spyan snga bas/ bon 'di nang pa sangs rgyas par gtogs gsungs/ des na bon thams cad la yang chos log lta log ces khas gtong mi rung ste/ bla ma zhang gis/ 'o skol bon la ras chod mi bgyi'o gsungs/ sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa sna tshogs bkyes te chos sna tshogs bstan nas/ 'khor ba'i gnas kyi sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal bsal nas bde ba la ma bkod pa gcig kyang med de bsngags 'os bsngags bstod las/ khyod kyis gang las 'gro ba dag /ma drangs rgud pa de gang mchis/ /gang dag 'jig rten ma spang ba'i/ /phun tshogs de yang gang zhig mchis/ /gsungs/ tha na 'khor ba'i gnas kyi 'bab chu ljon shing la sogs nyer 'tsho'i yo byad thams cad kyang sangs rgyas kyi rnam 'phrul las byung ba yin te/ bzhi brgya ba las/ thub pa ma gtogs ji lta'i dngos/ /de bzhin gshegs las gzhan yod min/ /gsungs/131

des na thams cad thub pa'i dbang po'i rnam 'phrul du shes par byas nas gang la yang gus par bya dgos te/ bla ma zhang gis/ 'o skol rang cag chos dang chos min zhes/ /khyad du mi gsod ris su ma bcad cing / thams cad thub dbang sras bcas rnam 'phrul du/ /shes par bya zhing mi spangs 'khur bgyi'o/ /gsungs/ dka' chen ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ gnas 'di la rtog ge'i rigs pas ci'i phyir gyi lam na med pas rgyal ba'i bka' la yid ches bskyed nas/ ston pa thugs rje can de nyid kyis bdag cag rnams kyi don du/ thabs mkhas kyis mdzad pa 'di ltar mdzad do snyam du snying nas gus par bya'o/ /gsungs/ bstan pa'i snying po las/ rnam par snang mdzad chen po de'i sku la me tog gi rgyan dpag tu med pa bkod pa rnams sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku'i zhing khams kyis gang bar gyur cing /de'i phyag g.yon pa nas skyes pa'i me tog padma'i ze'u 'bru gcig la stong gsum nyi shu rtsa lnga brtsegs nas gnas pa'i bcu gsum la/ mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gye khams mnyam du chags shing / mnyam du 'jig pa 'di la/ gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya zer 'bum phrag gcig tu sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku shākya thub pa 132

bye ba phrag brgya ther 'bum phrag gcig sku bltams pa dang /sangs rgyas pa dang chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa la sogs pa/ mtshan dang zhing khams dang / sku tshe dang / 'khor dang / 'od kyi tshad mi mthun pa dpag tu med pas gdul bya rnams kyi don mdzad pa yin te/ sangs rgyas phal po che'i mdo las/ gling bzhi 'di na bcom ldan 'das don grub pa dang / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / seṅge nga ro can dang / go'u ta ma dang / rnam par snang mdzad dang / shākya thub pa la sogs pa/ gzugs dang sku tshe dang / mtshan mi mthun pa stong phrag brgyad cur shes so/ /de bzhin du stong gsum mi mjed 'di na/ gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya yod de/ de re re na yang sangs rgyas stong phrag bcu yod do/ /mtshan mi mthun pa bye ba stong phrag bcu yod do/ /'di nas shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams tshad med pa grangs med pa dpag tu med pa ba rjod du med pa thams cad na yang gzugs dang / sku tshe dang /mtshan mi mthun pa stong phrag bcur grags so/ /de bzhin du phyogs bcu kun tu de lta bur snang bar gsungs so/ /de ltar mchog gi sprul pa ma yin pa gzhan mi snang ngam zhe na/ bzo'i sprul pa pi wang rgyud mang la sogs pa dang / skye ba'i sprul pa bya 133

dang ri dwags la sogs pa dang / dman pa'i sprul pa me dang sbrul dang / smad 'tshong ma la sogs par yang gang la gang 'dul sna tshogs su snang nas 'gro ba 'dul bar mdzad pa ste/'khor lo sdom pas nges par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma las/ rdo rje can ni thams cad du/ /cha med cha ni rnam spangs pa/ /lus las 'das shing gos pa med/ /la lar gzugs can dag tu bzhugs/ /la lar tshor bar bcas pa'i sems/ /la lar skom dang la lar bkres/ /la lar khro dang la lar zhi/ /la lar me tog 'bras bur snang / /la lar 'byung ba chen po lnga/ /la lar bram ze gdol pa dag /la lar ma dang sring mo ru/ /la lar chung ma bu mo ru/ /la lar tshangs dbang khyab 'jug dang / /la lar nyi zla gza' skar dang / /la la nyin dang mtshan mor snang / /la lar byang chub chen por gshegs/ /la lar pha rol bdud las rgyal/ /la lar byams pa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /la lar rgas shing 'khogs pa dang / /la lar na dang 'chi ba dang //la lar rnam par snang mdzad sogs/ /la lar sgol ma gos dkar sogs/ /la lar 'dab chags mkha' lding dang / /la lar klu dang sbrul chen po/ /la lar smad 'tshong bye'u sogs/ /la lar gnyid dang rmi lam mthong / /la lar mya ngan 'da' ba 134

dang / /la lar sreg pa'i me dag dang / /la lar mtho ris skyes ba ste/ /rnam par 'phrul ba 'di lta bu/ /bstan nas 'gro ba 'dul bar mdzad/ /ces pa dang / dkon mchog brtsegs pa dang yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las/ la lar bltams pa yongs su bstan/ /la lar mya ngan 'da' bar bstan/ /la lar chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /la lar spyad pa spyod par mdzad/ /sems can 'dul ba'i don slad du/ /dgyes shing mgur len rol bar mdzad/ /bshum mo dag kyang 'byen par mdzad/ /sems can sus kyang yongs ma 'tshal/ /'dod chags mi mnga' chags pa'i tshul/ /'jigs pa mi mnga' 'jigs pa ltar/ /rmongs med rmongs pa'i tshul bstan te/ /byis pa ma lags byes pa'i tshul/ /spyos pa ma lags smyos pa'i tshul/ /zha ba ma lags zha ba ltar/ /brgya byin tshangs pa'i cha byad dang / /la lar bdud kyi cha byad dang / /bud med cha byad spyod pa mdzad/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas dag na'ang gda'/ /rnam par 'phrul pa sna tshogs kyis/ /sems can rnams ni 'dul bar mdzad/ /ces dang /lha mo dri ma med pa'i 'od kyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ bskal pa bzang po'i rgyal sras rnams/ /li yul 'khor gyi grong khyer der/ /skye ba dag kyang bzhes 'gyur zhing / /mi dang 'dra ba 135

snang bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / mdo gzhan las/ nga yang mya ngan las 'das nas sems can rnams la phan zhing snying brtse ba'i phyir du mir skye bar rigs par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ jo bo thugs rje chen po'i spre'u gcig pu'i sku'i skye ba bzhes nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzhugs pa/ nyang ban sha'i spyan gyis gzigs par gsungs/ bka' gdams glegs bam las/ sangs rgyas dag ni sprul ba cir yang ston/ /mi shes bzhin du kun la nyan par ston/ /dmyal ba'i snang ngor dmyal ba'i yul du'ang gshegs/ /dmyal ba de dang mthun pa'i chos kyang ston/ /'dra ba gzhan du de bzhin sna tshogs sprul/ /'dod chags can la 'dod chags lta bur ston/ /zhe sdang la sogs can la'ang de bzhin ston/ /rgyal por sprul nas 'gro ba 'dren pa la/ /rgyal po'i bur sprul rim gyis rgyal sa 'dzin/ /gal te rgyal po'i bu nyid ma yin na/ /rgyal sa mi thob 'khrugs pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de bas thabs mkhas bu ru ston par byed/ /de ltar rgyal la mi shes mi mnga' na 'ang / /gzhan gyi slob ma lta bur kun bsten nas/ /de yi rgyal tshab bzung nas bla mar byed/ /gzhan yang bu med rnams la bur ston cing / /phongs pa rnams la nor gyi rnam par ston/ /mdor na gang dang 136

gang la gang mkho ba'i/ /de dang de la mkho ba sprul bar byed/ /des na sangs rgyas rnams ni cir yang ston/ /ston yang rnam par rtog pas ci yang med/ /med kyang smon lam dbang gis dgos 'dod 'byung / /gsungs/ rgyal bu dkon mchog 'bangs kyi zhal nas/ nga sna tshogs sprul par ston na yang / /rgyud ma dag rnams la ci cha yong / /nga bu med rnams la bur ston yang / /ma snying med ma la ci cha yod/ /mi dbul po dag la nor ston yang / /khong mngon shes med la ci cha yod/ /thang skam po dag la chu 'byin kyang / /mi mngon shes med la ci cha yod/ /mi nad kyis gdungs la sman ston yang / /nad sgrib pas g.yogs la ci cha yod/ /nga khroms ldan mkhan po'i skur ston kyang / /nga thugs rje chen por su yis shes/ /nga gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i paṇḍi ta/ /rgyud gang la gang phan ston gyur kyang / /mi mkhas par rloms la ci cha yod/ /mi nga yi sprul pa phyogs ris med/ /gsungs/ 'brom gyi zhal nas/ 'jig rten gyi mgon po shākya thub pa nas bzung nas/ da lta bla ma zhal bzhugs pa yan chad yon tan thams cad sbas nas sems can gyi don byed pa yin/ bla ma dam pa'i rjes su mi 'jug na slob ma 'chal ba yin/ lar kyang nang na yon tan phun sum tshogs 137

pa yod na/ phyir g.yengs mi 'tshal/ rang bzhin gyes 'od 'phro/rmongs pas mi mthong ste/ mkhas pas mthong / phug na nor yod na/ phyir nor yod ces ma bsgrags kyang babs kyis rang gzhan la phan pa yin gsungs/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ gzhan kun bstod ra btang bas dga' bar 'dug na thang la thongs/khyod rang tshol byed med pa'i khong gi 'khrul pa mi btsal/ sbed pa mnyam po la rang gi yon tan rnams sbos/ dgos pa'i dus su slebs nas 'ongs pa yin/ sgrogs pa mnyam po la gzhan gyi yon tan sgogs/ gzhan dga' nas rang la brten nas sdig mi gsog chags sdang nyon mongs kyi rmang 'gyel ba'i dgos pa yod pa yin/ gzhan gyi yon tan gang 'dug pa'i sna rtse re nas sgrub la ston par gyis gsungs/ yang rang gi nyes pa bsgrag bya zhing / /gzhan gyi 'khrul pa btsal mi bya/ /bdag gi yon tan sba bya zhing / /gzhan gyi yon tan bsgrag par bya/ /zhes dang /dad can 'dug na bzang po smra/ /mkhas pa 'dug na yon tan bstod/ /btsun po 'dug na btsun la bstod/ /bzang po 'dug na lag len smra/ /sdig can 'dug na bags kyis gzhol/ /gnyen por 'gro na gang yang smra/ /gsungs/ 'brom gyes jo bo la/ yon tan gyi gzhi ma mi gzhi legs po dang dad 138

pa gang gal che/ 'brom gnyis ka gal che/ jo bo mi dang 'grogs na gal gang che/ 'brom thun mong du mi gzhi legs po gal che/ bzang sna 'dren pa la dad pa gal che/ jo bo mi gzhi legs po byed pa ci 'dra zhig 'tshal/ 'brom khyod bod kyi mi chen 'dra ba byas na mi gzhi legs po mi 'ong / yon tan gang gi phyogs nas che yang / nga mi rgyal bar mtho dman bar gsum gyi 'og tu zhugs nas/ mi rung ba ma gtogs pa ci zer 'dzum gyis sgrub pa zhig dgos pa yin/ jo bo blo sna yar la 'khrid pa'i dad pa de ci 'dra ba zhig dgos/ 'brom yul khyad par can mthong tsa na mig nas mchi ma 'khrugs/ lus kyi ba spu g.yo/ rjes su yi rang dang / re ltos kyi yus kyis shugs ring 'don zhing / gsol ba 'debs pa zhig 'ong ba yin/ jo bo kho bo'i dad pas gzhan blo sna yar ci ltar 'khrid/ 'brom kho mi gzhi legs pas thams cad kyi sems zin pa de dad/ ma ngu na bu ngu ba bzhin du kho la brten nas dad pa mi skye'i rang dbang med pa zhig 'ong ba yin gsungs/ yang jo bos/ bla ma mkhan po nam mthong yang /gus par mchod pas brgyan pa dang / /yid kyis phyag dang g.yas bskor zhes/ /spyi bor blangs pa'i 'du shes bya/ /mkhas btsun bzang ster 'di yi drin/ /drin can ci mnyes bya bar 139

babs/ /chos mkhas pa dang chos mthong dang / /rgyu 'bras mi bslu gzhan 'dzin can/ /mkhyen brtse can la rang 'dren pas/ /ston pa yin zhes dag par sgoms/ /las dang po pa yi sems ldan yang / /bzang po'i gzhi mar nges dgos pas/ /de yang phan bde ster byed yin/ /de yang ston pa nyid du sgoms/ /gsungs/ yang jo bos/ bla ma mkhan po mthong ba'i tshe/ /gus pas rim gro bskyed par bya/ /gang zag chos kyi mig can dang / /las dang po pa yi sems can la/ /ston pa'i 'ardu shes bskyed par bya/ /gsungs/ sngon khye'u padma la/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya yang mang po 'dus/ gang zag chos kyi mig can shes bya la mkhas pa dang / las dang po pa tshogs lam sna ma zin pa du ma byung / de dag thams cad la dmigs nas sangs rgyas thob pa ni 'di dag med na mi 'byung bas 'brel ba can yin no/ /de'i phyir na 'di dag la sangs rgyas gnas so/ /zhes ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed de/ bstod bkur gyis bskyangs so gsungs/ 'brom gyes/ gzhan rang rgyud thul na gang byas kyang skyon mi mchi/ rab tu cig byung phan chad bdud mo mtshar mo brgyas bslu mi nus la/ bdud nag po brgyas chos las 'bral mi nus pa de 'dra zhig 'tshal/ de lta bu'i chos pa gang la'ang 140

skur ba btab mi rung / byed lugs sna tshogs pa zhig 'ong ba yin bsam pa'i 'khyer so ma 'phyugs na des chog pa yin gsungs/ yang 'brom gyis jo bo la/ 'jig rten khams 'di na chos pa rigs mi 'dra ba du ma re la/ chos lugs kyang rigs mi 'dra ba du ma re re/ de la lag len gyi byed lugs kyang bsam gyes mi khyab pa re re/ gzhan phar bzhag pa'i bla ma gcig gi gsung la'ang / slob ma du ma yod pa de'i 'dod lugs re re/thams cad kyang nga khyod/ nged kyi chos lugs dang / khyed kyi chos lugs/ 'gal 'gal 'dra ba mang po gda' ba las jo bo khyed kyis kun mkhyen pas de rnams nges par gang lam du 'gro ba yin/ gang mi 'gro ba yin zhus pas/ 'brom 'di kun sangs rgyas kyi shes bya yin/ chos lugs gang la'ang skur pa mi 'debs pa dang / rang rang gang mos pa de la 'dun pa drag tu byed pa dang / rang gi chos lugs de la bla ma mkhas pa'i gsung gis sgo 'dogs bcad/ bde bar gshegs pa'i lung na ci 'dug blta/ rang re'i rigs pas kyang lam du gang 'gro dpyad gsungs/ yang jo bo chos lugs de ltar mang yang lam du 'gro ba'i gnad de gang lags/ 'brom gzhan don du sangs rgyas 'dod nas de'i gegs bdag gzhan gnyis su 'dzin pa 141

spong zhing / chags sdang gi dri mas ma gos pa de lags mod gsungs/ yang 'brom thabs sna tshogs kyis chos lugs gang mos pa la 'jug lam gyi 'gro lugs gang byas kyang / mthar sangs rgyas kyi sar 'khrid par byed/ gsungs/ 'brom/ chos lugs mang yang rang lugs zungs/ /lugs la ma zhen gzhan la'ang slobs/ /gzhan lugs dag la sgo skur spongs/ /thams cad slong la gcig tu 'dril/ /gsungs/ gzhan yang / chos la skur pa mi gdab cing / /gang mos de la 'dun pa dang / /chos spyod rnam bcu'i sgo nas ni/ /nyin mtshan phyed par 'bad par bya/ /gsungs/ yang / 'brom rje'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ rdzogs sangs rgyas la gang nye ba'i/ /mthar thug chos shig zhu legs te/ phyi rabs don du 'gyur ba'ang 'tshal jo bo'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ 'brom 'tshang rgya ba la nye ba zhig dgos na/ gsang sngags zab mo rnams 'doms/ khyad par du do ha sems la tshud/ 'tshang rgya ba la de las thag nye ba med/ ston dus kyi lo tog kham rum me ba dang 'dra/ grub thob chen po rnams kyi nyams len yin/ khyad par du do ha 'di kun byas na lung stong na phar la rnal 'byor ba bzang po nyams gar brtse zhing ḍā ma ru khrol le ba 'ong srid/ blo rab la chos rab 142
