mchi/ khyod kyi cha lugs 'di kun la lhag par du 'di mthun gsung ba'i glu ni/ sras rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi dbu rgyan can/ /thugs theg pa gsum gyi gzhal yas khang / /blo khyad par 'phags pa'i gzhan don gnyer/ /dus gsum gyi mdun ma rdzogs gyur kyang / /ma grangs med don du mthar thug phyir/ /sku rin chen gsum la nye ba'i chos/ /lam mthar thug zab mo dgos so gsungs/ /gson gsang sngags theg pa'i yang rtse yin/ /sgos dam chos zab mo do ha de/ /rjes sa ra ha yis nga la byen/ /bu thugs kyi dkyil du 'di chongs gsungs/ /lar gsang sngags theg pa'i spyod tshul ni/ /phyi yi dam lha yi gzhal yas khang / /nang pho mo lha yi rang bzhin te/ /de bskyed pa'i rim pa tsam du zad/ /kye rdo rje 'dzin pa 'brom rje mchog /chos ye stong lhun grub zab mo de/ /don rdzogs pa'i rim pa chen po sgoms/ /kye phyi yi cha lugs du ma yang / /khong gdul bya'i blo la bskyed rim yin/ /don ye stong zab mo'i rang bzhin la/ /phyi cha lugs drang don tshugs mi thub/ /bu mthar thug dgos na de la mdzod/ /mi khyed 'dra byung na lung stong rnams/ /rje rig 'dzin du ma'i gar gyis gang / /skom smyo chu 'thungs kyang 'o mar 'gyur/ /grogs bdud mos bskor yang lha mor 'char/ /de'ang legs par 143

dpyad na sheg rab dbyings/ /sems rab mthar phyin pa'i chos lugs yin/ /gsungs/ 'brom gyi dgongs pa la/ bla ma dam pa'i gsungs lugs kyis/ sangs rgya ba la theg pa chen po gsang sngags 'di shin tu nye ba'i theg pa'i yang rtse yin te/'di nyams su lon na dag sangs rgyas sgrub pa la 'di bas nye ba med dgongs/ kho bo dag nyams su blangs nas/ phyis kyi sku mched gsum 'dra ba snod dang ldan pa 'ga' re lung stong du 'khrid cing bsgom/ nyams rdol 'od gsal gyi rig shes 'bar sa'i dkyil 'khor gar gyis 'gengs pa 'ong gsungs dag zad do ha la rtsal thon pa zhig byas/ nu bo gsum la sogs pa 'ga' zhig 'khrid nas/ lung stong zhig na bzang bo kha cig 'dug go zer ba'i sgra zhig bsgrags tsa na/ grub thob ngo mtshar can yong chos zhu ru 'gro zer gsungs/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags las ngo mtshar che ba gang na med/ thams cad kyi rgyud sde nas ji skad 'byung ba bzhin du las skal dang zas skal rten 'brel du 'dzom nas 'gro ba'i dpal mgon chen por gyur na/ de las lhag pa med/ ngo mtshar che gsungs/ da hril te dril ba'i mdo don la/ gsang sngags zab mo snod min rnams la legs par gsang la/ 'tshang rgya ba la 'di las bsngags pa med pas snod 144

ldan rnams la 'di dben par bstan cing / bstod bkur bsngags gsum bya'o gsungs/ de dus lha bzhi'i zhal nas/sras khyod kyi the tshom rab spangs nas/ /sngags zab mo 'dam kha legs so rje/ /gsang zhes pa chos kyi skyon ma yin/ /rje sangs rgyas sgrub la rab bsngags kyang / /snod tha mal rnams kyis 'chun par dka'/ /mi khyod kyi blo dang rab bstun nas/ /bu sngags kyi dkyil 'khor nang du bsten/ /ces gsungs nas/ rnam par dag pa'i mkha' la yal/ yang jo bos/ chos dam tshig ma nyams legs bsrungs na/ /dus ring por mi thogs mngon sangs rgya/ /chos mthar thug theg pa'i yang rtse yin/ /sogs gsang sngags la bsngags brjod du ma gsungs so/ /yang 'brom gyis/ nga mi rgan nyi ma lde ba 'dra ba/ sde snod thung mar brdal nas/ su reg reg su lta lta kha reg kha snum/ lag reg lag snum/ khe ri rtsam pa/ gang thob thob rgyal ba'i chos shig mi byed dam gsungs/ yang 'brom gyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dge 'dun la rag las/ dge 'dun dam pa'i chos 'dul ba la rag las/ 'dul ba 'dul ba 'dzin pa la rag las pas/ kho bos sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bsam nas/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba la chos skal cig bgyi'o/ /drang pa'i don/ nges pa'i don/145

sngon rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis dka' ba spyad tshul la sogs zab dgu thams cad mdo sde la yod pas/ mdo sde la'ang kho bo'i chos skol cig bgyi'o/ /kho bo kun rdzun la mi mkhas/mngon shes thogs pa med pa'ang med pas/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ston pa la ri bo mchog rab la sogs pa'i tshad dbyebs gling bzhi stong gsum la sogs mngon pa la bsten nas so so skye bos kyang shes su rung bas byang chub la dmigs te kho bos mngon pa la'ang chos skal cig bgyi'o/ /sde snod gsum byas kyang rung / bslab pa gsum byas kyang rung / chos gsum po 'di ni phyi rabs kyi gdul bya la byen te/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pas sa gzhi gang ba tsam byas/ de dag gi rgyud thams cad sde snod gsum gyis rgyas par byas te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yongs su gsal bar bya'o snyam du nan tan thugs la bcing zhing sems pa na/ lha bzhi'i zhal nas/ chos bslab gsum lam ston bka' gdams pas/ /rgyud gdul bya dag pa dpag med 'byung / /bka' zab mo'i gdam kha ma log rje/ /dus thog mtha' bar gsum rab tu btsan/ /gsungs/ /yang jo bo'i zhal nas/ bu the tshom ma mang sde snod bzung / /dus gtan gyi mdun ma 'di nyid bzang / /gsungs/ yang lan cig a mes kyis/146

jo bo la bla ma ci tsam yod zhus pas/ de dus jo bos kyang bla ma 'di 'dra rang bsten/ 'di 'dra rang bsten bla ma rnams sdom na 'di tsam zhig yong bar 'dug bla ma la 'dam kha mi byed par rgyud man ngag che chung med pas phyug pa zhig 'ong ba yin/jo bo'i zhal nas/ u pa si ka de yin nam gsungs/ de lags zhus pas/ 'o na a mas/ nga la bla ma btsun po btsun po'ang mang po yod/ mkhas pa dang / bzang po'ang mang po yod/ rnal 'byor pho mo'ang yod/ sbas pa'i brtul zhugs mdzad pa'ang lnga bcu tsam yod/ lar sdom na brgya dang lnga bcu tsam yod gsungs/ dag snang che na rang rgyud la yon tan khyad par can cir yang 'char te jo bo rjes/ dag snang bya bar cir yang 'char/ /gsungs/ bla ma 'od zer snying pos/ las dang skal bar ldan pa la/ /ye nas dag pa'i nam mkha' nas/ /rtsi shing nags tshal la sogs pa/ /gzhan las sgra 'byung smos ci 'tshal/ /kun las chos kyi sgra yang 'byung gsungs/ bsam pa ma dag na bde gshegs gsungs kyang mi thos te/ rgyal bu kun tu dga'i zhal nas/ ma dag rnams la bde gshegs kyi/ /nges pa'i tshig kyang mi thos na/ /rtsi shing bar snang la sogs pa/ /gzhan las sgra 'byung sgos ci 'tshal/ /gsungs/ 'brom gyis/147

tshul khrims ldan pa rnams spyi bor mchod/ tha na na bza' ras ma yan chad blangs nas spyi bor 'jog btsun chung chung chung zhig byung kyang / khyed dge 'dun yar 'byon par zhu zer/gsungs/ yang jo bo chen po'i zhal nas/ gzhan yang bla ma dag kho bo la shin tu byams pa ni byams/ la la sems tsam pa yin pas/ ngas grub mtha' ma bzung zer nas/ bka' bkyon pa skad gsungs pa'ang yod de drang don yin hril de dril na/ de ring gi chos de dag 'dus che la zab/ las chung la go bde gsungs/ yang jo bo nyan mtsho ru byon pa la/ bod ston rnams kyis bye brag tu smra ba dang / mdo sde pa dang / sems tsam pa dang / dbu ma pa la sogs rang re'i lta ba gang 'dzin pa de'i lta ba phul gyin/ nga'i bla ma'i lta ba 'di ltar 'tshal na/ 'dis go chod dam mi chod byas kyin zhus pas/ de thams cad la lta ba des shin tu yang go chod do/ /da lta ba de bzung la spyod pa phyin ci ma log pa snying rje dang / byang chub kyi sems sbyongs shig 'on kyang don 'grub pa yin no gsungs/ skyes bu dam pa mnyam med jo bo yab sras kyi gsung la tshad mar mi 'dzin pa su yod/des na skye bo pho mo rnams kyis chos lugs rab 'bring tha gsum gang la yang dag snang sbyangs nas rang gang mos kyi chos la 148

nyams len byed pa gces so/ /smras pa/ bla ma nor bu dbang gi rgyal po de/ /bdag gi spyi gtsug rgyal mtshan rtse mor bzhugs/ /chos kyis phongs pa'i gdul bya sems can la/ /zab rgyas chos kyi dgos 'dod char bzhin phobs/ /sngar med bsod nams che ba'i ded dpon ngas/ /legs bshad rin chen mdzod kyi sgo phyes nas/ /skabs 'dir zhal gdams gser gyi phreng ba zhig /skal bzang gdul bya'i mgul pa'i rgyan du 'bul/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams mtha' yas na/ /sangs rgyas byang sems grangs las 'das pa bzhugs/ /de dag rnams kyis 'gro ba grangs med la/ /sngon dus chos kyi 'khor lo dpag med bskor/ /khyad par sangs rgyas kun gyi nang nas kyang / /pad dkar lta bur bsngags pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ /shākya thub pa snyigs ma'i dus su byon/ /chos 'khor bskor tshul bshad na brjod mi lang / /sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyang deng sang gi /dus 'dir bla ma rgyal blon mkhas grub kyi/ /tshul gzung gsung rab dgongs 'grel tshig don rnams/ /rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum brtsams nas ston pa mang / /phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum du/ /'gro ba 149

gang la gang 'dul skur bstan nas/ /gang 'tshams chos bstan 'gro don mdzad par gsungs/ /de phyir bod yul gangs can ljongs 'di ru/ /dar ba'i chos lugs grub mtha' sna tshogs pa/de 'dzin skyes bu dam pa thams cad ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sprul par blta ba gces/ /chos lugs kun kyang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /gsungs pa'i chos kyi nang nas khyad par du/ /nang pa sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di nyid las/ /mched pa yin pas dag snang sbyong ba gnad/ /deng sang dus ngan bskal pa'i snyigs ma la/ /nga yi chos dang khyod kyi chos lugs zhes/ /so sor phye nas bstan dang bstan 'dzin la/ /dgra ltar sdang ba 'di la skyo ba skyes/ /dad gus dag snang sgo nas mi bkur kyang / /gshe skur btab nas las ngan mi gsog par/ /nye ring chags sdang med par btang snyoms su/ /bzhag na chos spong nyes pas gos mi 'gyur/ /sngon byon dam pa gong ma thams cad kyis/ /chos lugs gzhan la dag snang mdzad bzhin du/ /rang nyid gang mos chos de nyams blangs pas/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob par gsungs/ /de phyir mchog thun dngos grub sna tshogs pa/ /thob par 'dod pa'i chos dang gang zag gzhan/ /bzang por blta zhing mchod bstod bkur ba dang / /gang mos chos rnams 150

nyams su len par mdzod/ /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /yang rje bdag nyid chen pos mdzad pa'i byang chub lam rim chen mo las/ bstan pa ni/ shes rab sgron me'i rgya cher 'grel pa las/ bstan pa zhes bya ba ni/ lha dang mi bdud rtsi'i go 'phang thob par 'dod pa rnams yongs su shes par bya ba dang / spang bar bya ba dang mngon sum du bya ba dang bsgom par bya ba dag la phyin ci ma log par ston pa ste bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab ces bya ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyal bas legs par bshad pa ji snyed pa'o/ /de thams cad 'gal ba med par rtogs pa ni/ 'dir gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i lam du go ba ste/ de yang kha cig ni lam gyi gtso bo/ kha cig ni lam gye yan lag ci rigs par 'gyur ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bzhed don ni 'jig rten gyi don sgrub pa yin la/ gdul bya yang rigs can gsum ga rjes su 'dzin pas de dag gi lam la bslab dgos te/ byang chub sems 'grel las/ rang nyid nges bzhin gzhan dag la/ /nges pa bskyed par 'dod pa yis/ /rtag tu 'khrul ba med par ni/ /mkhas rnams rab tu 'jug pa yin/ /zhes dang / rnam 'grel las 151

kyang / thabs byung de rgyu lkog gyur pa/ /de 'chad pa ni dka' ba yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ rang gis ji lta ba bzhin ma nges na gzhan la bstan par mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /theg pa gsum gyi lam shes pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i bzhed don sgrub byed kyi thabs yin par ma pham pas/ 'gro la phan par byed rnams lam shes nyid kyi 'jig rten don sgrub mdzad pa gang / /zhes gsungs shing / rgyal ba'i yum las kyang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni nyan thos kyi lam gang yin pa dang rang sangs rgyas kyi lam gang yin pa dang sangs rgyas kyi lam gang yin pa'i lam thams cad bskyed par bya zhing shes lam thams cad shes par bya'o/ /de dag kyang yongs su rdzogs par bya zhing de dag gi lam gyi bya ba yang bya la zhes gsungs pas/ theg pa chen po pa yin pa'i phyir theg dman gyi sde snod la bslab par mi bya'o zhes smra ba ni 'gal ba'i rtags so/ /theg pa chen po'am lam la 'jug pa la lam thun mong ba dang thun mong min pa gnyis yod la/ thun mong pa ni theg dman gyi sde snod nas 'byung ba rnams yin pas de dag dor byar ga la 'gyur/ des na rang gcig pu zhi bde don gnyer la sogs pa'i dmigs bsal can 'ga' re ma gtogs pa thams cad theg chen pas 152

kyang nyams su blangs dgos pas/ byang sems rnams kyis shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod las theg pa gsum ga rgya cher ston pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin no/ /gzhan yang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni skyon phyogs re zad pa dang yon tan phyogs re rdzogs pa min gyi/ skyon gyi rigs thams cad zad cing yod tan gyi rigs mtha' dag rdzogs pa yin la/ de sgrub pa'i theg pa chen po yang skyon mtha' dag 'gog cing yon tan mtha' dag bskyed pas na theg pa gzhan thams cad kyi spangs rtogs kyi yon tan gyi rigs thams cad theg pa chen po'i lam du 'du ba yin no/ /de'i phyir sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i theg pa chen po 'am lam gyi yan lag tu gsung rab thams cad 'du ste/ skyon sna re zad pa'am yon tan sna re bskyed pa min pa'i thub pa'i gsung med pa'i phyir dang / de thams cad kyang theg chen pos mi sgrub pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa chen por 'jug pa la theg dman gyi sde snod nas bshad pa'i lam rnams dgos na'ang rdo rje'i theg par 'jug pa la ni phar phyin gyi theg pa'i lam rnams thun mong par mi 'gyur te lam mi mthun pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ 'di yang chos mi rigs te/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam gyi ngo bo ni bsam pa byang chub tu sems bskyed 153

pa dang / spyod pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug la slob par 'du ba yin la/ de ni rnam pa thams cad du bsten dgos par dpal rdo rje rtse mo las ji skad du/ 'tsho ba'i srog gi phyir yang ni/ /byang chub sems ni 'dor mi bya/ /zhes dang / pha rol phyin drug spyod pa ni/ /nam yang 'dor bar mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / gzhan yang sngags kyi gzhung du mar gsungs so/ /rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor du 'jig pa'i skabs du mar yang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa gnyis gnyis gzung dgos par gsungs la/ snga ma ni byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa nyid yin cing sdom pa gzung ba ni tshul khrims gsum la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la slob par khas blangs pa yin pas sems bskyed nas bslab pa la slob par khas blangs pa bzhin du slob pa las gzhan pa'i lam pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa la yang med pa'i phyir dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang sasbu ṭa dang rdo rje rtse mo rnams su/ phyi dang gsang pa theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung / /zhes 'od dpag med kyi dam tshig bzung ba'i skabs su gsungs pa ltar sngags kyi sdom pa 'dzin pa na khas blangs dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /'di dag la gnang bkag mi 'dra ba'i cha than thun 154

mthong nas tsha grang ltar thams cad du 'gal bar 'dzin pa ni rtog pa shin tu rtsing bar gsal lo/ /de ltar nang dmigs bsal can gyi gnang bkag 'ga' re ma gtogs pa gsung rab rnams shin tu mthun pas theg pa gsum mam lam lnga lta bu gong ma gong mar 'jug pa ni theg pa dang lam 'og ma'i 'og ma'i yon tan gyi rigs tshang ba dgos so/ /pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam ni rgyal ba'i yum las/ rgyal ba 'das dang ma byon da ltar gang bzhugs pa/ /kun lam pha rol phyin pa 'di yin gzhan ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sangs rgyas su bgrod pa'i lam gyi gzhung shing lta bu yin pas dor du mi rung ngo / /'di nyid rdo rje theg pa las kyang mang du bka' stsal pas na mdo rgyud gnyis ga'i lam thun mong pa'o/ /de'i steng du gsang sngags kyi lam thun mong min pa dbang dang dam tshig dang sdom pa dang rim pa gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa bsnan pas sangs rgyas su bgrod pa myur ba yin gye lam thun mong ba dor na ni nor ba chen bo'o/ /de lta bu'i go ba mi rnyed na chos re re la nges pa ltar snang re rnyed pa na gzhan rnams spong zhing khyad par du gong ma la mos pa ltar snang zhig skyes pa na rim pa ltar theg dman gyi sde snod dang pha rol tu phyin pa rnams spong zhing / sngags la yang rgyud sde 'og ma 155

gsum la sogs pa spong bar 'gyur bas 'brel che la 'byung nye zhing rnam par smin pa ches lci ba'i chos spong ba'i las kyi sgrib pa chen po gsog par 'gyur te/ de'i khungs ni 'og tu ston par 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir dam pa'i mgon la brten nas gsung rab thams cad gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i cha rkyen du 'gyur ba'i tshul la nges pa brtan par byas la/ da lta nyams su longs pa rnams nyams su blang zhing dngos su 'jug ldog ma nus pa rnams kyang rang nyid kyis 'jug ldog ma nus pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ ma spang bar de dag la dngos su 'jug ldog gi sgo nas nyams su lon pa zhig nam zhig na 'ong snyam du bsams nas de'i rgyur tshogs bsag pa dang sgrib pa sbyang ba dang smon lam gdab par bya'o/ /des ni ring por mi thogs par blo'i mthu je che je cher song ste de dag thams cad nyams su len nus par yang 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen ston pa rin po che'i zhal nas kyang / bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer shes pa nga'i bla ma/ /zhes gsungs te tshig 'di dpyad gzhi shin tu che ba yin no/ /de ltar na gdams ngag 'dis mdo sngags kyi gnad thams cad gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i lam du bsdus nas 'khrid pas na 'di ni bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du 156

rtogs pa'i che ba dang ldan no//gsung rab thams cad gdams ngag tu 'char ba ni/ spyir thar pa 'dod pa rnams la 'phral dang yun gyi phan bde thams cad bsgrub pa'i thabs ni rgyal ba'i gsung rab nyid yin te/blang dor gyi gnas thams cad ston pa la 'khrul pa ma lus pa dang bral ba ni sangs rgyas nyag cig yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar yang rgyud bla ma las/ gang phyir rgyal las che mkhas 'ga' yang 'jig rten 'di na yod min te/ /ma lus de nyid mchog ni tshul bzhin kun mkhyen gyis mkhyen gzhan min pa/ /de phyir drang srong de nyid kyis bzhag mdo sde gang yin de mi dkrug /thub tshul bshig phyir de yang dam chos la ni gnod pa byed par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na rgyal ba'i bka' mdo sde dang rgyud sde rin po che rnams gdams pa'i mchog yin no/ /de lta na 'ang tshad ldan gyi dgongs 'grel dang dam pa'i man ngag dang mi ldan par bka' la rang stobs kyis zhugs pas phyi rabs kyi gdul bya rnams kyis dgongs pa mi rnyed pas shing rta chen po rnams kyis dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos dang man ngag rnams mdzad do/ /de'i phyir man ngag rnam par dag pa yin na gzhung chen rnams la nges pa ster cig dgos kyi man 157

ngag la ci tsam sbyangs kyang bka' dang dgongs 'grel chen mo rnams kyi don la nges pa ster mi nus pa'am de dag dang mi mthun pa'i lam ston na ni 'dor bar bya ba kho na'o/ /gang yang gzhung chen mo rnams la nyams len gyi gnad med pa'i bshad chos su byas shing nyams len gyi gnad snying po'i don ston pa'i man ngag zur du yod par go nas dam pa'i chos rang la bshad pa dang sgrub pa'i chos log log pa gnyis yod par 'dzin pa ni/dri ma med pa'i mdo rgyud dang dri ma med pa'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos la gus pa chen po skye ba'i gegs byed cing / de dag la nang gi don mi ston pa'i phyi rgya tsam gcod pa'o zhes brnyas pa'i gnas su 'dzin pa'i chos spong ba'i las kyi sgrib pa gsog par shes par bya'o/ /des na thar 'dod rnams la mi bslu ba'i gdams pa mchog ni gzhung chen mo rnams yin mod/de yang rang nyid blo zhan pa la sogs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis gdams pa'i mchog tu gzhung de tsam la brten nas nges mi nus pas dam pa'i man ngag la brten nas de dag la nges pa btsal bar bya'o snyam du man ngag tshol dgos pa yin gyi gzhung rnams ni phyi rgya gcod pa tsam yin pas snying po med la/ man ngag rnams ni nang gi don ston pas mchog go snyam du mi gzung 158

ngo / /rnal 'byor pa chen po byang chub rin chen gye zhal nas/ /gdams ngag la nang byan chud pa ni/ be'u bum lag mthil tsam zhig la nges pa rnyed pa la mi zer gyi gsung rab thams cad gdams ngag tu go ba la zer zhes pa dang / jo bo chen po'i slob ma sgom pa rin chen bla mas kyang / a ti sha'i gdams ngag la stan thog gcig tu lus ngag yid gsum rdul du brlag pas da gzhung thams cad gdams ngag tu go ba zhig byung gsungs pa ltar go dgos pa yin no/ /ston pa rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos mang du bslabs nas chos byed lugs gzhan du rtsad gcod dgos pa byung na nor ba yin gsungs pa ltar/ yun ring bor chos mang du bslabs kyang chos byed lugs ye mi shes par chos byed 'dod byung ba na rtsad gzhan nas gcod dgos pa rnams kyang sngar bshad pa ltar ma go bas nongs te/ 'dir bstan pa ni mdzod las/ ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lung rtogs kyi bstan pa gnyis las med la/ lung gi bstan pa ni chos lag tu len pa'i tshul sgrub pa byed lugs gtan la 'bebs pa yin la/rtogs pa'i bstan pa ni/ gtan la 'bebs pa na ji ltar gtan la phab pa ltar sgrub pa yin pas de gnyis rgyu 'bras su 159

'gro ba yin te/ dper na rta rgyug pa na sngon la rta la dkyu sa ston pa dang bstan zin nas de ru rgyug pa lta bu yin no/ /dkyu sa gzhan du bstan nas rgyugs gzhan du byed na bzhad gad du 'gyur ba ltar/ thos bsam gyis gzhan zhig gtan la phab nas sgrub pa na gzhan zhig sgrub tu ga la rung / de ltar yang sgom pa'i rim pa tha ma las/ yang thos pa dang bsam pa las byung ba'i shes rab kyis rtogs pa gang yin pa de nyid bsgoms pa las byung ba'i shes rab kyis bsgom par bya'i gzhan du ma yin te rta dkyus kyis bstan nas rgyug pa bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar na gdams pa 'dis bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi bar gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i lam gyi gnad thams cad tshang bar bsdus nas de dag thams cad 'jog sgom dgos pa rnams la 'jog sgom byed/dpyad nas sgom dgos pa rnams la so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad de nyams su len pa'i rim par dril nas 'khrid pas na gsung rab thams cad gdams ngag tu 'char ro/ /de lta ma yin pa'i lam gyi lus yongs su ma rdzogs pa'i cha shas 'ga' re la/ so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab dang bral bar tshe dril nas nyams su blangs pas ni gzhung chen mo rnams 160

gdams ngag tu mi 'char bar ma zad de dag la phyi'i go rgya gcod pa tsam du mthong nas spong bar 'gyur te/ gzhung che ba rnams nas bshad pa'i brjod bya de dag ni phal cher so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad dgos pa sha stag tu snang la/ de yang nyams len gyi tshe dor na de dag la gdams pa'i mchog tu mthong ba'i nges pa ji ltar skye/ de dag gdams pa'i mchog ma yin na ni de dag mdzad pa las lhag pa'i gdams ngag mkhan po su zhig gis rnyed/ de ltar mdo sde zab cing rgya che ba dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa gdams ngag tu shar na rgyud sde zab mo dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs chen mo rnams kyang tshegs med par gdams ngag tu shar nas de dag la gdams pa'i mchog tu 'dzin pa'i nges pa skyes te de rnams gdams ngag dngos min pa'i chos rgyab tu 'dzin pa'i log rtog rnams lhag ma med par ldog par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag tu rnyed pa ni/ gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i gzhung che ba rnams gdams pa'i mchog yin kyang yongs su ma sbyangs pa'i gang zag las dang po pas ni/ dam pa'i man ngag la ma brten par de dag la 161

zhugs kyang dgongs pa mi rnyed la/ rnyed du chug kyang dus shin tu ring ba dang tshegs shin tu che ba la ltos so/ /bla ma'i man ngag la brten na ni bde blag tu rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /gdams pa 'dis ni bka' dang bstan bcos kyi gnad ma nges pa nges pa bde blag tu ster bar 'gyur te de'i tshul ni skabs rnams su rgyas par ston par 'gyur ro/ /nyes spyod chen po rang 'gags su 'gro ba ni/ padma dkar po dang bden pa po'i le'u nas bshad pa ltar sangs rgyas kyi bka' thams cad dngos dang brgyud pas 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs ston par ma go bar 'ga' zhig 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs dang 'ga' zhig 'tshang rgya ba'i gegs su bzung nas bzang ngan dang rigs mi rigs dang theg pa che chung du phye ste/ byang sems kyis 'di la slob dgos 'di la slob mi dgos so zhes 'dor byar bzung na chos spong bar 'gyur te/ rnam par 'thag pa thams cad bsdus pa'i mdo las/ 'jam dpal dam pa'i chos spong ba'i las kyi sgrib pa ni phra'o/ /'jam dpal gang de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i bka' la la ni bzang bar 'du shes la la la ni ngan par 'du shes pa ni chos spong ba'o/ /gang chos spong ba des chos spangs pas de bzhin gshegs pa la skur pa 162

'debs pa yin/ dge 'dun la ngan du brjod pa yin no/ /'di ni rigs pa'o 'di ni mi rigs pa'o zhes zer na chos spong ba'o/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ched du gsungs pa'o 'di ni nyan thos rnams kyi ched du gsungs pa'o zhes zer na chos spong ba yin no/ /'di ni rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi ched du gsungs pa'o zhes zer na chos spong ba yin no/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa ma yin no zhes zer na chos spong ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /chos spangs na de'i nyes pa shin tu lci ba ni ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ gang gis 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir ni/ /mchod rten thams cad bshig byas pas/ gang gis mdo sde spong byed pa'i/ /sdig pa de ni ches khyad 'phags/ /gang gis gaṅgā'i bye snyed kyi/ /dgra bcom bsad par gyur pa bas/ /gang gis mdo sde spong byed pa'i/ /sdig pa de ni ches khyad 'phags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /spyir chos spong 'byung ba la sgo mang du snang na'ang sngar bstan pa'i sgo 'di che shos su snang bas 'bad pas spang bar bya'o/ /de yang sngar bstan pa ltar gyi nges pa rnyed pa tsam gyis ldog par 'gyur bas nyes spyod rang 'gags su 'gro ba'o/ /zhes gang gsungs pa ltar bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du rtog cing gsung rab ma 163

lus pa gdams par 'char ba rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag tu rnyed pa nyes spyod chen po rang 'gags su 'gro ba zhig ci nas kyang bya'o/ /yang kha cig na re/ skyes bu chung 'bring gnyis skyes bu chen po'i lam gyi sngon 'gro 'am yan lag lta bu yin/ byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i sgo nas skyes bu gcig sangs rgyas kyi sar 'khrid pa de nges par bden na/ skyes bu chung 'bring gi lam yang skyes bu chen po'i lam gyi khongs su bsdus nas chung 'bring gi bsam pa ma bskyed par thog ma nas byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas skyes bu chen por 'khrid/ skyes bu chen po'i lam gyi rim pa zhes ming btags nas 'khrid na tshegs chung la don che ming don mthun pas ches legs kyi kha nas skyes bu gcig sangs rgyas kyi sar 'khrid pa skad zer kyang / don la skyes bu chen po'i lam la slob pa bzhag nas thar pa tsam dang /'khor ba'i bde ba tsam gnyer ba'i theg dman lam la blo 'khrid pa skyes bu chen po'i lam las ring bar 'gyur bas sangs rgyas thob pa'i gegs/ don med bskar re bskor re mang po byas skyes bu blo kha chung ba rnams kyis gang sgrub ngo mi shes pa mgo 'khor ba'i rgyu/ dgos pa ci yang med par ma zad byang chub kyi lam la ring du btang ba yin la/164

yang skyes bu gcig sangs rgyas kyi sar khrid pa'i byang chub lam rim zhes zer ba de bden na skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim zer ba gnyis dngos 'gal yin gyi/ skyes bu gcig byang chub tu 'khrid pa'i lam rim yin na skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim yin zer ba mar bud/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim yin na skyes bu gcig byang chub tu 'khrid pa'i lam rim yin zer ba mar bud/ 'di 'dra la dgos ched mi 'gal bar shes byed kyi lung rigs ci yod zer na/ de ltar 'khrid pa la dgos pa che tshul bshad na mtha' yas kyang 'dir rags pa tsam go sla phyir bshad na/ sngon sbyangs gang zag las 'phro can theg pa chen po'i rigs can dang / tshe 'dir yang bla ma yun ring bsten nas blo kha sbyangs sbyangs pa'i gang zag dbang po rab tu song ba zhig yin na khyod kyis bshad pa ltar byas kyang 'gal ba med mod/ 'on kyang 'o skol tshe 'khor ba thog med nas 'khor ba mtho dman du 'khor la zhen cing chags pa'i skye bo ngan song gsum nas thon ma thag cig yar sangs rgyas kyi sar 'khrid dgos pa la lam la rim gyis bslabs nas blo ma sbyangs par thog ma nas sems bskyed du bcug nas rgyal sras kyi spyod pa bya dka' ba rnams la bslab tshul bstan na/ dper na khab mig tu ras yugs brdzangs pa 165

ltar blo khar mi shong zhing / dper na byis pa btsas ma khad cig la thog mar nu zho/ de nas rtsam nyog sogs byen nas kho rang gi tshod dang bstun nas ma byin par/ sha chang mar thud bzang snyam nas byen na zos kyang mi phan par ma zad zas des gnod nas 'chi ba ltar/ 'o skol so skye blo kha chung ba'i byes pa lta bu la rtsam nyog lta bu'i chos chung chung sngon la bstan nas blo rim gyis ma sbyangs par/ thog ma nas bdag pas gzhan gces kyi byang sems stong nyid lta ba sogs bstan na/ log lta the tshom sogs skyes te 'dor ba'i nyen yod la theg chen sbyong ba theg dman gyi srog gcod zer ba ltar phan las gnod par 'gyur ba ches mang ngo / /'di dper na byis pa la de'i tshod kyi zas rtsam nyog sogs byen/ de nas gzhon du song tshe de'i tshod kyi zan badzis nas byin/ lang tsho dar la babs tshe sha chang sogs gang 'chun tshad byin nas zos na shin tu legs pa ltar/ las dang bo zhig la thog mar tshe 'di la zhen cing chags pa'i blo ngan gyong po de ldog phyir tshe mi rtag pa ngan song gi sdug bsngal sogs bsam du bcug phyi ma don gnyer gyi blo skyes pa'i tshe phyi mar mtho rim gye bde ba thob thabs las sla ba'i chos mi dge bcu spong sogs skyes bu chung ngu'i chos bstan/ de blor shong nas blo kha cher song 166

tshe de tsam zhig gis mi chog pa'i tshul 'khor ba spyi'i nyes dmigs bsam du bcug pas/ mtho ris kyang bde bar re ba'i blo de log nas thar ba'i bde bas yid phrogs tshe de 'thob thabs bslab gsum sogs skyes bu 'bring gi chos bstan/ de nas 'bring gi lam la blo sbyangs nas blo cher song tshe skyes bu chen po'i lam rim pas bstan na skyes bu gcig sangs rgyas kyi sar 'khrid pa la gang gi sa nas babs mi brdal ba zhig 'ong bas shin tu legs la/ gzhan yang skyes bu gsum gyi lam gye rim pa 'dir shes na sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi phung bo brgyad khri bzhi stong nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam gyi 'gro kun gnas skabs mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang dang / mthar thug nges legs thar ba tsam dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang 'thob pa'i thabs dang sde snod gsum rgyud sde bzhi la sogs pa'i rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel gang la bltas kyang bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du rtogs/ gsung rab ma lus gdams par 'char/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi dgongs don rnyed/ chos spong mi dge ba'i las sogs nyes spyod thams cad rang 'gags su 'gro ba'i dgos pa dang / gzhan yang skyes bu gsum gyi rnam bzhag shes na/ rang theg chen nam skyes bu chen por rloms pa'i nga rgyal 167

can gyis mthong tshe rang rgyud la skyes bu chung ngu'i chos bskor tsam yang ma skyes par 'dug snyam nga rgyal chag nas theg chen gyi lam la zhib tu slob pa dang rang theg chen gyi gral nas bud ma bud shes pa'i dgos pa dang / sems can la bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang zag dman pa dang 'bring dang chen po la sangs rgyas kyi gsung ltar gang la gang 'tshams kyi lam bstan nas/ gnas skabs mngon mtho mthar thug nges legs thar ba dang sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god pa'i blo rab 'bring tha gsum la phan che zhing gang 'dod byen chog pas sems can kun gyis re ba skong nus pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu yin te/ rje rin po ches/ skye dgu'i 'dod don ma lus skong bas na/ /gdams pa rin chen dbang gi rgyal po ste/ /gzhung bzang stong gi chu bo 'du ba'i phyir/ /dpal ldan legs par bshad pa'i rgya mtsho'ang yin/ /gsungs pa ltar zab rgyas chos kyi rgya mtsho chen po yin pas su gang la ston dgos kyang chos kyis phongs par mi 'gyur bas shin tu ngo mtshar che'o/ /dper na mi gcig la dang po chung dus byis pa/ de nas gzhon nu dar ma/de nas rgan pa zhes ming btags pa don la mi gcig yin kyang ming gsum btags pa mi 'gal ba ltar/ skyes bu gcig byang 168

chub kyi lam la 'khrid pa'i chos la skyes bu gsum zhes ming btags pa/ don la byang chub lam rim du gcig yin kyang /skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim zhes ming gsum btags pa mi 'gal bar ma zad/ sangs rgyas kyis nyan thos rang rgyal byang sems kyi theg pa gsum zhes btags kyang / theg pa gcig tu 'bab tshul mi gcig la rgan gzhon byes pa zhes ming btags pa dang 'dra zhes dpe bzhag nas gsungs pa dang mthun pas shin tu legs/dper na mi rgan zhig gis rang gi zas sha thud sogs za rung gzhon pas za ba'i zan dang byis pa chung ngu'i rtsam nyog la kha myang byas zos pas mi gnod par ma zad rang lus la phan cing /myong ba thon pas byis par zas ster tshul la sngar bas mkhas pa ltar/ theg chen pas kyang skyes bu chung 'bring gi lam la bslabs na rang rgyud chos kyis phyug cing / gzhan gdul bya dbang po chung 'bring la chos ston pa'i tshul la sngar bas mkhas par 'gyur bas legs la/ theg chen byang chub sems dpas sems can rnams kyi don mi bsgrubs pa gcig med sgrub dgos pa yin la de bsgrub pa la de dag gi lam shes dgos pa'i theg chen pas theg dman gyi nyan rang gi lam sogs la mi slob slob mi rung snyam nas 'khrul bar mi bya'o/ /dper na mgar ba mkhas 169

pas gser de dus su mer bsregs dus su chu la bcug cing brdung bas rgyan cha sku gzugs gang 'dod rnams byas na 'byung ba ltar sems rgyud gyong po 'di skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa'i sgo nas btul na mngon mtho nges legs kyi bde ba gang 'dod rnams bsgrubs na 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /des na byang chub lam gyi rim pa 'di la gus pa khyad par can bskyed cing ci nus kyis nyams su yang blang bar bya'o/ /rgyal ba yang dgon pa'i ri chos las/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyis gshegs pa'i shul/gsang sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam zab pa dang rgya che ba 'di go dgos/ bstan pa'i khog srol chen po 'di ma go na/ gdams chung i thi mtshal mgo ma re la btsir zin du bsgoms pas cir 'gyur cha med gsungs/ dpe chos las/ dper na thab chen po 'dzin pa la/ mi dgos dgu dgos zer ba skad du/ rten gyi gang zag gcig thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la mi bslab par bya ba'i dngos po ci yang med de/ bka' sde snod thams cad kyi tshig don ma lus pa thos dgos/ thos pa tsam gyis mi chog shes dgos/ theg pa mtha' dag gi don go longs pa zhig dgos te/mdor na rig pa'i gnas lnga la ma rmongs pa zhig gis thams 170

cad mkhyen pa sgrub dgos/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la mkhas par ma gyur na/ /'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen pa thob mi 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /des na dngos sam brgyud nas sems can gyi don byed pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis gsungs pa'i chos theg pa sna tshogs la/ thos pa rgya mtsho lta bu byed dgos gsungs/ sred med kyi bus zhus pa'i mdo las/rigs kyi bu thos pa dang ldan na shes rab 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /shes rab dang ldan na nyon mongs zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /nyon mongs pa med pa la bdud kyis glags mi rnyed do zhes pa dang / thos pas sdig las ldog par 'gyur/ /thos pas don ma yin pa spongs/ /thos pas dri med gzi brjid can/ /zhes so/ /'on kyang jo bo'i zhal nas/ tshe ni yun thung shes bya rnam pa mang / /tshe yi tshad kyang ji tsam mi shes pas/ /ngang bas chu las 'o ma len pa ltar/ /rang gi 'dod pa dang du blang bar gyis/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'o skol gyes lo stong gi bar du thos pa byas kyang sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pya'i chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gi rtsad mi chod la/ da lta snyigs ma'i dus 'dir tha snyad mang bo'i tshig rjes bcad pa'i long med/snying bo bsdu ba'i dus yin pas bla ma'i man ngag la gtugs la 171

thos bsam sgom gsum sprugs mar byed dgos gsungs/ de yang sangs rgyas kyis chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa de thams cad kyi don bden pa gnyis su 'dus la/ bden pa gnyis kyi don gtan la phab na chos thams cad gtan la phab pa yin gsungs pa ltar thos pa rgya cher bya/ gal te rgya cher ma nus kyang kun rdzob bden pa dang don dam bden pa la sogs pa'i don gtan la phab nas bsgoms shing / gzhan thos pa rgya chen po mdzad pa'i chos lugs yongs la dag snang sbyangs par bya'o/ /rgyal dbang rje'i zhal nas/ khong chen po rnams bzhed pa'i grub mtha' dang / /theg pa sna tshogs kyi chos skad kyang / /rang rang gi sa na bden mod kyang / /gung gcig tu 'grigs na zab pa yin/ /zhes dang / mdor na rgyud sde re re ba dang / rgya gzhung re re ba'i sgras zin tshad dang / dngos bstan gyi cha tsam ma yin par/ gsang ba zab mo rnam par 'byed pa'i mig dang ldan pas ni/ gnad gang yang rung ba re re la brten nas mtha' dag kyang gung gcig tu 'grigs pa ni/ sangs rgyas nas brgyud / bar ma chad pa'i bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gi khyad chos te/ gzhan du na gang yang rung ba zhig mchog tu 'dzin pa las cig shos sam gzhan mtha' dag mi 'thad par 'dzin pa'i 172

log par rtog pa'i chos spong ba mi zad pa la 'jug pa'i thabs ngan par 'gyur/ de bas na rgyal ba'i bstan pa la bag yod po'i bla gos kyis mdzes pa rnams kyis ni bstan pa thams cad 'gal med/ chos thams cad du ma ro gcig nyid kyi nges pa las brtsams te/ gsung rab thams cad gdams pa'i bdud rtsi'i nying khu mchog tu bsten na/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa'i gsang ba mtha' dag khong du chud cing / nyes spyod mtha' dag las rang sar grol bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / spyir yang gang zag bsam pa sna tshogs pas theg pa sna tshogs pa dang / blo'i mtho dman gyis theg pa che chung dang / skal ba dang ldan mi ldan gyis lam myur bul yin par thams cad cha yod bzhin du 'khrid tshul gcig kho nas byed dgos par sems pa ni/ rta zhar pa'i mig bzhin du phyogs gcig kho na mthong bas skyon no/ /des na bla ma nyams myong can med par slob ma'i rgyud tshod mi shes/ de ma shes par de dang mthun pa'i 'khrid tshul mi shes/ de ma shes par lam yin lugs mi mthong bas/ blo'i mtho dman gyi dbye ba gang yang mi phyed par bden yang dbyug pa bco brgyad/ mi bden kyang dbyug pa bco brgyad kyi tshul du ci yin cha med ces dang / rgya gar gyi grub chen brgyad cu thams cad kyis kyang /173

gnas lugs don ngo sprod pa'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang re la brten nas/ skal ldan gyi thugs rgyud smin cing grol bar mdzad pa yin/rgya gar nas bod du bsgyur ba'i man ngag gi gzhung rnams ni/sngon 'gro dang 'khrid kyi dmigs rim 'di dang 'di lta bu ni gcig kyang med la/ bod blo chung spos pa la dga'/ rnam rtog rags shing gnyen po zhan pas/ gang zag dam pa rnams kyis de dag gi blo dang bstun nas sngon 'gro bsags sbyang gi rim pa mdo rgyud nas gsungs pa rnams spros nas dang po bstan/ ces dang / de la dbang po'i khyad par gyis/ dbang bskur ba cho ga kho na ma ltos bzhin du gdams ngag la rang sangs rgyas la sogs pa thams cad kyis kyang / sgra med lus kyi rnam 'gyur gyi sgo nas chos ston pa yod/ sngags kyi theg par de bas ches lhag pa'i brda' thabs kyi sgo nas chos ston pa yod pas/ ngag kho na la ltos dgos pa'i nges pa med do/ /de bzhin du lung la yang glegs bam lag tu gtad pa tsam gyis 'grub pa dang /dgongs pa gtad pa tsam gyis 'grub pa dang / ma 'ongs pa na dus gzhan du chos 'di'i bdag po byed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'am gyis shig ces pa lung bstan pa tsam gyis 'grub pa yod pas/ tshig 'bru re re nas klog dgos pa'i nges pa med cing /174

klog pa kha ton du byed pa dang rgya chen 'chad pa rnams ni rnam gzhag gzhan yin/ zhes dang / chos kyi rgyal srid la dbang ba'i rdo rje slob dpon rnams kyis dam tshig dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnams chos 'di'i bdag po gyis shig ces pa'am/ gdams pa 'di nyams su longs shig ces pa'am/ gzhan la rgya cher ston cig ces bka'i nges pa de nyid lung gi don yin no/ /dper na dbang bskur ba'i mjug tu chos kyi dung bus/ chos kyi sgra sgrogs/ chos kyi bshad pa gyis shig ces glegs bam lag tu gtad pa tsam gyis de dag gi bya ba la dbang ba lta bu yin no/ /'di la ni bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dang slob ma snod dang ldan pa gtso bo yin gyi/ yi ge klog pa'i bya ba gtso bo ma yin no gsungs/ bshes gnyen thar ba gling pas/ dus 'khor nas bshad pa'i gling bzhi ri rab kyi gnas tshul dang / mngon pa nas bshad pa mi mthun pas don la ji ltar bzhed dris pa'i lan du/ 'di'i dogs gcod byed pa shin tu mang po 'dug na yang / spyir snod bcud kyi dbye ba mtha' yas pa rang gi bsam pa dang / khams dang dbang po'i dbye bas gnyis su 'dus pa ma yin zhing / rdo ba 'phangs pa'i mdo dang / byams pa lung bstan pa'i mdo dang / lag na rdo rje gos sngon can/ rdo rje 'og 175

gi rgyud dang / sdom pa 'byung ba sogs nas 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rnam gzhag mi 'dra ba ci tsam re gsungs pa dag dang /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal por/'dab ma bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad kyi bum pa dang / rnal 'byor ma rnams rdzogs pa'i tshe/ ri rab kyi steng gi char 'bebs pa'o zhes pa nas brtsam nas/ zla ba'i gling dang ku sha'i gling sogs ri gling mtsho gsum gyi grangs dang ming rnams dus kyi 'khor lo dang mthun pa zhig kyang gsungs pas/ des na sems can rnams kyi bsam pa'i mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes kyi 'jug pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir/ gang yang rung ba zhig mtha' gcig tu dngos gnas la grub par sems pa'i dngos por mngon par zhen pa yongs su dag pa'i phyir/ rgya ma nges pa dang tshad ma nges pa dang /bkod pa ma nges pas 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa gsungs pa mthong bzhin du/ gang rung gcig kho nar sgrub par 'dod pa tshul ma yin zhing / rnam par shes pa tsam du smra bas kyang / phyi don bden par dngos su mi 'dod na/ dbu ma bar khas 'che ba rnams kyis 'jig rten gyi khams su ma zad mtha' 176

yas pa'i rnam gzhag thams cad gnas skabs su rang gi don byed par snang ba dang / stong ba nyid las chos gzhan med par ston pa mi 'gal bar rtogs dgos pa yin no gsungs/ de yang sangs rgyas kyi dgongs gzhi tha dad la dgongs nas gsung mi 'dra ba sna tshogs 'byon te/ dper na bstan pa'i gnas tshad la mdo bskal ba bzang por lnga stong du gsungs la/ zla ba'i snying po las nyis stong du gsungs/ 'dul ba lung phran tshegs las stong du gsungs/ sprin chen po las bdun brgyar gsungs pa dang / chos nyid rang gi ngo bo mi g.yo bar tha dad par snang ba las bdun stong dang brgyad brgyar gsungs pa dang / gser 'od las/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las mi 'da' chos kyang nub par mi 'gyur par gsungs pa dang / mdo bstan bcos phal cher las lnga brgya phrag bcu las mi gnas par gsungs/ de bzhin du mdo rgyud bstan bcos na tshig gi ngos nas mi 'dra ba 'gal ba ltar snang ba mang yang / de dag rnams kyi dgongs don btsal nas mi 'gal ba'i tshul shes na mkhas pa yin pas/ bka' thang las/ tshig la mkhas pa mkhas pa ma yin te/ /mi g.yo don la mkhas na mkhas pa yin gsungs/des na gsung rab thams cad 'gal med du rtogs nas 177

gdams par 'char bar 'dod pas bka' dri med dgongs don 'tshol ba la rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i zhal nas/ sprang bdag la blo gtad slob ma rnams/ /skyabs dkon mchog gsum la blo gtod la/ /bka' dri med dgongs don 'bod gsungs so/ /des na yi ge na gcig yan chad 'dor rgyu med par bka' bstan bcos thams cad gdams par shar ba la/ bka' gdams pa dang / bka' brgyud pa zhes zer ba'i bod du dar ba'i grub mtha' phan tshun gyis nga'i chos bzang / khyod kyi chos ngan zhes grub mtha'i bzang ngan la bsnyad btags nas sangs rgyas kyi bka' bstan bcos la spang blang dgag sgrub byed pa'i tshig rjes 'brang ba'i mkhas par rloms pa rnams mi g.yo'i don la mkhas pas snying rje dang bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /grub chen tā ra na ba'i zhal nas/ chos thams cad gcig du bral dang rten 'byung gi rigs pa sogs la brten nas snang ba ltar rang bzhin ma grub pa'i tshul la dmigs nas gsal stong du bsgom mo/ /'di yang las dang po pa zhi gnas phyogs mthun tsam yang ma grub cing / rnam par mi rtog pa'i sgom gyi 'jug sgo tsam yang ma shar ba ji snyed cig 'byung ba rnams su ches phan par 'gyur bas thabs mkhas zab mo yin pas/ rdo rje slob dpon chen po 178

grub chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi zhal snga nas sgrub pa'i thabs kun tu bzang po las shin tu rgyas pa che thang du gsungs pa dang / de'i dgongs 'grel gye 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs tshad dang ldan pa mtha' yas pa zhig las bshad pas/ gang dag gsang sngags kyi lugs la rnam par mi rtog pa 'ba' zhig yin zhes smra ba de dag ni/ bdag nyid legs par ma bslab bzhin du/mtha' yas pa'i sems can sgrol bar mdzad pa'i dam pa rnams la so so skye bo ci yang ma bsgoms shing / sde snod dang rgyud sde la ma bslabs pa'i blun po 'ga' zhig gis skur ba 'debs pa'i tshig tsam zhig gi rjes su 'brang nas/ snying nas smod pa'i las ngan pa gsog pa tsam du zad kyi/ lung rigs kyi sgrub byed sna gcig med par ma zad/ gsang sngags rdzogs rim gye skabs su bden med kyi 'dun pa sbyong ba sogs rang lugs dang yang 'gal ba yin no/ /yang 'ga' zhig las dang po ba'i skabs su rnam par mi rtog pa'i phyag rgya chen po nan gyes 'gog pa de dag ni shin tu mi 'thad mod kyi/ lung rigs du ma'i sgo nas gzhan du bkag zin te/ de na grong khyer chen po'i sgo nas 'gro na nub sgo kho nas 'jug dgos pas/ phyogs lhung gi grub mtha' ngan pa 'di ma 'dzin cig ces gdams ngag tu bya'o gsungs so/ /po 179

to ba'i gsung sgos be'u bum sngon po las/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po las/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rnam par spros pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po zer nas dbu zhabs thams cad bkang nas gsungs pa yin/ de la gzhan dag gis phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba ming btags nas/ de gcig pus chog zer gsungs/ yang dge bshes spyan sngas po to ba la/ chos dang chos ma yin pa'i khyad par gye be'u bum zhig bskur nas/ gcig gis po to ba'i spyan sngar bklags pas/ po to ba'i zhal nas/ de 'dir khyogs dang gsungs nas gzigs te/ phag tu sbas nas 'di ni 'di kho na tsug byar btub ste mi 'ong / ngas ni phur tsho ba la chos min zer mi nus/ a ma na si la yang chos min zer mi nus te/ a ma na si bya ba yid la mi byed pa la bya ba yin te/chos bzang po yang dag pa yin/ gang zag de lta bu la zhugs ma ran pa rnams kyis zhugs pas lan pa yin te/ dper na spyod pa ma ran par byas pas spyod pa ba nag po'i gtam rgyud dang 'dra ba yin gsungs/ ras chung rdo rje grags kyis/ chos snga 'gyur 'di la las 'thab cing 'dug pa/ 'di la sangs rgyas kyis ni gsung ngo shes sam zhus pas/ mi la'i zhal nas/yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas ma gsungs 180

pa'i chos shig lo paṇa sprul sku rnams kyis khyer ga na 'ong gsungs/ yang grub thob o rgyan pa la slob ma bu chen rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa'i rtsa ltung gi skabs na/ theg pa chen po spong byed cing / /dam chos 'du snang ston byed pa/ /zhes pa 'di'i dngos gzhi ji tsam gcig la ngos 'dzin pa lags zhus pas/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ de'i don la 'di ltar yin/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gang zag gi rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa la dgongs nas/theg pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa yin/de la rang rang gis blo dang gang 'bad pa'i chos de la nyams len byas nas/ chos gzhan la ma smad par rjes su yi rang phul na/ chos gang nyams su blangs kyang lam du 'gro ba yin la/rang gi chos de zab par 'dod pa la chos gzhan la smad pas/chos spong ba'i las bsags pa yin/ mdo las chos gcig zab la gcig mi zab pa ni chos spong ba'i las so/ /zhes bshad de de'i gnad ma go bar chos spong ba'i gang zag mang po 'dugabaka' bstan bcos rab 'byams kyi don ni ma go rang gi grub mtha' dum cig tsam gyis rdo 'jong phugs su bcang nas stong pa nyid bsgom pa'i snga phyi dang / stong pa nyid bsgom pa'i dus 181

yin min dang / theg chen la chos 'di tshod cig gi shlau ga'i grangs brtsi ba la sogs pa'i log shes kyi bsam mno du ma zhig gi sgo nas/ stong nyid kyi don la thag bsring bar byed/ stong nyid kyi don ci yis mi rtogs par byed/ stong nyid kyi don dang ci phral byed pa'i gang zag mang po 'dug pas/ de rnams la lhung ba de 'phog pa yin/ de bas kyang kham che ba'i log lta bzung ba yod de/ stong nyid la thag bsrings pa tsam gyis mi do/stong nyid chos ma yin zhing / klu sgrub kyi log shes yin zhes pa dang / yang yi/ ma na si chos ma yin/ rdzogs pa chen po chos ma yin/ nges pa'i don gting rtsa ba nas spong ba don dam pa'i bden pa gting nas spong ba/ chos zab mo gting nas spong ba/bsam gyes mi khyab pa'i don rtsa ba nas spong ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rtsa ba nas spong ba/ dbu ma chen po'i don rtsa ba nas spong ba ste/ bka' dri ma med pa la/ bka' ma yin par skur ba btab/ rang rang gi grub mtha'i rdo 'jong mgo bton nas/ rang gi rgyud thog tu chos spong ba'i las kham po che bsags pa ma tshor ba'i gang zag gi rigs 'di rnams la/ ma mthong ba'i g.yang sa chen po yong bar 'dug gzhan yang da lta stong nyid bsgom pa'i dus ma yin/ stong nyid bsgom pa snga na/ las rgyu 182

'bras khyad du gsod pa yin pas dang po stong nyid bsgom pa de lings kyis zhog la/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgom pa dang /dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsgom pa dang / 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid mi rtag par bsgom pa dang / las rgyu 'bras kyi 'dor len la 'bad dgos zer ba'i gang zag mang bo gda'/ de rnams kyang mas 'jog gi bstan pa'i go rim yin te/ a ma na si chos ma yin/ rdzogs pa chen po chos ma yin zer ba kham ches pas theg pa chen po spong ba'i rtsa ltung yong bas de skad zlar mi btub/skur ba de lta bu ma btab par/ rang gi rgyud dang mthun pa'i chos de rnams nyams su blangs na legs pa yin te/ a ma na si zer ba de la/ a ma na si kwa ra zhes bya ba ni/ saṃ skre ta'i skad yin te/ de bsgyur bas a ma na yid/ si kwa ran byed pa de as bkag pas/ yid la byed pa med pa zhes byas pa ste/ yid la mi byed pa'am/ yid las grol ba'am/ yid las 'das pa la 'jug ste/ de ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /zhes bya ba 'di nyid kho na ste/ brgyad stong pa las/ chos thams cad kyi mi dmigs pa gang yin pa de ni/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / stong phrag brgya ba las kyang / gzugs yid la mi byed/ tshor ba yid 183

la mi byed/ ces pa la sogs rgya cher gsungs pa de nyid spangs pas lhung ba phog pa yin mod/ rdzogs pa chen po rnam dag tsho la yang kha btang du ga la btub ste/ dam pa rgya gar la/ rdzogs pa chen po la las dkar nag gi 'bras bu med skad pa de bden nam zhus pas/ rdzogs na bden gsungs/ 'o na de lta ba mtho ba lags sam zhus pas/ rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba la mtho dma' med nam mkha' dang 'dra gsungs/ rdzogs chen la'ang sems 'dzin gyi bsgom dang ni yod skad zhus pas/ nam mkha' khos khab mig tu yang yong shes par gda' gsungs pas na/theg chen spangs par 'gro ba mi 'dug gam/ lung thams cad nas kyang / gang yid la byed pa'i chos thams cad ni mi dge zhing / yid la mi byed pa'i chos thams cad kyi byang chub thob par bshad pa sha stag yod/ lung gang nas bshad na/ ye shes snang ba rgyan gyi mdo la sogs pa bka' bstan bcos du ma nas bshad/ lung gang gis btub na/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' dri ma med pa rnams dang / rtsom pa po tshad dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos chen mo rnams lung de che ba yin/ gzhan yang bka' bstan bcos thams cad kyi bcud phyung nas/ nyams su blangs pa'i sgrub brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rtogs pa dang ldan zhing 184

grub pa thob pa chos kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi gsung /mgur ma dang tshigs bcad brda'i bye brag dang / thabs kyi khyad par dang / ku re dang / bzhad gad kyi sgo nas gsungs pa rnams kyi nang na/ bka' dri ma med pa rnams kyi don phyin ci ma log pa yod pas lung du che ba yin no/ /chos rje'i zhal nas/rtogs ldan nyams myong bde gshegs bka' dang 'dra/ /zhes gsungs pa de shin tu mad pa yin te/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad thugs rje'i rang bzhin 'ba' zhig tu bzhugs/ de nyid smon lam gyi dbang gis gang la gang 'dul gyi skur byon pa yin te/ de yang skus 'dul ba la skur byon/gsung gis 'dul ba la gsung byon/ thugs kyis 'dul ba la thugs su byon/ skus 'dul ba la bem po'i skus 'dul ba dang /rig pa ye shes dang ldan pas 'dul ba ste/ bem pos 'dul ba la/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan/ bal yul 'phags pa shing kun/rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga/ bod yul na lha sa 'phrul snang / brag dmar bsam yas/ gzhan yang ri byen rlabs can/ dgon gnas byin rlabs can/ sku'i rnam pa la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku/ byang chub sems dpa'i sku/ grub thob kyi sku la sogs pa/de yang lugs ma'am/ bris sku/ lder sku ru bzhengs pa la 185

sogs pa'i gzugs sna tshogs su byon nas sems can gye don mdzad do/ /gzhan yang skyes bu dam pa sku yal ba rnams la sku dang ring bsrel dang me tog gi char dang / 'ja' tshon la sogs pa dang gzhan pa'i rdo dang shing la sogs pa la rang 'byon gyi sku dpag tu med pa byon nas sems can gye don mdzad do/ /gzugs brnyan ma yin pa'i bem po'i skus 'dul ba la/ 'byung ba lnga la sogs pa gang la gang 'dul sna tshogs su byon pa yin/ de'ang sas 'dul ba la sa'i khyad par ram bye brab/ sna tshogs su byon pa yin/ de bzhin du chus 'dul ba dang /mes 'dul ba dang / rlung gis 'dul ba dang / nam mkhas 'dul ba la sogs pa rnams la so so'i khyad par sna tshogs su byon pa yin no/ /rig pa can ye shes dang ldan pas 'dul ba la/ khyad par bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba la sangs rgyas/ byang chub sems dpas 'dul ba la byang chub sems dpa'/ rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos kyis 'dul ba la de dang de rab tu byung ba dang / rgyal po dang / btsun mo dang /blon po dang / khyim bdag dang / so so skye bo rnams dang /rngon pa dang / bya ba dang / nya ba dang / gdol ba la sogs pa rnams gdul ba la de dang de'i gzugs su snang nas de dang de 186

'dul zhing don mdzad do/ /gsung gis 'dul ba la yang /bem po'i gsung gis 'dul ba dang / rigs pa'i gsung gis 'dul ba ste/ dang po ni nam mkha' la chos kyi sgra bsgrags pa dang / 'byung lnga'i sgra bsgrags pa dang / dung gi sgra dang / rnga bo che'i sgra dang / pi wang gi sgra la sogs pa rol mo sna tshogs pas sems can gye don mdzad do/ /rigs pa'i gsung gis 'dul ba la/ zhal nas gsungs pa'i bka'/ byin gyes brlabs pa'i bka'/ rjes su gnang ba'i bka'/ khyad par dpag tu med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'dul ba dang /mkhas grub chen po rnams kyi bstan bcos kyis 'dul ba dang /bla ma'i man ngag dang byin rlabs kyis 'dul ba dang / brda dang thabs kyis 'dul ba dang / zhi ba dang phan 'dogs pas 'dul ba dang / drag pos tshar bcad pas 'dul ba dang /btang snyoms su bzhag pas 'dul ba dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang snyan dngags kyis 'dul ba dang / tshig 'jeng po dang lhug pas 'dul ba dang / mu cor smra ba dang kha rgod ci tho dod kyis 'dul ba dang / glu gar la sogs pa'i bzhad gad sna tshogs kyis 'dul ba dang / de la sogs pa bsam gyes mi khyab pas sems can gye don mdzad de/ de skad du yang / lha yi skad 187

dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad/ /grul bum dag dang mi yi skad rnams dang / /'gro ba kun gyi skad rnams ji tsam par thams cad skad du bdag gis chos ston to/ /zhes gsungs pas/gang zag dag gis zhi rgyas la sogs pa'i 'phrin las kyi 'dul du mi 'dod pa la/ drag pos tshar bcad de rim gyis drangs nas 'dul ba ste/ bde ba'i lam la 'god dgos pa yin te/byang chub sems dpa' des snying rje 'ba' zhig gis kun nas bslangs nas/ pha rol po de la gnod pa'i las byas te/ las kyi 'brel ba de la brten nas nam zhig byang chub sems dpa' de'i gdul byar cis kyang yong ba yin te/ de bzhin du pha rol po des kyang byang chub sems dpa' de la gnod pa byas pas/las 'brel de la brten nas kyang byang chub sems dpa' de'i gdul byar cis kyang 'ong ba yin/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs nas/ gzhan don la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des pha rol po la phan btags sam gnod pa byas kyang rung la/ de la pha rol pos kyang bsnyen bkur byas sam/ gnod bskyal kyang rung ste/ de nyid dngos su gnod pa ltar snang yang brgyud nas gdul byar 'gyur bas phan pa chen por 'gyur ba yin te/ gang la sems kyi dam pa 188

rin chen de/ /skyes pa de yi sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la gnod pa byas kyang bder 'brel ba'i/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs la/ de bas na rang la zhe 'dod gting nas med pa'i snying rje chen po 'ba' zhig gis sems can gye dbang du gyur pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de ni gdul bya la phan pa byas pa dang / gnod pa byas pa dang /legs pa byas pa dang / nyes pa byas pa dang / spyod lam 'thad pa dang mi 'thad pa'i rnam 'gyur dang / bya ba gang dang tshul dang mi mthun pa'i spyod pa sna tshogs ston par gyur kyang /gzhan de tshar gcod pa dang / sma 'bebs pa dang / chad pa gcod pa dang / mtshang nas 'bru ba la sogs pa mi rigs pa sna tshogs byas kyang / rnam 'gyur de thams cad la nyes pa gtan nas med cing / legs pa 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur gnod pa rtsa ba nas med cing phan pa 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur te/ de lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' de ni stong pa dang snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i phyir na/ mdzad spyod sna tshogs snang yang / thabs la mkhas pa'i rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dgongs pa dang / gdul bya dpag tu med pa thar pa'i lam la 'god par byed de/ de lta bu'i skyes bu de ni sems rab tu dwangs pa zhes bya ste/ zhe 'dod 189

bral ba'i snying rjes kun nas bslangs pa'i phyir/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol ba'i gru gzings chen po yin gsungs/ yang rgyal ba'i gsung rab rdo rje'i tshig re re la yang 'grel pa mi 'dra ba mang ste/ rje rin po ches sgon gsal las/ rdo rje'i tshig re la bshad pa mi 'dra ba mang po 'jug pa'i phyir te/ dper na le'u bdun par de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs bsags na dngos grub mchog thob par gsungs pa/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis lha mos 'od gsal sdud pa la sbyar/ 'phags pa lhas de'i don rdzogs rim gyi 'od gsal du 'jug pa la bshad/ ces dang /sor sdud la sogs pa'i ming 'dra bas don gcig tu bya dgos pa ma yin te/ ming gcig la don du ma dang / don gcig la ming du ma 'jug pa ni mdo sngags kyi phyogs rnams la mtha' yas pa zhig snang gsungs/ des na rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang 'grel pa rnams mtha' gcig tu bzung nas gcig dang mi mthun pa rnams yang dag par mi 'dzin pa ni/ chos spong gi sgo 'byed pa'i rgyu yin pas blo gros can gyis gsung rab dgongs 'grel mi 'dra ba ci mthong yang mi spong bar ma zad ya mtshan par bzung nas mi 'gal ba'i dgongs don 'tshol ba la 'bad cing gal te dgongs pa ma lon yang mi spong bar 'di 'dra yang 190

yod snyam dag snang sbyangs dgos/ yang chos kyi nang na tshig 'dra yang don mi 'dra ba mang ste/ dper na byang chub kyi sems zhes gsungs pa la yang / don dam byang chub kyi sems stong nyid dang kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems la/ dbye na smon pa byang chub kyi sems/ 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems/ de yang bskyed rim gyi skabs su snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba rjes su dran pa de kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang / de'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa rjes su dran pa don dam byang chub kyi sems dang / mtshan bcas rdzogs rim gyi skabs su rten thig le kun lta bu la gnad du bsnun pa de kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang / de las byung ba'i bde stong dbyer med du shar ba de don dam byang chub kyi sems dang /mtshan med phyag rgya chen po'i lugs la/ gdangs ma 'gags pa kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang / gshis skye ba med pa don dam byang chub kyi sems/ yang bskyed rim smon pa byang chub kyi sems dang / rdzogs rim la 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems zhes rgyud sogs las gsungs/ yang snying rje zer ba la yang /sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje/ chos la dmigs pa'i snying 191

rje/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje/ rdzogs rim skabs su thabs bde ba chen po la yang snying rje zer/ de bzhin du chos kyi nang na tshig 'dra yang / de dag gi don mi 'dra ba brgya dgos na stong yod tshod na 'dug pas/ des na ming 'dra la don mi 'dra ba'i chos mthong yang log lta mi byed par 'di 'dra yang yod srid snyam du dag snang sbyang dgos/ yang don gcig la tshig mi 'dra ba mang ste/ dper na zab mo stong pa nyid lta bu la mtshon na/ gnas lugs kyi lta ba/ don dam bden pa/ ye shes kyi tshogs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ de kho na nyid/chos kyi dbyings/ chos sku/ don dam byang chub kyi sems/dbu ma/ rdzogs chen/ phyag chen/ zhi byed/ gcod yul/ lhan cig skyes sbyor/ 'od gsal rdzogs rim/ gnyug ma'i sems/shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems/ thig le nyag gcig khregs chod/tha mal shes pa sogs ming gi rnam grangs mang po 'dogs pas/de dag gi gang yin gang min zer/ lha mo la ming brgya ma la mtshan stong ma zer ba ltar don gcig la ming mi 'dra ba mang /dper na rin chen gser lta bu gcig la yul so so'i ming mi 'dra yang gser rang gi ngos nas gcig pa ltar/ chos kyi ming mi 'dra yang don gcig yin pas/ des na sa dge rnying 'brug192

'bri dwags dkar gsum/ zhi byed gcod yul sogs bod du dar ba'i grub mtha' mi 'dra ba 'di dag thams cad ming mi 'dra yang don gyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa kho na yin pas kun la dag snang sbyang dgos/ 'o na sa dge rnying 'brug sogs nang pa'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa mtha' dag gis sangs rgyas kyi gsung la tshad mar mi 'dzin pa gcig kyang med kyang / rang rang gi grub 'tha' 'jog dus gzhan lugs rnams sangs rgyas kyi gsung 'di dang 'gal zhes lung rigs du mas bkag rang lugs kyi lta spyod sogs 'di rgyal ba'i gsung 'di dang dgongs 'grel 'di'i dgongs pa dang mthun zhes lung rigs kyis bsgrub nas bzhag pa de yang la las bzhag pa la las dgag la las bkag pa la las bzhag pa 'di gang bden snyam na/ spyir sangs rgyas kyis sems can dbang po'i bye brag la bltas nas chos mi 'dra ba mtha' yas gsungs/ gsung rab kyi rdo rje'i tshig re la yang rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyis 'grel bshad mi 'dra ba mang po gsu/ngas pas na/ rang lugs bzhag gzhan lugs dgag mkhan rnams kyis/ de kun sangs rgyas kyi gsung gcig dgongs 'grel gcig la mi mthun pa gcig med pas/grub mtha' thams cad rang rang gi sa na shin tu bden pas 193

'di mi bden zhes 'dor bya gcig med/ de ltar dgag bzhag mdzad pa la yang rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' dang / gdul bya la phan pa'i dgongs gzhi re med mi srid pas chags sdang gis de skad smras par sems mi rung / skyes bu dam pa de dag la rang gi mgo gcod kyang chags sdang skye mi srid na gzhan smos ci dgos/'o na de kun bden na thamaso cad mi gcig gis nyams su len dgos sam zer na/ snyigs dus tshe thung nam 'chi nges pa med pas de kun gyi mtha' chod dka' zhing nyams su len long med pas/ thams cad la log lta mi skye zhing skyes pa bkag nas dag snang mos gus byas rang gis nyams su gang lon zhig nyams su blangs na chog de kun gcig gis nyams su len dgos par mi 'gyur/ sangs rgyas kyis gang zag gcig la chos de kun bstan pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na kha cig gis sangs rgyas kyi gsung thams cad shes dgos nyams su len dgos gsungs pa dang 'gal lam zer na/ de na bstan pa thams cad yun du gnas phyir thos bsam rgya cher byed pa sogs bstan dang 'gro la phan pa'i dgongs gzhi mang po yod nas de skad gsungs pa yin la/ thams cad nyams su lon na mi legs pa yang ma yin shin tu legs mod/ 'on kyang snyigs dus tshe thung nam 'chi cha 194

med pas kun gyi mtha' mi chod nyams su mi lon pa sogs la dgongs nas mkhas grub rnams kyis gsung rab kyi snying po bsdus nas bstan bcos mdzad dgos pa byung ba yin la/thams cad ma shes nyams su ma lon kyang gcig nyams su blangs na mi grol ba ma yin te/ dper na sngags la sgrub thabs mtha' yas kyang / de'i nang nas gsang 'dus lta bu zhig nyams su blangs na/ gzhan 'jigs byed bde mchog dus 'khor sogs ma shes kyang gsang 'dus kyi sgo nas 'tshang rgya/gzhan ma shes nyams su ma blangs na sangs rgyas mi 'thob ces bshad na 'gal ba du ma 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /des na gdams ngag phyogs re ba res tshim par mi bya thams cad shes nas nyams su len dgos thos bsam rgya cher gyes zhes gsungs mkhan dang / gdams ngag re re tsam gyis chog thams cad shes mi dgos gcig la nyams len rtse gcig gyis zhes gsung mkhan thams cad la rjes su yi rang bya dgos/ log lta skad cig tsam yang bya bar mi rigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa len tshul mi 'dra bar ma zad/ dgongs 'grel mdzad mkhan rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi dgongs pa yang len tshul mi 'dra ste/dper na rje bdag nyid chen po'i dgongs pa la mtshon na/195

ser ra gung ru rgyal bzang ba'i zhal nas/ dgag bya bkag shul gyi 'dzin stangs sbyor ba 'di mkhas grub dge legs pa rang gis rtsal bshad byas pa'i kha 'dzin ri bo dge ldan pa yongs kyis sgog par snang / rje rin po che dang bla ma rje btsun red mda' pa gnyis/ dgag bya dngos 'dzin phra zhib dpyod tshul bag tsam byung zhib las/ mnyam gzhag 'jog tshul 'dra/lar rang mdo sdud par/ rtswa dang shing las me 'byung bas ni de nyid bsreg /ces shing dgra me/ me dgra shing yin cing / shing sreg pa la me dgos/ me sbar ba shing dgos/ shing zad mthar me 'chi/ phan tshun med na me mi 'byung gis/ ltos chos rten 'brel yin gsungs pa dngos su thos zhes pa dang / rgyal dbang lnga pa'i lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung las/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang po'i rjes 'brang rnams/ gnad bzhi'i dpyad pas drangs te/ med par lhang gis des ban de ga'i rgyun 'thud cing / gnad bzhi'i dpyad pa yang yang dran tsam byas nas nyams su len dgos kyi/ nga snang tshul ltar med snyam du bsgoms pa dang / snang tshul de ltar grub pa med snyam du bsgom pa ni phyin ci log yin par 'chad la/ mkhas grub shes rab seṅge'i rgyud 'dzin la la nges pa drangs zin nas snang tshul 196

de ltar du grub pa med snyam du bsgom par bzhed pa'i lugs mang du byung gsungs so/ /des na sangs rgyas kyi gsung la dgongs pa len tshul mi 'dra ba rnams kyang log pa min pa ltar/mkhas grub rnams kyi dgongs pa la yang len tshul mi 'dra ba byung ba rnams kyang log par mi lta bar gang zag gi bye brag mi 'dra bas/ dgongs pa mi 'dra ba de kun gyis kyang rang rang so so'i rgyud la phan thogs srid/ gcig gi rgyud la phan ma thogs pa la brten nas 'dor ga la rung snyam du mi spong bar kun la dag snang sbyang bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang rnam snang mngon byang las/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byung ba de'i tshe/chos de tshul sna tshogs pa dang / dgongs pa sna tshogs kyis sems can bsam pa sna tshogs pa rnams la/ tshig sna tshogs dang / yig 'bru sna tshogs dang / yul nges pa'i tshig tu brjod pa sna tshogs dang / dbyangs sna tshogs su go ba rnams su byen gyes brlabs te gsang sngags kyi tshul 'chad do/ /zhes bshad bya 'di gcig pu la 'chad byed kyi gzhung mang po yod par gsungs/ lho brag mar ba la gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud gcig pu la 'chad tshul mi 'dra ba bdun tsam zhig yod skad/ des na thams cad la dag snang sbyongs rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 197

'grel gyi dgongs pa mi 'dra ba lon dka' bas/ mi lon bzhin du spang blang gnyis su bya bar mi rigs so/ /yang sangs rgyas la ye shes mnga' mi mnga' dang / mnyam bzhag rjes thob yod med zer ba rnams mi 'gal bar gang ltar btub pa'i tshul ni/ rje btsun mi las da lta'i tha mal gyi shes pa gsal stong 'gags med 'di dang 'dra bas gang ltar byas kyang btub gsungs/ da lta lta ba mkhan gyi mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ting 'dzin gsal stong spros pa dang bral ba'i gnas lugs la rtse gcig mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus su tshogs drug gi snang ba bzang ngan gang yang ma 'gags par so sor sa ler gsal zhing de dag la der 'dzin gyi rtog pa med par sa ler gnas pa ltar/ sangs rgyas kyang thugs chos sku nam mkha' lta bu'i dgongs pa la dus rtag par bzhugs dus/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad so sor ma 'dres par lag mthil gyi ri mo la bltas pa ltar mnyam bzhag gi ngang nas dus gcig la sa ler gzigs kyang / de dag thams cad la 'di ni 'di'o zhes der 'dzin gyi rtog pa med par sa ler gnas pa yin/ des na thams cad dus gcig la sa ler gzigs pa'i cha nas brjod na/ sangs rgyas la ye shes mnga'/ mnga' bar ma zad ye shes 198

bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga'/ mdor bsdus ye shes lnga mnga'/de yang tshur bsdu na ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes gnyis mnga' zhes brjod na chog pas/ de ltar yod ces gsung mkhan byung ba yin la/ yang de ltar sa ler gzigs kyang der de dag thams cad la so sor rtog pa'i rnam rtog ci yang mi mnga' bar mnyam bzhag gi ngang nas skad cig kyang mi g.yo bar sa ler gnas pa'i cha nas brjod na sangs rgyas la ye shes med/ med par ma zad sems can gyi don mdzad snyam pa dang /mi mdzad snyam pa gang yang med ces brjod kyang chog pas na de ltar med ces gsungs mkhan yang byung ba yin/ dper na da lta mnyam bzhag mkhan gye mnyam bzhag gi ngos na tshogs drug gi snang ba la bzang ngan der 'dzin rtog pa med bzhin du dri zhim mi zhim sogs tshogs drug bzang ngan gang yang mi 'gags par tshor nas nyams su myong ba ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi mnyam bzhag gi ngos la sems can thams cad sa ler gsal ba la 'gro don mdzad mi mdzad kyi rtog pa med/ 'bad rtsol med bzhin du sems can gye don byed pa yang mi 'gags par 'gro don mtha' yas pa mdzad pa yin/ des na rtog pa mi mnga'/'bad rtsol med pa'i cha nas brjod na sangs rgyas kyis gang 199

yang mi mkhyen/ dus nam yang 'gro don mi mdzad mdzad par mi 'gyur zhes brjod kyang chog la/ yang yid bzhin gye nor dang dpag bsam gyi shing ltar rnam rtog gis 'bad rtsol med bzhin du 'gro don mdzad pa'i cha nas brjod na/ sangs rgyas kyis thams cad mkhyen 'gro don 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du lhun grub tu mdzad ces brjod kyang chog dper na zla ba la bri gang dus nam yang med rung dus kyi dbang gis gnam stong dus mi snang ba'i ngos nas med zer kyang chog yang gtan med ma yin par nam mkha'i dbyings na gnas shing slar snang ba'i cha nas yod zer kyang chog pa ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi sku dang ye shes la bri gang 'pho 'gyur med rung / gdul bya'i dbang gis 'gro don med dus/ sku dang ye shes rnams chos skur 'dus nas gdul bya la mi snang ba'i cha nas brjod na sku dang ye shes med zer kyang chog yang gtan med min pa'i chos sku'i dbyings na lhun grub tu gnas/ slar gdul bya yod dus snang ba'i cha nas brjod na yod zer kyang chog dper na nam mkha' dang zla ba 'od zer 'du 'bral med pa ltar sangs rgyas kyi thugs chos sku dang gzugs sku ye shes rnams dus nam yang 'du 'bral med/dper na nam mkha' rtag tu 'pho 'gyur med bzhin du zla ba 200

shar/ zla ba'i gzugs brnyan chu snod thams cad du shar ba chu snod med tshe zla ba'i gzugs brnyan mi snang bar zla ba la thim/zla ba yang gnam stong slebs tshe mi snang bar nam mkha'i dbyings su thim/ bri gang 'pho 'gyur med par gnas/ de nas yang tshes bzhi lnga nas sngar bzhin 'char ba ltar/ sangs rgyas kyang thugs chos sku'i dbyings la rtag tu 'pho 'gyur med par bzhugs bzhin/ sa ba cu'i byang chub sems dpa' sogs la longs skur bstan nas 'gro don mdzad/ 'gro ba rnams la sprul skus gang 'dul bstan nas 'gro don mdzad/ sprul pa'i sku'i gdul bya med tshe/ sprul sku longs skur thim/ longs sku yang gdul bya med tshe chos skur thim nas bri gang dang 'pho 'gyur med par bzhugs/ slar gdul bya yod tshe longs sku sprul sku sngar bzhin byon nas 'gro don mdzad par 'gyur ro/ /dper na rta rtsal can gyis rta thog las ma g.yos bzhin mda' me mda' rgyag pa sogs byed pa ltar/ sangs rgyas ni mnyam bzhag las ma g.yos bzhin du rjes thob 'gro don mdzad pa yin/mnyam rjes gnyis su ma mchis la/ rjes thob sgyu ma'i 'gro don mdzad rung dus rtag tu mnyam bzhag las ma g.yos pa'i cha nas brjod na/ sangs rgyas la rjes thob med rtag tu mnyam 201

nyid yin brjod kyang chog mnyam bzhag gi ngang nas ma g.yos rung / rjes thob sgyu ma'i 'gro don dus rtag par mdzad pa'i cha nas brjod na/ sangs rgyas mnyam rjes so sor yod par ma zad gtso bo rjes thob 'gro don kho na mdzad brjod kyang chog de ltar ma shes na 'ga' res sangs rgyas tshe sku dang ye shes mnyam rjes gtan nas med mnyam pa dang / kha cig gis yod snyam kyang yod tshul 'jog mi shes/ mtshams 'di nas 'khrul gzhi chen po byung nas/ yod zer mkhan dang med zer mkhan gnyis kyi gang rung gcig min snyam/ log lta the tshom skyes nas gcig gis gcig la dag snang skye dka' ba yong bas/ 'di ltar mi 'gal ba'i tshul shes na/ de ltar bshad mkhan su la yang dag snang skye bar 'gyur ro/ /des na kun gyis de ltar shes nas su la yang kha mi gtong bar dad gus dag snang sbyong ba shin tu gces so/ /phyag chen rgyal po'i gan mdzod las/ sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya bsam pa sna tshogs pa 'dul byed kyi thabs sna tshogs pa/ so so la 'os pa bstan pa so sos grol ba lung gis grub gsungs/ lho brag mar pa'i zhal snga nas/ bsgoms nas sangs rgya ba gtum mo dang sgyu lus/ ma bsgoms par sangs rgya ba 'pho ba dang las rgya/ gnyid log pas sangs rgya ba rmi lam 202

dang 'od gsal/ rang bzhin shes pas 'tshang rgya ba bar do dang phyag chen/ zhes dang / gdams ngag kun la yod mod kyi/ /snyan brgyud yod na yod pa yin/ /bsgoms nas sangs rgyas kun la yod/ /ma bsgoms rgya na rgya ba yin gsungs/ des na snyan brgyud ma bsgoms par yang 'tshang rgya ba'i gdams ngag yod gsungs na gzhan smos ci dgos snyam du kun la dag snang sbyangs/ gzhan yang don gyi lam rim be'u bum sngon po'i 'grel pa las/ spyir bcom ldan 'das kyis gdul bya'i 'khor gyi yul la bltas nas/ dgongs pa dang ldem dgongs sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas/ mtho gcig dma' gcig tu gsungs pa rnams lag tu len par byed pa la/ slob dpon chos kyi bdag por gyur pa gcig gis/ slob ma tshos go zhing 'khred du btub pa gcig la 'khrid na/ chos thams cad dgongs pa bzhi dang sdem dgongs bzhi'i thig bar nas bton nas nyin zhag phrug gcig la lag len du chos thams cad la bor rgyu med pa gcig tu 'khyer shes dgos pa yin/ deng sang grub mtha'i 'khyer lugs kyis tha dad mi 'dra ba 'ong yang / 'di bden 'di bden byar mi btub ste/thad so thad so na bden pa yin gsungs/ des na bla ma mkhas pas slob ma shes rab can la 'khrid na chos thams cad 203

gdams par 'char la/ grub mtha'i dbang gis bzhed tshul mi 'dra yang thams cad bden pas dag snang sbyongs dgos/ dpe chos rin chen spungs pa las/ spyir yang pha rol ngos de'i pham bya/ rang ci rgyal bya snyam nas bgro gleng byed pa 'di tsho la nyes dmigs chen po yod de/ ting nge 'dzin mchog tu gyur pa'i mdo las/ cis kyang pha rol ngos de ci pham bya'o snyam nas bgro gleng byas pas/ de nas shi 'phos nas nam mkha'i bya ru skye'o/ /de nas shi 'phos nas 'dzam bu'i gling na chos byed thams cad la gnod pa dang / bar chad sna tshogs byed pa'i gnod sbyin chen po brgyad du skye'o/ /de nas shi 'phos nas lcags kyi tho lum za ba'i sems can dmyal bar skye bar 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas/spyir gang zag kun dang chos kyi bgro gleng mi bya/ dgos pa med/ sgos su bla ma la thal 'gyur rgol zhing tshig dma' phab na/nam mkha'i bya dang gnod sbyin du'ang skye long med par/ shi 'phos nas dmyal bar 'gro gsungs/ sangs rgyas la bzang ngan du byed/ chos la bzang ngan du byed/ rten la brnyas pa byed/ nyo tshong byed/ gte bar 'dzud de mdo las/ 'jam dpal gang la la de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos la/ la la ni bzang bar 'du shes/ la la ni ngan par 'du shes na dam pa'i 204

chos spangs pa yin no/ /dam pa'i chos spangs pas de bzhin gshegs pa la skur ba 'debs pa yin no/ /dge 'dun la ngan du brjod pa yin zhes so/ /dge 'dun la sde ris su bcad nas/gshe zhing mtshang 'bru/ rab tu byung ba'i rtags dang 'brel te/mdo las/ tshal bu tsam zhig 'dzin pa la/ /ston pa'i 'du shes mi bskyed pa/ /sdang zhing mtshang rnams 'bru ba ni/ /nga yi 'khor du mi gtogs so/ /bslab pa kun las btus pa las/ tshul khrims 'chal ba'i dge slong la/ /ngur sprig 'phrog dang brdeg pa dang / /btson rar 'jug par byed pa dang / /rab tu byung las 'bebs pa dang / /mtshams med lnga bo byed pa dang / /log par lta ba 'dzin pa dang / /grong la sogs pa 'jig pa rnams//rtsa ba'i ltung bar rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes so/ /dper na sman pa mkhas pa'i sman rkyal na sman gyi bye brag sna tshogs pa yod pa de dag sems can gyi nad kyi bye brag mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod pa'i gnyen por gtong ba yin pas/ de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi phung bo brgyad khri bzhi stong la sogs pa theg pa sna tshogs gsungs pa de dag sems can gyi rigs kyi bye brag dang / nyon mongs pa'i bye brag sna tshogs pa yod pa'i gnyen por gsungs pas/ de dag gi nang na 'bor du rung ba'i 205

chos gcig kyang med de/ ya mtha' dpal gsang ba 'dus pa nas/ ma mtha' ka ri ka yan chad po de thams cad don dang bcas/ dgongs pa dang bcas/ 'bras bu dang bcas pa 'ba' zhig yin pas/ chos thams cad la bzang ngan dang /mtho dman dang phyi nang gi rtog pa spangs la/ kun la gus par byed dgos gsungs/ dper na gru gcig tu zhugs nas/gtsang po la 'gro ba'i mi de dag thams cad gtsang po de las nyes skyon med par khar 'thon pa'i bsam pa mthun par 'dod pa ltar/ 'o skol gyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs so cog gi gang zag thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang 'thob par 'dod par bsam pa mthun pas/ chos sgor zhugs pa'i gang zag thams cad la rjes su yi rang bsgom zhing / dge 'dun la sde ris dang / phyogs su ma bcad par kun la gus par byed dgos zhes gang gsungs pa ltar bya'o/ /yang rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel rnams dang / de dag dang mthun pa'i rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi man ngag rnams la dag snang dgos par ma zad/ de dag dang mi mthun zhing mkhas grub mang pos dgag bzhag mdzad pa lta bu'i man ngag mthong yang /sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab rgya che ba gzhan bod du 'gyur ba dang /206

bod du ma 'gyur ba'i nang na 'di 'dra yod srid/ de med kyang sangs rgyas snyigs dus su dge ba'i bshes gnyen sogs sna tshogs gzugs su byon nas chos sna tshogs bstan nas 'gro don mdzad gsungs pas na/ de 'dra zhig kyang yin las che/ mkhas grub 'ga' zhig gis bzhag pa 'ga' zhig gis dgag pa lta bu snang yang dgongs gzhi yod pas ci yin mi shes snyam du dag snang sbyangs/ nyams su ma lon kyang kha mi btang bar btang snyems su bzhag de ltar thams cad la dag snang sbyangs pas chos spong sogs nyes spyod mang po dang / chags sdang nyon mongs mang po zhig 'gags nas chos gcig nyams su blangs kyang /chos yongs la ston pa'i gsung gi 'du shes bzhag nas dag snang mos gus byas pa'i shugs kyis rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad kyi byin rlabs zhugs nas/ rgyud la nyams rtogs khyad par can mang po 'khrungs nas gcig shes kun grol 'byung zhing / tshe rabs thams cad du chos kyis mi phongs par sangs rgyas kyi chos dang mjal ba'i dgos pa sogs yon tan mtha' yas 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /des na blo gros can rnams kyis chos lugs grub mtha' la yang dad gus dag snang gyis dang bzang /rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis dus nam yang sems can la 207

phan nga zhig ma gtogs mi phan pa'i chos log cig ston mi srid pas/ chos bzang mi bzang dang log ma log de cha gcig na chos kyi steng nas mi 'dog gang zag gi steng nas 'jog dgos/dper na byes pa la nu zho dang rtsam nyog sogs byin na bzang gis/ sha thud ja chang sogs byen na log pa yin pa ltar/ theg pa la gsar du zhugs pa blo kha dman pa la theg pa 'og ma'i chos bstan na bzang gis/ gsang sngags sogs theg pa chen po'i chos bstan na blon mi shong bas log par 'gyur/ dper na gzhon nu dar la babs pa la sha chang sogs byin na bzang gis/ma'i nu zho'am rtsam nyog cung zad re byin na log pa yin pa ltar/ theg pa 'og ma la sbyangs nas blo kha cher song ba la/bskyed rdzogs sogs theg pa chen po'i chos bstan na bzang gis/theg pa dman pa gcig pu la blo 'khrid na log pa'o/ /des na chos thams cad gang zag gi blo yi mtho dman gyi dbang gis log pa lta bu re byung ba ma gtogs/ chos rang gi ngos nas log pa zhig gtan nas med par thams cad don ldan 'ba' zhig yin pa'i grub mtha'i bzang ngan gye phyogs ris mi dgos te/ rje mkha' spyod dbang po'i mgur las/ chos rang rang sa na don dang ldan/ /lung grub mtha' ma dgos bla ma'i drin/ /gsungs/de ltar shes na rgyal ba sras bcas kyi gsung mdo rgyud bstan 208

bcos kyi tshig mi mthun pa ci mthong yang / da gang zag gi bye brag so so la dgongs nas gsungs pa thams cad ga la mthun snyam/ gang la yang chos min gyi log lta mi skye bar dad gus dag snang 'ong nges/ dgyes rdor rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa las/ rnam rtog las ni rnam rtog dang / /srid pa nyid kyis srid dag byed/ /ces dang / rgya ras pas/ dri mas dri ma bkrus pa/ khyi gus khye gu 'byin pa/ rtog pas rtog pa dbyung gsungs/ yang /rnam rtog med na ye shes med/ /rnam rtog las ni ye shes 'byung / /gsungs/ ji ltar 'dod chags gdungs pa la/ /'dod chags nyid kyis dbyung bar bya/ /ji ltar zhe sdang 'khrugs pa la/ /zhe sdang nyid kyis dbyung bar bya/ /ji ltar gti mug sros pa la/ /gti mug nyid kyis dbyung bar bya/ /zhes dang / chos rje rgya ras pas/ rnam rtog nyon mongs la sogs pa/ /dgos dang med thabs med par blta/ /skyon can mi sbangs srid du spyad/ /des na dgag sgrub gnyis dang bral/ /zhes dang / rje phag mo gru pas/ dgos dang sku drin che ba blta/ /che ba'i che lugs 'di lta ste/ /dkon mchog gsum yang rtog pa la/ /skabs brgyud lam lnga rnam rtog ste/ /dbang po lnga yang rnam rtog yin/ /mchog dang thun mong rnam rtog tu/ /'jam dpal rol pa'i mdo las 209

gsungs/ /yang / de bas rnam rtog med gyur na/ /dkar pos bsam pa ma 'grub pa/ /mkha' la me tog skye ba med/ /dkar nag ltos pas grub pa'i phyir/ /dran dang shes bzhin bag yod gsum/ /dkar po'i phyogs kyi rtsa ba yin/ /rnam rtog med na rtsa ba zhig /de bas rnam rtog ngo mtshar che/ /gsungs/ rgya ras pas/mtha' mar rnam rtog chos skur 'khyer/ /rnam rtog bsgom du ma shar na/ /gang byas 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras yin/ /gsungs/ pad dkar gyis/ 'pho ba zhi gnas kyi bsgom du mi byed/ lhag mthong nas snang ba chos sku'i rgya yan ma zhes pa zhig 'byung / de dus bsgom ngo mar 'gyur gsungs/ yang / drang don du rnam rtoganges don du chos sku/ dang po'i dus su rnam rtog spang bya/gnyis par rnam rtog ci mang ba chos sku'i yo lang du che ba gsungs/ kha cig gis/ nyon mongs ye shes yin pa la/ /nyon mongs spangs pa'i pha rol nas/ /ye shes 'tshal ba snying re rje/ /btsal bas mi rnyed nyon re mongs/ /zhes dang / a wa dhu ti pas/ rnam rtog ngo bo chos dbyings yin/ /byung na dga' ste bskul 'debs bzang / /gsungs/ rgyud las/ rnam rtog ye shes chen po ste//'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skem byed yin/ /zhes dang /yang / rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 210

ltung byed yin/ /gsungs pa lta bu nang mi 'gal tshul ni/ spyir rnam rtog bzang po thams cad kyis thar ba'i grogs byed pas blang bya/ ngan pas 'khor pa'i rgyu byed pas spang bya/ rnam rtog ngan pa yang thabs khyad par can gyis lam gyi grogs su bsgyur nus pas blang bya/ mi nus pas spang bya/ bzang po yang zhi gnas sogs kyi skabs gegs su 'gyur na spang bya/ grogs su 'gro na blang bya/ yang zhi gnas sogs kyi skabs bzang ngan gang yang spang bya/ lhag mthong skabs bzang ngan gang yang chos skur bsgrub bya/ rnam rtog ngo bo chos sku ru bsgyur mi nus pas nyon mongs spang bya/ chos skur bsgyur nus pas blang byar gsungs pa yin pas dgongs pa lon dgos/ ma lon par 'di lta bu'i gzhi re re gang zag dbang po'i bye brag gis spang blang gnyis re yod pa nang 'gal ba'i chos skyon can du 'dod na/pad dkar gyis/ drang nges kyi gzhung thams cad de lta bas na 'gal ba de ltar smra mkhan ni/ zas gtsang gi sras che ba yin pas re zhig de dang rtsod pa gyis shig gsungs so/ /chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang gi sems rgyud la rag las pas na/ skyabs mgon paṇa chen rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos rnams kun gyi dang po'i mgo /rgya gar skad mtshungs rang rgyud la/ /legs par 211

rtogs pa yin no zhes/ /zla med bla ma mchog des bzhed/ /ces dang / rgyud las kyang / chos thams cad ni sems la gnas so/ /sems ni nam mkha' la gnas so/ /nam mkha' ni ci la yang mi gnas so gsungs/ so thar mdo las/ rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/ sems ni rnam par g.yengs pa'i mi/ /nyon mongs mche ba'i phrag na gnas/ /gsungs/ gzhan yang lung las/ sems ni rnam par g.yengs pa'i mis/ /bskal par bzlas kyang 'bras mi 'byin/ /zhes dang / rgya ras pas/ sems ma btul pa'i sangs rgyas gang na'ang med gsungs/ thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ma lus nor/ /chos rnams rang gi sems su 'dus/ /zhes dang / rang sems rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /sems nyid la ni rtogs par bya gsungs/ rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/ sems ni rdo rje las byung bas/ /sems can sna tshogs rigs can la/ /sems ni bdag gi rnam rtog gis/ /skye bo dri mas nag por byas/ /de bas rab tu 'bad pa yis/ /sems kyi rdo rje rnam par sbyangs gsungs/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod las/ des na he ru ka dpal rgyud/ /sems rgyud dri med yin par bshad/ /gsungs/ dus kyi 'khor lor/212
