sems ni dag na mi de yang ni rgyal ba'i dbang bor 'gyur te rgyal ba gzhan gyis ci zhig bya gsungs/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ rab 'byor phyin ci log las nyon mongs pa thams cad bskyed mod kyi/ sems kyi rang bzhin nam yang kun nas nyon pa ma yin no gsungs/ sgyu ma chen mo'i 'grel par/dngos po thams cad sems tsam ste/ /dper na rmi lam khang chen dang / /skyed mo'i tshal dang gling bu dang / /rta dang glang po che dang ni/ /mi la sogs pa'i gzugs su snang ba ltar/ sems nyid dngos po de dang de'i rnam par snang ste/ sems las byung ba ni/ sems las gud na med pa'i phyir ro/ /chos thams cad sems tsam yin gsungs/ 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma'i 'grel par/sems kyi rang bzhin de ni thog ma med pa'i dus nas/ yang dag pa'i kun rdzob tu ye shes kyi sgyu mar snang / zhes dang / mi 'jigs pa skye ba med pa'i sems ni/ gtso bo 'am/ mgon po'am/ rten nam/ rgyu 'am/ thog ma zhes bya'o/ /'di skad bstan te/ rang gi sems kyi rgyun sgyu ma lta bur snang ba de don dam pa skye 'jig med par rtogs pa de la ye shes lnga'i tshul dang / rigs thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gsungs/rnam snang mngon byang las/ gsang ba'i bdag po de byang chub 213

gang zhe na/ rang gi sems yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes pa ste/ de yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bo gsungs/ 'da' ka ye shes las/ sems rtogs na sangs rgyas yin pas sangs rgyas gzhan du mi 'tshol ba'i 'du shes rab tu bsgom par bya'o gsungs/ do ha las/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon de/ /gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba /'dod pa'i 'bras bu thams cad ster byed pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / sems kyi sgrib sbyangs las/ chos rnams sngon du 'gro ba yid/ /yid gtso yid ni mgyogs pa ste/ /yid nyid kyis ni 'bad pa yis/ /smra ba'am ni byed pa po/ /zhes dang / de ltar bsam pa'i rtsa ba la/ /bsod nams sdig pa rnam par gnas/ /lung las 'di skad gsungs pa'i phyir/ /dge sems pa la nyes pa med/ /gsungs/ pad dkar gyis sems gang dgar bor nas/ lus chos gos kyis sgril/ rang lugs 'dzin/ gzhan lugs dgag 'dod kyi chos pa ga na 'dug chos pa'i gzugs brnyan tsher ma ltar btums/ 'khor 'das rang sems su shes rang sems yan par mi gtong ba zhig la nyon mongs tsho langs rogs gyes byas kyang / 'jam sim mdzad nas bzhugs par gda'/ chos 214

pa rnam dag de la zer dgos pa 'dra'o/ /dper na mi gcig ci bder bsdad pa la dgra gnyen bar mas mthong bas snying na ba dang / byams pa dang btang snyoms gsum skye yi 'dug de yul de'i skyon ga la yin/ rang gi dgra'o gnyen no snyam/gzung bas de de ltar mthong ba yin mod/ rang gis dgra 'am gnyen du ma bzung na/ de dgra'am gnyen du ci zhig gis 'gro/de'i phyir sangs rgyas kyis khams gsum po 'di dag sems tsam mo/ /zhes gsungs/ shel dri ma med pa dar sna tshogs kyi steng du bzhag pas/ de dang de'i mdangs su 'gro ba lta bu/sems 'di yang dmigs pas gang bsgyur bsgyur de gar 'char ba yin no/ /gsungs/ rje rdo rje rgyal pos/ lus po mi na rnam rtog na/ /snang ba bde chen 'char nus na/ /khab kyis btsugs kyang bde ba skye/ /byams dang snying rje 'byongs pa'i dus/ /rang srog gcod pa'i dgra la yang / /ma yi 'du shes yang yang 'byung / /mu stegs nag po sor drug gis/ /mkha' la dngos por bsgoms gyur te/ /rnam rtog mkhrigs par mthong bas na/sngon na ri bong zhig 'ong ba rkang bar nas phyir song ba ma shes/gsang gnas nas gyen du ri bong zhig 'dzul song snyam nas ma 'dzul rung lto ba na byung bas/ cig gis de shes nas ri bong 215

zhig bzung nas 'ong / phyi rgyab nas khu tshur gyis brdungs nas ri bong bton pa'i tshul byas/ ri bong btang nas 'thon song zhes bde ba byung / mi gcig gis bzo pa zhig la rtsed mo byas khab sbas te/ khyod kyi khab ga na byas pas kha ru bzung ba lto bar khab song ba'i snang ba byung nas na ba byung bas/ sbas pa bstan nas na ba sos/ spun gnyis la chung ma gcig yod pa/spun che bas chung ba la dug blud ces skye dman la bshad pas/skye dman gyis chang zhig dug yin pa'i khul byas/ thab khar bzhag pa spun che bas 'thungs pa la/ bud med kyis brdzun btang nas/ a kha mo las ngan ma chang 'di sus 'thungs smras pas/ kho bos 'thung smras pas/ de mo'i spun chung ba la blud snyam dug bsres nas bzhag pa'i chang yin smras pas/ kho brgyal song / dbugs yong kyang mtshan gcig na ba byung / phyi nyin de min smras pas drag song / des na bzang ngan thams cad sems la rag las/ sems kyis byas/ sems su snang / sems kyis myangs pa yin pas/ sems 'tsho ba 'di shin tu gal che zhes dam pa gong mas gsungs so/ /spyod 'jug las/ sems kyi glang po yan btang na/ /mnar med gnod pa byed par zad/ /kun nas dran pa'i thag pa yis/ /sems kyi glang po dam 216

btags na/ /'jigs pa thams cad med 'gyur cing / /dge ba thams cad lag tu 'ong / /gsungs/ dpe chos las/ dper na gtun pa'i g.yo 'gul thams cad mi'i lag pas gar bsgyur yin te/ 'phangs na 'gro la/ bzhag na sdod pa ltar/ 'o skol gyi lus ngag gtun po dang 'dra ste/ sems kyis gar bsgyur yin pas lus ngag la rang dbang med de/ byed mkhan thams cad sems yin pas rang gi sems rgyud bsrung ba la nan tan byed dgos te/ de skad du yang / bslab pa bsrung bar 'dod pa yis/ /rab tu bsgrims te sems bsrung bya/ /sems 'di bsrung bar ma byas na/ /bslab pa bsrung bar yongs mi nus zhes pa dang / sems 'di gcig pu btags pa yis/ /de dag thams cad btags par 'gyur/ /sems 'di gcig pu btul ba yis/ /de dag thams cad thul bar 'gyur/ /sems bsrung brtul zhugs ma gtogs pa/ /brtul zhugs mang pos ci zhig bya/ /zhes pas rtag tu dran shes dang ldan pas/ rang gi sems rgyud la brtags shing nang gi nyon mongs pa mtha' dag spangs shing bsrung ba nan tan byed dgos gsungs/ sems can gyi bag chags bzang ngan gang goms pa'i dbang gis snang ba yang bzang ngan de ltar snang ste/ dper na chu gcig pu la lhar 217

bdud rtsi/ mi la chu/ dud 'gro la btung ba/ yi dwags la rnag khrag dmyal pa la me mdag tu snang gsungs/ mi gcig la yang blo'i dbang gis pha ma spun zla bu chung ma/ mkhan slob dgra gnyen bar ma sna tshogs par mthong ba dang 'dra'o/ /des na da lta 'o skol la snang ba 'di yang / sems can la la mun pa/ 'o skol la mun pa/ gzhan la las snang ba yin tshul sogs mtha' gcig tu ma nges te/ 'jam dpal gyes smras pa/ snang ba thams cad ma nges pa ste/ la la'i snang ba ni/ la la'i mun pa/ la la'i mun pa ni/ la la'i snang ba yin tshul sogs gsungs so/ /da lta 'o skol rnams la 'khor bar snang ba las snang dag pa la 'di ka 'og min du snang ba yin/ des na dag snang sbyong ba gal che/sems bzang por bsgyur ba'i thabs kyi mchog dag snang 'di ka yin/ dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig sbyangs na/ 'khor ba yang mya ngan 'das par 'gyur/ ma dag pa'i snang ba log par bltas na/'og min gnas dang sangs rgyas kyang tha mal du 'gyur ba la tshegs med gsungs so/ /gang zhig chos kyi don po mchog /sems kyi gsang 'di ma shes na/ /bde thob sdug bsngal gzhom 'dod kyang / /de dag don med gyi nar 'khyams gsungs/ dge bshes ston pa'i zhal nas/ la kha'i pha bong stong mi stong 'dra ste/218

rang gi sems stong dgos pa yin gsungs/ dpe chos las/theg pa chen po sngags kyi thabs la ni/ dper na gser 'gyur gyi rtsi dang 'dra ste/ phyi nang snod bcud kyi snang ba thams cad lha dang gzhal yas khang du bsgyur/ spang bya nyon mongs lnga yeshes lngar gnas bsgyur/ rnam par rtog pa chos nyid du gnas bsgyur nas bsgoms pag rnal 'byor pa'i sems las su rung tsam na/ de bzhin du gnas 'gyur nas 'gro ba yin par 'dug gsungs/ sngags sogs gang la yang sems yid gnyis the tshom med na 'grub ste/ sngon bla ma zhig la slob ma zhig gis chos zhu ru phyin pas/ bla ma thugs brel te phyag phyi la kyog nas ma ra na dza byas pas slob ma'i snying la ma ra na dza sngags yin/ lag pa phyir kyog pa phyag rgya yin snyam nas/ ma ra na dza byas kyin lag pa phyir kyog kyog byas nas bsgrubs pas grub nas las bzhi'i phrin las byed nus pa zhig byung skad/ des na/ yid shes kyi dad pas byin rlabs 'jug /blo the tshom bral bas ci bsam 'grub gsungs/ de lta bu'i dag snang yod na sangs rgya ba la yang tshegs med pa yin/ dag snang 'di gal che de kho na nyid rab tu mi gnas pa'i rgyud las/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /bzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag lta/ /yang dag mthong na rnam par grol/ /ces dang / thar pa 219

phyogs su rgyas pa'i mdo las/ drang por 'dug la yang dag ltos/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag lta/ /yang dag mthong bas rnam par grol/ /'di ni 'gyod tshangs mchog yin no gsungs/de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba gnyis su med pa'i rgyud las/yid la yid kyis bltas gyur na/ /bsam gyes mi khyab ston par byed/ /ces dang / phyag chen gaṅgā ma las/ sems kyi rtsad chod rig pa gcer bur zhog /rtog pa'i rba rlabs rang sar sangs su chug /ces dang / pha dam pa'i ding ri brgyad cu las/ stong pa'i ngang du rig pa'i mdung bskor gyis/ /lta ba la thogs rdugs med do ding ri ba/ /zhes dang / laṅkar gshegs pa las 'du shes rnam shes spangs pa yi/ /sems kyi rgyal bo lta bar bya/ /zhes dang / ma dros pa'i mdo las/ shes rab mig gis bltas pas mthong ba ste/ /mthong ba med par mthong ba chos mthong ba'o /shes rab mig gis rten pa gang mthong ba/ /de ni sangs rgyas mthong ba yin zhes bya/ /zhes dang / rje mi las/ ngas cer gyis bltas pas ngo bo mthong / /spros bral nam mkha' lta bur mthong / /gsungs/ sems ngo bo de ltar stong yang rnam pa gsal sing nger gnas pa sems kyi rang bzhin yin te/ brgyad stong ba las/ sems la sems ma mchis te/ sems kyi rang 220

bzhin 'od gsal ba'o/ zhes dang / gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud las/ rtag chad skye 'gag la sogs pa'i/ /mtha' spangs sems ni rang rig cing / /gdon nas spros pa med pa nyid/ /de don bsam mi khyab par nges zhes dang / dus 'khor 'grel chen las/ rtag pa dngos pa dang chad pa dngos po med pa ste/ de dag gang la med pa ni rdo rje can te/ rnam par dag pa'i sems so/ /zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ yod min med min yod med min/ /gnyis ga'i bdag nyid min pa'ang min/ /mu bzhi las ni rnam grol ba'i/ /bde chen sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / sdom 'byung las/ bem po min phyir rang rig nyid/ /shes par bya min mthong bya min/ /gzugs med nyid phyir gang mi gnas/ /rnam par 'gyur med de rtag pa/ /zhes dang / nam mkha' rin po che'i mdzod las/ ji ltar mar la mar bzhag gam/ /ji ltar chu la chu bzhag ltar/ /rang gi rig pa'i ye shes ni/ /legs mthong gang yin 'di phyag yin/ /zhes dang / mi'am ci'i sdong po'i mdo las/ zhi gnas ni zhi bar byed pa'o/ /lhag mthong ni rig par byed pa'o/ /gsungs/sems kyi gnas lugs gsal rig stong gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngo bo de rjen cer gyis mthong ba'i ngang de la bzhag nas 221

ched du bsgom rgyu med rung ma yengs par bya dgos te/ gsang ba bdud rtsi rgyal po'i rgyud las/ rang bzhin stong pa 'od gsal ba/ /bsgoms pas rnyed pa ma yin te/ /ma bsgoms pas kyang rnyed pa min/ /bsgom pa nyid kyang rtog pa ste/ /mi bsgom pa yang rtog pa yin/ /sgom du rdul tsam med pa la/ /yengs su skad cig med pa'o/ /zhes dang / sher phyin bdun brgya ba las/ de bzhin gshegs pa blta bar 'dod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la/ mi bsgoms pa'i tshul gyis bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes dang / ye shes snang ba rgyan gyi mdo las/ 'das pa la rtog par mi byed/ ma 'ongs pa la mi sems/ da ltar byung ba la spros par mi byed do/ /zhes dang / rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab byams pas/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /bzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag lta/ /yang dag mthong nas rnam par grol/ /ces dang / rgyal ba nyid kyis kyang / dngos po med pa'i bsgoms pa med/ /bsgom par bya ba bsgoms pa min/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pas/ /bsgoms pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /zhes dang / te badzra las/ gang phyir yid kyis mi bsgom par/ /'gro ba thams cad bsgom par bya/ /gsungs/ rnam rtog gang lalaring cer bltas na stong gsal du rjen lhang 'char te brtag 222

gnyis las/ rnam rtog nyid kyis rnam rtog dang / /srid pa nyid kyis srid pa dag /ji ltar rlung gis zin pa la/ /mon sran rnge'u za ba bzhin/ /de bzhin dngos po'i rnam rtog kyang / /rnam par nges par sbyangs par bya/ /zhes dang / rgyal mtshan dam pa'i mdo las/ phyi rol yul la brten nas su/ /sems kyi rnam rtog gang skyes pa/ /sems kyis sems la brtag nas su/ /rang bzhin med par shes na ni/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'o/ /de yi ngang la ma yengs pa/ /de ni ting nge 'dzin zhes bya/ /zhes dang /laṅkar gshegs pa las/ rnam par rtog pa sna tshogs kyi don la/yang dag pa'i don ji lta ba bzhin yongs su shes pas/ rnam par grol bar 'gyur ces ngas smras so/ /zhes dang / kun nas sgo'i le'u'i mdo las/ 'dod chags stong bar shes gyur na/ /chags las grol ba gang yang med/ /gsungs/ rje sgam po bas/sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku/ /snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od/ /de phyir snang sems dbyer med lhan cig skyes/ /zhes dang / sa ra has/ ji srid sems las rnam 'phros pa/ /de srid mgon po'i rang bzhin te/ /chu dang rlabs dag gzhan min no/ /zhes dang / bya btang sngon po yon rdor gyis/ phyi ru yul la lhod kyis glod dang / /snang ba chos sku rgya 223

yan ma 'di shes so/ /nang du sems la cer gyis ltos dang / /sems nyid gzhi med rtsa bral ma 'di shes so/ /zhes dang / chos rje 'ba' ra bas/ snang srid phyag rgya chen po 'di la/ /kha yan ci bder mi skyong bar/ /sdug btsir byas shing yang yang bsgoms kyang / /sgom chen sgom gyis bslu bar mchi'o/ /zhes dang / rje gtsang pa rgya ras kyis sgom shes mang ste bshig shes nyung / zhes dang / yang dgon pas/ ye sgom la blo yis ma bsgoms par mdzod la/ /rang babs la bzo yis ma 'chos par zhog dang / /sgom 'dod na sgom min gyi snang ba 'dug gi /sgom dum bu ru ma gcod phyal pa ru zhog dang / /zhes dang / bka' gdams glegs bam las/ dge bshes 'brom gyis jo bo la/ da ni gcig pur nyams len pa'i/ /snying po bsdus pa gnad kyi mchog /dben par gnas pa'i chos shig zhu/ /'brom gcig pur 'dug na sems la dpyod/ /rje bla ma'i thabs kyis bkrol na gsal/ /'brom sems med yul rnams su yis 'dzin/ /rje 'dzin pa po med 'dzin mi 'gyur/ /'brom sems med gang la su yis smra/ /rje smra ba po med chags sdang ci/ /'brom yul dang yul can de 'drar zad/ /rje sems kyi gzhi rtsa gang zhig lags/ /'brom kho bos don 'di rnyed ma gyur/ /rje rnyed par mi 'gyur ji ltar 224

lags/ /'brom skye gnas 'jig pa mi gda' ba/ /rje sna tshogs rig pa ji ltar lags/ /'brom 'di ni snang med snang ba yin/ /rje snang ba de nyid ma lags sam/ /'brom snang ba bya ba ci la zer/ /rje sna tshogs yul du dmigs pa lags/ /'brom yul nyid dmigs sam sems nyid dmigs/ /rje sems kyis yul rnams dmigs pa yin/ /'brom sems de dpyod pa'i dus la babs/ /rje 'di yi dpyod lugs dus la babs/ /'brom khyod kyis rig pa snga ma ston/ /rje 'das pa 'di ru bstan ma mchis/ /'brom 'o na ma 'ongs rig pa ston/ /rje ma 'ongs 'di ru 'byung srid dam/ /'brom 'o na da lta'i sems 'di ston/ /rje mdzug gu gtad sa mi gda' ba/ /'brom de 'dra 'ong ba ci zhig yin/ /rje de bas khyed la 'dri ba yin/ /'brom sangs rgyas kun kyang 'di la rdugs/ /zhes dang / rje yang yang btsal zhing ma rnyed na/ /'brom rang lugs yang yang mthong ba yin/ /rje ma rnyed pa la bzhag lags sam/ /'brom lhod de glod na dam pa yin/ /rje gnad don 'di yi brgyud pa gang / /'brom rgyal dang sgol ma nga nyid yin/ /gsungs/ 'brom gyi zhal nas/ 'o na 'ching ba'i rtsa ba gang lags/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ bdag tu 'dzin pa yin gsungs/ bdag tu 'dzin pa gang lags zhus pas/ legs 225

pa'i yon tan thams cad bdag gcig pu dgos pa/ nyes pa thams cad gzhan kho nas len par byed pa zhig yin gsungs/'o na de 'dra'i bdag 'dzin 'di yin gsung bar zhu zhus pas/jo bo'i zhal nas/ bdag 'dzin sgo btags la 'di yin bstan rgyu ga na rnyed gsungs/ 'o na bdag 'dzin 'di gnas pa gang na gnas zhus pas/ cha med kho bos mthong ma myong / gnas bya med pas gnas byed mi shes/ ngo bo med pas dbyibs kha dog mi shes gsungs/ 'o na 'di 'dra'i nyam thag pa zhig mi 'ong la thang a zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/smig rgyu'i chu dang zla gnyis dang rmi lam gyi rta glang la sogs pa'ang mi mthong la thang a gsungs/ jo bo de 'khrul snang lags mod zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas kho bo de bzhed bdag 'dzin kho yong nas chags sdang byed pa ma yin/ gzhong stong gi phyir du lung stong gi khye zugagazhi med la rang rgyud chen po 'khrul/ jo bo dpe de 'dra na bdag 'dzin ye med 'dra zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ 'dra bya ba ci la zer dngos yin mod gsungs/ 'o na chags sdang gi rtsa ba de bdag 'dzin de rang sems yin nam ang zhus pas/sems de'i kha dog gang du gda'/ de kho bos mthong ma myong zhus pas/ 'o na dbyebs ci 'dra zhig gda' gsungs/ jo bo kho 226

bos mthong ma myong zhus pas/ 'o na dbyibs dang kha dog gnyis su ma grub/ mig gis mthong ma myong tsa na/ gzugs su med pa'i rtags yin gsungs/ yang 'brom gyis jo bo la zhus pa/nged bdag 'dzin can rnams ji ltar spangs/ 'brom nyin gcig la rnam rtog ci tsam zhig rgyu/ jo bo bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig rgyu'o/ /'brom chos dbyings ci tsam skye/ jo bo rtog pas zil gyis mnan nas skye ba mi gda'o/ /'brom da la bla ma a wa dhu ti pa'i bzhed pa de dgos pa yin gsungs/ jo bo bla ma'i gdams ngag de bstan 'tshal/ 'brom rnam rtog byung tshad chos nyid du bsgyur ba yin/ jo bo sdong dum thams cad gser du song na 'dod pa can la mkho bar gda' ste/ ji ltar bsgyur tu btub bam/ 'brom man ngag la brten nas gser 'gyur gyi rtsi bya bas/ lcags gser du 'gro ba yod/ gnad shes dgos pa yin/ jo bo gnad bstan 'tshal/ 'brom dgra 'joms pa la dgra ngos zin 'tshal/ jo bo dgra gang lags/ 'brom rnam par rtog pa yin/ jo bo de ji ltar 'joms/ 'brom kho 'bur te byung tsa na 'joms 'tshal/ jo bo 'joms lugs ci ltar bgyid/'brom gzhi gang na 'dug dbyibs kha dog la sogs pa la dpyad/ snga ma phyi ma la sogs pa la dpyad/ 'gro sa dang byung sa 227

btsal/ de dus su kho mi rnyed/ jo bo de ci lags/ 'brom kho yod ma myong bas ma rnyed pa yin/ jo bo ma rnyed na ji ltar bgyi/'brom rnam rtog chos dbyings su bsgyur ba bya ba yin/ btsal nas ma rnyed na chos dbyings yin pa'i rtags yin/ de la glod la zhog jo bo yang byung na/ 'brom yang 'bur 'joms gyis gsungs/ 'brom sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i rnam rtog brgya byung na/ 'tshol thengs brgya tham pa byas pas mi rnyed pa brgya tham pa 'ong / ma rnyed pa'i don rnyed pa de chos dbyings yin/ de la bla ma a wa dhu ti pa'i zhal snga nas/ rnam rtog ngo bo chos dbyings yin/ /byung na dga' ste bskul 'debs bzang / /ci phan rnyed par ma gyur pas/ /gnas lugs yo lang tsam du zad/ /ces gsungs na/ 'brom dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa khong la yod/ 'brom kho bos kyang / nyi ma nyin gcig la yang bdag 'dzin la/ /mi dgos dgu dgos rnam par rtog pa brgya/ /'phros ma thag tu gnyen pos btsal ba yis/ /ma rnyed chos dbyings kho na yin par gda'/ /gal te yod na rnam rtog mang lugs la/ /gal te gcig tsam ma rnyed khrims yod dam/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'brom gye zhal nas/ de ring gsung gleng nyams re dga' gsungs/ yang 'brom rin po che'i zhal nas/ thams 228

cad sems kyi rang bzhin yin/ sems nyid stong ba nyid kyi rang bzhin yin/ stong pa ye stong spros bral gyi rang bzhin du shes pa ni ye shes yin/ de sangs rgyas su gsungs pas sangs rgyas las lhag pa'i lha med gsungs/ jo bo chen pos/ blo thams cad 'das pa'i cha dngos med/ ma 'ongs pa'i cha yang dngos med/da lta yang dngos med/ dngos med rang stong / rang stong dbu ma/ de ltar gnas pa de la shes rab zer/ sems bla ma la 'dzin pa la sogs la thabs zer gsungs/ 'brom gyis/ kye ma dpyad sna tshogs mdzes mdzes 'dra/ /ha cang dpyad na mi gda' ji ltar lags/ /a skye med rang gis stong pas lan/ /phaṭa da ni rang grol lhug par zhog /gsungs/ jo bos/ 'khrul pa gzhi med sgro btags yin/ /yin min mtshan mar su zhig 'dzin/ /'dzin na 'dzin pa nyid gang 'khrul/ /'khrul pa gang zhig bden pa mthong / /mthong ba med na mthong byed bral/ /bral ba shes na 'bras bu yin/ /'bras bu rang grol lhug par zhog /zhog ces tha dad gcig pa'i stong / /stong la 'jog bya 'jog byed med/ /gsungs/ chos kyi gnas lugs stong pa yin/ /bzang ngan rtog pa ci yang med/ /yod med mtha' la ma zhen par/ /rig pa dbu ma chen por zhugs/ /zhes dang / 'di 229

yang bden pa ci yang med/ /don gyi ngo bo spros bral yin/ /skye 'chi med pa'i chos dbyengs la/ /rig pa lhod de bzhag par bya/ /gsungs/ snang snang 'dra ste gzung du med/ /gzung med 'dzin pa ma byed par/ /gnyis med rang grol lhug par zhog /bzhag bya bral na 'brom rje yin/ /ltar med lta na rin chen yin/ /gnyis med shes na dbu ma shes/ /zhes dang / stong pa shes na 'dzin pa 'jig /gzung 'dzin gnyis med blo las 'das//blo 'das bya ba chos dbyings yin/ /gzigs dang 'brom rje ltar med la/ /ltar med shes na lta ba 'jigs/ /'jigs med shes na dbu ma yin/ /dbu ma'i ngang du bzhag na zab/ /gsungs/ ma cig gsang ba ye shes kyi zhal nas/ yang gsan dang ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /lar chos kyi gnas lugs ye stong la/ /nga brag cha'i chos sgra sgog par zad/ /chos don la grub pa ci yang med/ /gzhi skye med ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang blo ma bcos lhug pa nyid du bzhag /lam gnas med rang grol chen po yin/ /mthar 'gag med 'bras bu chen po la/ /dpe mi gda' nam mkha' dag par zad/ /de gsan nam yab sras 'gro ba'i bshes/ /de nyams su longs dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /zhes pa la sogs rgya cher gsungs so/ /de dang de 'dra ba'i mdo 230

rgyud bstan bcos kyi lung dang mthun pa'i gzhan chos lugs grub mtha' thams cad la yid g.yo ba'i dad pa skyes na rab de min kyang dag snang sbyong dgos te/ mkhas grub nyis 'dzom rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i zhal nas/ gzhan chos lugs grub mtha' sna tshogs la/ /yid g.yo ba'i dad pa skyes na rab/ /de min kyang dag snang sbyongs pa dang / /don med par mi sgod dam bca' yin/ /zhes dang / chos rang rang mos pa'i ngo na zab/ /mchog sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs dam pa/ /sa dge ldan gsar rnying kun la yod/ /gzhan ma smod kun la dag snang sbyongs/ /gsungs pa ltar kun la dad gus dag snang sbyong ngo / /smras pa/ sku gsum ye shes lnga yi dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i 'od snang phyogs brgyar 'phro/ /gdul bya'i ma rig mun pa kun sel ba'i/ /bla ma nyi ma gzhon nus 'gro kun skyongs/ /rje btsun bla ma'i thugs rje'i tsha zer gyis/ /bdag gi blo gros padma dkar po'i kha/ /phye ba'i nang gi dbyangs snyan sbrang rtsi'i tshogs/ /skal bzang bung ba kun la yang yang ster/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas ston pa'i gsung rab kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgya ba'i/ /thabs su go nas mdo sngags chos kun la/ /thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa 231

shin tu gces/ /'on kyang chos kun nyams su ma lon yang / /bde gsang 'jigs gsum lta bu re res kyang / /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob pa'i ha go nas/ /gang mos chos re nyams su blangs kyang chog /deng sang gzhan gyi grub mtha' sna tshogs la/ /dag snang mi byed dgag pa gtong ba dang / /lhag par bstan pa'i la rgya brtsad zer nas/ /'khrug rtsod byas nas bstan pa bshig pa mangs/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa thams cad 'gal med rtags/ /mdo rgyud man ngag thams cad gdams par shar/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa thams cad 'khrul med lon/ /chos spong nyes pa thams cad rang 'gags pa'i/ /sngon byon dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar la/ /bsam gyin dad gus dbyar gyi mtsho ltar 'phel/ /chos pa gzhan yang god ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /nges par mdzod ces lag gnyis thal mo sbyor/ /chos dang gang zag yongs la dad gus dang / /dag snang dgos tshul glu ru blangs pa des/ /thos tshad rnams kyi rgyud la phan thogs nas/ /dad gus dag snang ches cher rgyas par smon/ /zhes pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de yang mkhas grub mang pos spyir 'khor ba sdug bsngal gye rang bzhin/ sgos su 'dod yon lnga sdug bsngal gyi longs spyod/232

de'i nang nas lto gos bud med gsum sdug bsngal gyi 'byung gnas yin pas/ 'di rnams ma spangs par chos rnam dag cig gtan nas mi 'ong / thams cad blos btang nas chos byed dgos zhes dpe bzhag lung drangs rigs pas bsgrubs nas gsungs pa 'di bden na/ 'dod yon ma spangs bsten bzhin du sangs rgya ba'i thabs sngags bla med kyi chos dang de nyams su len pa'i gang zag 'dod yon la rol ba rnams la dag snang bzang po zhig skye dka' bar gda'/ 'di mi bden na gsang sngags kyi chos zab mo dang skyes bu dam pa 'dod yon gyi skyon gyis mi gos pa sogs 'dod yon spyod bzhin byang chub sgrub pa rnams la skur ba btab par 'gyur bas/ de skad gsungs pa rnams la dag snang skye dka' bar 'dug 'di ltar gsungs pa la bstan 'gro la phan pa'i dgongs gzhi ci yod zer na/ de ltar lung rigs kyis bsgrubs nas gsung tshe 'dod yon la spyod pa'i gang zag mchog dman bar ba thams cad la dgag pa btang kha btang byas pa lta bu snang yang / nges par gsang sngags kyi chos zab mo dang de nyams su len pa'i skyes bu dam pa 'dod yon gyi skyon gyis mi gos pa tsam du ma zad/ 'dod yon la brten nas yon tan du ma skye gzhan don rgya chen 'byung ba 233

rnams la kha btang byas pa yin snyam nas 'khrul bar mi bya ste/de ltar gsungs pa'i dgongs gzhi ni/ 'khor ba bde bar bzung nas 'khor ba'i rgyu 'ba' zhig sgrub pa rnams kyis sdug bsngal du mthong nas nges 'byung skyo shas skyes/ 'khor bar zhen pa log nas thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob 'dod kyi blo shugs drag rgyud la skye ba'i phyir dang / 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la spyod pa'i sems can la dmigs pa'i byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa skye ba'i phyir dang /'khor ba 'di me'i 'obs/ srin mo'i gling / dug sbrul gyi tshang ltar bltas te/ 'khor ba'i phun tshogs dug sbrul mgo'i nor bu/spu gri kha'i sbrang rtsi/ dug dang 'dres pa'i zas ltar mthong nas/mi gtsang ba gshang gci snabs lud bzhin dor nas sngon byon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi rnam thar bzhin dben pa'i gnas su dka' thub byas te thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob thabs dam pa'i chos sgrub ba'i phyir dang / spyir 'dod yon lnga/ sgos su lto gos gnyis kyis lus gso phyir mi dge bcu sogs byed pa'i nyes spyod chen po rnams rang 'gags la 'gro ba'i phyir dang / chags bral gyi gang zag yongs la brnyas smod khyad gsod sogs mi byed par mchod bstod bkur ba'i phyir 234

dang / bstan pa'i gzhi ma sde snod gsum gyi bstan pa rin po che 'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring gnas nas 'gro ba yongs la 'phral yun gyi phan bde 'byung ba'i phyir sogs la phan par dgongs nas gsungs pa yin/ gsungs pa des kyang bstan 'gro la phan thogs kyang 'byung nges pas/ de skad gsung ba'i bla ma dang de ltar mdzad pa'i chos pa yongs la khas mi gtong bar ma zad/ dad gus dag snang sbyangs nas mchod bstod bkur zhing de ltar rang gis kyang nyams su len pa gces so/ /'o na yang mkhas grub mang pos/ spyir gnas lugs rtogs na 'khor pa yang bde ba'i rang bzhin/ thabs la mkhas pas spyod shes na 'dod yon lnga bde ba'i longs spyod/ de'i nang nas lto gos bud med bde skyid thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas yin pas/'dod yon la ma brten par chos rnam dag cig mi 'ong bas/gsang sngags zab mo nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pa sogs chos mdzad rnams kyis 'dod yon spyod bzhin chos byed dgos zhes dpe bzhag lung drangs rigs pas sgrub nas gsungs pa de bden na/ sde snod gsum dang de nyams su len pa'i gang zag 'dod yon spong ci thub byed pa rnams la dag snang bzang pa zhig skye dka' bar gda'/ 'di mi bden na sde snod gsum gye 235

chos dang skyes bu dam pa tshe blos btang nas byad chub sgrub pa rarnams la skur ba btab par 'gyur bas de skad gsungs pa rnams la dag snang skye dka' bar 'dug 'a di ltar gsungs pa la bstan 'gro la phan pa'i dgongs gzhi ci yod zer na/ de ltar lung rigs kyis sgrub nas gsungs tshe/ 'dod yon spong ba'i gang zag mchog dman bar ma thams cad la dgag pa btang kha btang byas pa lta bur snang yang nges par sde snod gsum dang / de nyams su len pa'i skyes bu dam pa 'dod yon spongs pas yon tan du ma skyes gzhan don rgya chen 'byung ba rnams la kha btang byas pa yin snyam nas 'khrul bar mi bya ste/de ltar gsungs pa'i dgongs gzhi ni/ 'khor ba bde bar bzung 'dod yon bde ba'i rgyur rloms pa'i gdul bya sems can 'dod chags dang ser sna che ba rnams rim gyis kha yar drangs pa'i phyir dang / pho skye zhe sdang shas che ba'i tshe 'di ma dang chung ma sogs skye dman la sdang ba rnams kyis mi sdang bar byams pa'i phyir dang / glen pa 'ga' zhig gis thabs mi mkhas par zas gos ye med pa byas/ chos phyir dka' spyad drag po byas lus la nad 'jug gis bcug rang gis rang lag nyes gtong ba rnams kyis dal ba'i rten mi brlag par gces par 236

bskyangs nas chos kyi snying po len pa'i phyir dang / 'dod yon gyi skyon gyis mi gos pa'i bla ma skyes bu dam pa dang gsang sngags nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor ba sogs 'dod yon spyod pa yongs la kha mi gtong bar mchod bstod bkur pa'i phyir dang /bstan pa'i snying bo gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring gnas nas sems can la phan pa dang bde ba 'byung ba'i phyir sogs la phan par dgongs nas gsungs pa yin la/ gsungs pa des kyang bstan 'gro la phan thogs 'byung nges pas/ de skad gsungs pa'i bla ma dang de ltar mdzad pa'i chos pa yongs la khas mi gtong bar ma zad/ dad gus dag snang sbyangs nas mchod bstod bkur zhing de ltar rang yang nyams su len par rigs so/ /'o na spyir mdo na sha chang sogs 'dod yon lnga dang / khyad par bud med dug ltar spangs dgos zhes gsungs pa dang / sngags na sha chang sogs 'dod yon lnga dang / khyad par bud med sman ltar bsten dgos zhes gsungs pa 'di gnyis/ gnang bkag mi 'dra ba rgyab 'gal che bas na/ skyes bu gcig gis tshe gcig la mdo sngags gnyis nyams su blangs na tsha grang ltar 'gal bar snang / rang nyid gang mos shig tshe 'dir nyams su blangs/237

gcig de ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba tsho nyams su len pa'i yid smon tsam byed pa ma gtogs/ gnyis ka nyams su mi lon par 'dug zer na/ 'o de cha gcig na khyod bden te/ skyes bu blo dman dbang po brtul po rnams kyis mdo sngags gnyis ka nyams su lon pa phar zhog gcig nyams su len rgyu yin yang nyams su ji bzhin mi lon pa mang mod/ 'on kyang gang zag dbang po rab kyis mtshan ldan bla ma bsten nas nyams su len rgyu yin na mdo sngags gnyis mi 'gal ba tsam du ma zad/ gcig grogs su gcig song nas myur du thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang mngon du byed pa'i dgos pa yod de/ des na myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar 'dod pas gnyis ka nyams su len dgos/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ mdo gcig pu nyams su blangs na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das lta bu'i gang zag dbang po rab yang bskal chen grangs med gsum gyi 'phro sangs rgyas dgos pa yin kyang / mdo la sngags lam gyi snon pa btab na de tsam gyi yun ring po bsgugs mi dgos par rje mi la lta bu'i skyes bu brtson 'grus can tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgya ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /skyes bu gcig gis tshe gcig la yang mdo sngags zung 'brel nyams su blangs kyang phan tshun 'gal med grogs su 238

'char ba'i rtags su/ jo bo bka' gdams pa rnams kyis rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo rgyud kyi yi ge na gcig yan chad 'dor rgyu med par gdams par shar nas thugs nyams su bzhes pas bka' gdams pa zhes grags pas sa steng khyab pa yin la/ de bzhin du rje rgyal ba gnyis pas kyang mdo sngags gnyis skyes bu gcig gis nyams su len pa'i tshul sngar med pa'i legs bshad sa gsum gyi sgon me chen po lam rim chen mo/ sngags rim chen mo/ rim lnga gsal sgon sogs gsungs pa yin/ de'i che ba bzhi la yang / bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du rtogs pa'i che ba/ gsung rab ma lus gdams par 'char ba'i che ba/rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag tu rnyed pa'i che ba/ nyes spyod chen po rang 'gags su 'gro ba'i che ba zhes che ba bzhi bstan pa yin/ 'gal na che ba bzhi gsungs pa dang mdo sngags kyi lam rnams skyes bu gcig gis nyams su blang byar gsungs pa dgos pa med par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /'o na mdo sngags gnyis mi 'gal ba'i tshul ji lta bu zhig yin/ da shod dang zer na/ de la thog mar mdo ltar mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam sbyor gnyis kyis bsten nas/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes 239

dmigs/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems phar phyin drug dang bsdu bzhi sogs lam thun mong pa'i rgyud sbyangs/ lam thun mong pa'i rgyud 'byongs nas sngags kyi snod rung du gyur tshe/ mdo'i ring lam de gcig pu la mi zhen par/ lam thun mong ma yin pa theg pa kun gyi mchog sngags kyi lam ma nor ji bzhin ston pa'i bla ma la gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i myur lam gyi 'jug sgo smin byed kyi dbang yin pas dbang bzhi rnam par dag pa zhus dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i sdom khrims mig gi 'bras bu bzhin bsrungs nas/ sha chang sogs 'dod yon dngos su mi bsten par rdzas tsam bsten nas sngags kyi lam bskyed rdzogs nyams su blangs/ rtogs pa mthon por slebs nas 'dod yon bsten na 'od sred slar langs 'dod yon gyi dbang du mi 'gro bar 'dug snyam dus las rgya mi bsten par ye rgya mos pa tsam byas/ sha chang sogs 'dod yon gzhan rnams dngos su bsten/de nas rtogs pa cher song nas 'dod yon la brten nas rdzogs rim gyi 'od gsal mngon du byas/ tshe 'dir zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur du thob pa'i grogs su 'gro bar 'dug snyam pa'i tshad la slebs dus/ spyir sha chang sogs 'dod yon lnga dang khyad par mtshan ldan gyi las rgya ma btsal nas 240

dbang bskur byen gyis brlabs nas shin tu gsang ba'i tshul du zhag bdun nam/ nyer gcig lo re tsam sogs ci tsam bsten pa de tsam du dngos su bsten kyang gsang sngags nas de lta bu'i gang zag la gnang ba dgyes bzhin byen par ma zad/ mdo 'dul ba'i dgongs pa dang mi 'gal ba yin pa'i gnang ba yod de/ de ci'i phyir na/ mdo 'dul ba yang sems can rnams dngos sam brgyud nas sangs rgyas pa'i thabs sha stag yin pas/nyon mongs pa zad tshogs bde blag tu rdzogs nas sangs rgya na dgos pa che bas mdo na dgag bya ba las dgos pa gtso bas de 'dams na skyon med ces gsungs pa'i dgongs pa dang mthun pas na/ de lta bu'i gang zag la 'dul ba nas kyang dmigs bsal gyes gnang ba yod par gsungs so/ /'o na de lta bu'i gang zag dbang po yang rab la dgos pa che ba'i dbang gis dmigs bsal byas gnang ba byen yod kyang / de'i dus so thar gyi sdom pa shor ba ma yin nam zer na/ de shor ba ltar snang tsam yin/ don gyis ma shor bar ma zad so thar gyi sdom pa gong 'phel du 'gyur te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bskyed rim gyis tha mal snang zhen sbyangs nas rang gzhan snod bcud lha sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi rang bzhin du 'char ba ma gtogs/ tha mal gyi 241

snang ba gtan nas mi 'char zhing / rdzogs rim gyes rtsa rlung thig le rgyas las su rung nas mar yungs 'bru tsam yang 'chor mi srid par dbab bzung ldog 'grems bzhi nus pa'i dus su bsten pa yin pas/ de dus las rgya la brten nas kyang thig le sngar bas mang du song / dper na rkyal ba 'o mas bkang ba ltar skabs shig rnal 'byor pa'i lus thams cad byang sems kyi thig les gang nas/ sku'i rtsa zhig la gtar kha zhig rgyag rgyu yin na yang khrag gi tshabs su byang sems 'bab gsungs de lta bu'i rnal 'byor ba sngon byung ba'i gtam rgyud mang bo snang / thig le ma nyams par ma zad sngar tshul khrims bsrung ba'i dus las kyang brgya 'gyur gyis gong 'phel du btang nas so thar gyi sdom pa ma nyams par ma zad/ slar sngags la zhugs nas gong 'phel du don gyis btang ba yin pas/ sngags kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams tshangs spyod bsrung ba'i dge slong kun gyi mchog yin te/ sngon bram ze sa ra has/ mda' mkhan gyi bu mo phyag rgyar bzhes nas/kha sang phan chad bram ze yin/ /da ring tshun chad dge slong yin//tshangs par spyod pa dge slong ste/ /he ru ka dpal dge slong mchog /gsungs skad/ des na o rgyan gyi bstod pa na/ leb rgan dmar po'i chos gos gsol ba ni/ /tshul khrims rnam dag 242

sdom dang ldan pa'i rtags/ /gsungs/ grub thob gling chen ras pa'i bstod pa na/ lha dang mi mo dang 'grogs kyang / /'dzag pa'i dri ma mi mnga' ba'i/ /tshangs par spyod pa thams cad kyi/ /mchog tu gyur pa khyod la 'dud/ /gsungs/ deng sang chos pa dga' mo 'ga' res kyang / o rgyan chen po dang rje btsun mi la sogs rgya bod kyi grub thob phal che ba don gyi dge slong mchog yin pa de mi shes par/ yar gyi rdo rje 'chang man chad la 'phog pa'i skur 'debs brnyas smod byed pa de chos ma shes pa'i rang mtshang phyir bstan pa yin pas gzhan ma sems/ dge slong zer tshad skra bregs chos gos gyon pa kho na ma yin te 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo las/ khyem na gnas shing / kha spu ma bregs/ chos gos kyang ma gyon/ tshul khrims kyang ma mnos kyang / 'phags pa'i chos nyid dang ldan pa de nyid/ don dam pa'i dge slong zhes bya'o/ /gsungs/ des na sngags 'dul ba'i grogs su song ba 'di lta bu'i tshul la zer zhes/ rnying ma'i bstan 'dzin gyi khyu mchog mdo sngags gnyis gdams par shar ba'i kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pa dang / phyag chen gyi bstan 'dzin bla ma zhang rin po che sogs kyis mdo rgyud kyi lung yid ches kyi gnas su drangs nas yang yang gsungs/ de ltar rje bdag nyid 243

chen pos kyang dgongs pa 'khrul med yin pa kun la ma bshad kyang shes sla/ de lta bu'i nus pa ma thob bar du/ sngags kyi rnal 'byor pas kyang spyir 'dod yon lnga dang / sgos su phyag rgya ma yid kyis mos pas spyod pa tsam ma gtogs/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i skabs lta bu yang sha chang gnyis rdzas tsam ma gtogs bag med du bsten mi chog ces sngags gzhung du ma nas gsungs na/dngos su rigs ma bsten mi chog pa smos ci dgos/ 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ gsang sngags kyi bskyed rdzogs 'dis nyon mongs pa phra zhib gcod dgos pas mi gnyis ma bsgom/ sngags la spyod zer nas nag chang bag med du ma bsten/ gnas brtan chen po bcu drug dang jo bo di ṭwāṃ ka ra sogs sngags kyi bdag por 'dug ste de 'dra rang mdzad sgos mi gda'/ phyi 'dul ba dang nang gsang sngags pa zer te/ 'dul ba don dang mthun na gsang sngags de kha'i nang na bzhugs/ sngags kyi spyod pa 'di drod ma thob pa'i gang zag gis spyad na/ bong bu gzig lpags bkab nas lo tog zos mthar gzhan gyis bsad pa bzhin 'ong bas/ re zhig yid smon gyis la dngos su ma spyod gsungs/ de lta bu'i gang zag la 'dul ba nas gtan nas gnang ba med ces gsungs pa yin no/ /rtogs pa mthon por 244

ma slebs par rang dgar spyad na so thar gye rtsa ba bzhi'i sdom shor ba tsam du ma zad/ sngags kyi bde gshegs bka' 'das kyi ltung ba 'byung / 'dod yon lam gyi grogs su bsten na lam sgrub pa la sa chod chen po byung nas myur du zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang reg pa'i dus su bsten na rgyal ba rnams kyi rnam thar dang mthun te/ sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis sngags kyi lam gyi rtogs pa mthon por slebs dus yum thig le mchog ma zhes bya ba zhig bsten nas rdzogs rim gyi 'od gsal mngon du byas nas zung 'jug gi go 'phang brnyes pa'i tshul bstan skad/ mnyam med jo bo chen pos kyang / rgya gar na bzhugs dus sngags nyams su blangs nas rtogs pa mthon por son dus/ sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol mtshan ldan gyi phyag rgya ma grogs su 'khrid nas sngags kyi brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa lo drug bskyangs zhes rnam thar nas gsungs/ rje rin po ches kyang /'ga' zhig gis bar dor longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ru sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan zhes bshad srol 'dug ste/ yang kha cig gis sku tshe 'dir sngags nyams su bzhes nas rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa mthon por slebs nas lha mo dbyangs can ma grogs su bsten nas rdzogs rim mngon du byas zung 'jug gi sku tshe 245

'dir brnyes rung / gdul bya rnams kyi snang ngor ma brnyes pa'i tshul lta bu sbas nas bzhugs/ sngags kyi lam rnams kyi ma rtogs log rtog the tshom gyi dra ba yongs bcad nas/ ma nor ji bzhin par rgyas par bstan pas mkha' spyod dang yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi sogs la gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis kyang sngags kyi lam zab mo rnams dmar khrid lag len du bstan pa mthong nas ser sna shor ba yin/ rje rin po ches sngags gsung gsung zhig sngar gzhan gyis ma gsungs zhes skyes bu dam pa du mas gsungs/ gdul bya rnams la bar dor sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan pa tsam ma gtogs don gyis rje mi la bzhin tshe gcig la sangs rgyas pa yin zhes skyes bu dam pa re gnyis kyi ngag rgyun du gsungs/ de cha gcig na rje rin po che'i bsngags brjod bla na med pa zhig tu snang / de bden shas kyang che ste/ dpal gsang ba'i bdag pos rje bdag nyid chen po'i phyi nang gsang ba'i yon tan khong gis kyang brjod kyis mi langs gsungs/ skyon zad yon tan kun ldan zung 'jug gi sku ma brnyes na dpal gsang ba'i bdag pos brjod kyis mi lang ba'i yon tan zhig so skye zhig la ye med pa'i phyir ro/ /lung bstan na yang /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni lhag pa'i lha/ /dbyangs can ma ni las 246

rgya ste/ /nges par kho na byang chub bo/ /zhes gsungs pas na cha gcig na 'di yang yid ches kyi gnas su 'dzin par rigs so/ /dgos pa che na mdo ltar na yang / dper na gzhan gyi srog 'tsho ba'i slad du byang chub sems dpa'i lus kyang sbyin par gtong dgos par gsungs kyang / lus ma btang bar lus 'di'i steng nas rang gzhan yongs la 'phral phugs phan pa'i dgos pa chen po 'byung na/ lus slong mkhan byung yang mi ster bar ma zad lus la gces spras byas yun ring 'tsho ba'i thabs bya dgos la/ byas na sangs rgyas kyis lus gzhan la gtong dgos gsungs pa dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa med par ma zad phan yon yod par gsungs/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom ldan gyis dus rtag tu srog gcod spong dgos zhes gsungs kyang /mi brgya stong mang po'i srog 'chor ba'am bstan 'gro dpag med la phan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' re re tsam gyi sku tshe'i bar chad bsal nas 'gro don tshad med 'byung ba lta bu'i dgos pa che na gzhan phan byang sems kyis kun nas bslangs mi re tsam bsad kyang / sdom pa shor ba lta bu kun gyi mig tu snang rung / don gyis sdom pa ma shor bar ma zad bskal pa mang po'i tshogs rdzogs par gsungs/ dper na ded dpon snying rje 247

can gyis mi nag mdung thung can bsad pas bskal pa mang po'i tshogs rdzogs pa'i lo rgyus lta bu'o/ /so thar sdom ldan gyis mi tshangs pa spyod mi rung gsungs kyang / gzhan gyi srog chad pa 'thud nus pa lta bu'i dgos pa chen po byung na mi tshangs pa zhig gzhan la spyad kyang skyon gyis mi gos gsungs/ dper na bram ze'i khye'u skar mas tshong dpon gyi bu mo la spyad pas tshogs rdzogs pa'i gtam rgyud lta bu'o/ /de bzhin du rab byung dge slong gis chang rtswa mchog zil pa tsam yang 'thung mi rung ba'i bcas pa gnang yang / nad kyis btab nas 'chi la phyogs pa slar gso ba'i sman du 'gro na/ chang ji tsam bsten dgos pa de tsam sman pa'i ngag bzhin bsten kyang chog ces dmigs bsal gyi gnang ba yod/ de yod pa'i rtags su dus dran na chos ldan gyi bya ba dang gzhan gyi don du glu gar dang rol mo la sogs pa byed dam byed du gzhug pa dang / zhes sogs gnang ba zhus pa yin/ gnang ba med na gnang ba zhu don med/ des na mdo sngags kyi gnang bkag gi mtshams mtshan ldan gyi bla ma dang /tshad ldan gyi bstan bcos la brten nas shes pa gces/ de rnams dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i spyod tshul yin gyi/ dge slong gi rten ma yin pa rang dga' sna 'ga' bzung ba'i dge bsnyen 248

nam/ khyim pa'i sngags pa yin na 'dod yon dang las rgya 'bad rtsol med par bsten rgyu yod/ bsten na grogs su 'gro phyin gsang sngags kyi dbang thob nas bzung / bskyed rdzogs nyams su len dus kyi thog mtha' bar gsum du bsten chog par gsungs so/ /mdor na mdo sngags kyi gzhung rgya che bas 'di ltar gnang bkag mi 'dra ba rgyab 'gal lta bu mang bas/de rnams gang zag spyi dang bye brag dbang po rno rtul gang la dgongs nas gsungs/ drang don nges don gab sbas dkrugs pa sogs gang dgos pa'i che chung gnang bkag gis mtshams dmigs bsal yod med legs par brtags shing dpyad nas 'khrul med nges pa rnyed na/ mdo sngags kyi gsung rab thams cad mi 'gal ba tsam du ma zad gcig grogs su gcig 'gro ste/'brom ston pa rin po ches 'dul ba sngags kyi grogs su 'gro/sngags 'dul ba'i grogs su 'gro ba jo bo bka' gdams pa yin gsungs/yang bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer shes pa nga'i bla ma yin zhes/ jo bo rje'i bsngags brjod du mdzad par gda'/ 'o na sngon rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho dang 'brug pa kun legs sogs skyes bu dam pa 'ga' res sngags nyams su len dus/ so thar gyi sdom pa sngar bzhes pa 249

yar phul chas kyang rnal 'byor ba lta bu'i tshul mdzad pa de ci yin zer na/ de btsun pa'i tshul bzung nas sngags kyi nang ltar spyir 'dod yon lnga dang khyad par sha chang bud med la spyad na/ spyir 'dul ba'i bstan pa la gnod kyis dogs nas de la phan phyir de lta bu'i tshul bstan pa tsam ma gtogs/ sngags nyams su len dus so thar gyi sdom pa btang skya bo'i chas su zhugs dgos zhes mdo rgyud bstan bcos tshad thub gang nas ma bshad ces kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams dang / rje bdag nyid chen po sogs gsar rnying gi bla ma bzang bzang thams cad kyi zhal mthun par gsungs/ de bden te ci'i phyir zhe na/sngags nyams su len dus so thar phul dgos na thog mar so thar gyi sdom pa len yang mi dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /deng sang 'ga' zhig gis 'di lta bu'i dgongs pa ma lon par/ sngags nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor bar rloms pa 'ga' res 'dul ba rgyan du ma song khur du song so thar mi len/ gal te sngar blangs pa yin na phyis bslab pa rin po che yar 'bul ci thub byed pa mang / 'dul ba mkhan du rloms pa 'ga' res sngags kyi lam grogs su 'gro ba phar zhog dgra ru song nas nga'i chos khyod kyi chos lugs zhes chos skad mi 'dra ba mang po byas/250

chags sdang langs chos la brten nas sdig pa bsags rang gi sdom pa 'chor gi 'jug pa snyigs dus 'dir mang bas/ blo gros can rnams kyis 'di 'dra'i dka' gnas la nges pa rnyed par byas/ jo bo bka' gdams pa sogs gong ma'i rnam thar ltar so thar tshul khrims kyi gzhi bzung nas mdo sngags kyi chos gang yin yang yi ge na gcig gi don yan chad nyams su len pa la 'bad cing / gal te snyigs dus tshe thung / rang nyid le lo che/gsung rab rgya che bas tshe 'dir nyams su len mi nus kyang /ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba bzang po brgyud nas mdo sngags kyi lam yongs su rdzogs pa rang gis nyams su blangs/ gzhan la lam yongs su rdzogs pa bstan nas rang gzhan sems can thams cad smin grol gyi lam la 'god pa'i yid smon byed pa gal che ste/'brug pa kun legs kyis/ phyi ru nyan thos spyod pa skyong zhing //nang du gsang sngags rdo rje 'dzin/ /gsungs/ o rgyan chen pos kyang / phyi ltar lag len 'dul ba'i lugs su spyod//rgyu 'bras spang blang zhib pa'i dgos pa yod/ /nang ltar gsang sngags thun mong lugs su spyod/ /bskyed rdzogs don dang 'brel ba'i dgos pa yod/ /gsang ba gsang chen a ti'i lugs su spyod/ /tshe gcig 'od skur grol ba'i dgos pa yod/ /gsungs/ rje rin po 251

ches kyang / mdo sngags kyi chos rnams skyes bu gcig sangs rgyas pa'i lam gyi cha rkyen du 'gyur ba'i tshul la nges pa rnyed par byas/rang nyams su len cing / gal te nyams su ma lon kyang / rang gis ma lon pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas mi spang bar/ nam zhig nyams su lon pa'i rgyur tshogs bsags sgrib pa sbyangs/ smon lam yang 'debs dgos zhes lam rim sogs nas yang dang yang du gsungs so/ /yang dper na dug gi lto yod pa rma bya ma gtogs khwa ta sogs bya gzhan gyis mi 'ong bas/ dug spangs nas gzhan zos na lus la gzi mdangs rgyas pa ltar/ 'dod yon lnga dang khyad par sha chang bud med lam gyi grogs su khyer nas sangs rgya ba'i gang zag dbang po yang rab sngags kyi rnal 'byor re re tsam ma gtogs/ gzhan gang zag dman pa mang mang gis dka' bas 'dod yon spangs nas chags bral gyi lam bzang mdo 'dul ba ltar byas na rim gyis sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bde blag tu thob pas na/ skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis sems can spyi la sngags mi gsung bar sde snod gsum rgya cher gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin/ jo bo rje bod la byon nas chos ci 'dra zhig dar dgos dris pa'i lan du/ bod kyi mi chen 'ga' res khyed la chos gang mnga' de gsungs dgos zhus pa'i 252

tshe/ khong la sha chang bud med sogs 'dod yon ma spangs par longs spyad glu gar rol mo byed bzhin nyams su blangs nas sangs rgya ba dang / 'dod yon lnga spangs nas nyams su blangs na sangs rgya ba'i chos sogs mang po yod pa'i gang dar dgos/'dems thongs gsungs tshe/ thams cad gros byas/ ga re 'dod yon bsten nas sangs rgyas pa'i chos shig dar na legs legs te/ 'o skol bod 'di nyon mongs rags 'dod sred che/byed las mang chos de 'dra zhig dar gi bcug na las can dbang rab re gnyis kyis nyams su blangs na sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i khe che ste/ phal che ba spyi de ltar nyams su mi lon pa 'dod yon gye dbang du song / las ngan pa bsags sangs mi rgya bar ma zad ngan song du lhung ba'i nyen che bar 'dug de bas 'dod yon spangs nas sgrub dgos pa'i chos de rang dar gi bcug na sems can spyi la phan che zhing nyen chung snyam nas/de lugs ltar zhus pas/ jo bo chen pos skal ldan dbang po rab re re tsam la gsang ba'i tshul du gsang sngags kyi chos gsungs pa ma gtogs/ gzhan yongs la mdo 'dul ba'i chos gtso bor bton nas gsungs pa yin zhes 'ga' re'i ngag las go de cha gcig na gang zag spyi la gsung gis ma bcug pa 253

bka' drin che bar gda'/ deng sang bla ma 'ga' res sngags nyams su bzhes/ gzhan la cung zad re gsungs pas kyang dgon pa phal cher ser khyem du song nas chos 'jig rten gnyis kyi gang yang med tshul la ltos/ sngon jo bo rjes gsang sngags chos 'di kun la dar du 'jug rgyu yin na/ da tsam dgon pa 'di kun gang 'dra zhig gis song yod dam mi shes/des na 'brom ston rin po ches/ gang zag rab kyis nyams su lon na khe che yang / ma lon na nyen yang che ba/ gang zag spyi la phan chung ba'i gsang sngags sgeg mo'i sha gzugs 'dra ba de sped na sbed dka'/ gsang na gsang mi thub pa de ga'i ci bya/kho bos sde snod gsum gyi thang ma brdal nas/ kha reg kha snum/lag reg lag snum/ khe ri rab tsam/ nyen mgo bo tsam las med pa 'di 'dams gsungs skad/ dper na ri rtse zhig la 'gro ba'i lam rtsub 'phrang dog pa la gzar ba mi bde mo re re tsam ma gtogs 'gro dka' ba/ lam thag nye rung / rkang lag mi bde ba'i rigs rnams kyis lam cung zad thag ring rung lam chen bde sa zhig yod na de gyen du dal por song na bzang ba ltar/ khe nyen gnyis ka che ba'i gsang sngags nye lam gang zag dbang po rtul po rnams kyis nyams su lon dka' bas/ de bas 254

lam thag ring rung chags bral gyi lam mdo 'dul ba la zhugs na legs/ 'di ni snga rabs 'das pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad/ da ltar byon pa rgyal ba shākya thub pa/ ma 'ongs 'byon pa byams pa mgon po sogs dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams gshegs pa'i lam bzang yin te yum las/ rgyal ba 'das dang ma byon da lta gang bzhugs pa/ /kun lam pha rol phyin pa 'di yin gzhan ma yin/ /gsungs/ des na 'dod yon la ma brten par chags bral gye lam la brten nas sangs rgyas pa grangs mang / sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa rnams kyis chags bral gyi skyes bu dam pa ngur smrig 'chang ba rnams la khas gtong mi rung / sde snod gsum gye bstan pa nub na bstan pa'i gzhi ma nub pa yin pas snying po yang nub 'gro zhes mkhas grub du mas gsungs/sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis kyang mdo khas mi gtong ba tsam du ma zad nyams su blangs gzhan la spel dgos te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ theg chen chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub sems yin pas rang gi nges 'byung byang chub kyi sems che ru 'gro zhing /gzhan gang zag mang po la phan thogs/ bstan pa'i gzhi ma 'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring du gnas nas 'gro ba dpag tu med pa la phan thogs 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /yang gsang 255

sngags sgrub pa'i rten khams drug ldan gyi lus sa gzhi lta bu la 'dod yon lnga'i chu lud sbyar/ byang chub sems kyi sa bon btab/bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi drod gsher gyes bskyangs na/ zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi sku lo tog lta bu myur du 'byung ba yin la/zhing la chu lud ma bkram na ston thog legs po zhig mi 'ongs pa ltar/ sngags nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor ba 'dod yon bsten chog pa rnams kyis 'dod yon ma bsten par sangs mi rgya zhes rgyud du ma nas gsungs/ sngon rgyal bo in dra bo rnyis gsang sngags gzhung bzhin 'dod yon lnga la spyad/ nyin mtshan med par btsun mos bskor kyang tshe gcig lus gcig la rgyal po 'khor bcas sangs rgyas/ de bzhin du grub thob sa ra ha ba/te lo ba/ nā ro ba/ mar pa rnams kyis 'dod yon rgyan du rol bzhin sangs rgyas/ slob dpon chen bo/ rje 'bangs nyer lnga/ rgya gar grub chen brgyad cus phal cher 'dod yon la brten nas sangs rgyas/ rje btsun mi las sngon bla ma'i drung du dbang yon zangs 'bul dus stong bar phul ba'i rten 'brel gyis/sngags bsgom dus lo du mar dka' ba spyod dgos pa byung yang /sring mo dang mdzes se gnyis kyis sha chang drangs pa'i rten 'brel gyis rtsa mdud grol/ nyams rtogs khyad par can 256

'khrungs byas pa drin gzo'i mgur gsungs/ gsang sngags 'dod yon la brten nas 'grub ces lho brag mar pas sngar gsungs pa la nges shes lhag par 'drongs gsungs/ dper na rkang bde lag bde mi gzhon rnams ri rtse zhig la lam thag nye ba zhig nas song na myur du thon pa yin kyang / mi phyugs rkang chag shed ngan lo lon mang po yod pa lam thag nye ba nas song na lam rtsub/ 'phrang dog la che bas chad lus 'gyel nas 'chi ba shes nas dzi bos lam thag ring yang bde ba'i lam chen zhig la bde mi bde thams cad ded nas song na/ yun ring song nas rkang bde lag bde shed can gzhon pa rnams myur du ri rtser phyin pa la gnod pa ltar/ gang zag dbang po rab rnams sngags lam la zhugs na myur du sangs rgya ba yin kyang / gang zag dbang po rtul bo mang po sngags lam la zhugs na nyams su mi lon par ngan song du 'gro ba shes nas/ skyes bu dam pa 'ga' res lam thag ring yang / gang zag spyir mdo lam nyams su len du bcug pas yun ring song nas dbang po yang rab sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje can rnams myur du sangs rgyas pa la cung zad gnod par dgongs nas/ rje btsun mi la ras pas mnyam med dwags po lha rje la/ lar bod kyi snying du 257

'dre zhugs pas/ a ti sha gsang sngags 'chad du ma bcug pas mi mang po phung gsungs/ des na 'do da yon spyod bzhin du sangs rgya ba grangs med pa thabs med kyis 'dod yon dug ltar spong dgos pa'i nges pa med/ chags bral rnams kyis sngags lam nyams su len pa rnams la khas gtong mi rung /sngags kyi chos 'di nyid nub na bstan pa'i snying po nub pa yin zhes rje rin po ches gsungs/ mdo nyams su len pa'i bla ma rnams kyis sngags kyi lam bzang 'di khas mi gtong ba tsam du ma zad gsang ba'i tshul du nyams su blangs/ gzhan yang dbang po yang rab rnams la spel yang dgos te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/rang nyid myur du sangs rgyas zhing gzhan gang zag rab la phan thogs/ bstan pa'i snying po 'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring du gnas nas 'gro ba mang po sangs rgya ba'i phyir ro/ /yang sngags kyi bskyed rim gye dus phyi snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang bcud thams cad lha lha mo sogs dag pa rab 'byams 'ba' zhig tu mos/ 'od zer spro bsdu sogs kyi dus 'od zer phar 'phros rgyal ba mchod byin rlabs rnams tshur bsdus rang la bstem yi dam gyi lha dngos dang khyad par med pa'i nus pa thob/ yang 'od zer 'phros mnar med sogs 258

rigs drug sems can la 'phog de dag gi sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu las nyon bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs nas snod thams cad gzhal yas khang / bcud thams cad yi dam lha'i rang bzhin du byas song snyam pa'i mdun pa drag po byas skyes bu brtson 'grus can gyis tshe gcig lus gcig la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mngon du byas/ 'gro ba mtha' dag smin grol gyi lam la 'god pa myur lam gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i khyad chos yin pa la/ deng sang bla ma 'ga' res bdag gzhan mnyam brje zer/ bskyed rim sogs kyi skabs 'ga' zhig tu rang gzhan thams cad tha mal du bltas/ rang gi bde ba dang dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba rnams 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par phar btang / sems can gyi sdug bsngal nad gdon sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chag thams cad dud pa nag po sogs kyi rnam par tshur blangs pa'i 'dun pa drag po byed dgos zer ba 'di/ dper na dbul po rtsal stobs chung ba zhig gis rang gi sprang zas mi ltogs mang po la phar byen/ de rnams kyi khur lci ba gang yod pa tshur blangs nas rang thog tu spungs na lto phyir sprang du yang 'gro mi thub par sdug bsngal myong ba ltar gzhan la phan chung zhing / rang la nad sogs byung nas gnod 259

che bas thabs rdugs kyi dmigs pa ngan pa 'di 'dra/ lam bde nas bde bar bgrod pa thabs mkhas sngags lam la zhugs pa'i byed gtan nas mi rung / spyir chos thams cad 'dun pa la rag las gsungs/ sgos su sngags mos lam gyis 'grub pa yin pas 'di lta bu'i dmigs pa ngan pa byas na/ yi dam lha'i nga rgyal gsal snang 'don pa la gnod cing / skabs shig de'i steng du nad sna du ma yang 'byung / nad byung na mi bzod par sngar de 'dra byas pa'i ma bzang ba yin snyam 'gyod pa skye/bskyed rim bsgoms pa sogs gang yang mi nus pas lam gyi bar chad du 'gyur/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa la ring du 'gyur ba sogs nyes 'gal du ma 'byung bas sngags kyi rnal 'byor pas 'di lta bu'i dmigs pa ngan pa rnams dug ltar spong ba gal che/ de ltar ma byas kyang byang chub sems bsgom tshul med pa ma yin/ bsam pa bzang po thams cad la byang chub kyi sems zer bas/ sngags kyi 'od zer spro bsdu de bas byang chub kyi sems rgya che ba bzang ba zhig med/des na rang gzhan la phan rgya chen thogs pa'i dmigs pa gang legs pa thams cad bya dgos zer na/ sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas bzung da lta'i skyes bu dam pa du 260

mas bdag pas gzhan gces kyi byang chub kyi sems rin po che 'di thugs dam gyi mthil du bzung / theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pas kyang bdag gzhan bde sdug brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che 'di sngags lam gyi thog mtha' thun mtshams su bsten na/ lam la sa chod chen po 'byung zhes lan grangs du mar gsungs pa 'di khyod kyi lam gye bar chad yin byang chub yun ring por mi thob pa'i rgyu yin pas dug ltar spong dgos zer ba 'di/ rang nyid gces par 'dzin pa'i theg dman nas yar ma 'phags pa'i gtam/ theg chen chos kyi rtsa ba byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems med pa'i rang mtshang phyir bstan pa yin te/ theg pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa yang byang chub kyi sems yod med kyi steng nas bzhag pa yin/ byang chub kyi sems med na chos theg pa chen po'i gsang sngags yin kyang gang zag theg pa chen por mi 'gyur/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i rgyu sa bon lta bu de byang chub kyi sems yin/ phar phyin drug dang bskyed rdzogs sog sa chu lud drod gsher dang 'dra gsungs/ dper na sa bon med par son ma byas kyang ston thog mi 'ong ba ltar byang chub kyi sems kyis ma zin par lam bskyed rdzogs sogs la ci tsam 'bad kyang sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 261

thob par mi 'gyur/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar 'dod pas byang chub kyi sems mtha' dag la slob pa gal che/ mnyam med jo bo chen pos rdo rje gdan la bskor ba mdzad dus/ ci ltar byas na myur du 'tshang rgya 'am thugs la dgongs pa na/ lha chung ba rnams kyis bzhengs nas che ba la phyag phul nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar 'dod pas gang la bslab par bya zhes dris pa la/ lha che ba rnams kyis myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar 'dod pas byang chub kyi sems la bslab par bya'o gsungs/ gadho la'i gtsug lag khang gi steng nam mkha' na bud med rgan ma zhig la gzhon ma zhig gis phyag byas nas dris pa la yang sngar ltar gsungs tshe/bla ma gser gling pa sogs bsten nas byang chub sems kyi gdams pa blangs nas nyams su bzhes/ gzhan la spel nas rgya bod gnyis gar rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i skar tshogs tsam byung ba yin/byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi thugs dam gyi mthil de khyod ma gtogs sus mi bzang zer/ sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi slob pa lam gye gnas skabs sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal yid kyis blangs pa tsam du ma zad/ dngos su 262

yang sdug bsngal blangs nas sbyangs pa'i dus dpag tu med/ de ltar mdzad pas sangs rgyas pa yin/ 'o skol rnams kyis gces 'dzin byas sdug bsngal dngos su len pa phar zhog yid kyis kyang len ma nus pas da bar 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin/da yang sangs rgyas 'dod na de ltar bya dgos/ gces 'dzin 'dod na ci shes/ skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis/ rang nyid gces 'dzin rgud pa kun gyi sgo/ /ma rnams gces 'dzin yon tan kun gyi gzhi/ /de phyir bdag gzhan brje ba'i rnal 'byor la/ /nyams len snying por byed par byen gyis rlobs/ /gsungs snang / 'o na kho bo sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa theg dman pa yin dogs med/ byang chub kyi sems de bas rgya chen po smon pa byang chub kyi sems/ 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems bskyed/ don dam byang chub kyi sems sogs la slob pa yin/ kho bo tsho la de gas chog zer na/ 'o skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de rgyu gcig gnyis las byung ba ma yin/ rgyu bsam gyes mi khyab pa las byung ba yin pas/ ded dpon lta bu'i sems bskyed/ mnyan pa lta bu'i sems bskyed/ dzi bo lta bu'i sems bskyed byang chub sems bskyed nyer gnyis sogs mtha' yas la phun sum tshogs pa slob dgos/ tshogs gnyis gsog pa 263

yang gcig gnyis tsam ma yin par bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig la slob dgos/ khyod kyis 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems bskyed na bdag gzhan bde sdug brje ba la dngos su yang 'jug ces khas blangs pa yin na da dngos su mi 'jug rung yid kyis kyang mi 'jug pa de ya mtshan/ bdag gzhan bde sdug brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems la slob mi thub pa de bdag 'dzin che bas lan/ bdag 'dzin che na khyod kyi don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa gnad du song ma song gi ha go yang / byams snying rje smon 'jug byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i theg pa chen po'i gang zag gis rgyal sras kyi spyod pa thams cad la blo sbyong dgos na/ 'di la blo sbyong dgos pa smos ci dgos/ yang 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam ltar rang bzhin gyis grub pa rdul tsam med cing / gang snang thams cad nam mkha'i 'ja' sprin/ chu nang gi zla ba/ me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar rang gi sems kyi rnam rol tu thag chod la/ nang sems nyid la ngo bo ngos bzung dbyibs kha dog sogs gang yang ma grub par skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba/ stong gsal phyi nang mtha' dbus med pa nam mkha' yangs pa ltar khyab gdal zang thal chos sku nyag gcig tu blo thag chod pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams 264

kyis/ bdag 'dzin bzang ngan dga' sdug blang dor re dogs nye ring chags sdang sogs nyon mongs pa dang gtan bral byas/skye med chos dbyings kyi ngang du dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med par gnas pa'i btsan sa zin pa'i phyir gtong len 'di la 'bad na legs te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ mdo sngags kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad bdag 'dzin sogs nyon mongs 'dul ba'i gnyen po yin pas bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen por 'gro dgos/bdag 'dzin ma thul na 'khor ba las grol ba zhig mdo rgyud bstan bcos gang nas ma gsungs/ des na gsang sngags pas kyang bskyed rim sogs bsgoms nas bdag 'dzin sogs nyon mongs pa 'dul dgos snyam/ de 'dul dgos na bdag 'dzin gyi dgra chams la phab nas/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa la gtong len 'di gdams pa zab pas/ 'di sngags kyi rnal 'byor pas spong dgos zer ba de chos ma shes pa'i gtam zhig yin bas gzhan ma sems/ sems can thams cad mar shes drin dran drin gzo dgos tshul bsam/ byams snying rjes kun nas bslang rang gi tshe 'di'i drin can pha mas gtso byas pa'i rigs drug gi sems can spyi'i sdig sdug gtam ngan/ khyad par 'jig rten khams 'di'i mdze nad gam dang / dmu chu skran 265

dang rma 'bras sogs nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi gza' gdong thugaklu gdol pa/ rgyal po smyo 'bog btsan gzer nad gtong ba sogs gdon stong phrag brgyad cu sogs mi 'dod pa'i rigs dang / gzhan yang mi dge ba bcu/ mtshams med pa lnga/ nye ba lnga/ phyi ba bzhi/ log pa brgyad sogs sdug bsngal gyi rgyu las ngan pa gzhan gyis bsags tshad/ gzhan yang chos kyi sgor zhugs pa rnams kyis so thar gyi sdom pa/ byang sems kyi bslab pa/ sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba gang bgyis nyes ltung gi tshogs ci mchis pa rnag khrag dud khu sol khu dud pa nag po sdom sdig sbal sbong 'od zer nag po sogs kyi rnam par rang gi lus kyi steng du byung nas/ 'jig rten khams na nad pa sogs sdug bsngal can ji snyed mchis pa bde phyam gyis song / dga' ba'i lus kyis gar dang ngag gis gtam smras par bsam/ rang gi lus la nad kyi tshang bcas/ gdon gyi gzhi bting / nad rnams sha rus la thim/ gdon rnams rgyun du nyal/ lus skrangs rtsa 'phar/ rus pa gzir ba sogs byung / sems can thams cad kyi tshab tu rang nad gdon sdug bsngal thar med kyi 'og tu shor song snyam pa byas na/ de ltar byed mi rung chos rnams 'dun pa la rag las/ de ltar ma byed/ byas na rang gi thog tu mdze nad 266

la sogs nad ngan pa re 'byung nyen yod snyam bdag 'dzin mngon gyur du 'ong bas/ de'i dus su 'o lags so da bzang btsal bas ma rnyed pa'i dgra de lag tu chud byung snyam du kho rkun ma bzhin ngos tshir gyis bzung la/ 'o nga 'am bdag ces ming gnyis yod pa don gyis gcig pa khyod la gnod pa yin na/khyod la gnod yul 'di 'dra zhig go zhes ston rgyu zhig yod dgos/ yod na lus sems dang gcig tu yod dgos/ yang na tha dad du yod dgos/ de ma gtogs gzhan yod tshul zhig gtan nas med snyam du thag bcad/ lus sems gnyis dang gcig byas yod na/ lus yan lag lnga yod pa dang / sems la rnam rtog mang po yod pa bzhin nga yang mang po zhig yod dgos/mi gcig la nga gcig min mang po mi srid/ gcig yin na nga'i lus dang nga'i sems zhes gnyis su 'byed pa dang yang 'gal/ nga zer ba 'di lus sems dang gcig ma yin par 'dug snyam du thag bcad/ lus sems gnyis dang tha dad yin na lus sems so sor bsal/ de yang sems kyi dran rtog snga phyi bar gsum thams cad yid kyis so sor bsal nas/ nga zer ba zhig shul na e yod ltos dang / lus kyi yan lag nying lag phyi nang bar gsum thams cad kyis so sor phyes nas bsal ba'i 267

shul na/ nga zhes pa'am bdag zer ba zhig e grub bltas pas/rang bzhin gyis grub pa rdul tsam ma rnyed tshe/ yang lus zer ba khyod la gnod pa yin na lus khyod yan lag lnga po dang gcig tu grub bam tha dad du grub sngar ltar dpyad/ de bzhin du sems zer ba khyod la gnod pa yin na/ sems khyod rnam rtog snga phyi bar gsum rnams dang gcig tu grub bam tha dad yin sogs sngar ltar dpyad/ 'o na yang nad dang gdon zer ba khyod tshur steng du 'ongs pa yin na rgyu rkyen gang las byung / de dag gcig tu grub bam tha dad du grub par dpyad nas ma rnyed tshe/ 'o nga bdag lus sems nad gdon sogs chos thams cad phreng ba dmag gi dpe bzhin/ rgyu rkyen rten 'brel tshogs pa'i steng du ming gis phar btags pa tsam ma gtogs rang ngos nas grub pa rdul tsam mi 'dug nga sngon chad ma rig 'khrul pa'i dbang du song nas nga med pa la ngar bzung / bdag med pa la bdag tu bzung / gzhan yal bar dor/ rangagaces par bzung bas 'khrul pa tsam ma gtogs/ bla ma'i gdams ngag ltar brtags shing dpyad na ngos bzung gang yang mi 'dug bdag med pa la bdag tu su zhig 'dzin/ gzung ba don mi 'dug da ni bdag gces 'dzin thams cad blos btang la sngon gyi rgyal ba sras 268

bcas kyi rnam par thar pa ltar snying thag pa nas bdag gzhan bde sdug brje dgos snyam du rang bde phar btang / gzhan sdug tshur blangs/ lhag par gzhan gye nad ma rungs pa 'jig rten khams na yod pa mig gis mthong ba/ rna bas gang thos pa thams cad tshur ched gnyer gyis blangs/ yang nga bdag lus sems nad gdon sogs la rig pa sna tshogs pas brtag dpyad byas/ rang bzhin gyis e grub bltas ma grub tshe/ gnas lugs kyi ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa sogs byas na/ bdag 'dzin bzang ngan blang dor re dogs nye ring chags sdang dang bral nas/ bdag med gnas lugs mngon sum du rtogs nas gzhan gye sdug bsngal yid kyis len pa la zhum pa med par ma zad/ dngos su len rgyu byung na spro bzhin 'jug nus/ de lta bu'i blo bcos ma ma yin pa rgyud la skyes tshe bdag pas gzhan gces kyi byang chub kyi sems rin po che rgyud la skyes pa yin pas/de lta bu'i gang zag la theg pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa 'am/byang chub sems dpa' zhes mtshan gsol kyang chog de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skyes pa'i bsod nams la gzugs shig yod rgya yin na nam mkha'i khams la mi shong ste/ de bzhin gshegs dro'i gsang ba'i mdo las/ byang chub sems kyi bsod 269

nams gang / /de la gal te gzugs mchis na/ /nam mkha'i khams ni kun bkang ste/ /de ni de bas che bar 'gyur/ /gsungs/ sangs rgyas ni bsod nams rgya chen pos mthu las thob pa yin pas/ byang chub sems kyi bsod nams kyi mthus myur du 'tshang rgya nges shes nas gtong len byed pa 'di bdag 'dzin 'joms pa'i tho ba/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i myur lam/gzhan yongs la ma grags pa'i khyad chos can zhig yin pas sngags kyi rnal 'byor pas 'di thog mtha' bar gsum du bsten par rigs so// spyir chos thams cad 'dun pa la rag las/ smon lam gang btab 'grub gsungs pa de/ las dge ba bsags nas mtho ris thar pa'i bde ba gang 'dod la 'dun pa byas smon lam btab na 'grub gsungs pa yin gyi/ las sdig pa byas/ 'bras bu bde ba 'dod nas 'dun pa byas smon lam btab nas sdig can gyis thar pa 'thob pa zhig shin tu dkon/ yang las ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad/ byas pa chud mi za gsungs pa yin pas/rang gis tshe sngon las ngan ma bsags na/ de ltar gtong len gye 'dun pa brgya stong byas rung / byas kyin steng du bde ba zhig mi 'byung rung nad gdon sogs gtan nas 'byung mi srid de/270

sngon dge bshes glang ri thang pas sems can dmyal bar skye ba kun gyi tshab tu skye ba phyi ma de la dmyal bar skye bar 'dod nas/de la 'dun pa drag po btang smon lam btab kyang mar dmyal bar skye ba'i rtags ma byung bar yar dag zhing du skye ba'i ltas mang po byung tshe/ slob ma rnams la/ nga la 'dod pa zhig yod de/de mi 'grub par gda' gsungs tshe/ de gang lags zhus pas/sems can dmyal bar skye ba rnams kyi tshab tu dmyal bar skyes na snyam smon lam btab ste/ da de ru mi skye bar gda'/ dag zhing du skye ba'i bltas mang po 'ong gin 'dug gsungs skad/ 'o na gtong len byas steng du mi 'ong na sems can la phan ga la thogs/ de yin na steng du mi 'ong ba shes nas sems can la kha bzang rdzun gyes mgo g.yogs shig byas pa red/ dgos pa mi 'dug zer na/ de ltar bsam pa sbyangs pas sems can la 'phral du phan thogs shig ma byung kyang / de lta bu'i sems lan cig bskyed kyang bsod nams dpag med 'thob cing bdag 'dzin thul/ bdag med chos sku mngon du byas myur du sangs rgyas nas/ phugs su sems can la phan rgya chen thogs pas don med par ga la 'gyur/ 'on kyang / chos rnams thams cad rkyen bzhin du/ /'dun pa'i rtsa la rab tu gnas/ /gsungs pa dang /271

sngon gyi dam pa 'ga' res gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dngos su blangs gsungs pa rdzun nam zer na/ gal te de ltar gtong len shugs drag la yun ring bar sbyangs nas/ 'phral du gzhan gyi sdug bsngal rang steng du lon pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bzang po re gnyis yod srid/ de ltar gtong len byas steng du lon na skal ba bzang / 'dod thog tu song ba yin pas mi dga' rgyu ci yod rang gi byed nyes mi dge ba byas pa'i mthu las byung ba ni min/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che bsgoms pa'i mthu las byung ba yin/ sems can gcig gi nad sel phyir dmigs nas gtong len byas tshur lon pa byung na/ de gcig pu'i phan yon mtha' yas na/ sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdug bsngal sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad bsal nas/ bde bar gnas pa'i phyir du dmigs nas steng du nad sogs mi 'dod pa zhig byung na/ de'i bsod nams nam mkhar mi shong / thugs dam gyi mchog de ka yin pas/ kha nas ma ṇi sogs 'bag 'bug bton pa dang / rlung bzung zang zing byed pa sogs thugs dam gyi mchog yin par ma sems/ sngon gyi bka' gdams bla ma gong ma rnams kyis rkyen ngan byung na dbul pos yid bzhin nor bu rnyed pa'am/ mi zad pa'i gter dang 'phrad 272

pa bzhin dang du blangs/ ma gyur sems can gzhan gyi sdig sdug gtam ngan mthong na snying rje nas/ de'i rnam smin bdag la 'dus nas de kun bde bar shog ces tshur 'ongs pa'i 'dun pa drag po byas smon lam 'debs pa yin skad/ de yin na rang gi sdug bsngal gzhan la mi bsgyur ba smos ci dgos/sngon jo bo chen pos 'brom ston pa rin po che la/ khyod kyis byang chub kyi sems rin po che 'di la thugs dam gyi mthil gyis shigasku tshe'i mjug gshegs kha la snyung gzhi mdze zhig 'ong na dga' ldan du skye zhes gsungs/ phyis 'brom ston pa'i gdul bya rdzogs nas sku tshe'i mjug der/ sems can nad pa ji snyed pa myur du nad las thar ba'i phyir gtong len la sbyangs pas snyung gzhi de ka byung tshe/ thugs dgyes 'dod thog tu song da dga' ldan du skye'o gsungs skad/ khong gis sku gshegs pa'i dus su yang spyir 'jig rten khams kyi nad dang khyad par mdze nad thams cad kyi rgyun bcad sems can dpag tu med pa nad las grol/de'i bsod nams kyis khong dga' ldan gnas su padmo las brdzus te skyes/ don gcig gis don gnyis 'grub par byas pa yin/ 'o skol rnams kyis lus 'di gces 'dzin byas bskyang bskyangs pa'i mthar khyi dang bya rgod la 'cha' ru bcug pa las 273

don gcig kyang ma byung bas snying po ci blangs soms dang / ba nga ga'an gyi sdug bsngal dngos su len nus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sdug bsngal mi 'dod dus gzhan sa rdo ri brag sogs la spo 'dod na spo yang nus te/ rje mi las snyung gzhi sgo la sgos nas sgo tsag tsag yer yer zhig 'gro ba lta bu byas pa dang 'dra/ nad byung ba ma bzang da ci bya zhes sems khral mi dgos/ rang mi 'dod dus gzhan sa rdo ri brag sogs la spos chog yang gnas lugs stong nyid rtogs nas mngon du gyur pa'i rnal 'byor pa nad byung yang / nad gdon rnams nam mkhar 'ja' tshon shar ba'am/ rlung rgyu ba bzhin sems nyid stong pa'i rgyan yin pas spo yang mi spo/ sdug bsngal ri tsam byung yang 'ja' tshon mang po zhig gi nang du gnas pa tsam gyi snang ba ma gtogs phan gnod gang yang mi 'ong bas nad spo mi dgos/ des na gtong len 'di mdo sngags kyi chos nyams su len pa thams cad dang / khyad par bdag med gnas lugs bsgoms nas mngon du gyur par 'dod pas lam gyi bogs 'don yin pas bsten pa gal che/ 'o na mdo sngags gang na yang thog mar smon 'jug gi sems bskyed dus/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/274

de'i ched du dam pa'i chos bya'o snyam nas chos gang nus byas pa/phyi nas dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo dgos pa la/ gtong len byed dus dge ba thams cad sems can la phan phyir btang gtong ba 'dis sems can la 'phral du cung zad phan thogs rung / phugs su rang nyid sangs rgyas thob nas sems can la phan rgya chen thogs pa'i gegs su song ba yin/ dper na dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal sel phyir nor bu len snyam 'gro chas bsgrubs pa rnams dbul po la byen pa dang 'dra zer na/ dpe de dang 'dra dogs med/ dper na bu blo rgod cig gis pha ma nye 'brel sogs la phan 'dogs snyam/ 'bru rnams zhing la btab tshur blangs/ slar yang de thams cad zhing mang por btab/yang tshur blangs/ slar yang 'bru rnams zhing de bas mang bar btab tshur blangs khyim na nor rdzas gzhan gang yod bu lon du btang / tshong byas gong 'phel du btang / slar yang de dag rnams sngar ltar yang yang byas na myur du phyug por gyur nas rang gzhan yongs la phan pa ltar sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam/ chos byas pa de dag sems can thams cad la gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgya ba'i phyir bsngos na/ sems can re re la brten nas 275

bsod nams sngar gyi de bas brgya 'gyur re 'ongs/ bsod nams brgya 'gyur mi dgos sems can re re'i steng nas khab rtse tsam re las ma byung yang sems can gra ngas med pas bsod nams de kun phyogs gcig tu bsdus na 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir mi shong / brgya 'gyur re thob na ni nam mkha'i khams la'ang mi shong / de ltar bsngos nas bsod nams cher song ba de yang / slar sems can la phan phyir bsngos na de bas che ru 'gro/ de yang bsngos na de bas rgya cher 'gro/ sangs rgyas ni bsod nams rgya chen po bsags pa'i mthu las byung ba yin pas myur du sangs rgyas pa'i thabs la de lhag par bzang /des na deng sang bla ma skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis rang gzhan gyi dge ba bsngo dus/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa dang / bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams sku tshe brtan cing rnam dkar mdzad phrin rgyas pa dang / sems can thams cad gnas skabs su bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgya phyir bsngo ba de gnad shin tu che/ de ltar yang yang bsngos na ci tsam bsngo thub pa de tsam gyi bsod nams rgya chen po 'byung / skabs re bsod nams de 276

dag rnams sems can gyi don du myur bar sangs rgyas pa'i phyir bsngo ba smon lam btab na shin tu legs/ des na bsngo ba mtha' yas rgya chen po byas na dge ba 'phel ba ma gtogs zad mi 'gro bas/ bsngo ba gcig byas na da bsngo rgyu zhig med mi sems par bsngo ba smon lam rang gi gang shes dang rgya gang che rnams yang dang yang du byed pa gces te/ bsod nams dam pa'i mdo las/ dge ba chung ngu nas bsags dgos/ de yang bsngo dgos/ ma bsngos pa'i rdzas rnams ni/ bye tshan la chu thigs gcig brgyab na chu de myur du skam pa dang 'dra ste/ bsngo ba byas pa'i phan yon ni/ rgya mtsho chen po la chu thigs gcig blug na chu de mi zad cing slar 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang 'dra gsungs/yang deng sang 'ga' res sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'di zhwa mo dang gon pa'i mdog dbyibs zhig gi steng na yod par sems/gsar rnying sogs rang gi grub mtha' gang yin pa de dang cha lugs mi mthun pa re mthong na bstan bshig ka tsho zer ba 'di/mkhas pas bltas na yi mug la dgod kha 'chor ba'i gnas shig yin te/ bstan pa zer ba de gang la zer/ phyi cha lugs la zer ram nang chos lugs la zer/ so sor phye la dam bca' tshugs dang / phyi cha lugs la zer na/ phyi cha lugs bstan pa 277

yin pa rtags ma grub/ rgya gar na phyi rol pa mang bas/ nang pa dang phyi rol ba gnyis mi nor ba'i rtags dang / cha lugs 'di ltar mdzad nas sdig spong dge sgrub byed dgos zer ba'i brda' tsam yin gsungs kyis/ bstan pa yin zhes ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /bstan pa yin na/ phyis rtags tsam 'dzin gye dus 'dul ba la sogs pa'i bstan pa med/ skyes bu dam pa'i gsungs pa dang yang 'gal bar 'gyur/ khyod kyi 'di yin na de'i dus kyang bstan pa yod par khas len dgos/ de khas len na khyod kyi bstan pa 'di dar dgos na las sla bar gda'/ zhwa mo dang chos gos dmar ser re mi 'gyu ba su yod/ rgan rgon dang byes pa bshan pa yugs sa ma yan chad kyis gyon nas bstan pa rgyas su bcug na chog ste/ des mi yong / 'on kyang deng sang chos pa rnams kyis zhwa mo dang gon pa sogs phyi cha lugs dmar ser gang yin yang de nges na chos lugs de gas yong yong 'dra ste/ de yin na gzhan la rtags tsam 'dzin zer ba zhig phyi nas 'ong zhes smra bar mi rigs/ rtags tsam 'dzin rnams da slebs yod do zhes bsgrags par rigs/ 'o na phyi'i cha lugs bstan pa min rung gcig dgos/ sna tshogs byas na bstan pa bshig pa'i rgyu yin zer na/ 'o na cha lugs de su dang 278

gcig dgos/ mdo rgyud gnyis gsung ba po rdo rje 'chang dang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sogs dang gcig dgos sam/de 'dzin pa'i rgya gar grub chen brgyad cu bod kyi yul du byon pa'i jo bo yab sras/ rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa mar pa mi la sogs kyi skyes bu dam pa zhig dang mthun dgos/ so sor phyes la shod dang / nag nog byas gang yong / mdo nyams su len pa'i gang zag gis sangs rgyas kyi mdzad spyod gsung ltar byed dgos zer na/ de yin na sangs rgyas kyis kyang rang gi bstan pa rang gis bshig par 'gyur/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ khong rdo rje 'chang rigs lnga sogs bongs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bzhengs nas gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde du ma gsungs pa yin la/ gzhan yang gang la gang 'dul gyi skur sprul nas chos bstan sems can gyi don mdzad ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /yang byams pa 'jam dbyangs spyan ras gzigs sogs dang / rgya gar gyi te lo na ro/ bod kyi mar mi 'brom ston sogs dbu ral can rus rgyan can sogs cha lugs sna tshogs mdzad pa de rnams kyang khyod kyis sangs rgyas bstan bshig tu khas longs/ mnyam med jo bo rjes kyang sangs rgyas kyis ma gnang ba'i dbu zhwa dmar po sgu 'gag sngon po zhig mnabs 'dug pas des kyang bstan pa 279

bshig par 'gyur/ sngags nyams su len pa'i gang zag gis rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang o rgyan chen po sogs kyi mdzad spyod gsung ltar byed dgos zer na/ de yin na sangs rgyas nas bzung gnas brtan bcu drug rgyan drug mchog gnyis rgya gar mkhas grub phal cher dang / bod kyi rgyal ba yab sras sogs mkhas grub dbu bregs zhabs rjen thams cad kyis gsang sngags kyi bstan pa bshig par 'gyur/ yang bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams dang mthun dgos zer na/ de yin na gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin dpal mar me mdzad kyi cha lugs ltar mdzad dgos/ de ltar mdzad na dbu zhwa dmar po sku 'gag sngon bo kun gyis gnang dgos kyang / shing rta'i srol 'byed chen po rje rin bo che'i dbu zhwa ser po sku 'gag rgyan drug ma gsol bas na/rje rin po ches kyang dpal ldan mar me mdzad kyi bstan pa bshig par khas longs/ rje rin po che ltar mdzad dbo/sa na/deng sang bla chen rnams kyis gser zhwa chen po 'od lam me ba gyon/ na bza' phu dung can chu la sogs bzhes pas bla chen rnams kyis kyang rje rin po che'i bstan pa bshig par 'gyur/gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pas stong gsum 'jig rten gye khams thams cad khyab yod pas/ lha klu gnod sbyin grul bum 280

sogs kyi cha lugs mthun dogs med/ des na nged rang deng sang gi bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams dang cha lugs mi mthun pa'i tshangs pa brgya byen la sogs pa yang bstan bshig tu khas len dgos/ de yin na bstan 'dzin gcig mi 'dugade ci'i phyir zhe na/ cha lugs mi mthun pa byas pa'i phyir ro/ /yang 'o na cha lugs mdo rgyud bstan bcos gsung ba bo kun dang mthun dgos sam/ gcig dang mthun pas chog so sor phyes la shod dang / kun dang mthun dgos zer na/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad gdams par shar ba'i bka' gdams pa dang / rje rin po ches/ gzhung bzang stong gi chu bo 'du ba'i phyir/ /dpal ldan legs par bshad pa'i rgya mtsho 'ang yin/ /gsungs pas/ 'di nyams su len pa'i chos pa gcig gis cha lugs mi 'dra ba brgya yi mi tshad stong byed dgos par gda'/ de su zhig gis 'gyu/ 'gyu rung lus gcig gis ji ltar dus gcig la gyon/ thugs bsam bzhes/ de tsam gye mang po zhig mi dgos gcig tsam gyis yong zer na/ de yin na khyed kyi cha lugs mi mthun pa re mthong dus bstan bshig tsho zer ba de sku rlung langs pa'am/ snying khams ma bde ba'i gtam zhig ma yin nam sems rnal du phob la dag snang gi sman 281

re bzhes 'tshal/ da ston pa'i rjes 'jug rnams kyi cha lugs khong gi bcas pa ltar mdzad dgos na yang / deng sang bskal pa snyigs ma yul dus ngan pa'i dbang gis gsung thams cad ji bzhin sgrub pa dka'/ chos gos rnam gsum yang / dus rgyun du gyon gsungs pa yang / deng sang 'o skol rnams kyis zad 'gro gi dogs nas dril nas khur dgos par gda'/ des na 'brug pa kun legs la/ 'dul ba dang su mthun dris pas/rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang jo bo yab sras mthun gsungs/gzhan ma gsungs pa de gang yin soms dang ha go yong / de bzhin du rdo rje 'chang slob dpon pad 'byung sogs kyi gsung rnams ltar byed pa shin tu dka' re re tsam sgrub nus na yang bu rgod du brtsi dgos/ ston pa dang rdo rje 'chang slob dbon padma sogs rgyal ba gong ma zhing brjes pa'i shul na/ bla ma re la chos lugs re/ chos lugs re la cha lugs re byung 'dug de gang yin gang min zer/ chos dang mthun na gang yin yang 'dra skyon med dag snang gyis/ gal te dag snang ma byung yang bstan bshig ces dngos sam brgyud nas skyes bu dam pa thams cad la 'phog pa'i gtam 'di 'dra ma smras na bzang / 'o na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa phyi'i cha lugs gcig pu la rag ma las nang 282
