chos lugs la rag las na/ bstan pa de gang la zer/ sus bzung nas sus 'jig zer na/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ni mdo las/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyod/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /gsungs/ rang rgyud na byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems yod sems can la dngos sam brgyud nas phan pa'i thabs srog bskyabs sbyin gtong sogs rgyal ba'i gsung rab ltar byed na cha lugs pho yis mo chas spras kyang skyon med de/ 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ ci byas chos su song na cha lugs mo chas spras kyang mdzes po yong gsungs/ dge bshes nam mkha'i snying pos/ chos dang mthun na cha lugs gang byas kyang chog gsungs/ de bden te/ ston pa'i gsung bzhin dge bsgrub mkhan gyi mi la/ gzhan lha mi su zhig gis mthong yang yid smon byed pa'i gnas yin/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bya ba bzang po de phan byed rgyu med/ de la bstan 'dzin mi zer na su la zer/ de ltar go na deng sang yang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa mang po yod pas gang la khas mi gtong / yang nang bsam pa nag sbyor ba rtsub/ chos gos gyon nas srog gcod byas snam sbyar gyon nas bud med la spyod rgyu yin na/ phyi'i cha 283

lugs ston pa sangs rgyas las mjes kyang sdig chas yin te/chos rje kun legs kyis/ bsam ngan khong par bcug na cha lugs gser gyi beer yang sdig chas yin gsungs/ lha mi yongs kyis khrel ba'i gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dngos su khyad gsod byas rma de phan 'bebs rgyu med/ de bas skye bo mi nag pas las de byas na drag zhe sdang langs nas gzhan la bstan bshig ces tshig rtsub smras na yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa yin pas bstan 'dzin du ma rloms/ de bzhin du mi dge bcu sogs chos min gyi las byas tshad bstan bshig yin par go na/ bstan pa yod med bshig ma bshig sogs kyi gnad shes sla bar 'dug pas/ blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis de ltar shes par gyis la chos pa rab 'bring tha gsum cha lugs bzang ngan gang la'ang brnyas smod khyad gsod sun 'byen sogs mi byed par dad gus dag snang sbyongs/ yang skyabs mgon rgyal ba pan chen la sogs sa thob kyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i rnam 'phrul bla ma sku skyes kyis chang dang bud med gnyis ma gtogs gzhan sha khrag sogs 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod pa rnams dang / gsang sngags kyi lam nyams su len pa'i gang zag dbang po yang rab rnams kyis sha chang bud 284

med gtso bor bsten pa dang / khrims ldan byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis 'dod yon dkor la longs spyod pa rnams kyis ci tsam spyad kyang skyon gyis ma gos/ pa de mi shes/ deng sang 'ga' res khong rnams kyis 'dod yon lhag par spyod mi rung ba lta bu'i go ba log pa skyes/ 'dod yon la spyod pa'i skyes bu dam pa zhig mthong na/ khong rnams kyis 'di ltar mdzad na 'o skol skye bo phal pa rnams kyis byas na los chog zer dpe 'then tshad ki bzhag nas lad mo byed pa 'di chos ma shes pa'i rang mtshang ston bzhin du rang 'phung du bcug pa yin te/dper na rma bya la dug 'ju ba'i nus pa rang bzhin gyis yod pas dug ci tsam zos kyang lus la mi gnod par ma zad/ zos bzhin sgo mdongs 'ja' tshon las mdzes pa skye ba dang / mi rdzas sngags ting 'dzin mkhan gyis dug zos na mi gnod par lus 'tsho ba'i zas kyi mchog tu 'gyur ba dang / sman pa mkhas pas dug dang 'dres pa'i zas zos kyang dug gsod pa'i sman yod pas 'thungs na lus srog la mi gnod cing / gzhan skye bo phal pas de rnams kyi lad mo byas dug zos na lus mi 'tsho bar ma zad srog myur du chad pa ltar/ skyabs mgon rgyal ba paṇa chen sogs bla ma skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis 'dod yon ci tsam 285

brten kyang skyon gyis mi gos par ma zad/ de la brten nas thugs la nyams rtogs khyad par can gsar du 'khrungs shing gzhan bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po 'byung la/ gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor rab kyis 'dod yon la spyad kyang mi gnod par lam gyi grogs su 'gyur/ mdo lugs sha stag byed pa'i khrims ldan byang chub sems dpas 'dod yon dkor la spyad kyang / tshul khrims dang byang chub sems kyi stobs kyis skyon gyis mi gos/ gzhan skye bo phal pa rnams kyis khong rnams kyi lad mo byas/ spyir 'dod yon lnga dang khyad par sha chang bud med la longs sbyad na mtho ris thar pa'i bde ba mi 'byung bar ma zad/ spyir 'khor ba dang khyad par ngan song gsum du 'gro ba thag chod/ des na gzhan bla ma skyes bu dam pa dang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa 'ga' res 'dod yon lnga dang khyad par sha chang bud med bsten pa la brnyas smod nam yang mi bya bar dad gus dag snang sbyongs ci nus kyi mchod bstod bkur sti gyes/ rang la 'dod yon spyad na skyon gyis mi gos pa'i nus pa ma thob bar du khong rnams kyi lad mo byed mi rung / yang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang ldan cing chos thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam ltar rtogs/ gnas lugs stong nyid kyi don mngon du gyur/ bskyed 286

rdzogs la brtan pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa gsad pa gso nus/gsang ba go nus/ dzu 'phrul ston nus pa'i gang zag gis gzhan phan gyi dgos pa che na phan sems kyis kun nas bslang /zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs sogs sangs rgyas bstan dang sems can bde la gnod pa'i sems can la mtshon cha rdo dang dbyug pa sogs kyis brdeg brdung dang / rgyab kyi gos bshus kha'i zas phrogs/ dzun phra ma tshig rtsub sogs lab/ lus ngag gi bya ba ma yin pa gang yang byas chog ste/ kun tu spyod pa'i rgyud las/ mi bya ci yang yod min te/ /rtag tu mi bsam yod ma yin/ /mi za ci yang yod min la/ /dge dang mi dge gang smras med/ /ces dang / gnyis med ye shes sems ldan gyis/ /mi bya ba ni ci yang med/ /rnam par mi rtog sems gcig brdar/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams spyod/ /ces dang /sasbu ṭa las/ rtog pa kun las rnam grol bas/ /sems can bsam pa'i khyad par gyis/ /sgyu ma la sogs sbyor ba yis/ /thams cad du ni longs spyad bya/ /zhes dang / sems can bslu ba spangs nas ni/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad bya/ /zhes dang /lung gzhan las/ rgyal sras rnams kyis mi slob pa'i/ /dngos de gang na'ang yod ma yin/ /de ltar shes pa'i mkhas pa la/ /287

bsod nams mi 'gyur gang yang med/ /ces dang / gsang 'dus kyi dam tshig tu/ khyod kyis srog chags bsad par bya/ /ma byin pa yang khyod kyis longs/ /rdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya/ /pha rol bud med bsten par gyis/ /gsungs/ dper na gzhan rgyud mkhyen pa'i grub thob 'brug pa kun legs kyis/gzhan 'dul phyir gang la gang 'dul gyi spyod pa 'jam rtsub sna tshogs pa bstan pa lta bu'o/ /de lta bu'i rnal 'byor pas spyir 'dod yon lnga dang khyad par sha chang bud med sogs bsten nas spyong pa gu yangs mdzad/ gzhan la brdeg brdung srog gcod sogs mi 'os pa byas kyang skyon gyis mi gos par ma zad/bstan 'gro la dngos sam brgyud nas phan pa'i dgos pa yod srid pas khas gtong mi rung / btang na nyes pa che ste bde mchog bsdus pa las/ dam tshig spyod par byed pa yi/ /rnal 'byor che la gang zhig sdang / /khye yi skye ba brgyar skyes te/ /rme sha can du skye bar 'gyur/ /gsungs/ de lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa mang / mngon shes med pas shes dka' bas de lta bu mdzad pa'i gang zag mthong thos kun la smod mi rung ste/ rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ byang chub sems dpa' gang na bzhugs mi shes/ /mthong thos kun la ma smod ri 288

khrod pa/ /gsungs/ 'o na gsang 'dus kyi lung de'i 'grel pa mkhas grub gzhan gyes mdzad tsa na/ khyod kyis srog chags bsad par bya/ /zhes pa bskyed rdzogs sogs kyi gdams pa mtshon rnon lta bus 'dod chags bya/ zhe sdang sbrul/ gti mug phag dang nyon mongs pa rtog tshogs srog chags lta bu rnams bsad par bya zhes pa'i don yin gsungs par gda'/ de bzhin du tshig gzhan gsum la'ang de 'dra'i 'grel pa gnang 'dug pa la/ khyod kyis sgra ji bzhin par bzung nas lung 'dir 'dren bar mi rigs zer na/ 'o de la phyi nang gsang gsum du sbyar ba'i 'grel pa bshad tshul mang / de khyod blta rgya chung zhing blo gros chung nas mtha' gcig tu bzung bas lan pa yin/nga'i 'di phyi ltar gyi 'chad tshul yin/ 'di ltar rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo rgyud kyi rdo rje'i tshig re la don sna tshogs pa 'jug pa mang / log par ma go bar legs par go na lung re re gong 'og mang por drangs kyang 'gal ba med de/ rgyud las/tshig gcig la ni sna tshogs don gsungs pa/ /gcig tu gsungs kyang so sos du mar go /gsungs/ des na mdo rgyud kyi tshig re la rgya bod kyi mkhas pas 'grel pa mi 'dra ba mang po mdzad pa la/ legs par go na tshig ngan pa yang bzang por 289

'gyur na bzang po smos ci dgos/ sngon bla ma skyabs 'gro tsam min mi shes pa zhig la rgan mo dad can zhig gis chos nan gyis yang yang zhus pas/ bla ma skyabs 'gro ba de sdug thug nas mi shes pa 'di sdug bsngal zhes smras pa rgan mos chos su go nas/mi shes pa 'di zhes pa mi rig pa red/ sdug bsngal gsungs pa mi shes pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal 'byung gsungs pa red snyam ma rig pa spangs pas dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i gtam rgyud dang 'dra/ log par go na chos bzang po yang dgos pa med par ma zad nyes pa bskyed de/ sngon sngags pa gcig gi phreng ba'i nang du mu men zhig yod pa bla ma zhig la 'bul dus/ mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma gsungs/ mu men 'di bzang po zhig red 'di kho la mi dgos bla ma khyed la 'bul smras pa dang / yang gcig gis ge sar rgyal po de byi ba lo pa zhig yin rgyu red smras pa la/ gzhan zhig gis de gang nas bshad 'dug dris pas/ de sgrol ma'i nang na ge sar byi ba lo nas byung ma/ /zer ba 'dug smras pa dang / bla rgan zhig gis ja mang po 'thung ba la 'ga' res bla rgan khyed la snod chen po 'dug smras pas/ bla rgan na re/ dge 'dun 'dra ba'i snod med de gsungs pas/ snod che na bzang smras pa dang / yang grwa pa zhig 290

gis bla ma zhig la khyed kyi mal sa stan 'di bzang po 'dug smras pas/ de red/ brtan spro le lo ma mchis shing gsungs/ stan spro na le lo med pa red smras pa dang / sngags pa zhig gis ang gi yi ge ma shes lha chen 'di la 'khor ra po zhig kyang yod rgyu red smras pas/gzhan zhig gis de ga na bshad 'dug dris pas/ de lha chen gsol mchod nang na lha chen ra po 'khor bcas kyi zhes bshad 'dug smras pa dang / yang cig gis bzang spyod bton nas mjug na ngan song rgyu rnams ma lus stong bar shog zer ba de la/ ngan song rgyud rnams ma lus 'grub par shog smras pas/ gzhan zhig gis de ci yin dris pas/ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud rnams stongs song na mi bzang bar 'dug 'grub par shog ces smras pa'i kha gtam rnams dang 'dra/des na blo gros can gyis rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang bla ma dam pa'i gsung sgos bzang ngan 'bring gsum gang yin kyang sdig spong dge sgrub dad gus dag snang 'phel ba'i thabs sogs chos dang mthun par shin tu legs par go ba gces/ bla ma'i chos zab mo gsungs kyang slob mas log par go na mi zab par 'gyur/ bla ma'i chos mi zab pa gsung rung slob mas legs par go na zab par 'gyur bas des na/ dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam par thar pa la/ /skad cig tsam yang log lta mi sgye zhing / /291

ci mdzad legs par mthong ba'i mos gus kyi/ /bla ma'i byen rlabs sems la 'jug par shog /gsungs pa ltar bla ma dang mched grogs phyogs bcu'i chos mdzad rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad spyod bzang ngan gang mthong yang ci mdzad legs par mthong ba'i mos gus 'di gal che/ de ltar legs par go na bla ma mched grogs phyogs bcu'i chos mdzad thams cad chos re dang mi mthun pa gcig med/ des na chos pa rnams kyis ci mdzad ci gsung thams cad la bzang ngan spang blang med par thams cad legs pa 'ba' zhig tu bltas nas dus rgyun du dad gus byas na bla ma dang phyogs bcu'i chos mdzad rnams kyi byin rlabs sems la 'jug par the tshom med/'o na sngon gyi mkhas grub rnams kyis ngo mtshar ba'i yon tan mngon shes dzu 'phrul sna tshogs thogs pa med par bstan kyang deng sang de 'dra'i skyes bu dam pa mthong ngam thos rgyu med pas na 'dod yon la spyod pa 'di rnams la dag snang zhig skye dka' bar 'dug zer na/ 'o deng sang dbu rdzogs phyag gsum sogs grub mtha' gang na yang ngo mtshar yon tan dang ldan pa'i skyes bu dam pa med pa ma yin/ mang po yod de snyigs ma las kyang ches snyigs ma phyi snod 'jig rten sdig pa'i 'bras bus gang /292

nang bcud sems can nyon mongs dug lngas myos nas rang pas gzhan la mthong chung / gzhan gye yon tan rnams kyang skyon du bltas/ rang gi skyon zhig yin yang yon tan du rloms pa'i dus ngan 'dir/ yon tan can gyis yon tan bstan kyang /gzhan mang bo'i rgyud la chags sdang phrag dog log lta sogs skyes/ lkog nas sgro skur btab/ dug dang mthu sogs sbyor ba rtsub pa byed pa ma gtogs ya mtshan par bzung bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa byed pa re re tsam yang dkon te/ sngon rje btsun mi la ras chen la yang / ston pa dar lo dang lo ston gnyis kyis phrag dog gis rtsod pa byas/ brnyas smod khyad gsod mang po dang kha nang du thal ba gtor/ dgon pa gcig gis chad lta ba zhes skur ba btab brdeg brdung byas/ dge bshes rtsag phu pas dug drangs nas gshegs/ gzhan yang bla ma mkhas pa dang grub pa la gzhan gyis dug dang mthu btang nas sku tshe la bar chad byas pa mthong thos mang / des na skal ldan dad gus can ma gtogs mngon shes dzu 'phrul bstan rung ya mtshan par mi 'dzin par ma zad/ de la brten nas chags sdang nyon mongs langs las ngan pa gsog pa mang bas/ de la dgongs nas mkhas grub rnams kyis yon tan yod kyang skal ldan dad 293

gus can re re tsam la ston pa ma gtogs/ gzhan yongs la mi ston par dus rgyun du yon tan gang yod sbas nas skye bo tha mal pa dang khyad med pa lta bu'i tshul gnang ba yin/ deng sang 'brel tshad don ldan sbas pa'i sangs rgyas mi gzugs can mang bas rang gi bla ma chos grogs phyogs bcu'i chos pa mchog dman bar pa yongs la skyes bu dam pa'i 'du shes bzhag nas dad gus dag snang sbyangs/ 'brel ba che thog chung thog gyis dang bzang / sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum po gcig char du sa ler mkhyen kyang /bdud sdig can gyis sgogs rdo dang mtshon char phab pa la sogs ma mkhyen pa'i tshul gnang dzu 'phrul yang bsam gyis mi khyab rung lhas sbyin gyis sbyogs rdo 'phangs pas zhabs kyi mthe'u chung cung zad bsnad pa'i tshul dang / spyogs rdo'i zer ma zhig dzambha la'i mgor 'phog pas da dung yang rma yod pa'i tshul dang /drag po 'jigs byed 'khor bcas kyis mi thams cad za ba la/sangs rgyas byon nas bden bzhi'i chos bshad kyang / slar go'u ta ma khyod bya rgod phung po'i ri la song la gso sbyong gyes zer ma thul/ sbyan ras gzigs byon nas phar phyin bcu'i chos bshad pas/ mi dkar po khyod rang song la yig drug thon zer 294

nas ma thul/ rta mgrin gyis phyag rgya bzhi'i chos gsungs pas/khyod rang gnas su log la ri'i rtswa zo lung pa'i chu 'thung la rta skad 'thon zer ma thul pa'i tshul bstan par gsungs/ mo'u 'gal gyi bu rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med rung mu stegs kun tu rgyu rnams kyis 'dam bu'i tshal ltar bcom dus rdzu 'phrul gang yang mi mnga' ba'i tshul bstan pa sogs de lta bu'i lo rgyus mang /des na deng sang rgyal ba paṇa chen la sogs bla ma skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis mkhyen pa chung zhing rdzu 'phrul med pa lta bu'i tshul bstan pa dgongs gzhi re yod pas/ gtan nas med rgyu red snyam nas log lta byed mi rung ste sngon mi dgu brgya dang dgu bcu go dgu bsad pa'i sdig can sor phreng can yang tshe sngon mar 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing lho phyogs gaṅgā'i klung drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'das pa na 'jig rten gye khams rin chen thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhes bya bar/de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten thams cad kyis mthong na dga' bar mngon par 'phags pa brtson pa chen po zhes bya ba de yin par mdo nas gsungs/ bdud lhas sbyin gyis chos ma yin pa sna tshogs bstan/ bdud kyi las mang po byas khyad par sangs rgyas 295

la sgogs rdo 'phangs mtshon char phab pa sogs mi mtshams pa'i las byas kyang mdo sde pad dkar las/ lhas sbyin ma 'ongs pa na 'jig rten gyi khams lha'i them skas su sangs rgyas lha'i rgyal po zhes bya bar lung bstan/ lhas sbyin byang chub sems dpa' chen pos sangs rgyas kyi che ba dbyung ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bya dka' ba spyod gsungs/ des na deng sang bla ma 'ga' zhig gis srog gcod sogs mi dge ba bcu byed pa'i gros dpon byed pa dang / sde rigs 'dzin pa sogs byed mi 'os pa byed na'ang mngon shes mi ldan par su yin ngo mi shes bzhin du bdud sprul khrims 'chal dam nyams bstan bshig bla btsongs rkang 'dren sogs ngan smras byed mi rung ste/sdud pa las/ sems can 'di dag khrims ldan 'di dag khrims 'chal zhes/ /sna tshogs 'du shes zhugs pa shin tu tshul khrims 'chal/ /zhes de lta bu'i 'du shes skyes na rang gi tshul khrims de bas kyang shin tu 'chal du bcug pa yin gsungs kyang deng sang rang sdom ldan du rloms pa rnams kyis kyang 'di la mi 'dzem pa mang po 'dug ste/ mngon shes yod nas smras pa yin na ma gtogs/ med bzhin smras pa yin na sus sdom pa shor cha bas cha mi shes pas blo gros can rang gi sdom pa la 296

gces spras su mdzad 'dod pa rnams kyis 'di la 'dzem pa gal che/ sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la 'das grong mi mnga' yang skye 'gro rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul phyir/ sku snyung sman pas kyang gso ma nus par gshegs pa'i tshul bstan/ slob dpon chen po klu sgrub kyis zung 'jug gi sku brnyes dgung lo drug brgya bzhugs kyang / phyis mi sdig can zhig gis dbu 'jag ma zhig gis bcad nas gshegs pa'i tshul bstan/ rje btsun mi la'i sku la 'byung gzhi'i gnod pas nam yang mi tshugs kyang / phyis dug zas zhig la khag bzhag nas gshegs/ 'brom ston pa spyan ras gzigs dngos yin kyang /ma dag pa'i snang ngor sku tshe'i mjug mdze bzhes phyag gi mkhrig mtshun chad nas gshegs pa'i tshul bstan/ rje rin po che 'jam dbyangs dngos yin kyang zhabs snyung nas gshegs pa'i tshul bstan/ lho brag mar pa'i sras dar ma mdo sde yang bskyed rim mngon du gyur 'pho ba grong 'jug nus pa yin kyang / sgu gzhon dus rtas 'phangs drud nas dbu tshal par song nas gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa de 'dra'i lo rgyus mang / des na deng sang bla ma 'ga' res sku la snyung gzhi mi 'os pa byung gshegs khar 'khrul snang byung ldab ldib mang po lab bzhin gshegs pa rnams 297

kyis kyang gzhan rnams la sdig pa byed pa phar zhog dkor mang po zos nas dkor sbyongs ma byas na 'chi kha dang bar do phyi ma rnams su 'di 'dra'i dka' las che ba byung ba yin zhes de 'dra'i tshul bstan pa tsam ma gtogs/ nges par de ltar byung ba yin snyam nas khas gtong mi rung / dad gus dag snang sbyong dgos/ sngon bla ma zhig gis nyin re bzhin srin 'bu mang po gcur nas me la btab nas rnam shes dag zhing du drangs pa yin kyang / nyin zhig khong la thugs bral zhig byung nas srin 'bu gcur ba'i dus las yol tshe/ nye gnas zhig yod pas de ring khong gi thugs brel gyi dbang gis gcur mi thub par 'dug snyam/ srin 'bu 'khyer 'ong nas khong gi lad mo byas gcur nas bzhag dus/ bla mas nye gnas bos nas 'bu rnams khyer shog gsungs pas/ kho bos gcur tshar yod smras pas/khong gis a tsa ma snying rje 'dir ro rnams khyer shog gsungs mdun du bzhag nas spyan btsums te ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs se gol zhig brdabs pas/ 'bu rnams kyi ro sngar ltar sos tsi di ri ri nam mkha' la 'phur rnam shes dag zhing du 'dren nus pa'i rtags bstan skad/ rgya gar gyi grub chen brgyad cu'i nang gi 'ga' res khyi 'khrid nas ri la song ri dwags che chung mang po 298

nyin re bzhin bsad pas/ phyis mi rnams kyis dad log byas dus/ ri dwags bsad pa rnams gsos nas sngar bzhin 'gro gi bcug pas kun dad par gyur/ 'brug pa kun legs kyis ri dwags gshor du 'gro ba sogs byas pas phal cher gyis smyon pa lta bur bltas/ kha gtong ba yin kyang nyin zhig khye dkar nag gnyis shor yong bas sked par gris brgyab nas gtub/ khye 'di gnyis kyi dkar bo dang nag po thag chod byas gang yang khra khra byas na yags zhes khyi nag po'i stod du dkar po'i smad sprad/dkar po'i stod du nag po'i smad sprad nas slar gsos khra khra byas btang bas kun ngo mtshar/ de lta bu'i gtam rgyud mang po yod/ des na deng sang yang chos pa phal cher gyes srog gcod sogs la mi 'dzem pa yang ci yin cha med pa'i khas mi gtong bar dag snang sbyong dgos/ rang gis de'i lad mo byed mi rung las rgyu 'bras rtsis dang bzang / yang sngon mi rgyud spel ba'i spre'u byang chub sems dpa' de tshangs spyod bsrung ba zhig yin kyang / brag srin mos nyin re bzhin 'ong du ma bcug khyod kyis mo la chags pa spyod dgos mi spyod na mo srin po dang 'grogs nas yul khams phung du 'jug pa yin smras pas/ byang chub sems dpa' de rdzu 'phrul gyis lho phyogs ri bo po ta la'i rtser 299

gshegs/ spyan ras gzigs la de e rung zhus pas/ 'phags pa'i zhal nas khyod brag srin mo dang khyim thabs ma byas na srin po dang lhan du bsdebs pas phrug gu mang du byung / skabs shig srin pos bod yul gang nas rgyal khams sems can kun la gnod 'tshe byas phung bar 'gyur/ de bas khyod srin mo dang lhan du bsdebs nas mi rgyud spel na dam pa'i chos kyang dar nas 'gro ba yongs la bde skyid 'byung bar 'dug pas/ khyod brag srin mo dang lhan du sdod ces gnang ba byin nas mi rgyud spel bas bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen byung / sngon bram ze'i khye'u skar mas tshe lo bzhi khri bzhi stong du tshangs par spyad nas bzhugs kyang / nyin zhig bu mo zhig chags pa'i dbang gis 'chi la thug pa zhig gzigs nas snying rje drag po skyes bud med de mi 'chi ba'i slad du chags pa spyad nas slar sngar bzhin tshul khrims bsrung bas bskal pa mang po'i tshogs rdzogs par gsungs/ yang sngon ded dpon snying rje can gyis rgya mtsho'i tshong pa mi lnga brgya phrag tsam zhig sdig can mdung thung can gyis gsod par shes nas/ tshong pa rnams kyi tshe thar zhing bsam ngan can gyi mi de sdig pa'i dbang gis dmyal bar song nas nam yang mi thar bar sdug bsngal myong dgos pa la snying rje drag 300

po skyes/ ngas 'di bsad pa'i rnam smin gyis bdag gcig pu dmyal bar song yang bzod snyam/ mi de la kho rang gi mdung bsnun nas bsad pas tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs par gsungs/yang rgyal po gser mdog can gyis dpya khral ma byin par blangs pa dang / drang srong me byin gyis gzhan don du rdzun chen po smras pa sogs byang sems mang pos gzhan don du lus ngag gi mi dge pa spyad kyang sdig par ma gyur ba'i tshogs rdzogs pa'i lo rgyus mang / gzhan yang sems can gsod pa 'tshol ba'i mis khyod kyis e mthong zhes dris pa la/ mthong yang ma mthong zer ba'am/ yang mthong yang rjes mi zin par 'dug zer ba'i phan pa'i rdzun dang / bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang dma' ba bstod phyir yon tan spu tsam mthong ba yang ri tsam du btang nas dad pa can gyi rna bar sgrog pa dang / 'khon 'gras can gyis phan tshun gang gi rnar snyan yid 'bab kyi gtam mi smra rung smra gi zhes bde legs kyi gtam snyan bsgrags nas slar mthun po byed pa lta bu'i rdzun dang / gsang sngags kyi lta spyod rnams gnod min la mi ston par gab pa'i phyir rdzun bshad pa sogs bstan 'gro la phan thogs pa'i dzun bshad kyang / nyes pa med par ma zad phan yon yod pa skyes bu dam pa du mas 301

gsungs kyang phyug po ser sna can yi dwags su skye ba'i rgyu sgrub pa rnams kyi longs spyod phal cher rdzun g.yo sgyu rku 'phrog slong gsum gang rung gi sgo nas blangs/ chos phyogs su btang nas rgyu bdag kho rang la phan pa'i smon lam 'debs pa dang / sde dgon dang mi re gnyis kyi rtsod gzhi'i zas nor rnams rku ba sogs thabs gang rung gi sgo nas blangs te rtsod pa rang zhi la btang / zas nor rnams chos phyogs su btang nas de rnams la phan phyir bsngo smon byed pa dang / dug dang mtshon gyes sems can gzhan gsod nges pa rnams kyi tshe thar phyir dug mtshon brkus nas bcag me la bsreg gam sa la sbed pa sogs gzhan la phan phyir ma byin pa blangs kyang nyes pa med par gsungs/ de bzhin du gzhan la phan pa'i dgos pa yod cing dgos pa yod pa'i nang nas che chung sogs shes nas/ lus ngag gi mi dge ba bdun sogs bya ba ma yin pa gang byas kyang chog ces mdo rgyud bstan bcos du ma nas gsungs/ des na deng sang bla ma rnams kyis bstan pa'i gzhi ma dgon pa btab nas ra lug g.yag gsum gsod pa/ sa rko rdo slog byas srin 'bu mang po 'chi ba/ dge 'dun spyi'i don du bsod snyoms byas dre'u rta mdzo g.yag mang po la sgal pa bton nas shi ba sogs 302

srog gcod byed pa dang / de bzhin ma byin par len pa dang /mi tshangs pa spyod pa sogs dzun smra ba sogs chos dang mi mthun pa'i mi dge'i sdig pa byed pa lta bu mang yang yar 'dren thub pa dang / bstan 'gro la phan pa'i dgos pa chen po yod na de ltar bsam bzhin mdzad pa'ang yod srid pas/ chos pa spyi la kha btang mi byed par mngon shes ma thob bar du dag snang sbyong dgos/ yang dper na mkhris nad can gyis dung dkar gangs la thag nye ring gang nas bltas kyang ser por mthong ba ma gtogs dkar po'i cha nam yang mi mthong ba ltar/ deng sang skyes bu dam pa mang po yod kyang gang zag las snang ma dag pa phal cher gyis thag nye ring gang nas bltas kyang / skyes bu dam pa ru mi mthong bar skye bo tha mal pa dang khyad med par mthong yong / sngon rje btsun nā ro bas te lo ba nya gson bsreg byed par mthong ba dang / 'phags pa thogs med kyis rje btsun byams pa khye mor mthong ba dang / dge bshes tshems bu pas rdo rje phag mo mdze mor mthong ba dang / yang 'ga' zhig gis slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen 'ban po chung ma can du mthong ba dang / slob dpon shā wa ris dbang phyug ri dwags gsod pa'i rngon par mthong ba sogs skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi 303

yon tan ma mthong bar tha mal du mthong ba'i gtam rgyud mang /de 'dra'i gang zag bzang po rnams kyis kyang skyes bu dam pa'i yon tan ma mthong bar mthong snang ngan pa de 'dra byung na/ 'o skol las dang nyon mongs pa'i gting du lhung ba rnams kyis skyes bu dam pa'i yon tan mi mthong bar tha mal du mthong yong ba smos ci dgos/ des na skyes bu dam pa med dam snyam par rang gi las nyon gyi sgrib pa'i dbang gis ma mthong ba yin snyam du/ bla ma rdo rje spun grogs yongs la tha mal du mi blta bar skyes bu dam pa'i 'du shes bzhag nas dad gus dag snang sbyangs/rang gi las nyon gyi sgrib pa sel ba'i slad du tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong gyis/ dper na mkhris nad med cing mig shes bzang po'i mis dung dkar po la thag nye ring gang nas bltas kyang dkar por mthong ba ma gtogs ser por mi mthong ba ltar/ gang zag las nyon gye sgrib pa dag cing gang la dad gus dag snang 'byongs pas gang la bltas kyang dag pa'i snang ba ma gtogs ma dag pa'i snang ba mi 'char/ skyes bu dam pa ngo mtshar can brgya mthong dgos na stong mthong ba'i tshod yin/ las nyon gyi sgrib pa'i srab mthug dag ma dag gi dbang gis tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas pa'i skyes bu dam pa la yang bltas na 304

mthong snang bzang ngan 'bring gsum sna tshogs 'byung ste ras pa bcu gnyis kyis mdzad pa'i rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar na/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ rnal 'byor lus kyi me tog 'di/ /'chi bdag rkyen gyi ba mo yis/ /bcom nas pha rol 'gro dus su/ /nga la mthong snang sna tshogs yong / /gsungs pas/ 'bri sgom gyis dag ma dag gis lags sam zhus pas/ khyod kyis go 'dug de ka rang yin gsungs/ de zhib tu phyed na tsug lags zhus pas/nga la slob ma bcu gnyis la yang snang ba bcu gnyis 'char te/dag pa drug dang ma dag pa drug go /nga la dag pa'i lus dang ma dag pa'i lus gnyis su yod pas/ dag pa'i lus mkha' spyod du ma mkha' 'gros seṅge dang rin chen khri la gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas spyan 'dren pas/dag pa'i lha dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro min pas mi mthong /slob ma yang grub pa thob pa re res mthong ba srid/ ma dag pa'i lus gcig lus na yang lung bstan yong bas de bzhin mdzod gsungs pa ltar/ phyis nas gshegs dus snang ba dag pa rnams la gdung bzhu rgyu ma rnyed gzims mal bug pa ha re 'dug pa mthong / ma dag pa rnams kyi snang ngor gdung bzhu rgyu zhig lus pa bzhu ba la/ ras pa tsho dang yon bdag tsho kha ma 'chams pas/305

bu chung lo brgyad pa ral pa kham si ge ba zhig bar snang nas gar byed bzhin byung / lung pa gnyis kyi bar sgang 'dir bzhus na phan yon che zhes lung bstan pa'i brag thog der bzhu dus kyang / gang zag re re la mthong snang mi 'dra ba sna tshogs byung gsungs/ des na las snang dag ma dag gi dbang gis yin gye/deng sang skyes bu dam pa med zer ga la rung / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas bzung sngon byon rgya bod kyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis dang po thugs bskyed/ bar du tshogs bsags/ mthar sangs rgyas nas gdul bya rtag 'dzin can chos la bskul phyir gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdus nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan dus/ gdul bya rnams la zhal chems su/ ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus su dge ba'i bshes gnyen/rgyal blon paṇa grub/ khyem pa pho mo/ glang chen stag dang / seṅge/gru dang / zam pa sogs bzang ngan sna tshogs par sprul nas/'gro ba'i don 'khor ba ma stongs bar du mdzad pa yin/ zhi bar skad cig tsam yang mi gnas zhes zhal bzhes gnang yod pa rnam thar dang / gsung 'bum na mtha' yas yod pa yang dzun yin zhes don gyis skur pa btab par 'gyur/ 'jig rten gtam dpe la yang / rnga ci byas brdung gi nga 'cham de ltar byed 306

zer ba ltar/ snyigs dus 'dir rgyal ba sras bcas kyis sems can rang rang gi spyod 'gros dang mthun pa'i mdzad pa bzang ngan sna tshogs bstan nas 'gro don mdzad pa yin/ skyes bu dam pa tha mal du brdzus nas 'gro don byed pa shin du mang ste/ phal po che las/ kye rigs kyi bu/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul ba ni tshad med de/ 'gro ba gang la gang gis 'dul ba de dang de'i gzugs dang 'khor dang ming gis de dang de'i don mdzad do gsungs/ rtsod lan nges don 'brug sgra las/ gzhan yang 'dus pa chen po'i mdor/ gang dag glang po ches 'dul ba/ /sems can de dag thams cad kyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa glang por mthong / /de bzhin stag dang seng ge dang / /gru dang zam pa la sogs pa/ /de dang de yis 'dul ba yi/ /gzugs su mthong zhes ma gsungs sam/ /rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las kyang /gang du'ang snang nas sems can don/ /mdzad cing chang 'tshong ma sogs su/ /snang nas 'gro don mdzad par gsungs/ /zhes bshad la/ des 'o skol rnams kyis ma shes pa ma gtogs skyes bu dam pa snyigs ma'i dus 'dir je mang du song med rung je nyung du song ga la yod/ snod bcud thams cad dag pa'i dkyil 'khor 'ba' zhig tu mos la tha mal du 'dzin pa'i snang zhen 307

sbyongs dang / skyes bu dam par mthong bar ma zad/ snod thams cad dag pa'i zhing dang gzhal yas khang / bcud kyi sems can thams cad lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin dag pa rab 'byams 'ba' zhig tu mthong yong / ngas kyang dag snang 'ba' zhig byas pa'i mthus bla ma skyes bu dam pa du mar dbang lung re zhu dus kyang bla ma de yi dam gyi lha ru khra lam me mthong dus 'ga' re byung / gzhan yang ngo mtshar ba'i skyes bu dam pa mang po dang ya mtshan pa'i ltad mo sna tshogs mthong / gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs sogs nang ting 'dzin du ma la mnga' brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs yod dus/ gang zag dad gus dag snang can gyis bltas na mthong snang sna tshogs 'byung ste/ sngon lho brag mar pa mi la ras chung sogs skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis nang ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mang po phyes nas mnyam par bzhag yod dus/ slob ma rnams kyis sku dgyes pa rdo rje/'khor lo bde mchog gsang ba 'dus pa sogs lha sku sna tshogs dang / rdo rje dril bu 'khor lo rin po che padma sogs phyag mtshan dang / oṃ āḥ tt+waṃ a li ka li la sogs yig 'bru/ sa chu me rlung ci yang mi snang ba sogs mthong snang sna tshogs pa byung bas/ de gang yin zhus tshe/ rnal 'byor pa rab kyis nang ting nge 'dzin 308

du ma la mnyam par bzhag yod dus dang / gang zag dad gus dag snang can gnyis 'dzom pa'i rten 'brel las mthong snang sna tshogs 'byung ba chos nyid yin gsungs/ dar ma mdo sde sku gshegs khar bskyed rim gsal btab dus/ der 'tshogs pa'i mis yi dam gyi lha'i rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du khra lam me mthong zhes mar pa'i rnam thar nas gsungs/ bdag gi skyabs mgon chos rgyal wang rin po ches/ dus rgyun du dbu gtsug tu bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i rnam par bsgoms pas/nyin zhig ston gral zhig tu byon pas chang gis bzi ba'i mi zhig gis dbu thog na 'od zer ser po zhig 'phro ba mthong nas phyag 'tshal ba byung zhes nyid kyi zhal nas gsungs/ des na skyes bu dam pa mthong bar 'dod na thabs gzhan med/ gdams pa gzhan med dad gus dag snang 'ba' zhig gyes dang mang po mthong yong / 'o na skyes bu dam pa ngo mtshar can yod na skal ldan nges shes bskyed pa dang / log smra tshar gcod pa dang mkhas pa mgu ba bskyed pa dang bstan pa'i che ba 'don pa'i phyir mngon shes rdzu 'phrul ston dgos gsang nas ci bya/ kho bo la yon tan de 'dra yod na kun la ston pa yin zer na/ skal ldan nges shes bskyed pa sogs dgos pa che dus ston dgos pa khyod 309

bden/ sngon yang bstan pa'i lo rgyus mang po snang / deng sang yang re gnyis bstan pa mthong thos yod/ dus rgyun du rul mas bu gsor gsor byas ston pa dgos pa med par ma zad/ de la brten nas las dang nyon mongs pa gsog par 'gyur bas/des na dus rgyun du mkhas grub rnams kyi yon tan sbas nas bsdad pa la dgos pa che ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni dper na sgyu ma mkhan gyis sgyu ma'i rtsed mo sna tshogs pa shes pa lan re tsam kha ltad mo la dga' ba rnams la bstan na mdzes pas blta mkhan mang / dus rgyun du lam gyi gzhi mdo tshong 'dus sogs nas bstan na/ blta mi nyung bar ma zad 'ga' res 'dis nged tsho'i mgo bskor nas nor rdzas 'phrog yong zer dogs zon byed cing / gzhan gyi nor rdzas stor na sgyu ma mkhan kho la yid mi ches rkus btsugs gyod sna kha mchu yang yong ba ltar/ mngon shes rdzu 'phrul la mnga' brnyes pa rnams kyis skal ldan dad gus can la nges shes/ log lta can la dad pa bstan pa'i che khyad 'don phyir re re tsam bstan na/ slob ma rnams sgrub la brtson 'grus/log lta can chos la mos gus/ bstan pa nyams pa slar dar ba sogs dgos pa chen po 'byung bas legs kyang / dus rgyun du byung rgyal du bstan na/ 'ga' res ang de 'dra rdzas sngags la 310

brten nas kyang 'byung bar bshad pas de la yid brtan med/grub rtags dngos yin min da dung blta rgyu yod kho bo yid mi ches zer/ kha cig gis de 'dra phyi rol pa dang bon po gzugs med kyi lha 'dre yan chad la yod de la ya mtshan rang che rgyu med yon tan sems la yod dgos zer/ 'ga' res de mthun mong gi dngos grub tsam red mchog gi dngos grub la reg pa med tsho zer/ ya mtshan par 'dzin pa dka' ste/ sngon ston pa dar lo la rje mi las grub rtags mang po bstan rung / dar los rje mi la 'byung po zhig gis bdag tu bzung ba tsam zhig las chos mthong spu tsam ma byung bar 'dug sngon nye gnas legs skar gyis ston pa sangs rgyas kyis ci mdzad zog byas pa 'ba' zhig tu mthong ba ma gtogs yon tan til 'bru tsam yang ma mthong /mi lo bcu gnyis bar du khyod g.yog byas/ yon tan til 'bru tsam yang ngas ma mthong / zhes smras pa ltar/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa che bas skyes bu dam pa'i yon tan bstan rung log par mthong ba yang mang / 'ga' res ji bzhin mthong yang de rgyu mtshan du byas gzhan gye chos pa sgom chen pa la yon tan ngo mtshar can 'di 'dra 'dug khyod kyis lo 'di tsam la bsgoms pa'i yon tan gang yod ston dgos zer nas rgyud zhi 311

ba dul ba'i chos pa bzang po yang sun 'byin/ ma bstan na khyod la ci byung chos pa bzang po ma red zer brnyas smod khyad gsod byed/ de la brten nas chos pa de yang rgyud 'khrugs/pha rol rdzu 'phrul ston mkhan la phrag dog gi dbang gis sgo skur 'debs/ dug mthu yang shoms/ 'ga' res chos pa bzang po grub thob de red zer/ thams cad der 'dus 'bul ba thams cad de la phul/ chos pa gzhan la mthong chung brnyas smod mang chos pa gzhan gyi yong sgo la gnod pa 'byung / yang grub rtags ston rgyu zhig gi dbang du song na mi gcig la bstan pas mi yong / gnyis byung nas kho la yang ston zer/ de la ma bstan na grub rtags yod pa rdzun red zer/ log lta 'am the tshom byed/bstan na je mang du song nas bzhi ston dgos/ bzhi bstan na brgyad yong / brgyad bstan na bcu drug nyi shu sum cu bzhi bcu byung nas skabs shig khye dang phag min tshad la ston dgos/ston gyes ga la lang / mang po bstan na nyams rtogs mthar ma phyin pa'i rnal 'byor yin na skabs shig slar 'grib yang srid/ ma 'grib kyang 'du long mang po bsgom gye bar chad du song bsgom gyi 'phro chad nas nyams rtogs gong nas gong du 'phel mi srid/ de rnams la dgongs nas lho brag mar pa lo 312

tsās rje btsun mi yul du 'byon khar sku lha sku yig 'bru phyag mtshan sogs sna tshogs par sprul te bstan nas/ bu 'di kun rdzu 'phrul lus kyi bkod pa bya ba yin/ dus rgyun du byung rgyal du bstan pa la dgos pa chung / da lan bu 'gro ba'i rdzongs su bstan pa yin gsungs/ rje mi las kyang bsgoms nas 'di 'dra byed dgos snyam pa byung gsungs/ des na skal ldan dad gus can re re la skabs re tsam ston pa ma gtogs/ dus rgyun du yon tan gang yod mi la mi ston par rin chen gter ltar sbas na/ gzhan gyi phrag dog sogs sngar bshad pa'i nyes skyon de rnams mi 'ong bar ma zad/ chos pa gzhan la yang 'di ltar yon tan yod kyang sbas nas yod rgyu red snyam/ chos pa yongs la skye bo pho mo kun gyis brnyas smod khyad gsod sogs mi byed par dad gus dag snang byas sngar bas mchod bstod bkur ba sogs bstan dang bstan 'dzin 'gro ba yongs la phan pa'i dgos pa du ma yod/ sgyu ma mkhan gyis sgyu ma'i bkod pa ltad mo 'dod pa la lan gcig gnyis las ma bstan kyang / sgyu ma'i bkod pa mthong mkhan des gcig gis gcig la bsgrags nas ma mthong bas kyang thos tshe ya mtshan pa'i gnas su 'dzin pa ltar/ mkhas grub rnams kyis mngon shes dzu 'phrul lan re 313

gnyis tsam skal ldan 'ga' re la bstan kyang / de gcig gis gcig la bsgrags na skad cha rlung las myur bas kun gyis go nas gzhan ma mjal ba'i dad can mang pos zhal mjal gsung thos na 'dod cing / ma 'ongs pa na khong lta bur skye ba'i sgon lam thob zer rjes su yi rang byas smon lam btab/ thams cad dad pa'i spu long g.yo zhing mthar thug byang chub 'thob pa'i rnam dkar gyi bag chags bzang po rgyud la 'jog pas grub rtags mang po ston mi dgos/ des na sngon byon da lta'i mkhas grub bzang bzang thams cad kyis lan re tsam ma gtogs dus rgyun du yon tan gang yod nang du sbas nas zur tsam yang ston mi srid/ gzhan chos grogs slob ma rnams la yang rang gi yon tan gang yod sbos/ gzhan gyi yon tan gang mthong sgrogs zhes gsungs te/ nor bu'i phreng ba las/ rang gi yon tan sba bya zhing / /gzhan gyi yon tan bsgrags par bya /gsungs/ de ltar byas na bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin 'gro ba yongs la dngos sam brgyud nas phan thogs mang po 'byung /deng sang mkhas grub rnams kyis yon tan sbas nas mkhyen pa dang rdzu 'phrul sogs gang yang mi mnga' ba'i tshul mdzad pa che 'dod grags 'dod sogs 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi dri ma 314

gtan nas zad pa'i rtags chos la mkhas pa'i khyad chos kyang yin/ gzhan yon tan sna re tsam yod pa phu mdo bar gsum thams cad kyi mi dang khye yan chad la ngoms pa 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi khol par gyur pa'i rtags blun bo'i rnam thar yin te sa skya'i legs bshad las/ blun po'i yon tan kha ru 'byin/ /mkhas pa'i yon tan khog tu sbed/ /sog ma chu yi steng na 'phyo/ /nor bu steng du bzhag kyang 'bying / /gsungs pa'i dpe don soms/ dper na jag rkun che dus phyug po'i rgyu noms sbas nas nye ba re gnyis re ma gtogs kun gyis mi mthong ba ltar/snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus 'dir mkhas grub rnams kyi yon tan gang yod sbas nas grwa slob re gnyis ma gtogs gzhan kun gyis mthong dka'/ des na snyigs ma'i dus 'dir skyes bu dam pa zad nas med snyam de skad gzhan la sgogs pa chos ma shes pa'i rang mtshang du go nas rang la mngon shes med pa'i dbang gis ma shes pa ma gtogs/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa mang po bzhugs par thag chod 'dug snyam du nges shes bskyed dgos/ dper na mig shes ngan pa'i mi'i mig ra zhig mig la bkab nas bltas na sa rdo ri brag rab rib tu mthong ba gzhir bzhag nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon shar ba la bltas kyang rab rib 315

zang zing du mthong ba ltar/ gang zag sgrib pa mthug pas log lta byas na skye bo tha mal pa tha mal du mthong ba phar zhog gzhan skyes bu dam pa rnams la bltas kyang tha mal pa dang khyad par med par mthong ba rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin pas log lta 'di skyon thams cad bskyed pa'i gzhi dang rten lta bur mthong nas nam skyes kyang dug ltar spong dgos/ dper na mig shes bzang po'i mis 'ja' shel mig la bkab nas bltas na/mkha' la shar ba'i 'ja' tshon legs pa gzhir bzhag gzhan sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal sogs kyang 'ja' 'od kyi rang bzhin du mthong ba ltar/ gang zag sgrib pa dag pas dag snang byas na skyes bu dam pa sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba gzhir bzhag gzhan phal pa rnams kyang skyes bu dam pa ru mthong ba rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin pas dag snang 'di yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ dpag bsam gyi shing / gter chen gyi bum bzang lta bur bltas nas/rang rgyud la ma skyes pa bskyed cing skyes pa gong 'phel du btang nas thugs dam gyi mthil du 'dzin dgos/ dper na sman pas sman bzang po byen kyang ma 'thung na dug ro rnying par sha gsar pa'i rkyen gyis bslangs nas na zug byung / zas bzang po la 316

yang za 'dod mi skye ba ltar/ mkhas grub gong ma rnams kyis legs bshad 'di lta bu bstan kyang / de la ma nyan na sngon las ngan pa bla ma grogs ngan pa'i rkyen gyes bslangs te log lta byung nas chos dang gang zag bzang po la yang dad gus dag snang mi skyes yang dper na 'jig rten gyi lha 'bab pa 'ga' res lha mchod pa yin zer/ ra lug gson por gshags pa'i khrag dang rang la mtshon gyes brgyab pa'i khrag lag pas mchod nas yar gyi phu'i lha'i dri thang snyan dar sogs khrag gis dmar por btang nas brdzod pa ltar/ khog tu chags sdang gi gdon chen po 'jigs su rung ba zhugs pa 'ga' res bstan pa'i la rgya brtsad pa yin zer grub mtha' gnyis re 'khrug rtsod byed du bcug btsan pos gnyom chung gi tshod byas lag nas dgon sde 'phrog gnyom chung gis dug dang mthu byas/ btsan po tshang gi bla rabs gdung rgyud gcod pa sogs rang gzhan kun tshe 'dir sdug la phyi mar dmyal ba mnar med du song nas sangs rgyas stong gis kyang skyob mi nus pa'i las ngan pa byas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nag 'byams su btang nas brdzod pa 'di bstan pa la phan 'dogs pa ru badzus nas pham glan pa'i bstan bshig cig byung ba yin te/ sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan 317

pa'i sbyin bdag rgyal po kṛ kṛ zhes bya ba'i rmi lam bco brgyad rmis pa'i nang nas skye bo'i tshogs 'dus nas 'thab rtsod byed pa rmis pa de/ ston pa shākya thub pa'i bstan pa rtsod pa'i chos kyis nub pa'i bltas yin zhes sangs rgyas 'od srung gi lung bstan gyi steng du babs pa yin la/ 'di lta bu'i sbyor ba rtsub po lag len du 'debs pa phar zhog bsam ngan de 'dra skad cig ma ci tsam skyes pa'i grangs bzhin bskal par dmyal bar gnas dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ gal te ngan sems bskyed par byed pa de/ /ngan sems bskyed pa'i grangs bzhin bskal par ni/ /dmyal bar gnas par 'gyur zhes thub pas gsungs/ /zhes gsungs/ 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ sde 'khrug chen po dang / btsun pa dmag byed pa'i sa phyogs mthong pa'i mi dmyal bar 'gro bar bshad/ bcom ldan 'das la bdud kyis sgogs dang mtshon char phab dus/ nyan thos rnams kyis ser dmag nam byas/ mo'u mgal gyi bu/ kun tu rgyu rnams kyis 'dam bu'i tshal bzhin bcom 'dug ste/ sus ser dmag byas/ ming bstan pa 'dzin par btags nas/don la bstan pa bshig par 'dug gsungs/ de thugs bden/mdo las/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum 318

tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /gsungs pa dang rgyab 'gal byas pa'i phyir ro/ /bstan pa 'dzin mkhan dka' thub can gyi ngur smig 'dzin pa'i dge slong yin te/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen sgron/ /'bar ba'i snod ni dka' thub can/ /ngur sprig 'dzin pa shākya'i sras/ /dge slong rnams ni yin phyir ro/ /gsungs/ bstan 'dzin ngur smrig 'chang ba rnams rnyed bkur 'dod pa ma yin khong khro gtan nas bral ba zhig dgos te/ sdud pa las/ gtsang byas gtsang ma'i gos 'chang gsum po dben cing dag /rnyed pa 'dod pa ma yin khros pas sems dkrugs med/ /gsungs/ gzhan la gnod pa ni sangs rgyas kyi rjes 'jug bstan 'dzin gyi dge slong ngam dge sbyong ma yin te/ bzod pa dka' thub bzod pa dam pa ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa mchog ces sangs rgyas gsungs/ /rab tu byung ba gzhan la gnod pa dang / /gzhan la 'tshe ba dge sbyong ma yin no/ /gsungs/ gzhan la sdang zhing bzod pa med pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang nam yang mi thob ste/thub pas/ sdang zhing bzod pa dang bral ba la byang chub ga la yod gsungs/ byang chub mi thob par ma zad zhe sdang gi dbang 319

gis dmyal bar skye ste/ rin chen phreng ba las/ zhe sdang gis ni dmyal bar 'phen/ /gsungs/ grub mtha'i phyogs ris kha 'dzin byas gzhan gyi chos la smod pas nam yang thar pa mi 'thob ste/ rje mi las/ grub mtha'i kha 'dzin chos la smod/ /thar pa'i 'ju thag chad pa yin/ /zhes dang / dpal gsang ba'i bdag pos/ grub mtha'i kha 'dzin che bas thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam dang bral/ gsungs/ deng sang po ti kha shas re sbyangs nas mkhas par rloms pa 'ga' res mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi gzhung re 'am/ rgya bod kyi mkhas grub dang rang gi bla ma'i gsung re tsam la nges pa ltar snang re rnyed tshe/ gzhan de dang mi mthun tshad thams cad chos min du bltas/ bzang ngan 'dor len byed pa 'di chos dang bla ma la brten nas rang dmyal ba mnar med du ltung zhing sangs rgyas bstan pa nyams pa'i rgyu chos spong gi las ngan pa yin zhes tshad ldan gyi mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad nas zhal mthun par gsungs te/rnam par 'thag pa thams cad bsdus pa'i mdo las/ 'jam dpal dam pa'i chos spangs pa'i las kyi sgrib pa ni 'di 'dra'o/ /'jam dpal gang la la de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos la la ni bzang bar 'du shes/ la la ni ngan par 'du shes pa ni/320

dam pa'i chos spangs pa'o/ /dam pa'i chos spangs pas ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa la skur pa 'debs pa yin no/ /dge 'dun la ngan du brjod pa yin no/ /'di ni rigs pa'o/ /'di ni mi rigs pa'o/ /zhes zer na dam pa'i chos spangs pa'o/ /zhes dang / chos ni chos ma yin par ston pa'o/ /zhes zer na yang chos spangs pa yin no/ /zhes dang / spobs pa go bar mi byed zer na yang chos spangs pa yin no/ /mdo sde dang mdo sder 'gal bar byas so/ /zhes zer na chos spangs pa yin no/ /zhes dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang tshigs su ma bcad pa 'gal bar byas so zhes zer na chos spangs pa yin no/ /don la la mos shing / la la ma mos so zhes zer na chos spangs pa yin no/ /zhes dang / dkrugs ma byed na chos spangs pa yin no/ /kun tu rtogs pa'i smras na chos spangs pa yin no/ /'di la dpyad 'di la mi dpyad zer na chos spangs pa yin no/ /'di ni legs par gsungs/ 'di ni legs par gsungs pa ma yin no zer na chos spangs pa yin no/ /chos spong gi nyes pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab/mtshams med lnga dang mi dge ba bcu las kyang che ste/ yum rgyas pa las/ mtshams med lnga ni chos spangs par 'gyur pa 'di'i gzugs brnyan tsam du yang mi spyod do gsungs/ 'brom 321

ston pa rin po ches/ chos la brten pa'i sdig pa'i gam na/ mi dge bcu sdig brud brud yin gsungs/ de'i dbang gis shi ma thag mnar med dmyal ba sogs ngan song gsum du lhung nas sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa myong dgos te/ rnam snang mngon byang gi rgyud phyi ma las bdag gi sems kyi gnas lugs gtan la ma phebs par 'khrul nas 'di skad du/ 'di ni sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa ma yin gyi/ 'di ni rang bzo can gyis byas pa yin no zhes zer ba dag 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gsang ba'i bdag po/ mi blun po de dag ni/ 'gro ba gnyis su 'gro bar rig par bya ste/ gnyis gang zhe na/ sems can dmyal ba dang dud 'gro'o/ /zhes dang / sdud pa las/ thos nas blo chung de yis 'di ni spong byed de/ /spangs nas skyabs med gyur pa de ni mnar med 'gro/ /gsungs/ mnar med du song na thar pa'i dus mi 'byung ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ gang zhig yang yang sdig grogs bsten pas sangs rgyas ngan sems ldan gyur dang / /gang zhig pha ma dgra bcom gsod dang mchod tshogs 'byed pa'i mi/ /de yang chos nyid nges par bsam na myur du thar 'gyur gyes/ /gang zhig chos la sdang ba de la thar pa ga la yod/ /gsungs/ gal te dmyal ba gcig nas thar kyang 322

'jig rten khams gzhan gye dmyal ba bsam gyis mi khyab par skye/ dmyal ba de dag las thar kyang byol song sogs su skyes nas nam yang bde ba zhig thob mi srid de/ yum rgyas par/shes rab 'chal par gyur pa'i las byas shing bsags pa dag gis/ sher phyin dang chos spangs par 'gyur te/ de dag gis chos spangs pas/ dus gsum gye sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid spangs par 'gyur te/ rnam mkhyen spangs pas chos brlag par 'gyur zhing / de'i las kyis lo bye ba khrag khrig mang por sems can dmyal bar bsreg par 'gyur ro/ /de sems can dmyal ba de las thar yang / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gye khams bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dmyal ba rnams su skye la/ dmyal ba de dag med kyang 'jig rten khams gzhan gye dmyal ba rnams su 'pho zhing bsreg go /de nas byol song gi gnas su skye zhing / de'i de dag gi las zad nas brgya la mir skyes kyang chos spong gi las byas pa dang bsags pa dang sgrub pa dang tshangs pa dang rdzogs pa'i rnam smin gyis/ mi'i skye ba gang du yang / dmus long dang /phyag bdar dang / gdol pa dang / sbyig ma mkhan gyi rigs dang / zhar ba dang / sna dang lce dang rkang lag med pa dang /323

mdze dang / sha khra can dang / sgur po dang / dkon mchog gsum gye sgra med par skye ba sogs mang po gsungs/ kun mkhyen klong chen pas/ chos spong gi las bsags pa'i nyes pa gong du smos pa rnams dang / khyad par tshe 'dir yang lha mi kun gyis spangs shing yid du mi 'ong ba dang / bsnyen sgrub bzlas pa sogs la 'bad kyang ngag gi nus pa mi 'ong ba dang / chos bdag mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyis kyang glo bur du srog 'phrog pa dang / mi 'dod pa sna tshogs steng du 'bab cing rtsa ltung gnyis pa dang drug pas kyang phog ste/ de'i rkyen gyis rdo rje dmyal bar song 'o brgyal bar 'gyur ro gsungs/ chos spong gi nyes pa bsags nas phyis bshags pa byas kyang / bzod pa thob pa la bsngal pa bcu dgos te/ rgyal ba gnyis pa rje tsong kha pas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i lam gyi rim pa las sdig grogs kyi dbang gis der bshad pas chos spong ba byung na/ lo bdun gye bar du zhag re la lan gsum gsum du bshags na sdig pa 'dag pa dang / 'on kyang myur na'ang bzod pa thob pa la bskal pa bcu dgos par gsungs pas/ go ba log pa des dus 'das na don ma yin pa chen po la sbyor zhing / ma nor ba'i go ba rnyed na/ rnyed pa tsam gyis nyes pa de dag mi 'byung ngo / /324

de'i phyir bden pa po'i le'u las/ rgya mtsho chen por sgo tha dad nas chu mang po 'bab pa bzhin du/ theg pa gsum gyi chos kyi chu thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgya mtsho chen por 'bab par gsungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas kyis chos gang gsungs thams cad thad ga'i gdul bya la ltos te/ sangs rgyas kyi sar 'khred pa'i thabs kho nar shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ des na lus dang srog gi phyir yang dam pa'i chos mi spong ste/ ljon shing gi mdo las/ pha dang ma yi don du sdig pa'i las mi bya/ /lus dang srog gi phyir yang dam pa'i chos mi spang / /gsungs/chos spong gi las gsog pa'i gang zag dang 'phrad na/ rang gzhan kun 'phung bar 'gyur bas 'grogs pa lta ci smos/dug ltar spong dgos te/ yum las/ shā ri'i bu/ chos spangs pa'i bsam pas/ 'di skad du/ 'di la khyed dang bdag cag gis bslab par mi bya ste/ 'di ni chos ma yin no/ /'dul ba ma yin no/ /'di ni ston pa'i bstan pa ma yin no/ /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsungs pa ma yin no/ /zhes zer zhing de nyid kyis kyang spangs la/ gzhan yang mos pa med par byed cing / bdag gzhan gyi bsam pa nyams par byed pa/ bdag gzhan gyi bsam pa gdug par byed pa/ bdag gzhan chud 325

gzan par dga' ba/ bdag nyid kyi phyir spang bar 'dod la/gzhan yang spang du 'jug pas chos 'jig pa'i las bsags pa de'i gzugs brnyan du 'gyur re skan/ shā ri'i bu/ ngas ni gang zag de lta bu thos par bya ba yang ma gnang na/ 'phrad pa dang 'grogs pa lta ci smos kyang ci dgos/ zhes dang / o rgyan chen pos/ dag snang chung la log lta che ba/ mkhyen pa chung zhing phyogs cha che ba'i bla ma de bsten na phung bar 'gyur bas spang bar bya'o/ /gsungs/ 'o na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gces spras su mdzad 'dod pa rnams kyis ji ltar mdzad dgos zer na/ glang ri thang pa'i zhal nas/ ngas chos ci tsam gyi chos zab mo zhig zhal phyes bltas kyang / skyon thams cad rang gi yin/yon tan thams cad jo bo sems can gyi yin par 'dugade'i gnad gas khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la byin/ gyong dang pham kha rang gis len pa 'di min pa go rgyu med gsungs pa ltar/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rtsa ba bsam pa bzang po byang chub kyi sems dang / phyag len bzang po khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la byin/gyong dang pham kha rang gis len pa la goms par mdzad na/sdig spong dge sgrub kyi bstan pa rin po che 'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring gnas par 'gyur bas kun gyis phyag len la 326

ci jebs gyis shig /smras pa/ legs rgyu dge tshogs bye bas bskrun pa'i sku/ /legs bshad 'gro ba'i rna bar sgrog pa'i gsung / /legs nyes chos kun sa ler mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /legs pa'i lam ston bla ma thams cad mchod/ /mi rgan glu dbyangs len pa mi 'os mod/ /'on kyang rang gi gshis lugs yin pas na/ /bar skabs 'dir yang snyan pa'i glu zhig len/ /dad gus dag snang can rnams dga' bas nyon/ /mthong thos bla ma rnams la dad gus che/ /chos mdzad mched grogs kun la brtse gdungs che//nyam thag sems can yongs la snying rje che/ /chos lugs gzhan la dag snang che na legs/ /khyad par bod du dar ba'i grub mtha' kun/ /nang pa sangs rgyas bstan pa kho na yin/ /grub mtha' gang la'ang sdang po mi byed par/ /dag snang byed bzhin byams po byas na legs/ /dmigs bsal can gye gnang bkag re gnyis tsam/ /ma gtogs mdo sngags gnyis kyang 'gal ba med/ /gnang bkag so mtshams shes nas nyams blangs na/ /gcig grogs gcig 'gyur shin tu ngo mtshar che/ /deng sang gsar rnying gang yang phyogs ris che/ /chos pa 'ga' res chags sdang chen po snang / /zhwa yang dmar ser gnyis la 327

grub mtha' 'dug /nga ni zhwa med rnal 'byor byed snying 'dod/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /phyogs med rgyal khams nges med ri khrod 'grims/ /chos dang gang zag phyogs dman bar gsum la/ /dag snang sbyong bzhin zhabs tog sgrub par smon/ /snyigs dus tshe thung nam 'chi nges pa med/ /de ring tsam yang mi 'chi'i gdeng med bzhin/ /grub mtha'i phyogs ris byas nas ci zhig bya/ /dben par gcig pur lha chos byed par rigs/ /chos kyi snying po dag snang 'di yin pas/ /snod rnams gzhal yas bcud rnams lha yi sku/ /dag pa rab 'byams 'ba' zhig yin snyam du/ /mos na nam zhig de ltar mthong bar 'gyur/ /sa gseb srin 'bu yan chad lhar gyur nas/ /dngos grub ster na gzhan rnams smos ci dgos/ /de phyir chags sdang log lta the tshom spongs/ /dad gus dag snang kho na da sbyongs shig /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//de yang mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i rje yang dgon pa'i ri chos yon tan kun 'byung las/ phyi snod kyi lo ka gzhal yas khang du mos pa byas/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad yi dam du bsgoms shing mos pa bya/ khyad par du srog chags pho mo 'dod pa bsten pa thams cad yi dam yab yum du bsgom zhing 328

chags sdang mig ser mi bya/ bar do'i mngal sgo dgag pa'i gnad kyang de yin no/ /sems can thams cad kyi skyon nas mi bsam zhing / yon tan du bltas la zhing khams sbyangs/ dag snang brtan par bya/ sems can thams cad lhan skyes yi dam gyi 'khor lo yin no/ /bla ma chos sku'i rang bzhin ye shes kyi gzugs brnyan snang ba yin pas rang rgyud pas snying rje yang bsgom du mi rung na/ sdang zhing smod pa lta ci smos/ ngag brlang po dang 'gom pa la sogs pa dud 'gro tshun chad la spangs/brnyas pa dang khyad gsod mi bya/ thams cad bde gshegs kyi snying po can yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar sems can thams cad bla ma yi dam chos skur shes pas/ thams cad kyi yon tan nas bsam zhing mos gus byas pas/ dus gsum gye sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan bum pa gang byor thob pa la tshegs med/snang ba rang sems yin pa/ rang la 'gro ba thams cad kyi yon tan du mthong zhing / dngos po'i rgyur ldang / su dang su la yang ma dad pa mi 'byung bar dad cing 'dun par 'gyur ro/ /bskyed rim brtan pa'i yan lag mos gus kyi mthar thugabyams snying rje'i mthar thug dag pa ye shes kyi snang ba chos skur 'char ba dag snang sbyangs pa yin pas/ 'di gnad du 329

gtong ba gal che'o/ /tshur la gnod pa bskyal ba thams cad sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs su shes par bya/ smod tshig skur ba gtong ba thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bka' bkyon yin pas sgrib pa 'dag sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa ji ltar 'dug dang / khro ba dang zhe sdang su yis phod/ phan 'dogs pa dang bsnyen bkur byed pa thams cad sangs rgyas kyi thugs rjes 'dzin pa yin pas kha lan dang rloms sems su skyes/ phar su la phan btags kyang sangs rgyas la zhabs tog byas par 'gro ste/ zhing la bzang ngan med khyi la zan chang zhig byin dang / byang chub gter gyes sbyin par 'gro/ de ltar shes tsa na/ phar su dang 'phrad kyang sangs rgyas dang mjal/ tshur su dang lab kyang sngags/ gang du phyin kyang bskor ba/ snyan par smras tshad bstod pa/ ci byas chos su 'gro bar 'dug ste/ blo sbyong ngo mtshar smad du byung ba skyes pa tsam gyis ngo bo nyid kyis dge zhing 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa ya mtshan can gyi lam 'khyer yin no/ /'di ma shes pas sgom chen pa gzhan khyad du gsod cing rang kha lang rgyun chad med par 'ong ba yin/ 'di shes na grogs mched chos la zhugs pa lta ci smos te/ 'jag mig gi srin 'bu yan chad la ngan par smras pa gcad pa med par 'gro 330

ba yin no/ /soms shig bu kun/ de ltar dus rnam pa thams cad du rang gzhan lha'i dkyil 'khor gyis tha mal gyi sgo gsum skad cig dang ma shor bar sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i dam tshig dang ma bral bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ legs bshad bstan pa'i snying po las/ phyi nang snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i dngos po rten dang brten par bcas pa'i lha'i ngo bor gdod nas lhan skyes su gnas gsungs/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las/mdor na phung bo lnga rnams ni/ /sangs rgyas lnga ni rab tu grags/ /rdo rje skye mched nyid dag dang / /byang chub sems pa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /sa ni spyan zhes bya ba yin/ /chu yi khams ni ma ma ki/ /dkar dang sgrol ma zhes bya ba/ /me dang rlung du rab tu grags/ /mkha' dbyings rdo rje'i dam tshig ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid yin/ /zhes dang / 'khor lo sdom pa nges par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma las/ gzugs ni rnam par snang mdzad yin/ /tshor ba rdo rje nyi ma yin/ /'du shes padma gar dbang yin/ /'du byed rdo rje rgyal po ste/ /rnam shes rdo rje sems dpa' yin/ /bde gshegs kun nyid he ru ka /mig ni gti mug rdo rje yin/ /rna ba zhe sdang rdo rje yin/ /sna ni ser sna rdo rje yin/ /lce ni 'dod chags rdo rje ste/ /lus ni phrag dog rdo rje yin/ /skye 331

mched dbang phyug rdo rje'o/ /zhes dang / sdom pa 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i lha rnams kyi/ /lus ni sdug cing 'dzin pa ste/ /lus ni dbang po'i rang bzhin can/ /'di de sangs rgyas kun dang mtshungs/ /zhes rtsa dang khams rnams dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma'i dkyil 'khor du gsungs/ gzhan yang phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad bsgom rung ma bsgom rung gdod ma nas sangs rgyas kyi ngo bor gnas pas na/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las/ rang gi lus la sangs rgyas bzhugs/ /lus 'di sangs rgyas rang bzhin sku/ /cha shas byang chub yan lag gnas/ /de yi ba spu dgra bcom pa/ /zhes dang / sambu ṭa'i rgyud las/ rang gi lus la sangs rgyas bzhugs/ /gzhan du gang du sangs rgyas med/ /lus las gzhan du sangs rgyas nyid/ /mi shes pa yi sgrib par 'dod/ /gsungs/ 'o na de ltar gdod nas lha yin na/ sems can thams cad 'bad med du grol bar 'gyur ro zhe na/ dper na thag pa la sbrul du 'khrul pa'am/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che 'dam rdzab kyi nang na gnas pa ltar/ lha la tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rtog pas bsgribs nas/ sems can thams cad 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin la/'dir snod bcud lha'i dkyil 'khor yin pa la yin par ngo 332

shes nas 'di bzhin du bsgom dgos te/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje'i gur las/ de lta bu'i lus glo bur gyi dri mas sbags pa dag par byed pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi sku'i rnam par bsgom par bgye/zhes gsungs pa ltar/ snod bcud lha'i rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du bsgom nus na/ nam zhig de ji ltar bsgom pa de ltar mngon du 'gyur te/ thams cad gsang ba dang lha mo bzhis zhus pa'i rgyud las/ phung po la sogs sangs rgyas lnga'i/ /rang bzhin mngon shes bshad pa yin/ /dngos de nges par bsgom pa yi/ /rang sems mthu yis sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /zhes dang /rdo rje gur las/ sangs rgyas nga rgyal rnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid yun ring mi 'gyur/ /ston pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /mnga' bdag dpe byad brgyad cur ldan/ /gsungs/de ltar 'grub pa ci'i phyir zhe na/ snang ba rang gi sems yin pa'i phyir gong du grub pa de'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur cing / de tsa na grub pa thob pa'am/ yi dam gyi lha gang yin pa zhal mthong ba yin te/ des 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad zil gyis gnon/ snod bcud thams cad rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du khra lam me mthong / phrin las bzhi la thogs pa med pa yin gsungs/ des na snod bcud tha mal 333

du mi lta bar/ phyi snod thams cad dag pa'i zhing dang lha'i gzhal yas khang / nang bcud sems can thams cad lha dang lha mo'i dkyil 'khor du bsgoms pas dag snang 'ba' zhig la goms par byas na/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa char bzhin du 'bab par 'gyur/ gsang sngags nye lam yang de 'dra la zer bas gzhan du ma sems/ yang sems can thams cad kyi phung khams skye mched thams cad kyang gdod nas lha ru gnas pas tha mal du mi lta bar lha ru lta dgos te/ klong gsal las/ lus kyis khyab tshad sems can la/ /phung po lnga ni rigs lnga dngos/ /khams lnga yum lnga nyid du gnas/ /zhes dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud las/ he ru ka ni phung po nyid/ /phung po yang ni ho ru ka /khams ni rdo rje sems bya ste/ /rdo rje dpal mo khams nyid do/ /skye mched yang na de bzhin te/ /lha yi ngo bor shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs/ tha mal du bltas nas smad na sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa yin na rtsa ltung ba rgyad pa 'phog ste/ phung po sangs rgyas lnga bdag nyid/ /de la smod pa brgyad pa yin/ /gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na sems can mchog dman bar pa thams cad lha ru bltas nas gus par bya'o/ /gas/nga 'dus las/ mdor na phung bo rgyal ba lnga/ /de bzhin gshegs 334

pa thams cad yin/ /zhes dang / slob dpon dril bu zhabs kyis/ 'gro lnga 'di dag rang bzhin gyis/ /grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis med pa'o/ /brtag gnyis las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /'on kyang glo bur dri mas sgrib/ /de nyid bsal na sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces dang / mdo las/ bde gshegs snying pos 'gro ba yongs la khyab/ /'gro ba 'di dag ma lus sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces dang / zab don chos kyi gter mdzod las/ snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang / /bcud kyi sems can yi dam lha/ /gleng brjod sgra skad sngags su bsgom/ /chags pa spyod pa mthong tshad la/ /yi dam yab yum yin par bsgom/ /mos gus drag po gnad du btang / /chags sems skye ru mi gzhug go /pha rol su dang su yis kyang / /bdag la dngos po gang byen yang / /yi dam lha yis gnang bar bsgom/ /rang gis phar la ci 'bul yang / /yi dam lha la phul bar bsgom/ /sa steng du ni mthong ba kun/ /thams cad he ru ka dpal gzugs/ /'gro ba drug po'i srid pa sbyangs/ /'bu sbrang sbur pa la sogs pa/ /brnyas dang khyad gsod mi bya ste/ /bde gshegs snying bos khyab pas na/ /yi dam lha yi rang bzhin yin/ /yi dam lha zhes bya ba zhig /log na yo re ba zhig med/ /335

rang gi snang ba dag pa na/ /thams cad lha yi ngo bor 'char /rang gi snang ba ma dag par/ /dus gsum bde gshegs kun byon yang / /bdag gis mthong bar mi nus te/ /dmus long ba la gser bstan bzhin/ /mos dang gus pa cher byas na/ /sdig sgrib dag ngang tshogs rdzogs pa'i/ /dngos grub sbur pa yis kyang ster/ /rang gi lhag bsam dge ba'i phyir/ /btang snyoms bzhag na yi dam gyis/ /dngos grub ster bar mi nus te/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen la/ /gsol ba ma thebs pa dang 'dra/ /zhe sdang mi dge'i sems skyes na/ /yi dam gyis kyang ngan song bskyur/ /sbur bas kyang ni bsgyur bar nus/ /de phyir thams cad yi dam yin/ /mdor na mngon shes ma thob bar/ /dam pa su yin mi shes pas/ /su la'ang brnyas pa mi bya zhing / /bzang por lta zhing dag snang sbyangs/ /gsungs/ bla ma zhang gi zhal nas/ rang gi snang ba ma dag na/ /spyan ras gzigs kyang khyi ror mthong / /rang gi snang ba dag gyur na/ /'jag mig srin bu chos skur mthong / /zhes pa la sogs rgya cher gsungs pas gang la'ang dag snang kho na bya ba gces so/ /skyes mchog 'bar ra ba'i ri chos las/ rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bar bya ba dang / gzhan su dang su yi skyon nas mi bsam pa dang / thams 336

cad la dag pa'i snang ba sbyangs pa'o/ /dang bo ni/ spyod lam gang dang gang byed kyang / lus yi dam gyi nga rgyal dang ma bral bar bya ste/ slob dpon byang chub bzang po'i rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid kyi bden pa las/ bdag ni 'gro'am nyal 'dug rung / /spyod lam ji ltar gnas 'dug rung / /yid ni lha yi nga rgyal dang / / skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral bar/ /rang nyid yin par rtag tu bsam/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sems can ni su dang su mthong yang / de dag gi skyon la mi bsam par bya ste/ de la don lngas rtogs par bya ste/ dang po ni/ mi kha dog ngan pa 'du shes blun po/ nor med pa dag la brnyas par mi bya ste/ mi de'i bsam pa bzang po byang chub kyi sems ji 'dra yod dang / nyams rtogs bzang po ji 'dra yod mi shes pas so rmi lam bstan pa'i mdo las/ mdog nag glen nam yang na gnyen med dam/ /snyoms shing brnyas par bya ba yin na yang / /mi yi khams dang shes pa brtags dka' bas/ /de la the tshom skyed cing skyon mi gdags/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa dus 'dir sdig pa rlabs po che byas su zin kyang / snga ma'i las 'phro dang /bsod nams kyi stobs chen po yod pa tshe 'di'i sdig pas log par 'khrid mi nus pas/ rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'phrad pa tsam gyis grol ba'i rigs yod pa ci 'dra yod pa yin 337

nam ma yin mi shes pas na brnyas pa dang smad du mi rung ste/mdo de nyid las/ ma skyes dgra yis pha ni bsad byas shing / /de bzhin gshegs pa bkrongs par sbyar byas kyang / /de sems gcig gis ngan 'gro rnam grol na/ /gang zag dag pa gang yin smos ci dgos/ /zhes pas/ sdig can la yang smad du mi rung na/sdig pa mi byed pa rnams la de bas kyang smad du mi rung ngo //gsum pa ni/ chos pa'i rigs dben pa mi bsten par 'du 'dzi 'ba' zhig byed pa mthong kyang / de la btsun pa dben pa la mi gnas par 'du 'dzi g.yengs pa 'di lta bu zhes smad du mi rung ste/ lus 'du 'dzi la gnas kyang sems ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa 'du 'dzis mi 'phrog par gnas pa yod srid pas/'du 'dzi bsten pa la smad du mi rung ste/ mdo de nyid las/sems kyis 'ching bar byed cing grol byed pas/ /lus sems 'di la nges pa ci yang med/ /lus kyi 'du 'dzi mthong nas gshe ma byed/ /pha rol rgol bar ma byed lus sbyongs shig /ces so/ /bzhi pa ni/ skyes bu dam pa gang zhig 'gro phan rlabs chen po byed pa mthong ba na/ 'jig rten pa dang mthun 'jug dang /mdun gros dang / mi chos byed pa dag yod pas/ de dag byed kyang de dag gi rkyen gyis ma yengs pa dag yod pas/ de la smad 338

par mi bya ste/ mdo de nyid las/ gser ni mi gtsang nang du bcug gyur kyang / /'bar ba'i rang bzhin nam yang mi 'bri ltar/ /nges par 'ba' zhig 'jig rten chos spyod kyang / /nam yang bsam pa'i rang bzhin de mi spong / /la la dug zos 'chi bar mi 'gyur la/ /me stag bzung pas tshig par mi 'gyur zhing / /gang dag ye shes spyod pa rlabs de dag /byis pa'i spyod pas mi 'phrog smos ci dgos/ /zhes dang / dpa' bar 'gro ba'i mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das dang slan chad sems can la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/sems can gang la byang chub yongs su smon pa'i dbang bo rnams mchis pa dang / gang la ma mchis pa de shes par 'gyur pa de bdag la ma mchis pa'i slad du ste/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag ni shes pa ma mchis pas/ sems can de lta bu dag la dman pa'i 'du shes skyed nas/ des bdag cag smad par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung legs so legs so tshig de legs par smras pa'o/ /ngas don gye dbang 'di legs par mthong nas/ dge slong dag nga 'am nga dang 'dra bas gang zag gi drod gzung gis/ gang zag gis gang zag gi drod mi bzung ngo / /gang zag gis gang zag la drod 339

bzung na nyams par 'gyur ba shes par gyis shig khyod la de lta bu'i chos bstan te/ 'od srung bstan pa des byang chub sems dpa' 'am/ nyan thos kyis 'di na/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa'i gang zag yod du 'ong zhing / sems can thams cad la ston pa'i 'du shes skyed par bya'o/ /zhes dang / chos thams cad 'byung ba med par bstan pa'i mdo las/ 'di snyam du sems can gyi spyod pa ni shes par dka' bas/ bdag gi pha rol po'i sems mi shes so snyam du sems bskyed par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu/ de bzhin gshegs pas don gye dbang 'di gzigs nas/ gang zag gis gang zag gi drod mi bzung gis/nga'am nga 'dra bas gang zag gi drod bzung ngo / /zhes chos ston to/ /rigs kyi bu gang dag bsrung bar 'dod pa de rnam par 'phya bar mi bya ste/ 'di ni 'di 'dra'o zhes gzhan la 'phya smod mi bya'o/ /zhes pas/ gzhan gyi sems shes pa'i mngon shes ma thob bar du su la yang brnyas par mi bya'o/ /lnga pa ni/rang tshul khrims dang ldan pa tsam gyis sems khengs nas/gzhan tshul khrims 'chal pa de la brnyas par mi bya ste/ tshul khrims 'chal ba de la sems rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i 'od gsal de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po yod pas/ de 340

sangs rgyas kyi rigs dang sa bon yin pas smad par mi bya zhing /spyod pa ngan pa ltar snang yang / zeg chen tshul khrims bsam pa rnam dag su la yod mi shes pas skad par mi bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi mdo las/ nga ni tshul khrims ldan zhes bdag ma snyems/ /'di ni tshul khrims ngan zhes gzhan ma brnyas/ /tshul khrims tsam gyis gzhan la gang brnyas pa/ /brnyas phyir de ni tshul khrims 'chal zhes bya/ /zhes gzhan skyon mi brtag gzhan la skyon 'tshol tsa na/ rang la skyon nges par yod pas te/ gzhan la skyon rtog pa'i dus na/ rang gi sems la gzhan de sdug na/ ngan na/ rnyed bkur ma byung na snyam pa'i zhe sdang ngam/ phrag dog yod pas skyon med kyang 'tshol/ 'dug pa la sgro btags nas 'phya bas te/ bsam pa ngan pas chos pa las skyon che ba med de/ gcig gis gcig la gnod sems yid la byed na tshul khrims dang thos pa dang / sbyin pa la sogs pa gang gis kyang mi skyob par ngan 'gror 'gro bar gsungs pas/gzhan la skyon 'tshol ba de rang gi skyon du shes pas spang bar bya ste/ jo bos tshul khrims kyi spyod pa glur blangs pa las/gzhan skyon mi brtag rang skyon brtag /gzhan gyi snying la mi 'bab pa'i/ /tshig kyang mkhas pas ring du spangs/ /zhes dang /341

sdom pa gsum bstan pa'i mdo las/ nga ni dkar —gyis khyod nag ces/ /de ni gzhan la brnyas byas na/ /nag por 'gyur te mun pa bzhin/ /ngag ni shin tu bsdams par gyes/ /zhes dang /myang 'das las/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sems can gye skyon mthong yang mi brjod do/ /rang la nyon mongs pa skye bar dogs pa'i phyir/ gal te nyon mongs pa skyes na ngan song du skye ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa dag pa'i snang ba spyod pa la gnyis las/ dang po sems can thams cad la bde gshegs snying po yod pas/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin yin pas mos gus bya ste/ sems can gang mthong yang sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin chos kyi sku yin la/ chos sku sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin yin pas de la bsam nas mos gus bya ste/myang 'das las/ byang chub sems dpa' gal te legs pa cung zad mthong kyang bsngags shing bstod do/ /legs pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin no zhes pas/sems can la sbyin pa la sogs pa sbyin pa dang / gus pas snyan par smra ba dang / bkur sti byas na sdig pa 'dag bsod nams thob la brnyas pa dang brdeg 'tshog byas na sdig pa 'byung bas/mchod pa'i yul dam pa sems can yin te/ chos yang dag 342

par sdud pa'i mdo las/ sems can gyi zhing ni byang chub sems dpa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de las sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad thob par 'gyur bas/ de la log par sgrub pa mi rigs so snyam na/ de yang 'di snyam du legs par spyod pa dang / nyes par spyod pa thams cad ni/sems can la brten nas 'byung ste/ nyes par spyad pa la brten nas ngan song rnams 'byung ngo / /legs par sbyad pa la brten nas lha dang mir 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / dge slong gi bya ba rgyas pa'i mdo las kyang gsungs te/ gong du bshad do/ /sems can mgu bar byas pas sangs rgyas thob pa lta zhog tshe 'di rang la yang / longs spyod 'phel bas dpal che ba dang /thams cad kyis bzang por lta bas/ dam par grags pa che ba dang / thams cad dang mthun pas gnod 'tshe dang bral bas bde bar 'gyur te/ dge slong gi bya ba rgyas pa'i mdo las/sems can mgu byas las byung ba'i/ /sangs rgyas nyid 'gyur de lta zhog /tshe 'dir dpa' che grags pa dang / /bde bar gnas pa ma mthong ngam/ /zhes so/ /sems can la bkur sti byas pas/tshe phyi ma phan chad sangs rgyas ma thob bar du lus mdzes pa dang / nad med pa dang / mchog tu bde ba dang / tshe ring du 343

'tsho ba dang / 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po thob/ duḥ kha zhi ba'ang 'khor bar gnas pa na 'byung ste/ mdo de nyid las/mdzes pa nyid dang nad med dang / /mchog tu dga' dang ring du 'tsho/ /'khor los bsgyur ba'i bde rgyas dang / /zhi ba'ang 'khor bar 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa sems can gang mthong yang sangs rgyas su bsgoms la dag snang sbyangs te tshogs bsags pa ni/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin yin pas kyang sangs rgyas yin la/ phung po khams dang skye mched kyi rang bzhin chos nyid yin pas kyang sangs rgyas yin la/ sangs rgyas kyi che ba'i yon tan yang /lam goms pa'i rkyen gyis mngon du byar yong bas sangs rgyas yin te/ rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid kyi bden pa las/ gzugs su snang rnams sku nyid yin/ /sgra rnams gsung du bdag nyid brtag /sems can khams rnams ji snyed pa/ /thams cad byang chub rgyu yin phyir/ /de yi shes pa ye shes yin/ /zhes dang /bla ma'i yon tan yongs su bzung ba'i rgyud las/ sems ni sangs rgyas nyid yin te/ /gzhan du chen po'i sangs rgyas ni/ /'jig rten khams ni yod ma yin/ /de la rnyed bkur byas pa dang / /mi rtog pas ni srid pa gcod/ /mkhu bar byed na rnal 344

'byor pa/ /ngu 'bod la sogs dmyal chen 'gro/ /zhes pas/sems can mthong tshad yi dam gyi lhar bsgoms la/ sems can su la yang 'gom pa dang brnyas pa mi bya bar gus pa dang snyan par smra bar bya/ sems can gyi ngag nas smras pa thams cad sngags kyi sgrar bsgoms/ su la ster kyang sangs rgyas la 'bul bar bsgom/ sus rang la ster kyang yi dam lhas rang la gnang bar bsgom/ gang du 'gro yang bskor ba byed par bsgom ste/ bon bskor du 'gro dgos pa 'di la shes rab stong pa nyid kyis mtshon pa'i g.yon bskor bde mchog gi bskor ba dang /chos bskor du 'gro ba thams cad byams snying rjes mtshon pa'i g.yas bskor chos spyi'i bskor bar mos par bya'o/ /sa sangs rgyas spyan/ chu ma mā ki me gos dkar mo/ rlung sgol ma/ nam mkha' rdo rje dbyengs phyug ma/ sems can la sangs rgyas sam/bla mar bsgom la gar 'gro yang bskor bar shes par bya'o/ /zhes dang / slob dpon zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/ rgyal ba rnams dang sems can la/ /sangs rgyas chos 'grub 'dra ba la/ /rgyal la gus byed de bzhin du/ /sems can la min ci yi tshul/ /gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal la bsten nas gnas skabs su bde zhing mthar sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa ltar/ sems can la 345

brten nas kyang gnas skabs bde zhing mthar sangs rgyas 'thob pas na/ rgyal ba la dad gus bzhin sems can la dad cing gus par bya/ tha na mig gi lta tshul yang / ji skad du/mig gis sems can blta na yang / /'di dag nyid la brten nas bdag /sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ro zhes/ /drang zhing byams pa'i tshul gyes blta/ /gsungs/ gang gi skyon mthong yang mi bsgrags te/ zla ba sgon me'i mdo las/ gang gi 'khrul pa ci mthong yang / /de dag nyes par ma bsgrags te/ /ci 'dra ba yi las byas pa/ /'bras bu de 'dra thob par 'gyur/ /gsungs ji ltar smras na/ smras na yid phebs 'brel ba dang / /don gsal yid du 'ong ba dang / /chags dang zhe sdang spangs pa dang / /'jam zhing ran par smra bar bya/ /zhes gang gsungs pa ltar bya'o/ /paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyi zhal nas/ dbus gtsang mnga' ris bar gyi grub pa'i mtha'/ /thams cad rgyal bstan kho na yin pas na/ /phyogs lhung gdon gyes sdang shugs mi mdzad par/ /dag snang nor bu'i 'od kyis khyab na legs/ /zhes dang /rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan gyes/ rang re rnams spyir lus can kun dang / sgos chos byed yongs la dag snang sbyong ba zhig gtso bor bya dgos/ mi 'ga' zhig rang gi nyams len gye thad 346

nas/ slong mo ba'i phye ltar gang la mdzub mo 'dzug rgyu med pa'i dkar dmar khra gsum 'dzom pa zhig byas/ dag snang gi thad nas rang gi nyams su blang bya la'ang yid mi ches pa lta bu 'di 'dra byed mi nyan/ nyams len gyi don rdo ma 'phyugs pa zhig dang / dag snang gi phyogs ris su ma chad pa zhig bya dgos/ de yang mgon po byams pas/ gang dang gang la gang dang ni/ /gang tshe bya ba phan gyur pa/ /de dang de la der snang ngo / /zhes rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis gdul bya'i don du lha dang klu dang / dge sbyong dang / de la phan par 'gyur na/ sha za mi sdug pa lta bur yang sprul nas sems can gyi don mdzad par gsungs pa rnams la nges shes drangs te/ chos mdzad skye bo yin phyin chad cha lugs ci 'drar snang yang / 'di ni bdag nyid 'khor ba dang ngan song las 'don pa'i grogs kyi mchog dge 'dun dkon mchog go snyam du bsam dgos/ der ma zad rang tshul ma yin pa'i bya ba zhig la zhugs pa na/ khyim pa rgan 'khogs zhig gis/ khyed kyi dbu la sangs rgyas kyis skra gri bzhag pas de ltar mdzad par rigs sam zer na/ rgan po de yang sangs rgyas kyi sprul par blta dgos pa yin/ bka' gdams gong ma'i dus su btsun gzugs zhig gis lham dang shokka li 347

mnyam du khyer ba na/ rgan mo zhig gis dge slong lags sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang lham mnyam du 'khyer rung ngam byas pas/sangs rgyas a bo la ma grub ces zer nas/ se gol zhig byas tog ste phyin pa red/ de 'dra byas te rang nyid ngan 'gror mngon sum du mchongs rgyu yin na ci shes/ de min dbus gtsang mnga' ris sogs kyi grub pa'i mtha' phal cher sems can rnams ngan 'gro las rim gyis drangs te/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god pa'i thabs sha stag yin/ des na rang lugs 'di bden gyis/ chos lugs gzhan gyi grub mtha' ni ma rungs pa'o/ /de 'dzin pa'i skyes bu ni gti mug pa'o/ /zhes smod pa ni mdo las gsungs pa'i chos spong gi las 'bras bu sdug bsngal mi zad pa 'byin pa'i rgyu grung po yin pas srog gi phyir yang / de lta bu'i las la 'jug mi nyan zhes/ gzhan la dag snang sbyong ba'i skor 'di dpe dang gtan tshigs du ma'i sgo nas gal po cher gsungs so/ /rwa sgreng khri chen rdo rje 'chang gi zhal nas/ gang shar ngos 'dzin lta ba'i gnad/ 'di 'dra ba la ni rang cag ri bo dge lugs pa dang / rnying ma pa rgad po rnams dang / sa skya pa sogs mtha' dag dgongs pa mthun pa yin zhes/ thams cad kyi lta ba'i dgongs pa mthun tshul rgyas 348

par gsungs pa'i mjug tu/ rje bla ma tsong kha pa'i man ngag la brten nas/ 'di 'dra ba'i bshad pa gu yangs po brgyab chog ces gsungs pa ltar thams cad la dad gus dag snang skye ba'i bshad pa gu yangs po rgyag pa la kun gyis brtson par bya'o/ /da bshad pa kun mdor bsdu na/ 'o skol las dang po pa rnams kyis kun mkhyen go 'phang ma thob bar du/ rang gi bla ma chos grogs rnams kyis thog drangs/ phyogs bcu'i gang zag mchog dman bar ma thams cad la ston pa dang / chos thams cad la ston pa'i gsung gi 'du shes bzhag nas dad gus dag snang sbyong bzhin rang nyid gang mos chos de nyams su len dgos te/ byang chub sems dpa' nor bu'i phreng ba las/las dang po pa yi sems can la/ /ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya/ /zhes dang / spyan snga bas/ sems can kun la'ang ston pa'i 'du shes kyi/ /dag snang dgos pa mdo rgyud kun nas gsungs/ /zhes dang jo bo rjes/ rang dge ma bsam gzhan dge soms la kun la bran bzhin gus par mdzod/ /ces dang /rje rin po ches/ chos mdzad 'dug tshad rnams la mos gus gyis/ /zhes dang / paṇa chen rin po ches/ 'phags pa'i skye bo rnams kyi mdzad pa rnam thar so so skye bo rnams kyi yul las 349

'das shing / chos dang skyes bu dam pa la brten pa'i sdig pa ni shin tu mi zad pas/ phyogs 'dzin sdang shugs dor nas dag snang nor bu'i 'od kyis khyab par mdzad du gsol zhes chos kyi rgyal mtshan gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes dang / o rgyan rin po ches/ bshes gnyen rnams ji ltar byas nas 'dug kyang / de rang snang ma dag pa yin pas/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab la mi dag pa ga la srid/ rang gi byad kyi grib ma me long du mthong ba dang 'dra/ bdag rang snang ma dag pa las/ 'di rnams ni sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs sangs rgyas dngos yin skyabs su mchi'o snyam pa'i mos pa dang dag snang zhe thag pa nas gyes shig ces dang / rje btsun mi las/ chos thams cad la dag snang sbyongs la/ sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs/ gsungs pa ltar bya'o/ /bdag ni blo gros dman zhing tshe 'dir sbyangs pa chung ba dang / rgyal ba'i gsung rab rgya che gting dpag dka' bas 'di ltar bshad pa la 'gal 'khrul nongs pa mchis srid/ 'on kyang deng sang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir sngon byon dam pa gong ma rnams ltar bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam du 'khyer shes pa med pas/ slog hrul khyis thed pa ltar phyogs re ba bzung nas/gzhan gang la dad gus dag snang mi byed par ma zad/ nga'i 350

chos lugs dang gang zag bzang / khyod kyi chos dang gang zag ngan zhes/ chos dang gang zag la bzang ngan dang blang dor byas/chos spong gi las dang / 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la skur ba 'debs pa sogs las ngan pa bsags nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pha rin po che nyams pa mthong ba'i rgyu dang / slob bu rnams kyis 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes yang yang bskul ba'i rkyen byas/ bdag gis de dag rnams la phan thogs re byung na ci ma rung snyam pa'i lhag bsam dag pas/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang / bla ma dam pa'i gsung rgyun la brten nas bshad pa yin pas/ 'di la tshig gi ngos nas 'gal dang / ma 'brel ba 'dra yod srid kyang / mkhas pa rnams kyis gzigs na thugs mi khrel bar/ don gyi dgongs pa chos dang gang zag yongs la dad gus dag snang skye thabs su dmigs nas bshad pa yin par go nas/ khyed mchog dman bar ba skye bo pho mo su yin kyang mthun 'gyur mdzod la/ phyogs bcu'i chos dang gang zag yongs la dad gus dag snang sbyongs bzhin rang nyid gang mos chos de la thos bsam sgom gsum gyis dang / phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad bum pa gang byos tshul du thob nas 'bad rtsol cher mi dgos par rgyud la nyams 351

rtogs yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas shing / sa skya dge ldan rnying ma phyag chen zhi byed gcod yul sogs rgyal ba'i bstan pa bstan 'dzin rgyud pa dang bcas pa/ 'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring gnas nas sems can thams cad la bde skyid nyi ma bzhin du 'char bar gdon mi za'o/ /'di ltar rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo rgyud dang / rgya bod kyi mkhas grub tshad ldan rnams kyi gsung dpang por bzhag nas legs par bshad pa 'di la yid ches dgos tshul ni/ bsngags bstod las/ bcom ldan dus kun rtogs pa'i chos/ /rnam kun 'byung gnas thams cad ni/ /lag mthil skyu ru ra lta bur/ /khyod kyi thugs kyi spyod yul 'gyur/ /chos rnams g.yo dang mi g.yo bcas/ /gcig dang sna tshogs so so la/ /mkha' la rlung dag rgyu ba bzhin/ /khyod kyi thugs dag thogs mi mnga'/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs la dus gsum dang 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sa ler mkhyen pas na/ dus nam yang rdzun gsung don med de/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ zla ba skar mar bcas pa gnas ltung zhing / /ri dang grong du bcas pa'i sa zhig la/ /nam mkha'i khams ni rnam pa gzhan gyur kyang / /khyod ni mi bden pa yi tshig mi gsungs/ /zhes dang / mdo gzhan las kyang /352
