mtha' thams cad la hwa shang zhes sgro skur btab nas chos spong gi las ngan pa bsags na/ mtshams med lnga'i las byas pa las kyang sdig pa che ste/ stong phrag brgya ba las/ mtshams med pa lngas ni chos spangs par 'gyur ba 'di yi gzugs brnyan tsam yang mi spyod do/ /shā ri'i bu/ chos spong ba'i bsam pa 'di skad du 'di la khyod dang bdag cag gis bslab par mi bya ste/ 'di ni chos ma yin no/ /'dul ba ma yin no/ /'di ni ston pa'i bstan pa ma yin no/ /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa ma yin no zhes zer zhing / de bdag nyid kyang spangs la/gzhan dag la yang mos pa med par byed cing / bdag gzhan gyi bsam pa nyams par byed pa/ bdag gzhan gyi bsam pa gdug par byed pa/ bdag gzhan chud gsan par dga' ba/bdag nyid kyang phyir spangs par 'dod la/ gzhan yang spangs su 'jug pa/ chos 'jig pa'i las bsags pa de'i gzugs brnyan du 'gyur re skan/ shā ri'i bu/ ngas ni gang zag de lta bu thos par yang bya ba ma gnang na/ phrad pa dang 'grogs pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ zhes dang / chos spangs pa de yis dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid spangs par 'gyur zhing / rnam pa thams cad 562

mkhyen pa nyid spangs pas chos brlag par 'gyur zhing / de'i las kyis lo bye ba khrag khrig mang bor sems can dmyal bar bsreg par 'gyur ro/ /de sems can dmyal ba de las thar yang / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan gyi dmyal ba dag tu skye la/ dmyal ba de dag zhig kyang 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan gyi dmyal bar 'pho zhing bsreg go /de nas kyang byol song gi gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten dag tu skye'o/ /de dag gi las zad nas brgya la mir skyes na yang chos spong gi las byas pa dang / bsags pa dang / bsgrub pa dang / tshang ba dang /rdzogs pa'i rnam smin gyis/ mi'i skye ba gang du yang / dmus long dang / phyag dar ba dang / gdol ba dang / spyig ma mkhan gye rigs dang / zhar ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / rkang lag med pa dang / mdze dang / sha bkra can dang / sgur bo dang /dkon mchog gsum gyi sgra med par skye zhes dang / rgyud bla ma las/ gang zhig yang yang sdig grogs bsten pas sangs rgyas ngan sems ldan gyur dang / /gang zhig pha ma dgra bcom gsod dang chod tshogs byed pa'i mi de yang / /chos nyid nges par bsam na myur du de las thar 'gyur gyi/ /gang zhig yid ni chos la sdang ba de la thar ba ga la yod/ /ces dang / rnam snang 563

mngon byang las/ sems kyi gnas lugs gtan la ma phebs pa rnams/ rnam par 'khrul nas 'di skad du/ 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi gsung ma yin gyi/ 'di dag ni rang bzo can gyis/ rang bzo byas pa yin no/ /zhes zer ba dag 'byung ba ra 'gyur ro/ /gsang ba'i bdag po mi blun po de dag gi 'gro ba ni gnyis su rigs par bya ste/ sems can dmyal ba dang dud 'gro'o/ /gsang ba'i bdag po de dag la dge ba'i rtsa ba rgyu cung zad kyang yod par nga mi smra'o/ /zhes dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/gang zhig chos mchog gtso bo 'di/ /rgyal ba'i mchod pa'i chos kyi mdzod/ /sa steng mis ni spangs byed pa/ /de ni mnar med dmyal bar 'gro/ /zhes dang / phyag na rdo rjes dbang bskur ba'i rgyud las/ 'jam dpal ma 'ongs pa'i dus na sems can sdig pa can gang dag tshul 'di la yid mi ches pa dag yod do/ /zhes pa nas 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi gsung ma yin no/ /zhes zer te/ de dag ni bdagakyang phung la gzhan dag kyang phung bar byed do/ /de ltar byed pa'i sems can de dag la ni sngags kyi dngos grub med do/ /zhes kho bos smra'o zhes pa la sogs rgya cher gsungs so/ /des na deng sang kha cig gis/ sa paṇa dang rje yab sras kyang chos sgong gi las ngan pa gsog pa'i gral 'go ru 564

spyan 'dren mkhan yang 'dug pas/de 'dra'i kha la nyan nas don med kyi sdig pa gsog mi rung ste/ rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtshos/dam pa'i chos la mi zab gang yang med/ /don med kha sdig ma gsog ri khrod pa/ /zhes dang / rig 'dzin gang shar rang grol gyis/ deng sang chos lugs grub mtha' mang thams cad sangs rgyas lam du gcig /don med kha sdig ma gsog par/ /kun la dag snang mdzod cig ang / /gsungs pa ltar don med kyi kha sdig mi gsog par kun la dag snang sbyangs par bya'o/ /de ltar dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa'i gang zag rnams la sangs rgyas dngos dang / des bstan pa'i chos thams cad sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi 'du shes bzhag nas/ dus rgyun du dad gus dag snang sbyangs mchod bstod bkur na skabs shig las sgrib dag nas/ma sgrub pa'i lha zhal mjal ba dang / nam mkha' sogs nas da'i/ pa'i chos kyi sgra thos par 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ de ltar dad pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi snod du rig nas/ de'i drung du gshegs nas byang chub kyi lam yang dag par ston to/ /zhes dang / chos yang dag par sdud pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' dad 565

pa phun sum tshogs pa la ni sangs rgyas mi bzhugs na yang /nam mkha'i dkyil dang / rtsig pa dang / shing rnams las chos 'byung ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa rnam par dag pa la ni/ rang gi yid kyi spyod pa nyid las/ gdams ngag rjes su bstan pa thams cad 'byung ngo / /zhes dang / bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo las/ chos 'dod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan na 'dug kyang sangs rgyas rnams kyi zhal ston cing chos kyang thos par mdzad do/ /chos 'dod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis gter ri dang / ri sul dang / shing dag gi nang du bcug pa dag yod de/ gzungs dang chos kyi sgo mtha' yas pa glegs bam du byas pa dag kyang lag tu 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / bslab btus su sred med kyi bus zhus pa'i mdo'i lung drangs par yang de dang mthun par gsungs shing /de bzhin du yong ba'i smon lam yang 'debs dgos te/ spyod 'jug smon lam las/ lus can kun gyi bya dang ni/ /shing dang 'od zer thams cad dang / /nam mkha' las kyang chos kyi sgra/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa thos par shog /gsungs/ des na sgye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang dam 566

pa'i chos dang mjal bar 'dod pa'i gang zag rnams kyis/spyir bla ma rnams la mos gus/ mched grogs rnams la brtse dung / sems can la snying rje/ dam pa'i chos rnams la dad gus dag snang sbyangs shing / khyad par bod du dar ba'i grub mtha' ji snyed cig mchis pa 'di thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa kho na las mched pa yin pas na/ 'di rnams kyi chos gang gsung mkhan gye bla ma rnams la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes dang chos gang gsung thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi 'du shes bzhag nas/ gang la yang log lta spu tsam yang mi byed par dad gus dag snang sbyong ba la brtson par bya'o/ /de ltar byas na grub mtha' ris med kyi lha mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyang dgyes nas srung skyob mdzad cing / zhi rgyas dbang drag grub pa chen po brgyad la sogs pa'i mchog thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /da sngar bshad pa thams cad mdor bsdu na thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab zab la rgya che ba dang / rgya gar gyi paṇa grub rnams kyis brtsams pa'i rgya gzhung mang bo dang / bod kyi mkhas grub gong ma rnams kyis gsungs pa'i bstan bcos rgya chen po rnams kyi dgongs pa 567

rnams byis pa so so skye bo nged rnams kyis lon dka' ba'i phyir na/ da nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar du skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du rgya bod gang du dar ba'i nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs gang la yang log lta spu tsam yang mi byed par dad gus dag snang sbyong ba gnad che ste/ garma ba kun mkhyen chos kyi grags pa'i zhal nas/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa gang bos zhus pa'i mdor/ bde gshegs me ro ghanti'i bstan pa'i mthar/ /dge slong rnyarma shrī dang dran pa thob/ /ya sha rab tu 'dren pa zhes bya bzhi/ /skye ba rim par brgyud pa yin mod kyi/ /snga phyi'i chos kyi bstan tshul mi 'dra bas/ /de yi lugs zhes snga ma snga ma dag /phyi mas bkag kyang bstan pa ma nyams par/ /gsungs shing rgyal po kri kri'i rmi lam ltar/ /ston pa shākya'i dbang po'i bstan pa la/ /nyan thos gyes pa bco brgyad byung na yang / /bstan pa ma nyams tshul 'dis dag snang sbyongs/ /zhes dang / paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'phags pa'i skye bo rnams kyi mdzad pa rnam thar so so skye bo rnams kyi yul las 'das shing /skyes bu dam pa la brten pa'i sdig pa ni shin tu mi zad pas/phyogs 'dzin gyi sdang shugs dor nas/ dag snang nor bu'i 568

'od kyis khyab par mdzad du gsol zhes chos kyi rgyal mtshan gsol ba 'debs pa lags so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar skyes bu dam pa thams cad kyi mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig ltar gsungs 'dug pas/ gang gsung ltar kun gyis dad gus dag snang kho na la gzhol bar bya'o/ /bdag ni blo gros dman zhing sbyangs pa chung bas/ mkhas pa paṇḍi ta'i bstan bcos bzhin snyan dngags mngon brjod sngags skad brda' tshig gis bcings nas legs bshad rtsom mi shes mod/ 'on kyang shes nas brtsams kyang gzhan gyi ma go na glegs bam mang yang yi dwags phyug po'i nor bzhin su la'ang phan mi thogs te/ rje bla ma mi tro'i mtshan can gyis/ ha cang mngon brjod brda' tshig dam po yis/ /kun nas bcings pa'i glegs bam grangs mang yang / /yi dwags phyug po'i nor gyi phung bo ltar/ /su la'ang mi phan med pa nyid dang mtshungs/ /gsungs/ bzang spyod las/'gro ba kun gye sgra ni ji tsam par/ /thams cad skad du bdag gis chos bstan to/ /gsungs pa dang / mkhas pa 'ga' res/yul gyi skad kyis chos go na/ /bstan bcos skad kyis ci zhig bya/ /zhes bshad pa ltar/ 'dir bdag 'dra'i dbang po rtul po rnams kyis go ba'i phyir/ yul skad dang bstun nas bshad pa 569

yin/ kun gyis tshig don go na sangs rgyas kyi chos tshigs bcad re re yi ger bkod nas bshad na yang phan yon dpag tu med de gser 'od dam pa'i mdo las rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya bar 'dod pas/ mdo sde 'di rnams kyi nang nas tshig gcig gam/ le'u gcig gzhan la bkod de bshad na/de'i bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med cing / dge ba'i rtsa ba dpag tu med pa 'phel lo zhes dang / byams pa seng ge sgra'i mdo las/ gaṅgā'i bye snyed rin chen gser dag gis/ /bkang ste gzhan la sbyin pa byen pa bas/ /dus ngan tshe na tshigs bcad gcig brjod pa/ /de yis phan thogs ci 'dra de la med/ /gsungs/ khyad par chos gang la sdang ba rnams kyi log rtog bsal na phan yon dpag tu med de/ ye shes grub pa'i rgyud las/ chos la sdang ba des bsal ba/ /bsod nams 'bras bu gting dpag med/ /gsungs/ des na legs bshad mkhas pa'i spyi nor yin pas/ phyi rabs mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams kyis bstan 'gro la phan pa'i legs bshad 'di lta bu rtsom par rigs te/ dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas/ rgya mtsho'i chu bo sngon nas mang bcus mod/ /da dung su yis blangs kyang mi zad ltar/ /tshul 'di sngon rabs mkhas pas mang sbyar mod/ /da dung 570

legs bshad mkhas pa'i spyi nor yin/ /zhes dang / slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ sngon chad ma byung ba yang 'dir brjod med/ /sdeb sbyor mkhas pa'ang bdag la yod min te/ /de phyir gzhan don bsam pa'ang bdag la med/ /rang gi yid la goms phyir ngas 'di brtsams/ /dga' ba bsgom phyir bdag gi dad pa'i shugs/ /'di dag gis kyang re zhig 'phel 'gyur la/ /bdag dang skal ba mnyam pa gzhan gyis kyang / /ci ste 'di dag mthong na don yod 'gyur gsungs/ 'dir bdag gis bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i lhag bsam gyis kun nas bslangs te/ kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bka' dang / rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul rgya bod kyi mkhas grub tshad ldan rnams kyi gsung rnams lung du drangs nas legs par bshad pa yid ches dgos te ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ zla ba skar ma bcas pa gnas ltung zhing / /ri dang grong dang bcas pa'i sa zhig la/ /nam mkha'i khams ni rnam pa gzhan gyur kyang / /khyod ni mi bden pa yi tshig mi gsung zhes dang /sngags bstod las/ bcom ldan dus kun gtogs pa'i chos//rnam kun 'byung gnas thams cad ni/ /lag mthil skyu ru ra lta bur/ /khyod kyi thugs kyi spyod yul gyur/ /zhes dang mdo gzhan las/ nam mkha' sa gzhir gyur pa'am/ /sa gzhi nam mkhar 571

'gyur yang srid/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsungs pa la/ /gzhan du 'gyur ba ma mchis so/ /gsungs/ des na legs bshad 'di nyid rgyal ba'i gsung dang / rgya bod mkhas grub rnams kyi bstan bcos dang mthun par sbyar ba'i phyir/ 'di'i nang ltar byas na sangs rgyas kyi gsung ltar bslu mi srid de/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gzhan lha dang drang srong gi ngag la'ang bslu ba ma mthong na/ thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi gsung gis mi bslu ba smos ci dgos te sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i bshad rgyud chen po las/ lha dang drang srong bden pa'i ngag /gang la sbyar ba'i nus pa yang / /bslu bar byed pa ma mthong na/ /smon lam snying rjes gzhan don 'jug /ye shes chags pa mi mnga' ba'i thams cad mkhyen pa smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs/ des na lung dang mthun gal che ste/ gtsug na rin chen gyi mdo las/ lung ni nges byed tshig yin te/ /nges pa med pa dzun gyi tshig /smra bar mi 'gyur rgyu med phyir/ /nges byed lung du shes par bya/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa rgyan stug po bkod pa'i mdo las/ yid ches lung dang mi ldan pa'i/ /chos gang ston par byed pa ni/ /rnam par rtog pa'i bdag nyid de/ /bdag kyang chud zos gzhan chud zos/ /zhes dang / slob dpon 'phags pa'i man ngag drug cu 572

pa las/ gang dag bdag dang gzhan gyi don la mngon brtson pa'i/ /lung dag kun tu spangs nas smra bar mi byed de/ /shin tu yang dag min pas smras gyur na/ /ltung 'gyur lcags bsreg brgya phrag lce la 'debs zhes dang / nges par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma las/ rnal 'byor lung ni mi shes pa/ /sangs rgyas mu stegs can yin te/ /rtag tu lung ni mi spang zhing / /dkon mchog gsum ni spang mi bya/ /zhes dang / slob dpon arya de wa'i man ngag las/ gsang sngags mthar thug lta dus su/ /yid dang dbang po'i mngon sum dang / /rjes su dpag pa mi tshad de/ /lung zab man ngag tshad mar bya/ /zhes dang / slob dpon chos kyi grags pa'i zhal nas/ lung ni yid ches tshig yin te/ /nyes pa zad pa rdzun gyi tshig /smra bar mi byed rgyu med phyir/ /nyes zad lung du shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs/ lung dang mi mthun par rig pas dpyad nas 'bad kyang tshad mar 'dzin mi 'os te/ kri ya bsam gtan phyi ma las/ gsang sngags rgya mtsho chen po ni/ /dpe 'am tshad ma'i gtan tshigs dang / /rjes su dpag pa'i shes rab kyis/ /dbye bar nus pa ma yin no/ /zhes dang /'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i bshad rgyud las/ lung ma gtogs par rtog ge yi/ /chos rnams rnam par dag ma yin/ /573

drang srong rnams kyis shes na yang / /de yang lung ni sngon gtong na/ /long ba'i rkang pas tshod dpag cing / /nyam nga'i g.yang sar rgyugs pa ltar/ /rjes su dpag pa gtsor byed gang / /rnam par ltung ba dka' ma yin zhes dang / slob dpon 'phags lha'i man ngag las/ ma 'ongs phyi ma'i dus su ni/ /lung zab man ngag mi bsten par/ /'thad sgrub rig gnyis gtsor byed pa/ /rang rang grub mtha' dam par 'dzin/ /sbas don tsam gyis chog byed cing / /mthar thug lta ba zab mo la mi mos slar yang sun 'byen byed/ /des ni rang nyid gzhan brlag 'gyur/ /gsungs/ des na blo the tshom byung na yang rgyal ba'i bka' la blta dgos te/ rje btsun mi la ras pas/ yid mi ches na rgyal ba'i bka' la ltos/ /bka' dri med tshig gis nges shes skye/ /zhes dang tshangs pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ the tshom rnams nga'i gsung rab mdo sde yan lag bcu gnyis dang mthun par gcod par gyis shig gsungs/ des na slob dpon ārya de ba sa brgyad par grags pa dang / slob dpon klu sgrub sa drug par grags pa dang / slob dpon zhi ba lhas mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub thob pa dang / slob dpon a bhya legs ldan sku tshe de nyid kyis mkha' spyod du gshegs pa sogs sa thob rgya gar gyi mkhas 574

grub rnams kyis kyang mdo rgyud kyi lung tshad mar 'dzin na/ nged rnams kyis tshad mar 'dzin dgos pa smos ci dgos/ des na legs bshad 'di nyid blo ldan rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi gsung bzhin tshad mar bzung nas gus pas spyi bor len par rigs te/ rgyud bla ma las/ gang zhig rgyal ba ston pa 'ba' zhig gi /dbang byas rnam g.yeng med yid can gyis bshad/ /thar ba thob pa'i lam dang rjes mthun pa/ /de yang drang srong bka' bzhin spyi bos blangs/ /zhes dang / slob dpon ka ma la shī las/ dam pa phrag dog la sogs dri ma thag bsring ba/ /yon tan rnams kyis mi ngoms chu yi mtsho 'dra dag /rnam par phye nas legs par bshad rnams 'dzin byed de/ /ngang pa rab dga' chu la 'o ma len pa bzhin/ /de lta bas na mkhas rnams kyis/ /phyogs lhung dkrugs pa ring spong la/ /byis pa las kyang legs bshad pa/ /thams cad blangs pa kho na bya/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen klong chen pas/ phyi rabs skal bzang byang chub 'dod pa dag /yi ge 'di la rtag tu nan tan mdzod/ /mdo rgyud man ngag snying po 'dir tshang zhing / /zab don brgyud pa'i byen rlabs sprin phung mchis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyi rabs gang zag rnams kyis yi ge 'di la nan tan du gzigs nas/ 'di'i nang bzhin 575

dbu rdzogs phyag gsum zhi byed gcod yul la sogs pa'i grub mtha' gang la dad gus dag snang byed bzhin rang nyid gang mos chos de nyams su longs dang / phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan rin po che sgo sna tshogs nas phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas shing /bstan 'dzin gye skyes mchog rnams kyi sku tshe brtan cing mdzad phrin rgyas pa dang / sems can thams cad gnas skabs mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang thob nas bde zhing mthar thug nges legs thar pa dang thabo sa cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang bde blag nyid du thob par 'gyur ro/ / smras pa/ bla ma sangs rgyas dgyes bzhin spyi bor bzhugs/ /chos 'khor dbus su 'jam dbyangs gar gyes rol/ /longs spyod 'khor lor dbyangs can rgyud mang 'khrol/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis snyan pa'i glu dbyangs len/ /rnam dkar las ldan 'gro rnams sangs rgyas sar/ /tshe gcig lus gcig 'god mdzad phyag rdzogs kyi/ /lam srol de 'dzin brgyud par bcas pa la/ /hwa shang lugs zhes smod pa chos spong las/ /dper na mkhris nad can gyi snang ngo ru/ /gangs ri dung dkar ser por snang ba bzhin/ /kha cig 'khrul ngor phyag rdzogs lta spyod 576

rnams/ /hwa shang lta bur snang ba snying rje'i gnas/ /ma rtogs log rtog ze tshom mun pas bsgribs/ /zab mo'i lam bzang mthong ba'i skal med rnams/ /chos spong g.yang la gom 'gros 'khyor ba mthong / /de rnams kun gyis lam bzang mthong ba'i phyir/ /mkhas grub gong ma'i gsung 'bum rgya mtsho che/ /rnam dpyod srub shing bzang bos bsrubs pa las/ /thon pa'i lung rig 'od stong rab 'bar ba'i/ /legs bshad nyi ma shar la da ltos shig /ji srid nam mkha'i nyi ma nam gnas par/ /legs bshad 'di yang mi nub sa steng 'dir/ /yun ring gnas nas bstan dang 'gro ba la/ /phan thogs dpag tu med pa 'byung bar shog /'di nyid gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs kyi/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu thams cad thugs mthun cing / /ris med rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che/ /srid mtha'i bar du rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces legs bshad nyi ma rang shar zhes bya ba 'di ni dad brtson shes rab snying rje sogs slob ma'i yon tan thams cad tshang ba'i bu chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ dge slong dge ba'i blo gros/ sku skyes bstan 'dzin nor bu/ lha bzo ye shes bstan 'dzin sogs grub mtha' gang la dag snang che ba'i skal ldan gyi slob ma mang bos/ deng sang phal cher gyis sngon gye sgyes chen 577

dam pa gong ma rnams kyi gsung gi dgongs pa ma lon par dgos pa ci yang med bzhin du/ phyag rdzogs sogs bod snga rabs pa'i lta ba 'di hwa shang dang mtshungs so zhes brnyas smod khyad gsod sun 'byen byas chos spong gi las ngan pa bsags nas ngan song du 'gro mkhan mang bo 'dug pa/sa/ de dag rnams la phan pa'i legs bshad kha gsal bo zhig dgos zhes yang yang bskul ngor dpe cha mang po la lta mkhan gyi rnal 'byor zhabs dkar bas kun mkhyen pad dkar sogs mkhas grub gong ma rnams kyi gsung 'bum na rtsod lan gang yod rnams kyi nang nas rags rim tsam zhig phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bkra shis g.yang chags rma chu'i klung 'gram/ rin chen gser bye chags pa'i gling mchog rtsi shing nags tshal rgyas pa'i skyed tshal/spang gzhung me tog bkra ba'i sman ljongs/ bya rigs bdun tsam grags pa'i sa cha/ nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i dben gnas khe tsho bkra shis nyams dga'i gling nas sbyar ba'o/ /'dis kyang bstan pa dang 'gro ba yongs la phan thogs par gyur cig /spros bral chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub na/ /mi gnas ye shes chen por rtag gzhol kyang / /longs sprul gar gyis mchog dman gdul bya'i don/ /rgyun mi 'chad mdzad rgyal kun gtsug 578

gis mchod/ /gang gsung gdul bya'i ngor snang dam pa'i chos /'khor lo gsum gyi drang nges dgongs pa'i gnad/ /ma 'dres gsal bar gzigs pa'i 'phags bod kyi/ /rgyal sras sar gnas rnams la gus pas 'dud/ /gang zhig rgyal ba'i phrin las rmad po che/ /gdul bya'i khams dang dbang bo'i rim pa bzhin/ /ma 'dres gsal ba rnam kun mchog ldan gyi/ /chos nyid mngon sum rtogs par bya phyir yin/ /de yang drang don rmi lam sgyu ma bzhin/ /snang yang nges don rang gi ngo bos stong / /rnam thar gsum ldan phra zhib sor rtog gis/ /gtan phab sor rtog mi dmigs chos dbyings zhi/ /bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos nyid mi 'gyur ba/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po spros kun zhi/ /mi gnas ye shes chen po'i dgongs pa la/ /'gro rnams sbyor mdzad phyag rdzogs dbu mar grags/ /ngo bo'i gshis la dbye ba ma mchis mod/ /gdul bya'i dbang las snang tshul ma 'gags par/ /lta grub dbye ba mang gyes thams cad kyang / /myang 'das thob thabs rgyal ba'i phrin las yin/ /de dag spel ba'i sar gnas bshes gnyen rnams/ /sor rtog rigs pas 'char gzhi'i dpyod tshul la/ /rjes dpag go yul don spyi mngon sum gnad/ /ji bzhin rtogs dang ma rtogs khyad par las 'thad 579

dang mi 'thad dgag sgrub blos gzhal ba'i/ /rtsod yig grangs mang ji snyed byung ba ni/ /rang rang grub mtha'i dbu rmog btsan phyir dang / /gzhan phyogs grub mtha' gsal bar mthong phyir yin/ /rnga la dbyug gus ma bsnun rnga sgra med/ /mkhas la brtsad cing ma dris gting mi dpog /bstan pa'i sgron me ches cher sbar ba'i ched/ /lung rigs 'gran pa mkhas pa'i che khyad yin/ /byes blos dgag sgrub mtha' la zhen pa ni/ /zla mthong cha shas yongs su rdzogs ma rdzogs/ /zla ba yin min rtsod pa ngal ba'i rgyu/ /de las zla ba'i rang bzhin shes pa gces/ /de phyir 'thad dang mi 'thad sgo skur dang / /rtog dpyod rnon pos phyir lta'i dpyad pa las/ /nang bltas ngar 'dzin gang zag bdag med rtogs/ /de yis chos bdag rang bzhin med par grol/ /de ltar zla mthong rim gyes 'phel ba ltar/ /chos nyid don mthong thabs shes bskyed bsrings te/ /chos gzugs mngon gyur don gnyis lhun grub phyir/ /chos gzugs sgrub tshul dka' gnas shes pa gces/ /de lta mod kyang sngon byon mkhas grub rnams/ /rang rang spang rtogs ngom pa'i legs par bshad/ /phan tshun 'gran pa blo gros 'phel ba dang / /yin lugs ji bzhin gtan la 'bebs phyir yin/ /rang lta'i phyogs 'dzin gzhan gzhung rtsa 580

ba nas/ /sun dbyung 'dod pa'i log rtog ga la zhig /de phyir dgongs dang dgongs min byes blo yis/ /gzhal ba spangs te bsam mi khyab pa'i tshul/ /dran dang sar gnas sems dpa'i dgongs pa'i gzhi/ /dpyad dka' sgra yi rjes su ma 'brang zhes/ /bdag gi mgon des gsal bar bstan pa 'di/ /dpyod ldan rnams kyi thugs la bcangs par 'os/ /dam pa'i dgongs gzhi gang yin ma rtogs par/ /sgra rjes don dpag so so'i 'dod gzhung bsgrub/ /gzhan gzhung 'gog pa dam pa'i tshul min zhing / /rtsa ltung 'byung nye 'di nyid bklags pas shes/ /'on kyang 'gro ba'i blo yul tha dad pas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la'ang skyon gyi gong bu dang / /zol zog mkhan du lhas byin legs skar dang / /gcer bu ba rnams smra bar byed pa bzhin/ /chos nyid don gye gnas lugs ma mthong bzhin/ /spyod phyogs a 'thas chos nyid spong ba 'di/ /sgrib gnyis mun stug snang stong ro gcig tu/ /ma rtogs snyigs dus sgye bo'i rang mtshang ni/ /rgyal bas kyang ni re zhig sel dka' ba'i/ /tshul la bsam nas chags sdang mi bgyid par/ /rje yi gsung bzhin thams cad thod du 'khur/ /dag pa rab 'byams 'khor 'das gnyis med ltos/ /spang gnyen rang grol chos nyid gnyug ma'i ngang / /snang 581

stong zung 'jug sgrib bral bde ba che/ /srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas mya ngan 'da'/ /bsam gyis mi khyab chos dbyings klong du a/ /ma rig rmongs pa'i mun stug sel ba dang / /gnas lugs ji bzhin gsal bar ston pa yi/ /legs bshad nyin mo'i mgon po deng 'dir shar/ /las ldan bstan 'gro'i pad dkar dpal du mdzes/ /'on tang nyi ma'i bdag po'i snang ba yis/ /sbur len mig can ldong gyur rang gi tshul/ /legs bshad 'od stong ldan yang log rtog gi /byang bstan phug par snang ba nus ma yin/ /thar 'dod 'phyang mo nyug la 'phyan pa dag /yang dag lam la bkri ba'i legs bshad nyi/ /las ldan tshogs bsags can gyi chos kyi mig /rdul bral mthong thabs 'di la bsnyon du med/ /de phyir 'di nyid phyogs mthar spel ba'i slad/ /sngon goms mthu brtas bya bral nor bu yis/ /rkyen sbyar par bskrun yi ge'i 'du byed 'di/ /bka' 'bangs tha shal sangs rgyas rin chen gyis/ /bgrang bya'i khur non drug cu re bzhi steng / /son pa rab chos lcags lug sa ga'i nyar/ /grub par bgyis pa'i dge tshogs dal 'gro'i rgyun/ /kun mkhyen rgya mtsho'i klong du 'jug phyir bsngo/ /de'i mthus mchog sprul sku tshe srid mthar brtan/ /brgyud 'dzin bla slob ji snyed mchis pa kun/ /chos 582

'byor rdzogs ldan dpal la 'gran pa yis/ /mkha' mnyam bstan 'gro'i nyer 'tsho'i gzhir gyur cig /bstan 'dzin thugs mthun bstan pa 'gal med rtogs/ /nyin mtshan bshad sgrub bya bar rtag gzhol cing / /gang snang chos nyid rol bar 'char ba yi/ /chos pas nor 'dzin dog por bgyid gyur cig /'jig rten khams kyi nad mug 'khrug rtsod zhi/ /char chu dus babs lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /bde skyid rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dpal la 'gran/ /chos kyis nyin mtshan 'da' ba'i bkra shis shog /de skad smra ba'ang 'du gsum pa/ /budngha ratnar nye ba'i mched/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ngor/ /g.yar khral tsam du bris pa dge / //shu bhe mas sarba dza gā tt+waṃ/ /583

rje zhabs dkar tshogs drug rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/༵bye ༈༵ spe/ la/ mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang /(zi ling grong lo thun rin lam sgo mang/0)sbrag ang 810001 kha par 6143426brgyud 'tshong / mtsho sngon zhing chen zhin hwa dpe khang /par 'debs/ mtsho sngon mi rigs par khang /deb tshad/ 850 4nga1168la 1732dpar shog 235 75yig grangs/ 0 376gab ba 14ga 60bar thengs/ 2002lo'i zla6 bar par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/dpar thengs/ 2002 lo'i zla6 bar dpar thengs dang po dpar/dpar grangs/ 1500 dpe rtags/ 132ma7—5420—0874—972 35rin gong / deb bcu bo cha tshang la sgor330 00par gzhi 'di gar dbang bas par bshug brgyab na khrims chad phog(shog ngos chad nor slog skyon gang rung yod tshe par khang la dri gtug bya)

za khum lnga sbyo jo zaḥmalosko1lo sko 0 goyong 51 81000 thum 643426za ma dzo khrobam̐choro chostekhya // tho rṣazaḥ3khrikhro//nga) tshes 850 nga 68 732khyekhya rtasmo 23575dza ma 3760thorotshes 11 60 / ma 2002ro5tholko lokhyekhya / ma 2002ja5thazo1morngokhyakhye//5khya sa 500 ba 32ma7—5420—0874—973 35za yi za330 00za(༅0lo polotsho ༅5khya7mtshesgoshākhuthomamaṣṭhazatshokhri/ za zlodzeekhyokhyakhye//ngaḥtsho
